*Ruihong Shen,Žiga Kovačič,Peter Kulits,Xingrui Wang,Zizhang Li,Joshua B. Tenenbaum,Alan Yuille,Jieneng Chen,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出4DCodeBench基准，通过代码生成实现4D逆向图形，评测智能体从视频重建动态场景的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有静态重建能力较强，但能否可靠重建复杂动态尚不明确，缺乏评测智能体以代码理解世界动态的测试平台。

Method: 整理真实视频并构建涵盖形变、流体、断裂等多种物理现象的合成场景，要求智能体将视觉观测转化为紧凑的场景结构与动态表示，并通过物理仿真等抽象生成可执行图形程序；对前沿模型进行广泛基准测试。

Result: 测试发现，强大的静态重建能力尚不能转化为对复杂动态的可靠重建。

Conclusion: 4DCodeBench为追踪智能体通过代码理解世界动态的进展提供了测试平台，基准已开源。

Abstract: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench

</details>


### [98] [MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03716)
*Jiahuan Cheng,Zhiyi Li,Tian Xia,Ruojin Cai,Yilun Du,Qianqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoSE3 是首个从单目 RGB 视频前馈预测稠密逐像素 SE(3) 运动的模型，通过联合学习的 3D 点轨迹与刚性嵌入可微拟合刚体变换，并配套提出合成数据集 Art-Kubric。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稠密 3D 点跟踪仅提供每像素 3 自由度平移曲线，只能描述像素"去向"，无法刻画底层部件的旋转，也无法判断哪些像素属于同一刚体整体运动，因而不足以完整建模动态场景运动。

Method: MoSE3 不直接回归 SE(3)（旋转位于弯曲流形上不利于欧氏回归，且 SE(3) 标注难以获取），而是预测两个联合学习的中间量：3D 点轨迹与刚性嵌入，随后在每个软刚性聚类内可微地拟合变换以恢复逐像素 SE(3)，实现端到端预测与监督。为弥补数据缺口，构建了大规模合成数据集 Art-Kubric，为具有丰富物理交互的关节物体提供稠密 SE(3) 与刚性标签。

Result: 在刚性与关节基准上，MoSE3 在像素、部件和物体三个层级均取得最优 SE(3) 估计；在三个数据集上取得最优平均 3D 点跟踪精度；尽管仅在合成运动数据上训练，仍对真实视频展现强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 逐像素 SE(3) 运动可同时给出旋转、平移与分组信息，为动态场景运动建模提供更丰富的表征；借助中间量拟合与合成数据，MoSE3 实现了稠密 6-DoF 刚体运动的高精度预测与良好的真实场景迁移。

Abstract: Dense 3D point tracking has been a prominent paradigm for modeling motion in dynamic scenes, but a point track is just a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel: it captures where pixels go, not the rotation of the underlying part, nor which pixels move together as one body. We propose MoSE3, the first feed-forward model that predicts dense SE(3) motion from monocular RGB video, producing full 6-DoF rigid transforms at every pixel in world space. Per-pixel SE(3) motion offers a richer view of how a scene moves: rotation, translation, and grouping all at once. Directly predicting SE(3) is challenging: rotations lie on a curved manifold that is ill-suited to Euclidean regression, and annotations for SE(3) are particularly difficult to acquire. To address these challenges, MoSE3 predicts per-pixel SE(3) through two jointly learned intermediates, 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings, and recovers SE(3) by differentiably fitting transforms within each soft rigid cluster, enabling end-to-end prediction and supervision. To close the data gap, we introduce Art-Kubric, a large-scale synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels for articulated objects with rich physical interactions. MoSE3 achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on both rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, while showing strong generalization to real-world videos despite being trained solely on synthetic motion data.

</details>


### [99] [Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03717)
*Keerthi Kaashyap,Dennis Anthony,Akshay Krishnan,Nhi Ngoc Nguyen,Jeremy Collins,James Hays,Shreyas Kousik,Animesh Garg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SNAP，一种自监督编码器-解码器Transformer，通过姿态条件局部解码器与潜在空间重建目标，解决了编码器式NVS方法表征质量差的问题，在多项几何任务上达到或接近专用监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVS原则上应推理3D场景结构，从而产生可迁移的多视角几何表征；但现有基于编码器的NVS方法学到的表征质量很差。作者指出问题不是监督信号不足，而是不显眼的架构选择：空间表达能力强的解码器稀释了场景编码器的表征能力，以及低层次的像素空间目标阻碍了特征学习。

Method: 提出SNAP，一个自监督编码器-解码器Transformer。针对上述两个问题分别采用：(1) 姿态条件局部解码器（pose-conditioned local decoder），限制解码器空间表达能力；(2) 潜在空间重建目标（latent-space reconstruction objective），替代像素级目标。方法任务无关（task agnostic）。

Result: SNAP与专用几何监督方法具有竞争力，并在五个自监督任务上表现优异：视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计与机器人操作。其patch特征展现出涌现的视角不变性，在更低算力与数据预算下接近重度监督模型。在相机位移导致标准2D表征崩溃时，SNAP退化更平缓。

Conclusion: 限制解码器表达能力能够主动防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，表明架构设计（而非监督信号本身）是编码器式NVS表征质量差的关键；SNAP验证了以NVS为自监督信号学习可迁移几何表征的有效路径。

Abstract: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io

</details>


### [100] [GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23927)
*Linhan Wang,Zijian An,Mingyuan Zhang,Chen Dai,Yi Xu,Can Cui,Jiayan Wang,Zichong Yang,Yinlin Chen,Lifeng Zhou,Chang-Tien Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GlanceWAM 将视觉想象与动作控制解耦：在共享视频 DiT 主干上，异步提议器以慢时钟在后台生成单个前瞻帧，动作头在潜在空间以控制频率（48 ms）解码动作块，从而同时实现实时推理与更高任务成功率，打破速度-成功率困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）存在根本性权衡：在控制频率下同步生成视频延迟过高，而放弃测试时的视觉想象又会牺牲任务成功率。作者希望兼具实时推理与高成功率，因此探索将视觉想象异步生成并直接在潜在空间中消费。

Method: 提出 GlanceWAM，在单一共享视频 DiT 主干上将想象与控制解耦。异步提议器（proposer）在慢时钟下于后台"瞥一眼"未来数秒，想象单个前瞻帧；动作头在控制频率下于潜在空间解码动作块（48 ms），不阻塞。关键技术包括非干扰注意力掩码（non-interfering attention mask）以隔离视频表征，以及鲁棒于陈旧的时序训练（staleness-robust horizon training）以适应异步前瞻帧老化。

Result: 仅用演示训练：RoboCasa 24 项厨房基准达 72.2%（同步 Cosmos Policy 为 67.1%），LIBERO 达 99.0%，同时将每块控制延迟相对同步世界-动作模型降低 24×（单张 A100 上 48 ms）。在单臂和双臂真实机器人操作中，无需任何机器人数据预训练即取得高于 π_{0.5} 的平均成功率。

Conclusion: 将视觉想象异步地移出关键路径并直接在潜在空间消费，可同时实现实时推理与更优成功率，从而打破速度-成功率困境；GlanceWAM 在仿真与真实机器人任务上均验证了该范式的有效性。

Abstract: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control on a single shared video DiT backbone: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (vs. 67.1% for synchronous Cosmos Policy) and 99.0% on LIBERO while cutting per-chunk control latency $24\times$ relative to synchronous world-action models (48 ms on one A100). In single-arm and bimanual real-robot manipulation, it achieves higher average success than $π_{0.5}$ without any robot-data pretraining. Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.

</details>


### [101] [Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01939)
*Ruiyang Si,Jianxin Bi,Shunyu Yang,Rui Ni,Wenbo Huang,Qiang Wang,Shulong Jiang,Duomin Wang,Xiuyu Li,Haiwen Feng,Zhen Dong,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PyRUA-Lean是一个交互式代码执行框架，通过反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观测，降低VLM机器人代理的token开销并提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM代理虽能通过视觉反馈和动作原语控制机器人，但重复的模型调用和冗余观测带来大量token开销，效率低下。

Method: 将经典机器人原语与学习型VLA策略组合成Python单元，支持条件检查和局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像和状态反馈用于重新规划；在相同GPT-6 Astra规划器和底层原语下，与工具调用基线在700个LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365仿真任务上对比。

Result: 在相同LLM调用预算下，成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%；在双方均成功的实例上，LLM调用减少49%，输入token减少65%。

Conclusion: 交互式代码执行框架可有效减少冗余观测与调用，提高VLM机器人代理的效率与成功率。

Abstract: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [102] [Recursive Self-Improvement in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03002)
*Huijuan Wang,Chufan Shi,Cheng Yang,Yaokang Wu,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Xuezhe Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出递归跨能力自我改进（RSI）：在统一多模态模型中，用文本与视觉能力互为对方生成训练数据，并以程序执行作为外部真值来源，避免错误在多轮中累积。在图表任务上四轮 RSI 将跨措辞请求的得分从 45.7% 提升到 60.2%，而持续训练仅停留在 46.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型的自我改进仅将监督局限于视觉侧，即用图像理解来评判图像生成，文本与视觉能力之间未形成互补闭环，改进来源单一且易受模型自身偏差影响。

Method: RSI 是一个递归训练循环：每轮中模型先生成图像并读取，定位自身不足；再针对不足编写程序，由执行结果对照规格进行验证；验证通过的渲染图用于训练图像生成，带标签的渲染图与模型自身正确的程序用于训练视觉理解和程序编写，由程序执行充当模型外部的真值来源。同时在图表任务上构建 BasicChartBench，用于评估训练早期的开放模型。

Result: 在与训练措辞不同的请求上，四轮 RSI 将得分从 45.7% 提升至 60.2%，而持续训练仅维持在 46.3%。验证性构造贡献了主要增益，针对模型失败点进一步带来 3.5% 提升；验证程序占比从 48.9% 升至 95.2%，阅读器在编辑渲染图上的准确率从 55.6% 升至 87.4%。

Conclusion: 跨能力互供数据并以程序执行为外部验证的 RSI 能有效提升统一多模态模型的文本与视觉能力，且不依赖模型内部监督即可抑制多轮错误累积，显著优于同量级的持续训练。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) understand and generate both text and images, which lets a model produce its own training data. Existing self-improvement in UMMs keeps supervision on the visual side, where image understanding judges image generation. We propose recursive cross-capability self-improvement (RSI), a training loop in which the text and visual abilities of a UMM supply training data for one another. In each round, the model generates images and reads them to find where it falls short. It then writes programs aimed at these shortcomings, and execution verifies every result against its specification. Verified renders train image generation, while labeled renders and the model's own correct programs train visual understanding and program writing. Program execution thus acts as a source of truth outside the model, so errors do not accumulate across rounds. We study RSI on charts and build BasicChartBench to evaluate open models early in training. On requests worded differently from training, four rounds of RSI raise the score from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training stays at 46.3%. Verified construction carries most of the gain, and targeting the model's failures adds 3.5%. Along the way, the share of verified programs rises from 48.9% to 95.2%, and the reader's accuracy on edited renders rises from 55.6% to 87.4%.

</details>


### [103] [Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02875)
*Akshay Jain,Edward Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出查询端低秩适配器（LoRA）加确定性语言路由的跨语言检索方案，在保留原编码器同语性能与文档索引的前提下，提升芬兰语-瑞典语跨语检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言编码器同语检索表现强，但查询与相关文档语言不一致时检索效果明显下降；希望在提升跨语检索的同时不损失原同语性能、也不重建文档索引。

Method: 仅对查询端训练低秩（LoRA）适配器，训练时冻结文档嵌入；基于查询语言与索引语言做确定性路由——跨语查询走适配器，同语查询走原始编码器。在Nemotron-3-Embed-1B上微调得到SampoTron适配器。

Result: 在采样的金融基准上，六个英语、芬兰语、瑞典语检索方向的平均nDCG@10由0.241提升至0.291，相对提升20.9%；六个跨语方向全部改善，路由保持原同语性能（含两次芬兰语全语料评测）。

Conclusion: 该方案实现了可选择的跨语专门化，且文档嵌入向量可复用，无需重建索引即可同时兼顾同语与跨语检索质量。

Abstract: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves the original same-language performance, including two full-corpus Finnish evaluations. The approach enables selective cross-language specialization with reusable document embedding vectors.

</details>


### [104] [HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02293)
*Sait Furkan Teke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HakemBench 是土耳其语分类决策基准（v1.0，CC BY 4.0），含 2,346 题、4,275 个选择/是非/评分问题，覆盖 7 条赛道；以宏观 F1、校准（归一化 Brier）与选择性自动化（归一化 gAURC）的几何均值作为综合分，并用 2,000 次自助抽样给出区间，同时报告选项顺序、改述、英译与替换人名探针。金标多来自单一 AI 模型家族的盲测与跨家族大模型评审团投票，未经人工核验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分类决策评测多缺乏统一的"质量—校准—选择性自动化"联合度量，且非英语（土耳其语）场景覆盖不足；同时需要一套可复现、全开放的基准与评分框架，并显式揭示数据污染与标注来源带来的偏差。

Method: 构建 7 条赛道的有监督分类任务集，每题给定文本、问题与固定选项，模型需为每个选项输出概率；采用单一测试框架计算宏观 F1（决策质量）、归一化 Brier 得分（校准）与归一化广义风险—覆盖率曲线下面积（选择性自动化），三者取几何均值合成，并以 2,000 次自助抽样报告置信区间；附带选项顺序、改述、英译、替换人名四类鲁棒性探针。金标由同一 AI 模型家族盲测结果与来自其他模型家族的大模型评审团投票比对生成，未经人工验证。

Result: 16 行榜单中最佳模型综合分为 0.888；实验室自研模型以 0.660 位列第 7，且其成绩非盲测，因其训练数据受早期测试结果影响，护栏、审核与客服三条赛道的分数被标记；若所有模型仅在其余四条赛道计分，其综合分为 0.678，列 16 中之第 6。

Conclusion: HakemBench 提供了一套开放、可复现的土耳其语决策评测协议，但同时表明标注未经人工核验、榜单存在非盲测与数据污染风险；因此对受污染赛道的分数需加以标注，并在排除污染赛道后重新排名，以维持评测的可比性。

Abstract: HakemBench is a Turkish benchmark of typed decisions, in which the model under test reads a text, a question and a fixed set of options and returns a probability for every option. Version 1.0 is released fully open under CC BY 4.0, with 2,346 items and 4,275 choice, yes/no and score questions in seven tracks (fact-check triage, education, guardrails, legal routing, moderation, spam and phishing, and customer support). One harness scores decision quality (macro F1), calibration (from the normalised Brier score) and selective automation (from the normalised area under the generalised risk-coverage curve), combines them by a geometric mean and reports intervals from 2,000 bootstrap draws; probes for option order, paraphrase, English translation and substituted names are reported alongside. Most gold labels come from blind passes of one AI model family compared with the votes of a panel of large language models from other model families; they are not human-verified. On a board of 16 rows the leader scores a composite of 0.888 and the lab's own model is 7th at 0.660. Its numbers are not blind. Earlier runs' test results shaped its training data, so its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers are flagged; with every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16.

</details>


### [105] [Finding the Move Is Not Winning the Game: XiangqiBench for Closed-Loop Evaluation of LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02425)
*Yekun Chai,Qiwei Peng,Haoyi Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出XiangqiBench可执行基准，发现静态评估的高分掩盖了LLM智能体在闭环对抗中的真实弱势，三项"看似胜任"的信号均高估实际胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态评估仅考察模型能否说出正确着法，而真实智能体需在对手回应下将计划执行至验证结果，二者差距缺乏可量化基准。

Method: 构建XiangqiBench：基于119个有强制杀法的象棋残局，LLM智能体需在对弈引擎防守下完成将死；采用交互式REPL接口区分真实走子、状态查询与前向模拟，采集12个前沿LLM在两种观测协议下的8,568条多轮轨迹。

Result: 发现三类高估现象：转换差距（26.1%首步正确但仅13.9%取胜）、一致性差距（38.7% pass@3但仅5.9% pass^3）、模拟差距（32.3%模拟调用终止于非法着法，49.3%情形真实对手回应不同于模拟线路）。

Conclusion: 找到着法不等于赢下对局；智能体评估应衡量闭环结果，并在覆盖率之外报告可靠性指标。

Abstract: Static evaluations credit a language model for naming the right move, but an agent must carry a plan through to a verified outcome while an opponent responds. We introduce XiangqiBench, an executable benchmark that measures this difference in Chinese chess: starting from 119 tactical endgames with forced mates supported by engine or checks-only search, an LLM agent must deliver checkmate against an engine defender. An interactive REPL interface separates real moves, state queries, and forward simulation, and we record 8,568 multi-turn trajectories from 12 frontier LLMs under two observation protocols. Three signals that look like competence each overstate closed-loop success. (i) The Conversion Gap: models play the stored reference first move in 26.1\% of Sighted trials, yet only 13.9\% of these trials end in a win. (ii) The Consistency Gap: the leading model reaches 38.7\% pass@3 but only 5.9\% pass^3, winning all three trials on 7 of the 46 positions it ever wins. (iii) The Simulation Gap: 32.3\% of accepted simulation calls stop on an illegal move, and in 49.3\% of comparable cases the real defender replies differently from the line the agent simulated; self-authored rollouts check legality but cannot anticipate the opponent. Finding the move is not winning the game: agent evaluations should score closed-loop outcomes and report reliability alongside coverage.

</details>


### [106] [Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02444)
*Omar Farouk Zouak,Houssam Eddine Boukhalfa,Soumaya Lakehal,Shiv Katiyar,Samia Nefti-Meziani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出SymCE：包含4,707个错误（假）本科代数与实分析猜想及其可执行Python验证器的语料库，将反例生成建模为受约束的“见证”生成。用SFT+GRPO训练Qwen3-4B时发现“模仿陷阱”：仅用反例SFT会使真定理识别率从0.27崩至0.00，而稀疏结果奖励的RLVR可修复并提升至0.66。该现象在4个随机种子与Gemma-3-4B上复现。稀疏与稠密奖励在域内表现无显著差异，但在校准探针上相差33个点，归因于部分得分项。4B模型超越所有评测的7B开源数学专精模型，并与六个前沿商业API持平，且零改提示即可迁移至GSM8K、MATH-500与MMLU-college-math。177例人工审计显示验证器准确率97.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常能正向证明定理，却无法反驳一个紧密相关的错误命题，形成“证伪差距”；该差距在监督微调下不会弥合，甚至可能恶化。作者希望将反例生成作为可验证、可训练的任务来系统性解决。

Method: 将反例生成形式化为针对每个定理的确定性Python验证器的受约束见证生成；发布SymCE语料库（4,707个错误本科代数与实分析猜想，配对可执行验证器），验证器同时充当奖励函数，构成训练环境。以Qwen3-4B为对象，先SFT再GRPO进行RLVR训练，并对比稀疏结果奖励与稠密奖励。

Result: 发现“模仿陷阱”：仅反例SFT将真定理识别率从0.27降至0.00；稀疏结果奖励的RLVR修复并超过基线达0.66。该崩溃在4个随机种子与Gemma-3-4B上复现。稀疏与稠密奖励域内成功无统计差异，但在留出校准探针上相差33个点，差异源于部分得分项。4B模型优于所有评测的7B开源数学专精模型，与六个前沿商业API竞争力相当，并能零改提示迁移至GSM8K、MATH-500、MMLU-college-math。人工审计177个验证器决策，准确率97.7%。

Conclusion: 反例生成可被构建为带确定性验证器的约束见证生成任务，RLVR能以稀疏结果奖励修复SFT导致的真定理识别崩溃；稀疏与稠密奖励在域内相当但在校准上显著分化的现象揭示了部分得分项的作用。SymCE及代码、验证器、标注均已开源。

Abstract: Large language models often solve a theorem forward yet fail to disprove a closely related false one: a falsification gap that supervised fine-tuning does not close and can actively worsen. We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers. The verifier also serves as the reward function, making SymCE a training environment. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO under this oracle reveals an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs this and exceeds the base, to 0.66. The collapse replicates across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards yield statistically indistinguishable in-domain success yet diverge by 33 points on a held-out calibration probe, a dissociation we trace to the partial-credit term. Our 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist, remains competitive with six frontier commercial APIs, and transfers under unchanged prompting to GSM8K, MATH-500 and MMLU-college-math. A human audit of 177 verifier decisions finds 97.7% accuracy. Code, data, verifier modules and annotations: https://github.com/ce-rlvr/SymCE.

</details>


### [107] [FinDialogLens: Event Extraction over Multi-Party Dialogue for Missed-Trade Identification in Financial Chatrooms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02455)
*Chin-Lun Fu,Hong Ni,Behrouz Madahian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文将多方可信聊天室中的漏单恢复问题建模为多方对话上的事件抽取，提出混合LLM流水线FinDialogLens，通过小型微调分类器作为推理期支架，实现RFQ触发、价格与成交结果的抽取，并用难度感知路由器在成本与精度间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多方可信聊天室对销售与交易人员至关重要，但其中每个RFQ（报价请求）的最终价格与成交结果出现在触发消息之后的许多条消息中，且与其他并发RFQ交错，导致人工恢复漏单不可行，因此需要自动化的事件抽取方案。

Method: FinDialogLens为混合LLM流水线：紧凑的微调分类器作为推理期支架，检测RFQ触发消息与价格/成交结果元数据；RFQ-Level Module按事件切分RFQ窗口；Trade Engine填充论元角色。此外引入难度感知路由器，将RFQ在低成本规则引擎与高性能LLM驱动的Trade Engine之间分配，以平衡成本与精度。

Result: 使用GPT-4o时，FinDialogLens在最终价格与成交结果上的准确率分别达92.1%和94.3%，优于全聊天室CoT提示方法；仅3B参数的微调开源LLM在少量领域数据下即可达到相当性能。难度感知路由器将最终价格的LLM调用减少85%，并弥补与FinDialogLens（GPT-4o）精度差距的一半，在每日7万RFQ规模下每天节省超过300美元。

Conclusion: 该工作证明将多方可信聊天室漏单恢复建模为事件抽取是有效的，混合LLM流水线配合小型微调分类器支架可在高精度下实现；难度感知路由策略使LLM方案在大规模场景下兼顾成本与精度，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Multi-party financial chatrooms are vital for sales-and-trading professionals, but their complexity makes manual recovery of missed trades infeasible: each Request for Quote (RFQ) is an event whose final price and trade outcome appear many messages after the RFQ-trigger message (the inquiry message), interleaved with concurrent RFQs from other participants. We cast this as event extraction (EE) over multi-party dialogue and present FinDialogLens, a hybrid LLM pipeline in which compact fine-tuned classifiers act as inference-time scaffolds: they detect RFQ-triggers and price/trade outcome metadata, an RFQ-Level Module segments per-event RFQ windows, and a Trade Engine fills argument roles. With GPT-4o, FinDialogLens reaches 92.1% and 94.3% accuracy on final price and trade outcome, respectively, outperforming full-chatroom CoT prompting methods; fine-tuned open-source LLMs with as few as 3B parameters achieve comparable performance with modest in-domain data. To make the LLM-based solution practical at scale, a difficulty-aware router balances cost and accuracy by allocating RFQs between a low-cost rule-based engine and the higher-performing LLM-powered Trade Engine, cutting LLM calls by 85% on final price while recovering half of the accuracy gap to FinDialogLens (GPT-4o), saving over $300/day at our 70,000-RFQ/day scale.

</details>


### [108] [CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02460)
*Anjali Kantharuban,Jonas Mueller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CUE框架，通过编码真实会话并采样连续表示，再解码为persona指令来驱动LLM充当用户模拟器，无需训练即可实现结果校准，在τ²-Bench上更忠实复现真实用户的失败模式与成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于用户模拟器的智能体评测只做到了表面的人风格与行为保真，缺乏"结果校准"：模拟用户与真实用户在和同一智能体交互时的成功率及失败模式不一致，导致交互式基准测试的生态效度不足。

Method: CUE（Calibrated User Embeddings）：一是编码已观测的真实会话，二是从该表示空间采样连续隐表示，三是将其解码为persona命令以零训练地引导LLM扮演用户模拟器。借此进行两类评测：对历史会话的用户条件回放，以及为同一任务采样新persona时的聚合指标一致性。

Result: 在τ²-Bench上，CUE模拟器产生的"模拟器归因错误"更少，比其他人格类模拟方法更忠实地复现真实用户的智能体失败模式、聚合成功率以及特定"任务-用户"配对的结果，同时保持具竞争力的用户保真度。仅在以客服交互为主的数据上拟合后，仍能泛化到文档创作、数学辅导和日常闲聊，并可跨不同模拟器LLM生效而无需重新训练。

Conclusion: 结果校准应成为用户模拟器评测的关键指标；CUE以无训练、可泛化、跨模型通用的方式缩小了模拟与真实用户群体之间的差距，为生态效度更高的多轮交互基准提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Recent benchmarks rely on user simulators to evaluate AI agents in multi-turn interaction. While existing simulation techniques demonstrate surface fidelity to human style and behavior, ecologically valid interactive benchmarking also requires alignment in when and how agents fail across simulated and real user populations. We find that existing simulators lack outcome calibration: agreement with observed success rates and failure patterns when real users interact with the same agent. We introduce Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that both encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs to act as user simulators without training. Through this, we evaluate user-conditioned replay of past sessions and aggregate metric agreement when sampling novel personas for the same tasks. On $τ^2$-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and more faithfully reproduce real-user agent failure modes, aggregate success rates, and outcomes for specific task-user pairs than other persona-based simulation methods. These gains coexist with competitive user fidelity as measured using metrics established in prior work. After being fit to mostly customer support interactions, the same CUEd simulators generalize to document creation, math tutoring, and casual conversation, and remain effective across different simulator LLMs without CUE retraining.

</details>


### [109] [APDMem: Agent-Controlled Progressive Disclosure for Query-Adaptive Long-Term Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02472)
*Chin-Lun Fu,Anagha Kulkarni,Hong Ni,Behrouz Madahian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: APDMem 是一种分层长期记忆架构，将对话历史组织为四级渐进细节层，由控制器按需逐层深入检索，在仅访问 8% 对话的情况下于 LongMemEval 上取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化 LLM 助手需在长对话历史中恢复稀疏证据，且查询复杂度各异。现有方法依赖扁平记忆存储或固定检索粒度，难以在检索成本与证据保真度之间取得自适应平衡。

Method: 提出 APDMem，将对话历史表示为四个渐进明细层：主题摘要、个性化关键事实、轮次级证据笔记、原始消息。推理时由控制器实施渐进披露：先读高层摘要，仅在需要时钻取更细证据。另有笔记合成器将检索证据转化为面向查询的结构，整合事实、排序事件并标记矛盾，再进行答案生成。

Result: 在 LongMemEval 上，APDMem 在长上下文记忆推理任务中表现强劲，同时仅访问全部对话的 8%。

Conclusion: 渐进披露式分层记忆实现了自适应成本-保真度权衡：简单查询可提前终止，复杂的时间、多跳或精确证据查询则触发更深层检查，从而在低检索开销下保持高记忆推理性能。

Abstract: Personalized LLM assistants must recover sparse evidence from long conversation histories across queries of varying complexity. We introduce APDMem (Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory), a hierarchical long-term memory architecture that applies progressive disclosure to memory retrieval. Rather than relying on a flat memory store or fixed retrieval granularity, APDMem represents conversation history as four progressively detailed layers: thematic summaries, personalized key facts, turn-level evidence notes, and raw messages. At inference time, a controller applies progressive disclosure to the memory hierarchy: it first reads high-level summaries and drills into finer evidence only when needed. This creates an adaptive cost-fidelity trade-off: simple queries can terminate early, while complex temporal, multi-hop, or exact-evidence queries trigger deeper inspection. A note synthesizer converts retrieved evidence into a query-focused structure that consolidates facts, orders events, and flags contradictions before final answer generation. Experiments on LongMemEval show that APDMem achieves strong performance for long-context memory reasoning while accessing only 8% of the total conversations.

</details>


### [110] [From Retrieval to Typed Decisions: Calibrated System One Models from Biomedical Sentence Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02486)
*Pritam Deka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SBERT2S1 方法，将 Sentence-Transformers 检索编码器转换为 bi-encoder 类型决策模型（C 头与 PFR 头），并发布生物医学类型化决策评测集 BIODECIDE 与来自 NLM 索引的 24.3 万条训练决策 MEDLINE-S1，系统考察检索式预训练对类型化决策模型的迁移效果及 RLCD 训练配方的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类型化决策模型需在单次前向中回答受 schema 约束的文本问题并输出可阈值化的概率，而生物医学领域已有大量高质量检索式句编码器；作者希望验证：为检索任务训练的句子编码器是否适合作为此类决策模型的初始化起点，以及不同决策头与训练目标下检索预训练的作用规律。

Method: 提出 SBERT2S1，将 Sentence-Transformers 编码器转换为双编码器结构，并设计 cross-head（C）与 prior-fused residual（PFR）两种决策头；构建生物医学类型化决策套件 BIODECIDE 及源自 NLM 索引的 243k 训练决策 MEDLINE-S1；在六组 parent-retriever 配对上进行零样本匹配评测，并基于五组配对、三种训练集规模开展微调对比；另设两决策头 × 五训练目标的匹配网格，分析 RLCD 配方与交叉熵的差异，并通过温度缩放评估校准性。

Result: 检索式训练提升了含内容选项的零样本匹配能力；微调后其增益依赖决策头：在 15 组比较中，保留检索先验的 PFR 有 10 组显著受益，而 C 仅 1 组受益、5 组受损。匹配网格显示 C 在所有目标下均优于 PFR；开源 System One 模型的 RLCD 配方较交叉熵低 2.5–3.0 分，主要源于其奖励归一化使带噪 score-function 项放大 3.6–15 倍，改用无偏 leave-one-out 估计器可挽回大部分差距。温度缩放后，各目标校准性均不优于交叉熵。

Conclusion: 检索式句编码器可作为类型化决策模型的有效起点，但其收益高度依赖决策头设计，PFR 比 C 更能利用检索先验；RLCD 配方的性能劣势可由奖励归一化导致的方差放大解释，无偏估计器可显著缓解；交叉熵在性能与校准上仍是稳健基线。作者开源了代码、MEDLINE-S1 标签及一个模型。

Abstract: Typed decision models answer schema-constrained questions about a text in one forward pass and return probabilities meant to be thresholded. We ask whether biomedical sentence encoders trained for retrieval are good starting points for such models. We present SBERT2S1, which converts Sentence-Transformers encoders into bi-encoder, cross-head (C) and prior-fused residual (PFR) decision models, together with BIODECIDE, a biomedical typed-decision suite, and MEDLINE-S1, 243k training decisions derived from NLM indexing. Across six parent-retriever pairs, retrieval training improves zero-shot matching of content-bearing options. After fine-tuning, its effect depends on the head: across five pairs and three training-set sizes, retrieval training significantly helps PFR, which keeps the retrieval prior, in 10 of 15 comparisons, but helps C in one and hurts it in five. A matched grid of two heads and five training objectives shows that C outperforms PFR under every objective, and that the released RLCD recipe of open System One models trails cross-entropy by 2.5-3.0 points. The deficit stems mainly from its reward normalisation, which inflates the noisy score-function term 3.6-15-fold; an unbiased leave-one-out estimator recovers most of the gap. After temperature scaling, no objective is clearly better calibrated than cross-entropy. We release the code, the MEDLINE-S1 labels and a model.

</details>


### [111] [A generative-informed neuro-symbolic framework for syntactic ambiguity resolution: Evidence from Arabic DPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02529)
*Mohammed Damom,Muneef Y. Alshawsh,Ashraf A. Naji,Mustafa Ali Alhamzi,Fawwaz An-Nashef,Jameel Ahmed Elayah,Mohammed Q. Shormani,Noman AL-Sayadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个生成语法驱动的神经符号框架，将现代标准阿拉伯语名词短语（DP）的结构歧义建模为候选决策任务，通过候选条件化输入表示结合AraBERT进行评估。模型在未见测试集上达到96.88%准确率、95.92%宏F1、96.83%加权F1与93.94%二元F1，但类别表现不对称：高/VP附着（N1）召回率达99.71%，低/NP/嵌入式附着（N2）召回率仅89.26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语NLP长期受句法歧义困扰，尤其在形态丰富的名词性结构中，同一表层序列可对应多种结构解读。现有Transformer模型缺乏对形式句法结构的显式建模，难以可控、可解释地消解此类歧义，因此需要将生成句法理论与神经网络结合。

Method: 提出生成语法启发的神经符号框架：以生成句法概念刻画歧义，将歧义消解转为基于候选的决策任务，显式构造语言学动机的候选结构，并构建候选条件化输入表示，结合AraBERT进行判别。

Result: 在未见评估集上取得96.88%准确率、95.92%宏F1、96.83%加权F1、93.94%二元F1；类别层面表现不对称，高/VP附着（N1）召回率99.71%，低/NP/嵌入式附着（N2）召回率89.26%，表明嵌入式解读更难恢复。

Conclusion: 形式句法表示可在Transformer式NLP中被操作化，作为语言结构与上下文神经建模之间的显式接口，为阿拉伯语句法歧义消解及相关任务提供可控且可解释的方法。

Abstract: Syntactic ambiguity poses a persistent challenge for Arabic NLP, particularly in morphologically rich nominal constructions where multiple structu6ral interpretations may be compatible with the same surface sequence. This study proposes a generatively informed neuro-symbolic framework for resolving structural ambiguity in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) DPs. The framework integrates generative syntactic notions with AraBERT by representing ambiguity as a candidate-based decision task in which linguistically motivated alternatives are explicitly constructed and evaluated through candidate-conditioned input representations. Findings indicate that the model achieved 96.88% accuracy, 95.92% macro-F1, 96.83% weighted F1, and 93.94% binary F1 on the unseen evaluation set. Class-level analysis revealed asymmetric performance, with recall of 99.71% for High/VP Attachment (N1) and 89.26% for Low/NP/Embedded Attachment (N2), indicating greater difficulty in recovering the embedded interpretation. The study concludes that formal syntactic representations can be operationalized within Transformer-based NLP as an explicit interface between linguistic structure and contextual neural modeling, providing a controlled and interpretable approach to Arabic syntactic ambiguity resolution and beyond.

</details>


### [112] [Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Generalization of Large Language Models in Temporal Extraction Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02549)
*Fahmid Shahriar Iqbal,Ritam Dutt,Soumitra Das,Arnav Verma,Sagnik Ray Choudhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了多种LLM配置在时间和事件表达抽取任务上的泛化能力，发现强基任务性能通常预示更好泛化，但在显著分布偏移下关系减弱；归纳式提示在四类泛化维度上表现最稳定，规模、架构和演绎/溯因提示的增益不均匀且依赖维度。LLM泛化无法由单一维度预测，也无法从域内评估可靠推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间和事件表达抽取是时间推理的基础任务，但存在标注歧义、领域敏感和模型行为不稳定等问题。现有评估多聚焦域内性能，对分布偏移下的可靠性洞察有限，因此需要系统研究提示式LLM在抽取任务上的泛化规律。

Method: 跨模型家族、架构和推理策略评估多种模型配置，围绕泛化的四个维度（领域偏移、对抗扰动、组合性、长度增加）进行测试，分析基任务性能的迁移、跨维度相关性，以及规模、架构和提示策略的影响。

Result: 强基任务性能通常预示更好的泛化，但在显著分布偏移下该关系减弱。归纳式提示在四个泛化维度上表现最一致；规模、架构以及演绎和溯因提示策略带来的增益不均匀，且具有维度特异性。

Conclusion: LLM在时间抽取任务中的泛化无法由任何单一维度预测，也无法从域内或单维度评估中可靠推断，表明需要发展可跨维度泛化的推理策略。

Abstract: Time and event expression extraction are fundamental temporal reasoning tasks, but the problem remains difficult due to annotation ambiguity, domain sensitivity, and unstable model behavior. Existing evaluations focus on in-domain performance, offering limited insight into reliability under distribution shifts. We evaluate multiple model configurations across families, architectures, and reasoning strategies over four dimensions of generalization, examining transfer from base performance, cross-dimensional correlations, and the effects of scale, architecture, and prompting. This provides a systematic study of how prompted LLMs generalize in time and event expression extraction tasks. We find that strong base-task performance generally predicts better generalization. However, this relationship weakens under substantial distribution shifts. Inductive prompting performs most consistently across domain shift, adversarial perturbations, compositionality, and length increase, while gains from scale, architecture, and deductive and abductive prompting strategies are uneven and dimension-specific. We conclude that LLM generalization in temporal extraction tasks cannot be predicted from any single dimension alone and cannot be reliably inferred from in-domain or single-dimension evaluations, highlighting the need for reasoning strategies that generalize across dimensions.

</details>


### [113] [Learning When to Commit from Partial Speech for End-to-End Simultaneous Speech Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02612)
*Hieu Hoang,Amittai Axelrod*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文利用语音语言模型自身生成的全句与部分波形翻译构造前缀监督，无需转写或人工译文，即可将其适配到同步语音翻译任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同步语音翻译需在源语音结束前输出目标文本，同时保证已提交内容不被后续修正，而现有全句语音语言模型无法直接满足该流式要求，且依赖转写或人工标注的适配成本高。

Method: 以模型对完整波形与部分波形所生成翻译之间的前缀关系作为监督信号，对全句语音语言模型进行前缀适配；对比单轮强制前缀解码与多轮仅追加解码，使用置信度阈值控制推理阶段的质量—延迟权衡，并通过独立的合成边距调节训练前缀密度。

Result: 在FLEURS与CoVoST2的三个语言方向上，前缀训练改善了质量—延迟前沿，置信度给出最宽且稳定的工作区间；多轮解码在低延迟下更强，多轮训练使提交校准误差整体下降63–68%、早期前缀下降68–80%，而单轮训练仅有有限整体收益且早期前缀无改善；较小合成边距有时可将前沿扩展至更低延迟（尤见于短句），较大边距则损害翻译质量与校准。

Conclusion: 前缀适配可有效提升同步语音翻译性能，在仅追加的多轮解码下收益尤为显著，而合成前缀密度对质量—延迟权衡呈非单调影响。

Abstract: Simultaneous speech translation must emit useful target text before the source is complete while preserving every committed token. We adapt a full-utterance speech language model using prefix supervision derived from its own complete- and partial-waveform translations, requiring neither transcripts nor human translations. We compare single-turn forced-prefix and multi-turn append-only decoding, use a confidence threshold to control the inference-time quality--latency trade-off, and vary the density of training prefixes with a separate synthesis margin. On FLEURS and CoVoST2 in three language directions, prefix training improves quality--latency frontiers over the unadapted model, and confidence provides the broadest consistently competitive operating range. Multi-turn decoding is generally stronger at low latency; under multi-turn training, commit-calibration error falls by 63--68% overall and 68--80% at early prefixes, whereas single-turn training provides only modest overall calibration gains and no early-prefix improvement. A small synthesis margin sometimes extends the frontier to lower latency, particularly on shorter utterances, while a larger margin degrades translation quality and calibration. Prefix adaptation therefore improves simultaneous speech translation, especially under multi-turn append-only decoding, while synthesis density introduces a non-monotonic quality--latency trade-off.

</details>


### [114] [Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02665)
*Zhihan Yang,Wei Guo,Jean-Marie Lemercier,Simon Welker,Yonggan Fu,Mohammad Mahdi Kamani,Sajad Norouzi,Julius Berner,Tomas Geffner,Karsten Kreis,Yongxin Chen,Molei Tao,John Thickstun,Pavlo Molchanov,Ante Jukić,Arash Vahdat,Morteza Mardani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Sigma——首个大规模（3B/8B）连续扩散语言模型，基于可操控的低维ODE/SDE潜轨迹，在推理与代码任务上达到与离散模型相当的性能，并揭示连续dLM独有的结构优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型（dLM）虽支持快速并行解码，但其非光滑、高维空间阻碍了轨迹操控，不利于推理引导与推理加速。

Method: 构建在可操控低维ODE/SDE潜轨迹上的连续dLM（3B/8B）。采用分块（blockwise）似然优化训练，联合对高斯扰动的token嵌入去噪并学习最优嵌入几何；利用自回归（AR）模型预训练权重进行热启动以加速训练。推理阶段识别出无分类器引导（CFG）与分数温度（score temperature）对高保真推理与编码至关重要。

Result: 在数学推理与代码任务上对比最先进离散模型（掩码dLM与AR基线）：预训练后在GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP等标准基准上具竞争力，SFT后在MATH-500、AIME等困难推理任务上亦表现相当。并发现连续dLM独有性质：(i) 嵌入空间引导有效调控质量-多样性权衡，带来强pass@k表现；(ii) 连续轨迹支持低NFE下的优雅退化与高效蒸馏。

Conclusion: 连续dLM确立为高效语言生成的有前景范式。

Abstract: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Sigma, the first large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLM built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry. To accelerate training, Sigma leverages pre-trained weights from autoregressive (AR) models for warm-starting. During inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Across comprehensive math reasoning and coding evaluations against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Sigma achieves competitive performance with discrete models on standard benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) after pre-training and on challenging reasoning tasks (e.g., MATH-500, AIME) after supervised fine-tuning. Beyond performance parity, we uncover key structural properties unique to continuous dLMs: (i) embedding-space steering effectively governs the quality-diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@k performance and (ii) continuous trajectories enable graceful degradation for low NFEs and efficient distillation. These establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.

</details>


### [115] [Silent Dissent: LLM Agents That Yield to the Majority Still Represent Their Original Premise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02702)
*Ziang Ni,Peng Zou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用两跳事实问题与脚本化"同伴"制造一致多数压力，借助Jacobian lens（J-lens）从LLM智能体的残差流中读取其隐含的"桥接实体"，发现顺从改答的智能体内部仍保留原有推理前提，说明多智能体辩论中的公开共识可能高估真实一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体辩论常被用于让LLM智能体达成共识，但智能体容易屈从于一致多数。核心疑问是：当智能体改变答案时，它是真的改变了想法，还是只改变了表述？作者希望区分"观点改变"与"公开表态改变"，以评估辩论共识的真实性。

Method: 采用两跳事实问题，其中中间实体（bridge，如"圣家堂所在国家的首都"里的国家）始终不被任何人说出。由脚本化同伴扮演Asch式从众实验中的"同盟者"，一致给出取自另一不同bridge事实的错误答案。在智能体作答时刻，用Jacobian lens（J-lens）从残差流中读取bridge，并以logit lens作对照。在留出事实上对四个开放权重模型进行预注册检验。预注册补充实验通过隐藏或删除智能体先前的答案来测试。探索性干预中注入bridge的J-lens方向。

Result: 在预注册层（输出层以下）中，Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B和Gemma-4-E4B-it中改答的智能体仍表征原有bridge，hit@100（相对对照实体）分别为0.85、0.22、0.24，而logit lens很少将其排入前100 token（0.00–0.06）。这些智能体还表征了同伴答案背后的bridge，超出提及基线。隐藏先前答案后，四个模型改答智能体仍表征原bridge（分别为0.43、0.29、0.37、0.25，含Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），而Llama在答案可见时几乎不表征（0.03）。隐藏先前答案还改变从众率：Qwen3.5-4B从8%升至89%。探索性干预中，注入bridge的J-lens方向仅在两个Qwen模型中使智能体回到原答案。作者也报告了预注册计划的负面结果。

Conclusion: 即便智能体公开陈述多数派答案，前提仍可从问题本身计算得出，说明其内部推理并未被说服。多智能体辩论中表面的共识可能夸大了实际一致程度；J-lens等内部表征读取方法可揭示"改口不改心"现象。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate is increasingly used to reach consensus among LLM agents, yet agents often yield to a unanimous majority. When an agent changes its answer, has it changed its mind or only its statement? We study this with two-hop factual questions whose intermediate entity (the bridge, e.g. the country in "the capital of the country where the Sagrada Familia is located") is never stated by anyone. Scripted peers, in the role of Asch's confederates, unanimously assert a wrong answer taken from another fact with a different bridge. At the moment the agent answers, we read the bridge from its residual stream with the Jacobian lens (J-lens) and, for comparison, the logit lens. In pre-registered tests on held-out facts with four open-weight models, agents of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-E4B-it that gave in still represented their original bridge in the pre-registered layers below the output (hit@100 above a control entity: 0.85, 0.22 and 0.24), where the logit lens rarely ranked it among the top 100 tokens (0.00-0.06). These agents also represented the bridge behind the peers' answer, beyond a mention baseline. A pre-registered addendum hid the agent's earlier answer or removed it: agents that gave in still represented their original bridge in all four models (0.43, 0.29, 0.37 and 0.25 with the answer hidden), including Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which barely did so with its answer in view (0.03). The premise can thus be computed from the question alone while the agent states the majority's answer. Hiding the earlier answer also changed conformity: Qwen3.5-4B gave in on 89% of questions instead of 8%. In exploratory interventions, injecting the bridge's J-lens direction brought agents back to their original answer only in the two Qwen models. Stated consensus in multi-agent debate can thus overstate agreement. We also report the negative results of our pre-registered program.

</details>


### [116] [WakeKV: Reactive, Reversible KV Residency for Heads That Change Their Minds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02713)
*Utkarsh Ranjan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现注意力头的读取行为在生成过程中会动态变化，提出 WakeKV——一种反应式驻留策略，将"冷却"的头状态移至可恢复的 CPU 存储池而非冻结或永久驱逐，在匹配内存/预算下持续降低漏读率，并在真实硬件上验证了吞吐提升与质量保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KV-cache 压缩方法在离线阶段或 prefill 阶段对注意力头进行一次性分类，并在整个生成过程中保持该分类固定不变。论文通过实测发现这一静态假设不成立：在 3 个模型（1.5B–8B）、3 种任务场景（needle retrieval、长链式思维、多轮召回）下的 4 种模型-场景组合中，大多数注意力头在生成期间至少改变一次读取行为。

Method: 提出 WakeKV，一种反应式（reactive）驻留策略：当注意力头"冷却"时，将其状态迁移到可恢复的 CPU reservoir（存储池），而非冻结（freezing）或永久驱逐（permanent eviction），从而支持状态在需要时被重新激活。此外在 FlexiCache/vLLM 上针对 Mistral-7B 实现了该系统。

Result: 在匹配内存或预算条件下，WakeKV 在 miss rate 上持续优于冻结分类与破坏性驱逐，评估覆盖 5 种模型-场景组合，并与 3 个基线（SnapKV、uniform R-KV、ReasonAlloc）在 4 个符合条件的组合上对比。基于 FlexiCache/vLLM 的 Mistral-7B 硬件实现验证了收益：吞吐量提升，同时保持 LongBench 质量。

Conclusion: 注意力头的读取行为本质上是动态的，静态的一次性分类会带来性能损失；将"冷却"头状态放入可恢复的 CPU reservoir（而非冻结或驱逐）是一种有效且经硬件验证的 KV-cache 压缩优化方向。

Abstract: Most KV-cache compression methods classify attention heads once, either offline or during prefill, and keep this classification fixed throughout generation. Across three models (1.5B-8B) and three regimes (needle retrieval, long chain-of-thought, and multi-turn recall), we measure head behavior on four model-regime combinations and find that most heads change their reading behavior at least once during generation. We introduce WakeKV, a reactive residency policy that moves cooling heads to a recoverable CPU reservoir rather than freezing or permanently evicting their state. At matched memory or budget, WakeKV consistently improves miss rate over frozen classification and destructive eviction, evaluated across five model-regime combinations and over three cited baselines (SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and ReasonAlloc) across four eligible combinations. A FlexiCache/vLLM implementation on Mistral-7B confirms the benefit on real hardware, improving throughput while retaining LongBench quality.

</details>


### [117] [TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02736)
*Minji Park,Seunghyun Yoon,Hyuk Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"转折点驱逐"这一对话压缩失效模式，并构建TPBench，在相同保留预算下用三个互补探针（初始目标P1、当前值P2、联合P3）评估压缩方法，发现各方法在联合探针上均低于全上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话压缩评估只用一个整体保留分数，掩盖了"压缩器保留事实却丢弃改变事实的那一轮"的问题。用户纠正价格、翻转选择或增加约束时，该轮被驱逐，导致系统保留旧意图而丢失当前意图，即转折点驱逐（turning-point eviction）。单一分数混合了"用户最初想要"和"用户现在想要"，无法暴露这一失败。

Method: 提出TPBench，在共享的名义保留预算下评估三个互补信息目标：P1要求用户初始目标，P2要求用户已修改槽位的当前值，P3要求二者兼具（对话含晚期标注槽位更新）。当前值答案取自MultiWOZ与SGD的人工对话状态标注，初始目标答案取首个用户轮的首句，均无需新增众包。另外在LongMemEval-KU与中文RiSAWOZ上测试当前值恢复。

Result: 探针特定评估对压缩方法的排序不同。在主Llama阅读器上，保留比例0.30的联合探针中，所有被测压缩方法均低于全上下文。删除携带更新的那轮会显著降低当前值准确率，而删除一个匹配的无关轮则不变。Mistral阅读器复现了P2/P3排序及联合探针差距。在LongMemEval-KU与RiSAWOZ上，全上下文准确率最高，近期性（recency）在两种评估中获得压缩方法中最高均值。

Conclusion: 整体保留分数会掩盖转折点驱逐，需用探针式、目标分离的评估加以揭示。TPBench以共享保留预算、无需新增标注的低成本方式实现这一点，并为未来压缩方法提出明确要求：在压缩后仍应保住承载状态更新的那一轮。

Abstract: A compressor can keep the facts of a dialogue and still drop the turn that changed them. A user corrects a price, reverses a choice, or adds a constraint. We call this failure turning-point eviction. One overall retention score hides it, because that score mixes what the user first wanted with what the user wants now.
  We introduce TPBench, which evaluates three complementary information targets at shared nominal retention budgets. P1 asks for the user's initial goal. P2 asks for the current value of a slot the user revised. P3 asks for both, in dialogues with a late annotated slot update. The current-value answers come from the human dialogue-state annotations of MultiWOZ and SGD. The initial-goal answer is the first sentence of the first user turn. Neither requires new crowdsourcing.
  The probe-specific evaluations rank compression methods differently. On the joint probe at a retained fraction of 0.30, every tested compressed method remains below full context with the main Llama reader. Deleting the turn that carries the update sharply lowers current-value accuracy, while deleting one matched irrelevant turn leaves it unchanged. A Mistral reader repeats the P2/P3 rankings and the joint-probe gap. Current-value recovery is tested on an additional corpus, LongMemEval-KU, and on Chinese RiSAWOZ: full context has the highest accuracy, and recency has the highest compressed-method mean in both evaluations.

</details>


### [118] [Beyond Correctness: Resolving Underspecification in Agentic Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02739)
*Wen-Zhi Li,Yue Gong,Konstantinos Kanellis,Balakrishnan Murali Narayanaswamy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出Agentic Text-to-SQL系统存在"过早终止澄清"问题，并提出PlanPool方法（将澄清计划外化为可变问题池，要求每个计划问题必须被明确询问或放弃）以提升歧义覆盖、减少静默失败。三个基准上均优于无约束和提示式基线，同时保持竞争性执行准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic Text-to-SQL系统在与用户交互澄清欠指定查询时，即使SQL执行结果正确，也不代表真正解决了底层歧义——智能体可能静默地做出未经验证的假设而恰好命中目标答案。作者将该行为部分归因于"过早终止澄清"：强制智能体多提问可提升执行准确率，但歧义集中在早期交互中，暴力提问效率低；更关键的是，即便显式提示其规划澄清过程，智能体仍会放弃已识别为相关的问题。

Method: 提出PlanPool：将澄清计划外化为一个可变的问题池（mutable question pool）。每个计划的问题在提交前必须被显式地"询问"或"放弃"；同时交互过程中新发现的歧义可以动态加入问题池。

Result: 在源自BIRD-Interact和Spider的三个基准上，PlanPool相比无约束和基于提示的替代方案，一致地提升了歧义覆盖度并减少了静默失败，同时保持了有竞争力的执行准确率。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了智能体推理中的一个重要区分：仅识别缺失信息是不够的，智能体还必须在下结论前可靠地维护并解决这些信息。PlanPool通过外部化问题池强制执行计划问题的处置（询问或放弃），有效缓解了过早终止澄清导致的静默失败。

Abstract: Agentic Text-to-SQL systems can interact with users to clarify underspecified queries before generating SQL. However, a correct execution result does not necessarily imply that the agent has adequately resolved the underlying underspecification: the agent may silently make unverified assumptions that happen to match the intended answer. We show that this behavior is driven in part by premature clarification termination. Although forcing an agent to ask more questions improves execution accuracy, ambiguities are concentrated in earlier interactions, making brute-force questioning inefficient. More importantly, even when explicitly prompted to plan its clarification process, the agent frequently abandons questions that it has already identified as relevant. To address this failure mode, we introduce PlanPool, which externalizes the clarification plan as a mutable question pool. Every planned question must be explicitly asked or dropped before submission, while newly discovered ambiguities can be added during interaction. Across three benchmarks derived from BIRD-Interact and Spider, PlanPool consistently improves ambiguity coverage and reduces silent failures over unconstrained and prompt-based alternatives, while maintaining competitive execution accuracy. Our results highlight an important distinction in agentic reasoning: identifying missing information is not sufficient, and the agent must also reliably maintain and resolve it before committing to an answer.

</details>


### [119] [EpiWorld: Grounding LLM Policy Agents in Epidemiological World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02744)
*Zeeshan Memon,Yiqi Su,Kai Shu,Naren Ramakrishnan,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EpiWorld闭环框架，将LLM政策智能体与动作条件流行病世界模型、分层技能库结合，实现可解释、可控制的疫情干预决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疫情干预政策是以自然语言为载体、由人类决策者解释、论证与修订的文本产物，因而LLM天然适合疫情政策推理。但朴素LLM缺乏三类关键要素：预测干预后果所需的流行病动力学、评估严重程度所需的定量监测信号、以及界定可行动作范围的制度约束。

Method: EpiWorld由三部分组成：一个学习得到的、以动作为条件的流行病世界模型；一个分层技能库（公共卫生协议、监测工具、经事后复盘积累的自适应经验）；以及作为政策行动者的LLM。给定候选干预，世界模型预测区域疫情演化并进行快速反事实推演，为政策选择与细化提供反馈；模拟未来的结果被蒸馏为可复用经验，而协议约束保持固定，从而在不牺牲可解释性与可控性的前提下改进决策过程。

Result: 在回顾性COVID-19与Influenza数据集上评估世界模型与端到端框架：世界模型在所有预测基线中取得最优的分布外Peak-MAE；闭环框架将累计住院量最高降低59%，在六个LLM骨干上平均降低约16%，优于强化学习与最优控制类政策基线。

Conclusion: 通过将LLM政策推理锚定于动作条件世界模型与制度化协议技能库，EpiWorld在保持决策可解释性与可控性的同时显著改善疫情干预效果，验证了“学习式世界模型+LLM政策智能体”闭环范式的有效性。

Abstract: Epidemic intervention policies are textual artefacts that human decision-makers interpret, justify, and revise through natural language, making large language models a natural candidate for epidemic policy reasoning. A naive LLM, however, lacks the epidemic dynamics needed to project intervention consequences, the quantitative surveillance signals required to assess severity, and the institutional constraints that define admissible actions. We present EpiWorld, a closed-loop framework that grounds an LLM policy actor in a learned action-conditioned epidemiological world model and a tiered skill library of public-health protocols, surveillance tools, and adaptive lessons accumulated through after-action analysis. Given a candidate intervention, the world model predicts regional epidemic evolution and enables fast counterfactual rollouts that provide feedback for policy selection and refinement. Outcomes of simulated futures are distilled into reusable lessons while protocol constraints remain fixed, allowing the decision process to improve without sacrificing interpretability or controllability. We evaluate both the world model and the end-to-end framework on retrospective COVID-19 and Influenza datasets: the world model achieves the best out-of-distribution Peak-MAE among all forecasting baselines, and the closed-loop framework reduces cumulative hospitalisation by up to 59% across datasets and by an average of ~16% across six LLM backbones, outperforming reinforcement-learning and optimal-control policy baselines.

</details>


### [120] [When History Fails to Become Experience: Action Calibration in Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02769)
*Jingyu Liu,Zhiwen Wang,Yuxin Jing,Huanyu Zhou,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 语言智能体未有效利用交互历史：打乱历史影响有限，显式标注"观测为前一动作结果"可提升成功率，并据此提出经验校准器进一步改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长程交互任务中，智能体本应借助既往尝试与环境反馈来改进后续决策，但实践中增加交互历史反而可能降低任务成功率，说明智能体未能一致、有效地利用历史信息，需要探究其使用历史的机制与瓶颈。

Method: 通过消融式实验考察历史的作用：打乱过去动作的顺序、并破坏动作与观测之间的对应关系；随后在返回的观测上显式标注其为前一动作的结果（不引入任何新环境信息）；在此基础上提出一个可学习的校准器（learned calibrator），重新评估过去动作并选择性记录经验以指导后续决策。

Result: 历史总体上提升任务完成度，但即使打乱过去动作，其收益仍大部分保留；破坏动作—观测对应关系仅带来轻微成功率下降，说明智能体未可靠地将过去动作与其结果关联。显式标注观测为前一动作的结果可提升成功率并减少下一动作重复；可学习校准器在标注基础上进一步提升成功率。

Conclusion: 智能体利用历史的瓶颈在于动作—结果对应关系未被有效建立，而非缺乏历史信息本身；通过轻量化的显式标注与可学习校准器即可改善历史利用效率，为提升语言智能体长程任务表现提供了一条不增加环境信息的设计路径。

Abstract: Language agents should draw on prior attempts and environmental feedback to improve subsequent decisions within the same task. However, providing additional interaction history can sometimes reduce task success, suggesting that agents do not consistently use this information effectively. To investigate this limitation, we examine how agents use history. We find that history improves task completion overall, yet much of this benefit persists even when past actions are shuffled. Disrupting the correspondence between actions and observations causes only a modest decline in task success. We therefore hypothesize that agents do not reliably connect past actions with their outcomes when deciding how to proceed. To test this hypothesis, we explicitly label each returned observation as the outcome of the preceding action. This simple annotation improves task success and reduces next-action repetition without introducing new environmental information. Building on this insight, we introduce a learned calibrator that explicitly reassesses past actions and selectively records experience to guide subsequent decisions, improving task success beyond outcome labeling alone.

</details>


### [121] [AptMQL-Bench: From Text-to-SQL to Text-to-MQL via Access-Pattern Schema Design and Data-Preserving Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02770)
*Hy Nguyen,Nabi Rezvani,Robin Vujanic*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于编码智能体与人工校验的转换流程，将BIRD的text-to-SQL基准转为文档数据库场景，构建面向访问模式的text-to-MQL基准AptMQL-Bench（21库、3186条自然语言请求），避免启发式迁移的数据丢失与性能退化，并揭示text-to-MQL仍是难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档数据库（如MongoDB）是现代应用的核心基础设施，自然语言接口text-to-MQL能让非专家查询半结构化数据。该任务进展依赖高质量基准，而实用做法是把已有text-to-SQL基准转换为文档场景。但现有工作依赖启发式机械转换：文档schema照搬关系外键图、查询照搬源SQL，导致实验中21个BIRD数据库有6个无法迁移，其他库静默丢失最多25.9%的行，且ground-truth查询随数据规模增长慢一个数量级以上。因此需要一个更合理的转换方法。

Method: 提出由编码智能体（coding agents）驱动、带人在回路（human-in-the-loop）验证的转换流水线：依据预期访问模式设计每个文档schema，并将查询改写为MongoDB原生（MongoDB-native）形式，而非机械映射外键图与SQL。将该流程应用于BIRD，构建AptMQL-Bench。

Result: AptMQL-Bench包含21个面向文档的数据库、3186条自然语言请求及其对应MQL查询，数据库从SQLite迁移且无数据丢失、可高效扩展。最强模型Claude Opus 4.5在无外部知识证据下准确率为57.38%，有证据时为70.34%。

Conclusion: 基于访问模式的编码智能体转换流程可克服启发式迁移的缺陷，构建高质量text-to-MQL基准；即便最强模型准确率仍有限，表明真实的text-to-MQL生成仍是具有挑战性的任务。

Abstract: Document databases such as MongoDB are core infrastructure for modern applications, and natural-language interfaces to them---text-to-MQL---would let non-experts query complex, semi-structured data without mastering the query language. Progress on this task depends on high-quality benchmarks, which are most practically obtained by converting an existing text-to-SQL benchmark to the document setting. Unfortunately, existing efforts rely on heuristics for mechanical conversion: the document schema mirrors the relational foreign-key graph, and each query mirrors its source SQL. As a result in our experiments, these approaches fail to migrate 6 of 21 BIRD databases outright, silently drop up to 25.9\% of rows on others, and yield schemas whose ground-truth queries run over an order of magnitude slower as the data scales. We instead propose a conversion pipeline, driven by coding agents with human-in-the-loop verification, that designs each document schema from expected access patterns and rewrites queries to be MongoDB-native. Applying it to BIRD, we build an access-pattern-based text-to-MQL benchmark (AptMQL-Bench). It includes 21 document-oriented databases, 3,186 natural-language requests, and their associated MQL queries---whose databases are migrated from SQLite without data loss and scale efficiently. The strongest model, Claude Opus 4.5, achieves only 57.38\% accuracy without external knowledge evidence and 70.34\% with it. This indicates that realistic text-to-MQL generation remains challenging.

</details>


### [122] [Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02772)
*Ding Wu,Ye Zhang,Haoyu Wang,Tianci Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对无结构知识编辑(UKE)中的"上下文依赖"失效模式,提出FOVEATED框架,通过随机偏移RoPE位置构造聚焦视图,缓解上下文引发的难度低估,提升编辑后模型对独立事实的召回能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM参数无法自动反映预训练后变化的信息,知识编辑(KE)提供比重新训练更低成本的替代方案。传统KE使用结构化事实三元组,而无结构KE(UKE)使用含多个事实的自由文本段落。然而现有UKE编辑器存在"上下文依赖"问题:编辑后的LLM虽能复述编辑段落,但脱离原文语境时无法可靠回忆其中的独立事实。

Method: 作者识别出标准段落级编辑目标下的"上下文引发的难度低估":靠后的事实获得更丰富的真实上下文,初始损失更低,因而看似更易学习。为此提出FOVEATED——一种即插即用框架,通过随机偏移句子前文上下文对应键的Rotary Position Embedding(RoPE)位置,为每个句子构造聚焦视图。该扰动仅在编辑时施加、之后移除,推理时保持模型原生位置编码不变。作者将其实例化于直接优化类与定位后编辑(locate-then-edit)类编辑器。

Result: 理论分析了FOVEATED如何抵消上下文引发的难度低估,并在五个KE编辑器、两种LLM骨干和三个基准上实证验证了持续一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: FOVEATED作为一种通用、即插即用的方法,能够有效缓解UKE中的上下文依赖问题,提升编辑后模型对独立事实的召回,且不改变推理时的原生位置编码,具有良好通用性与扩展性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as general-purpose interfaces to factual knowledge, but their parameters do not automatically reflect information that changes after pretraining. Knowledge editing (KE) provides a targeted alternative to costly retraining by modifying selected knowledge and preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities. Conventional KE uses structured factual triples, whereas unstructured KE (UKE) uses free-form passages containing multiple facts. Nonetheless, existing UKE editors exhibit a failure mode known as context reliance: edited LLMs can often reproduce the editing passage but fail to reliably recall its individual facts without the original passage context. We identify context-induced difficulty underestimation under the standard passage-level editing objective: later facts receive increasingly rich ground-truth context and consequently incur lower initial losses, making them appear easier to learn. In response, we propose FOVEATED, a plug-and-play framework that constructs focused views of each sentence by randomly shifting the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) positions assigned to the keys of its preceding context. The perturbation is applied during editing and removed afterward, leaving the model's native positional encoding unchanged at inference time. We instantiate FOVEATED for both direct-optimization and locate-then-edit editors. We theoretically analyze how FOVEATED counteracts context-induced difficulty underestimation and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements across five KE editors, two LLM backbones, and three benchmarks.

</details>


### [123] [Automatic Evaluation of Mental Health Stigma in Online Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02775)
*Naomi Baes,Jemima Kang,Nick Haslam,Chris Groot,Alsa Wu,Luc Raszewski,Yulia Otmakhova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于理论的心理健康污名自动评估基准，包含细粒度分类体系，用于在线新闻和社交媒体文本标注，并评估LLM与相关分类器表现，发现现有模型难以捕捉该构念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康污名影响深远但构念复杂，既有显性贬低，也含隐性的指责、恐惧、家长式怜悯、社交距离、结构性排斥与歧视，现有评价工具难以有效衡量。

Method: 构建理论驱动的在线传播污名评估基准：对自然发生的在线新闻与社交媒体文本进行细粒度标注，覆盖七种心理健康状况。标注框架含二分类污名检测任务，以及多层级分类体系——(i)污名模式、(ii)领域、(iii)特定污名形式的具体成分。以该框架评估大语言模型，并与针对情感、毒性、仇恨言论的污名相关分类器对比。

Result: 针对情感、毒性、仇恨言论训练的相邻构念模型无法很好捕捉心理健康污名；LLM在缺乏明确操作规则时倾向过度预测污名，与人工标注中决策规则的重要性相呼应。

Conclusion: 心理健康污名不能由相邻构念模型替代检测，需依托细粒度标注框架与明确决策规则；已公开基准部分内容、标注、污名典型样例及代码。

Abstract: Mental health stigma has profoundly harmful impacts but its complexity makes it difficult to evaluate. Stigma may involve explicit derogation, but also subtler forms of blame, fear, paternalistic pity, social distancing, structural exclusion, and discrimination. We introduce a theory-grounded benchmark for automatic evaluation of mental health stigma in online communication, consisting of naturally occurring online news and social media text annotated with a fine-grained taxonomy of stigma across multiple mental health conditions. Our annotation framework comprises a binary stigma-detection task and a multi-level taxonomy covering (i) stigma mode, (ii) domain, and (iii) specific components of certain forms of stigma. We apply this framework to texts mentioning six mental health conditions and evaluate large language models alongside stigma-related classifiers for detecting sentiment, toxicity, and hate speech. Results show that mental health stigma is not well captured by models trained to detect these neighboring constructs, and that LLMs often overpredict stigma unless given explicit operational rules - mirroring the importance of decision rules in human annotation. We release the publicly available part of benchmark, annotations, prototypical exemplars of stigma and code at: https://github.com/jemimakang/mh_stigma.

</details>


### [124] [Text-Centric Post-Training for Omni-Modal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02819)
*Ziyang Cheng,Yuhao Wang,Hongcheng Liu,Qimin Wu,Jingru Fan,Chen Qian,Yanfeng Wang,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出以文本为中心的后训练范式：先用纯文本训练强化推理，再用少量原生音视频强化学习精修感知，从而以更低成本提升全模态大模型的音视频推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升全模态大语言模型的联合音视频推理通常需要大量数据构建与训练开销。诊断发现：即使所有单跳问题答对，模型仍存在多跳推理困难；且感知与推理目标在局部优化中出现部分解耦。这促使作者对这两种能力采用不同侧重的后训练策略。

Method: 采用分阶段后训练：先进行纯文本推理训练（SFT 后接 RL），并可完全使用纯文本 LLM 合成数据；再提出文本中心后训练范式，以纯文本训练承担主要推理优化，随后用缩减数据的原生音视频 RL 精修感知。

Result: 最佳纯文本配置使 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 在九项推理得分上的几何平均较基座提升 25.83%，优于完整原生音视频路线且节省 56.6% GPU 小时；完全由纯文本 LLM 合成数据训练仍提升 21.01%。但纯文本训练会损害感知。精修阶段输入 token 减少约 90%，将感知恢复至基座以上，并保留最佳纯文本流程 93.5% 的推理增益。

Conclusion: 纯文本训练可跨数据来源、模型规模与模型族带来推理增益，但会退化感知；文本中心后训练范式以极低数据与算力代价同时兼顾推理增强与感知恢复，为全模态模型的高效后训练提供可行路径。

Abstract: Improving joint audio-visual reasoning in Omni Large Language Models typically incurs substantial data construction and training costs. Our diagnostics reveal multi-hop reasoning difficulties despite correct answers to all corresponding single-hop questions and suggest partial decoupling in the local optimization of perception and reasoning objectives. This motivates post-training with different emphases on these capabilities. Text-only reasoning training yields gains across data sources, model scales, and families. With the best-performing text-only configuration, supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (RL) raises Qwen2.5-Omni-7B's geometric mean of nine reasoning scores by 25.83% over the base model, outperforming the complete native audio-visual route with 56.6% fewer GPU-hours. Training on data synthesized entirely by a text-only LLM raises this geometric mean by 21.01% without audio-visual data in construction or training. However, text-only training degrades perception. We therefore propose a text-centric post-training paradigm: text-only training provides the main reasoning optimization, and reduced-data native audio-visual RL then refines perception. Refinement uses about 90% fewer input tokens than full-data audio-visual RL, restores perception above the base level, and retains 93.5% of the best-performing text-only pipeline's reasoning gain.

</details>


### [125] [Clinical Concept Centers in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02829)
*Aishik Nagar,Abhishek Vaidyanathan,Arun-Kumar Kaliya-Perumal,Elijah Tzen Hsuen Boey,Stefan Winkler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将行为评估扩展到潜空间，检验临床概念是否作为可定位、因果使用的表示存在于开放权重LLM中，并在11个模型中发现可解释且因果驱动行为的临床概念中心。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床LLM可靠性研究几乎只评估语言输出（"模型说了什么"），而机制可解释性表明潜空间表示比文本更高保真：内部表示编码的信息远多于言语化内容，且陈述的推理会系统性遗漏因果驱动答案的特征。临床决策支持领域尚缺乏基于机制可解释性的模型行为评估。

Method: 将行为评估延伸到潜空间，探究临床概念是否以可定位、因果使用的表示形式存在于开放权重LLM内部；在11个开放模型上识别临床概念中心，并测试其在受限与开放式设定下的因果作用。评估方面采用对抗性角色提示与对齐提示；性能方面模拟真实部署场景，沿概念中心对模型进行steering；最后开展盲法临床医生验证。

Result: 在全部11个测试的开放模型中均发现专门的临床概念中心；这些中心可解释，仅对与其对齐的临床叙述激活，并在受限和开放式设定中显著且因果地驱动模型行为。在对抗性角色提示下模型内部仍保持一致并持续使用相关概念中心，而对齐提示可提升下游临床表现。沿概念中心steering带来有意义的下游改进；盲法临床医生验证显示概念中心的激活与使用能够预测临床医生的偏好。

Conclusion: 临床概念在开放权重LLM潜空间中作为可定位、可解释且因果驱动的概念中心存在，不仅是分析性表示，更是可用于临床实践的回路；其激活与使用特点在评估与性能两个层面均具价值，并能预测临床医生偏好。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in clinical settings. However, research into the reliability and performance of these models has focused almost entirely on the language substrate, scoring what the model says. Mechanistic interpretability has found that the latent space carries a higher fidelity of representation than the text: internal representations not only encode substantially more than the output verbalizes, but the stated reasoning also systematically omits features that causally drive the answer. An evaluation of model behavior in terms of mechanistic interpretability has not been explored in clinical decision support. In this work, we extend behavioral evaluation into the latent space and ask whether clinical concepts exist as locatable, causally used representations inside open-weight LLMs. We find dedicated clinical concept centers in the latent space of all eleven open models we test. These concept centers are interpretable, firing only on their aligned clinical narratives, and meaningfully and causally drive model behavior in both constrained and open-ended settings. They are not just analytical representations, but circuits that can be utilized in clinical practice, and we explore their use from the perspective of both evaluation and performance. From the evaluation standpoint, models stay internally coherent and keep using the relevant concept centers even under adversarial role-based priming, while aligned priming improves downstream clinical performance. From a performance perspective, we simulate realistic deployment settings and find that steering models along these centers leads to meaningful downstream improvements. Finally, we conduct a blinded clinician validation and find the activation and usage of these concept centers predicts clinicians preferences.

</details>


### [126] [How Robust Is Multimodal Claim Verification to LLM Rewriting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02841)
*Yun-Ang Wu,Xanh Ho,Andre Greiner-Petter,Sunisth Kumar,Tian Cheng Xia,Florian Boudin,Akiko Aizawa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究探讨LLM引发的文体改写对多模态主张验证任务的影响，发现模型总体稳健，但存在系统性概率偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM会改变生成文本的文体风格，但这类风格变化如何影响模型在科学任务上的判断尚不清楚，本文聚焦多模态主张验证场景展开研究。

Method: 采用两种改写策略：模拟研究者润色学术文本的自然改写，以及仅插入单个LLM相关词以隔离词汇选择效应的受控注入；评估11个开放权重模型，涵盖5个VLM家族、2B至38B参数规模。

Result: 模型对改写总体稳健，多数未出现显著准确率下降；相比此前关于评审分数操纵的研究，验证任务稳定性更高。但存在一致的概率偏移：对冲类条件在几乎所有模型上产生显著偏移，提升类条件效应较弱，通用润色（语法纠错、流畅度提升）影响甚微。

Conclusion: 多模态主张验证对LLM文体改写具有较强鲁棒性，但特定语言特征（尤其对冲表达）仍会引发可复现的决策概率偏移。

Abstract: LLMs are known to introduce stylistic changes into generated text, yet how these stylistic shifts affect model decisions on scientific tasks remains underexplored. In this paper, we focus on multimodal claim verification, where the goal is to determine whether a textual claim is grounded in a given piece of evidence. We apply two rewriting strategies: natural rewriting, which simulates how researchers routinely use LLMs to polish academic text, and controlled injection, which inserts a single LLM-associated word to isolate the effect of vocabulary choice. We evaluate 11 open-weight models spanning five VLM families and ranging from 2B to 38B parameters. We find that models are robust to these modifications: most show no significant drop in accuracy, and compared to prior work on review-score manipulation, verification appears far more stable. However, consistent probability shifts do occur. Hedging-oriented conditions produce significant shifts across nearly all models, while boosting conditions show a weaker effect and general polishing conditions (e.g., grammar correction, fluency improvement) have little effect.

</details>


### [127] [Adaptive Mutual Distillation for Balanced Multi-Task Post-Training of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02856)
*Baohang Li,Xiaocheng Feng,Yichong Huang,Chengpeng Fu,Wenshuai Huo,Zekun Zhou,Zekun Yuan,Tingjia Zhang,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应互蒸馏（AMD）框架，让两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型协同后训练，通过对蒸馏权重进行调整探测并利用任务级验证分数选择调整方案，在六个基准和三个LLM主干上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务后训练中训练数据量不均，现有方法主要关注单模型训练时的任务贡献平衡。不同任务平衡策略会训练出各具互补优势的模型，为跨模型互蒸馏创造机会；但跨模型监督的有效性会随任务、迁移方向和训练阶段而变化。

Method: 提出自适应互蒸馏（AMD）：联合训练两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型，通过跨任务共享的短时训练探测（probe）评估候选的蒸馏权重调整，再利用任务级验证分数为每个任务和迁移方向选择相应的调整方案。

Result: 在六个基准和三个LLM主干上，两个AMD模型的平均基准得分均高于采用相同采样策略的SFT基线，也优于实验中评估的任务平衡方法；合并两个模型可进一步提升平均基准得分，同时得到单一推理模型，合并模型在三个主干上平均超出多任务SFT 2.91分。

Conclusion: 通过跨模型互蒸馏与自适应的权重调整选择，AMD能有效融合不同任务平衡策略的优势，模型合并还能进一步增益并降低推理开销，为多任务后训练提供了一种协同且实用的方案。

Abstract: Multi-task post-training of large language models (LLMs) aims to improve performance across tasks with unequal amounts of training data. Existing methods focus primarily on balancing task contributions during single-model training. Different task-balancing strategies can produce models with complementary strengths, creating opportunities for mutual distillation. However, the usefulness of cross-model supervision can vary across tasks, transfer directions, and stages of training. We propose Adaptive Mutual Distillation (AMD), a collaborative post-training framework that jointly trains two models with different task-balancing strategies. AMD evaluates candidate adjustments to distillation weights through short training probes shared across tasks, then uses task-wise validation scores to select an adjustment for each task and transfer direction. Across six benchmarks and three LLM backbones, both AMD models achieve higher average benchmark scores than supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines trained with the same sampling strategies. They also outperform the task-balancing methods evaluated in our experiments. Merging the two trained models can further improve their average benchmark score while yielding a single model for inference. The merged models outperform multi-task SFT by an average of 2.91 points across the three backbones.

</details>


### [128] [ConvoDrift: A Multi-Turn Conversational Dataset for Modeling Stylistic Tone Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02873)
*Vihindi Kotalawala,Pamoda Dilranga,Gayani Thoradeniya,Prasan Yapa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ConvoDrift 数据集，用于建模固定语义意图下多轮对话中渐进式风格漂移，并配套构建人格条件偏好配对数据集，支持个性化与多元对齐研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有风格控制数据集多聚焦单句或假设风格静态不变，忽视了交互过程中用户偏好变化引发的动态风格迁移，语言风格演化问题在 NLP 中尚未被充分探索。

Method: 基于 15,727 个共享多轮对话结构构建 ConvoDrift，每段对话含六组提示-响应对，并标注风格漂移与漂移方向标签，覆盖多种交流体裁；进一步通过配对语义等价但风格不同的响应，并使用五种风格化沟通人格标注人格条件偏好，形成互补的成对数据集。评估涵盖人工验证、LLM-as-judge 以及词汇与语义自动评测。

Result: 三位标注者在七项 Likert 标准上的平均 Krippendorff's alpha 为 0.88；词汇与语义分析表明，漂移事件引发词汇变化，同时保持语义相似性。

Conclusion: ConvoDrift 为固定语义意图下的渐进式对话风格漂移建模提供了资源与评测框架，并支持个性化与多元对齐的语言语调研究。

Abstract: The evolution of linguistic style in conversations is an underexplored issue in NLP. Most style-control datasets focus on sentences or assume a static style throughout, missing the dynamic shifts that occur as user preferences change during interactions. We introduce ConvoDrift, a dataset designed to model progressive stylistic conversational tone drift under fixed semantic intent. It is built on 15,727 shared multi-turn conversational structures for adaptation and persona-conditioned alignment methods. It consists of six prompt-response pairs per conversation, each with the annotation of style drift and style direction labels. These pairs cover a range of communication genres. We further derive a complementary pairwise dataset by pairing semantically equivalent but stylistically distinct responses and annotating persona-conditioned preferences using five distinct style communication personas, enabling the controlled study of personalisation and pluralistic alignment in language tone. In addition to dataset construction, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation involving human validation, LLM-as-judge assessment, and automatic lexical and semantic evaluations. Across seven Likert criteria annotated by three human annotators, the average Krippendorff's alpha is 0.88, and our lexical and semantic analyses show that drift events induce lexical changes while preserving semantic similarity.

</details>


### [129] [Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Beyond Score Alignment: A Psychometric Analysis of Residual Judging Difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02877)
*Longwei Cong,Sonja Hahn,Sebastian Gombert,Leon Camus,Fabian Zehner,Hendrik Drachsler,Ulf Kroehne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 从心理测量学视角出发，用多面Rasch模型分解人类与LLM评分，提出"残差难度"指标，发现LLM评审与人类评审在难度结构上并不一致，且该差异强烈依赖于评价维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为自动评审已广泛使用，但现有评估多依赖与人类评分的整体一致性（聚合一致性），这种做法掩盖了一个关键问题：人类与LLM是否认为"同样的评估样例困难"。即整体对齐可能掩盖难度结构上的分歧。

Method: 在摘要评估任务上采用心理测量学方法：分别对人类和LLM评分拟合多面Rasch模型（Many-Facet Rasch Model），将分数分解为潜在摘要质量、评审者严厉度、维度严厉度与评分量表阈值；在此基础上定义"残差难度"（residual hardness）作为经模型校正的评判难度度量，并比较人类与LLM评审是否共享相同的难度结构。

Result: 在SummEval上对17个开源权重LLM评审者的实验显示：潜在摘要质量上的中等对齐并不意味着残差难度上的对齐；人类与LLM评审在哪些"摘要—维度"单元仍然困难上存在差异，且这种不匹配强烈依赖于维度——Consistency维度呈现明显的"LLM更难"偏移，Coherence维度则呈现"人类更难"偏移。进一步表明，"人类易但LLM难"的样例可部分由可观测的源文本—摘要属性预测。

Conclusion: 聚合层面的人类对齐只反映了LLM-as-a-judge可靠性的一部分；心理测量学的残差诊断能支持更具信息量的评审者评估与更有针对性的人机协作。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automatic judges, with validity typically assessed via alignment with human scores. However, aggregate agreement fails to reveal whether humans and LLMs find the same evaluation cases difficult. In this paper, we study this problem in summarization evaluation from a psychometric perspective. We fit Many-Facet Rasch Models separately to human and LLM ratings to decompose scores into latent summary quality, rater severity, dimension severity, and rating-scale thresholds. Building on this decomposition, we define residual hardness as a model-adjusted measure of judging difficulty and compare whether human and LLM judges share the same hardness structure. Across 17 open-weight LLM judges on SummEval, we find that moderate alignment in latent summary quality does not imply alignment in residual hardness. Human and LLM judges differ in which summary--dimension units remain difficult, and this mismatch is strongly dimension-dependent. Consistency shows a pronounced LLM-hard shift, whereas coherence shows a human-hard shift. We further show that human-easy but LLM-hard cases are partially predictable from observable source--summary properties. These findings suggest that aggregate human alignment reflects only part of LLM-as-a-judge reliability, while psychometric residual diagnostics support more informative judge evaluation and more targeted human--LLM collaboration.

</details>


### [130] [Evaluating VQA in Vision Language Models using Cooperative Principles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02878)
*Monika Shah,Sudarshan Balaji,Somdeb Sarkhel,Sanorita Dey,Deepak Venugopal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在问题违反Grice会话准则时的VQA表现，发现主流VLM（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Llava）性能下降，并揭示人类与VLM在语用推理上的差异，以及人类诱导与AI生成违规之间的推理差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究VLM在真实交流中面对违反Grice会话准则（如添加非必要、歧义或虚假信息）的提问时是否具备语用推理能力，并对比人类与VLM在语用处理上的差异。

Method: 利用VLM生成问题修饰语，向问题中注入非必要、歧义或虚假信息以违反Grice准则；在ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Llava上进行VQA测试；通过实验测量人类解决此类违规时的认知努力（以任务时间衡量），并对比人类诱导与AI生成的违规。

Result: 在存在Grice准则违规时，所评估的VLM性能均下降；人类与VLM的语用推理方式存在差异；VLM在处理人类诱导违规与AI生成违规时推理表现不同；人类解决VLM诱导违规的认知努力更低，但VLM在此类情况下准确率反而更差。

Conclusion: VLM在语用推理方面与人类存在显著差距，其处理违规问题的能力受违规来源影响，说明当前VLM在真实交流场景下的语用理解仍有局限。

Abstract: We evaluate the performance of Vision Language Models in Visual Question Answering (VQA) when questions violate Grice's maxims. To do this, we use VLMs to generate question modifiers that add non-essential, ambiguous or false information and show that in the presence of such violations, the VLMs that we evaluate (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Llava) show diminished performance. Further, we empirically show the difference between how humans reason pragmatically compared to VLMs, and the difference in VLM reasoning when it resolves violations that are human-induced compared to those that are AI-generated. Finally, we show that human cognitive effort (measured through time-on-task in an experiment) is lower for resolving VLM-induced violations, but VLMs themselves perform less accurately in such cases.

</details>


### [131] [Misinformation Without Triggers: From Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02886)
*Lin Tian,Marian-Andrei Rizoiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究虚假训练内容对模型"直接事实回答"与"下游决策行为"之间的脱节，提出"审计缺口"概念：直接探针报告的事实正确性无法预测模型实际决策，且纠正事实并不能纠正在其基础上建立的决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据投毒研究多通过注入触发器并在提示中激活，但真实虚假文档可在无触发条件下改变事实回答。关键未知在于：直接探针（直接问答）的结果是否能预测模型随后的决策行为。作者希望追踪虚假内容越过"答案"层面后对决策的影响，揭示评估中可能被忽视的安全隐患。

Method: 采用受控决策任务"Guess the Capital"：用固定解码器将事实答案转换为计分卡片选择，对比虚假训练与匹配的真实性对照训练。测试八个模型、剂量1,000，测量直接注入选择率与游戏选择率变化；并在Facebook 2019–20澳大利亚丛林大火虚假帖子上验证。进一步设计"计数×措辞"析因实验，检验计数与误导措辞各自对断言的影响。

Result: 在剂量1,000下，八个模型的直接注入选择率达95.8–100%，但游戏选择仅比匹配真实性训练提升1.7–14.4个百分点，存在审计缺口；缺口双向存在——通过直接探针的事实仍将决策推向注入答案，且游戏准确率下降幅度超过选择变化所能解释。真实性纠正能恢复事实，却无法恢复基于该事实的决策。在丛林大火案例中，用虚假帖训练使模型即使"丢失"被夸大的计数仍断言有人因纵火被捕；计数×措辞析因显示，即使训练计数保持24，误导性逮捕措辞仍产生逮捕断言。

Conclusion: 正确的事实回答并不保证正确的决策，丢失被注入的数字也不能移除误导性叙事。因此，仅依靠直接事实探针进行审计会低估虚假内容对模型决策的风险，需将评估延伸至决策层面并关注事实纠正后残留的行为影响。

Abstract: Language models learn from web documents, some of them false, and false content can reach a model's answer to a factual question and the summaries and decisions that use it. Most data-poisoning studies add a trigger to the training data and activate it in the prompt. False documents can also change factual responses without any trigger, but we do not know whether the direct answer predicts the decision. In this work, we follow false content past the answer and find an \emph{audit gap} between what a direct probe reports and what the model then does, comparing false training with matched truthful controls in a controlled decision task, \emph{Guess the Capital}, where a fixed decoder turns factual answers into a scored card choice, and on a misleading claim from Facebook posts about the 2019--20 Australian bushfires. Across eight models at dose 1,000, direct injected-choice rates reach 95.8--100\%, while injected game choices increase by 1.7--14.4 percentage points over matched truthful training. The gap runs the other way too. Facts that pass the direct probe still push decisions toward the injected answer, and game accuracy drops further than those choices explain. Truthful correction brings the fact back but not the decisions built on it.
