Over seven iterations, our model gains over 900 Elo points (1782 to 2697), substantially surpassing all frontier models on both playing strength and puzzle accuracy, despite containing three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Furthermore, LM-based evaluations show that our explanations are fluent and approach GPT-5.6-Sol (high) in coherence. The generality of our architecture and training procedure suggests a recipe for applying language models to domains where silent expert encoders are available, like games, robotics, and computer use.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [165] [From Expression to Reaction: Role-aware Visual Transfer and Stimulus-guided Reasoning for Interlocutor Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03016)
*Wei Wang,Zhaowu Li,Jianjie Luo,Fu Lee Wang,Lap-Kei Lee,Zhenguo Yang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出角色感知刺激引导（RASG）框架，用"仅听者视频+仅说话者音频"预测听者情绪，在MER-Cross达76.25%，较基线提升超17%，在ACM MM 2026 MER挑战赛Track 1获第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话者情绪识别中，听者情绪标注数据缺失导致监督错配，且听者的视觉反应往往相似，其含义需依赖说话者语境才能消歧。

Method: RASG含两个模块：角色感知视觉迁移（RVT）先筛选面部表情与情绪标签一致的说话者样本，再过滤听者轨迹并用可靠伪标签训练以听者为中心的视觉专家；刺激引导边界推理（SBR）仅在视觉模型不确定时启用二分类语言推理器，将说话者音频与文本作为语境而非直接情绪证据，以区分相似的听者反应。

Result: 在MER-Cross数据集上RASG取得76.25%的性能，较基线提升超过17%；团队在ACM MM 2026 MER Grand Challenge Track 1（MER-Cross）中排名第二。

Conclusion: RASG通过角色感知迁移缓解监督错配、借助刺激引导推理消解听者反应歧义，有效提升听者情绪识别性能，并在公开挑战赛中验证了其有效性。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a Role-aware Stimulus-guided (RASG) framework for interlocutor emotion recognition, which predicts listener emotions from listener-only videos and speaker-only audios. RASG consists of Role-aware Visual Transfer (RVT) and Stimulus-guided Boundary Reasoning (SBR) modules, which address supervision mismatch due to the lack of labeled listener data and ambiguity among visually similar listener reactions whose interpretation depends on speaker context, respectively. More specifically, RVT selects speaker samples whose facial expressions support their emotion labels. It then filters listener tracks and uses reliable pseudo-labels to train a listener-centric visual expert. SBR uses a two-class language reasoner only when the visual model is uncertain. It treats speaker audio and text as context rather than direct emotion evidence to distinguish similar listener reactions. Experiments conducted on MER-Cross dataset shows that RASG achieves 76.25\% on MER-Cross and improves the performance of the baseline over 17\%. Our team ranks second in Track 1 (MER-Cross) of the MER Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026.

</details>

### [166] [Scale-Recursive Rectified Flows for Few-Step Precipitation Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02611)
*Shunya Nagashima,Takumi Bannai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出尺度递归整流流模型，通过按空间尺度分配采样步数，在减少采样步骤的同时保持降水降尺度集合的多样性与概率精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精细分辨率降水估计对洪水风险评估和水资源管理很重要，但粗分辨率卫星产品无法刻画网格内部降水差异。生成模型可通过产生合理的高分辨率降水场集合来消除这种模糊性，而整流流（rectified flow）虽能通过迭代将噪声变换为降水场，但减少采样步数会加速生成的同时使集合成员过于相似，从而低估不确定性。

Method: 提出一种尺度递归整流流（scale-recursive rectified flow）：先生成大尺度降水格局，再生成局部细节；通过比较不同空间尺度上的集合变异性与预测误差来指导采样步数分配，并利用验证分数和降水功率谱约束该分配，以避免过度放大。

Result: 在美国本土的卫星到雷达降尺度任务中，分析发现大尺度降水格局是在缩减采样预算下集合变异性不足的主要来源。在固定架构和计算成本下，将更多步数分配给粗尺度流，提升了概率精度和降雨检测能力。与非递归流相比，该模型用更短采样时间即取得了更好的概率精度。

Conclusion: 按空间尺度递归生成并自适应分配采样步数，可有效缓解整流流在少步采样时集合多样性不足的问题，在固定计算成本下提高降水降尺度的概率精度与检测性能，并优于使用更多步数的非递归流。

Abstract: Fine-resolution precipitation estimates support flood risk assessment and water management, but coarse satellite products cannot resolve rainfall within each grid cell. Generative models address this ambiguity by producing ensembles of plausible high-resolution rainfall fields. Among these models, rectified flows generate samples by iteratively transforming random noise into rainfall fields. Reducing the number of sampling steps accelerates generation but can make ensemble members too similar, understating uncertainty. We propose a scale-recursive rectified flow that generates broad patterns before local details and guides sampling-step allocation by comparing ensemble variability with prediction error across spatial scales. Validation scores and rainfall power spectra constrain the allocation to avoid excessive amplification. In satellite-to-radar downscaling over the contiguous United States, our analysis identified broad rainfall patterns as the main source of insufficient ensemble variability under reduced sampling budgets. Allocating more steps to the coarse flow improved probabilistic accuracy and rain detection across training seeds at fixed architecture and computational cost. The proposed model also achieved better probabilistic accuracy with shorter sampling time than a nonrecursive flow using more steps.

</details>


### [167] [Adaptive Second-Order Solvers for Fast Stochastic Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03034)
*Ella Kemperman,Luca Ambrogioni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将比例-积分（PI）步长控制引入扩散采样，配合噪声归一化误差估计器，提出PI自适应求解器与固定调度方案，在图像和语言扩散上以低NFE获得更优质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型依赖时间离散化数值求解，离散化选择直接影响采样成本与质量的权衡。反向过程的计算难度沿轨迹和数据分布变化，因此最优离散化是问题依赖的，现有自适应方法仅响应当前误差。

Method: 将比例-积分（PI）步长控制用于扩散采样，基于自研的扩散噪声归一化误差估计器；PI同时纳入当前误差与前一误差，使步长调整更平滑。进一步发现各样本轨迹具有共享结构，可聚合为固定调度，保留自适应采样的大部分收益。

Result: 在自然图像与语言数据集上以匹配NFE下的FID/困惑度评估：图像上固定离散配随机Heun优于EDM调度，低NFE时配EDM-churn亦优；PI自适应FID优于多数随机与自适应基线，但低NFE不及EDM-churn。语言扩散上低至中等NFE困惑度优于EDM与熵调度，但token熵较低。逐样本自适应性收益问题依赖：1D玩具显著，图像与语言仅边际，有时平均调度甚至更优。

Conclusion: PI步长控制能产生更平滑的离散化并提升低NFE采样质量；单样本轨迹的共享结构使固定调度成为高效替代。逐样本自适应的价值高度依赖问题，在真实高维数据上收益有限。

Abstract: Diffusion models rely on numerical solvers requiring time-discretization, which has a large influence on the tradeoff between sampling cost and quality. However, the computational difficulty of the reverse process varies along the sampling trajectory and across data distributions, making the choice of discretization important. We adapt proportional-integral (PI) step-size control to diffusion, using our diffusion noise-normalised error estimator. Unlike existing adaptive methods in diffusion that respond only to the current error, the PI solver also incorporates the previous error, yielding smoother step adaptation. We further show that these per-sample trajectories exhibit shared structure and can be aggregated into a fixed schedule that retains much of the benefit of adaptive sampling. We evaluate both approaches on natural-image and language datasets, in terms of quality, measured by FID at a matched number of neural network evaluations (NFE), comparing them with widely used stochastic solvers and schedules. For images, our fixed discretization outperforms the commonly used EDM schedule in terms of sample quality when used with the stochastic Heun sampler, and with the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Additionally, our PI adaptive solver obtains better FID than most stochastic and adaptive baselines, although it does not beat the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Moreover, we find our solver outperforms both the EDM and the entropy schedule on language diffusion at low-to-medium NFE in terms of perplexity, with the drawback of lower token entropy. Lastly, we find that the benefit of per-sample adaptivity is problem-dependent. It is highly beneficial in 1D toy examples, while only marginal for image and language data, where the average schedule sometimes even outperforms the PI-adaptive solver. Code is available at https://github.com/ellakemperman/adaptive-second-order-diffusion-solvers

</details>


### [168] [WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03036)
*Jiangang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 WebFovea——一个基于视觉的 Web 智能体，在 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 中获得第二名（57.0/100）。其核心观点是：强大多模态大模型是必要条件但非充分条件，真正的瓶颈在于"模型与页面之间的 harness"。作者提出"四阶段"分析框架，并通过对每一阶段的加固将隐藏集分数从 31.0 提升到 57.0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在真实网站上进行端到端 Web 任务时，很多失败并非源于模型推理能力不足，而是发生在模型决策传递到浏览器的中间环节（即 harness）。作者希望通过定位这些工程性失败点，说明即使用同一模型，harness 的改进也能带来显著性能提升，从而把研究焦点从"换更强的模型"转向"修好模型与页面之间的管道"。

Method: 1. 任务设定：遵循 WebRetriever benchmark 的 Protocol III，从活网站的入口 URL 出发，操作站点自身界面并返回可验证答案。
2. 四阶段框架：每一步都必须满足——模型回复被正确解析为意图动作、动作在页面上生效、结果被准确回传、模型被展示所需信息。
3. 针对四阶段逐项加固：修正坐标空间错配（曾导致每次点击落在目标坐标的 3/4 处）、修复原生下拉框/iframe/文本框中的静默失败、清除污染 4.9% 任务回合的自生成 chat-template token。
4. 在循环外增加 guardrails，使智能体遵守规则与预算约束。
5. 采用控制变量：四次提交使用同一模型，以隔离 harness 改动的贡献。

Result: 官方隐藏集分数从 31.0 提升至 57.0，最终成绩 57.0/100，位列 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 第二名。由于四次提交模型相同，该提升可归因于 harness 的改动（叠加活网站上的运行间波动）。论文同时报告了各组件证据（含负面结果）、失败分析与局限性。

Conclusion: Web 智能体的性能瓶颈常位于模型与页面之间的 harness，而非模型推理本身；四阶段分析视角不依赖于具体模型（部分单独修复则依赖）。未来路线图包括将不同步骤路由到不同模型。

Abstract: We present WebFovea, a vision-based web agent that placed 2nd in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026 with a final score of 57.0 out of 100. The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer. A capable multimodal large language model (LLM) is necessary for this, but not sufficient. The model's decisions reach the browser through the harness, the code between the model and the page. At every step, four things must go right: the model's reply must be parsed into the intended action, the action must take effect on the page, the result must be reported back accurately, and the model must be shown the information it needs. On real websites, many of the failures we observed occurred at one of these four stages rather than in the model's reasoning. A coordinate-space mismatch placed every click at 3/4 of its intended coordinates; actions on native dropdowns, inside iframes, and in text boxes failed silently; and self-generated chat-template tokens contaminated 4.9% of task episodes. WebFovea hardens each stage and surrounds the loop with guardrails that keep the agent within the rules and its budget. The four-stage view does not depend on the model, although some individual fixes do. Because we used the same model in all four submissions, the rise of our official hidden-set score from 31.0 to 57.0 reflects changes to the harness, up to run-to-run variance on live sites. We describe the design, the evidence for each component (including negative results), a failure analysis, the limitations, and a roadmap that includes routing different steps to different models.

</details>


### [169] [What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713)
*Nishit Anand,Ramani Duraiswami,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张持续世界模型不应沿用"遗忘即失败"的持续学习惯例，而应按不变性时间尺度分层保持知识，并提出 differential retention 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习通常将旧数据性能下降视为失败，这一惯例源自预测目标平稳、标签永久正确的设定。但世界模型的预测目标是会变化的环境，过去正确的知识可能变为错误，丢弃它是必要行为而非缺陷。这一非平稳真值问题在概念漂移与语言模型时序事实性中已有研究，却尚未在世界模型中被形式化，而世界模型的独特之处在于它同时编码了"永不可修改"的知识。

Method: 将世界模型知识按不变性时间尺度分层：物理规律、客体永久性等不变量永不可修改；实例级事实应在环境变化后立即修正。据此提出 differential retention 评估方式：在适应流上同时报告不变量回归测试与修正延迟，且不做聚合。

Result: 现有标准遗忘指标无法区分"正确修正过时知识的世界模型"与"发生灾难性遗忘的世界模型"，因而会把冻结模型排在最高位；而现有物理推理基准也只评测冻结的检查点，无法揭示上述差异。

Conclusion: 持续世界模型需要按不变性时间尺度分层的保持机制，并应采用 differential retention 这类不聚合、双维度（不变量回归与修正延迟）的评估范式，以替代传统遗忘度量与冻结检查点基准。

Abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

</details>


### [170] [A Manifold-Aware Topic Modeling Approach via Rank-Based Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.29630)
*Thiago César Castilho Almeida,Daniel Carlos Guimarães Pedronette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MARETopic是一种免训练的主题发现框架，将主题发现建模为基于排序的原型选择，直接从语料中选出K个示例文档作为主题代表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主题模型虽引入预训练词向量，但神经架构产生的潜在表示缺乏对具体文本的锚定；基于聚类的流程仅在事后分配代表文档，并依赖在高维空间中被hubness和各向异性扭曲的绝对距离。

Method: MARETopic将嵌入投影到低维流形后构建编码序数邻域结构的排序列表，用贪心算法选出恰好K个真实语料示例文档，使其邻域覆盖整个语料。两个变体共享该准则：MARETopic_Corr用查询性能预测器和排名相关性度量对候选评分；MARETopic_Diff用基于排序的扩散矩阵评分，无需上述度量。另引入主题间最大边际相关性（MMR）步骤提升词汇多样性。

Result: MARETopic_Corr在类别最多的两个基准上取得领先的Purity和NMI，超越神经与聚类类主题模型；MARETopic_Diff无需度量且速度快1.7至1.9倍；在无任何梯度更新下，MARETopic在两个（三个中）数据集上主题连贯性领先；MMR步骤以极小连贯性代价提升词汇多样性。

Conclusion: MARETopic以免训练、基于排序的原型选择替代事后聚类分配，避免了高维绝对距离失真，在主题质量与效率上均具竞争力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent topic models leverage pretrained embeddings, but neural architectures produce latent representations without grounding in specific texts, and clustering-based pipelines assign representative documents only post hoc, relying on absolute distances distorted by hubness and anisotropy in high-dimensional spaces. We introduce MARETopic, a training-free framework that casts topic discovery as rank-based prototype selection. After projecting embeddings onto a low-dimensional manifold, MARETopic builds ranked lists encoding ordinal neighborhood structure. A greedy algorithm selects exactly K exemplar documents, real corpus texts, whose neighborhoods cover the corpus. Two variants share this criterion. MARETopic$_\text{Corr}$ scores candidates with a query performance predictor and a rank correlation measure, leading Purity and NMI on the two benchmarks with the most categories, ahead of both neural and clustering-based topic models. MARETopic$_\text{Diff}$ scores them with a rank-based diffusion matrix, needs neither measure, and runs 1.7 to 1.9 times faster. Without a single gradient update, MARETopic leads topic coherence on two of three datasets. A novel inter-topic Maximal Marginal Relevance step raises vocabulary diversity at little cost in coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/thcastilho/maretopic.

</details>


### [171] [Temporal Geometry of Deep Networks: Hyperbolic Representations of Training Dynamics for Intrinsic Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03000)
*Ambarish Moharil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种几何与时序图元学习框架，将MLP训练过程中的参数快照构建为时序参数图，并嵌入双曲庞加莱球以获得动态双曲表示，从而实现内在可解释性并揭示网络自组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在可解释性仍是难题，尤其在多层感知机需在优化环境中动态重训练的场合。现有基于度量的可解释性方法仅关注单一检查点，忽略了训练轨迹中同样承载的信息。作者认为神经网络不仅在权重中编码信息，也在训练过程中留下的轨迹中编码信息。

Method: 构建时序参数图，即对MLP优化/训练过程按时间T步采样得到的快照序列。借鉴复杂网络可嵌入隐度量空间（距离对应连接概率）的思想，将时序参数图嵌入双曲几何的庞加莱模型球中。学习过程中保持快照内神经元置换的等变性以及对过去快照置换的不变性，从而维持功能等价性并恢复网络潜在的演化几何。

Result: 在回归与分类任务上，使用已训练MLP进行实验，元网络表现出强劲性能，并伴随产生双曲时序表示。

Conclusion: 该方法揭示了网络结构在特定训练环境下如何随时间涌现，为理解网络的自组织提供了新的几何与时序视角，推动了内在可解释性研究。

Abstract: Intrinsic explainability remains a challenging problem, particularly in contexts where multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) require dynamic re-training within an optimization environment. This paper investigates how MLPs and their training dynamics can be represented and studied in non-Euclidean spaces; our representation features the Poincaré model of hyperbolic geometry. We aim to capture the geometric evolution of their weighted topology and self-organization over time. Instead of restricting the analysis to single checkpoints---as per established measure-based explainability methods---we construct temporal \textit{parameter graphs}, i.e., snapshots over time $T$ steps of the optimization/training process for MLPs. This reflects the view that neural networks encode information not only in their weights but also in the trajectory traced during training. Drawing on the idea that many complex networks admit embeddings in hidden metric spaces where distances correspond to connection likelihood, we present a geometric and temporal graph-based metalearning framework for obtaining dynamic hyperbolic representations of the underlying neural parameter graphs. Our model embeds temporal parameter graphs in the Poincaré model ball, and learns from them while maintaining equivariance to within-snapshot neuron permutations and invariance to permutations of past snapshots. In doing so, the approach preserves functional equivalence over time and recovers the latent evolving geometry of the network. Experiments on regression and classification tasks with trained MLPs show strong meta-network performance, accompanied by hyperbolic temporal representations. This reveals how the network structure emerges over time under specific training environments, thus providing insights into the network's self-organization.

</details>


### [172] [Co-design Gym: A Unified Benchmark for Embodiment-Policy Co-optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02366)
*Aviraj Newatia,Yordan Tsvetkov,Leonard Pleiss,Andrew Spielberg,Rika Antonova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-Design Gym，一个用于联合优化智能体形态（embodiment）与控制策略（policy）的基准环境套件，涵盖 10 类领域、20 个环境族、85+ 个共设计预设，并对代表性共设计算法进行系统评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习基准绝大多数假设智能体的形态（设计）固定，仅关注策略学习。然而形态与策略相互耦合：形态决定可发现的控制策略，而最优形态又由其所支持的最优策略定义。分离优化二者高度次优，因此需要面向"形态-策略联合优化"（co-design）的专门、系统化基准来推动可比、累积的研究进展。

Method: 构建 Co-Design Gym 基准套件，提供联合优化形态与策略的环境。环境覆盖机器人操作与运动、多机器人协作、可变形与软体动力学、视频游戏、电网、无线网络、F1 赛车、多智能体仓储以及最优控制等领域，共 20 个环境族、85+ 个共设计预设。基于该套件对代表性共设计算法开展系统性评估。

Result: 提出了一套大规模、多领域的形态-策略联合优化基准，包含 20 个环境族、超过 85 种共设计预设；并通过系统评估刻画了当前共设计算法的技术水平（state of the art）。

Conclusion: Co-Design Gym 为形态-策略联合优化问题提供了显式、系统且可比较的研究平台，为共设计领域的累积性、可比性进展奠定基础。

Abstract: Finding an optimal behaviour policy within a given environment is a widely studied problem in domains as diverse as games, robotics, energy infrastructure, communication networks, and multi-agent systems. Numerous benchmarks have been developed to support such research, but the vast majority assume that the agent's embodiment (design) is fixed, focusing instead on policy learning alone. Lifting this assumption gives rise to a broader class of problems in which optimizing embodiment and policy separately is highly suboptimal. An agent's embodiment strongly shapes which control policies can be discovered, while the optimal embodiment is in turn defined by the policies it admits. To help the research community study this class of problems explicitly and systematically, we introduce Co-Design Gym - a suite of benchmark environments for jointly optimizing embodiment and policy. Our environments span domains such as robotic manipulation and locomotion, multi-robot cooperation, deformable and soft dynamics, video games, electricity grids, wireless networks, F1 racing, multi-agent warehouses, and optimal control, offering 20 environment families (domains), with over 85 distinct co-design presets in total. We further contribute a systematic evaluation of representative co-design algorithms, characterizing the current state of the art. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for cumulative, comparable progress in co-design.

</details>


### [173] [Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients Stabilize Data-Scarce Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02505)
*Xinjie Liu,Ruihan Zhao,Anirban Chaudhuri,Cyrus Neary,Ufuk Topcu,David Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将多保真度策略梯度(MFPG)从REINFORCE扩展到现代actor-critic框架,提出MFPG-PPO及预算感知版本,通过重设计采样、优势估计与控制变量构造维持跨保真度相关性并抑制方差膨胀,在仿真机器人运动与真实Franka机械臂上实现了高保真数据高效且稳定的学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略梯度RL依赖昂贵且稀缺的目标域高保真(HF)数据,导致梯度估计噪声大、训练不稳定。低保真(LF)数据(如简化仿真器)廉价充足但有偏差;多数现有方法直接优化基于LF的有偏目标,会引入偏差。已有多保真策略梯度(MFPG)仅用LF构造控制变量以降低方差、不引入偏差,但仅限于REINFORCE与小规模仿真任务,未适配现代actor-critic。

Method: 1) 将MFPG扩展到GPU并行仿真的现代actor-critic学习;(2) 分析并指出朴素地将MFPG用于PPO会丢失跨保真度相关性或放大方差;据此设计MFPG-PPO,重新设计采样策略、优势估计与控制变量构造以保持跨保真度相关性,并通过监控估计器不确定性防止方差膨胀;3) 提出预算感知的MFPG-PPO,在固定的采样预算下在高保真与低保真数据源间进行分配。

Result: 在不同LF到HF迁移难度与HF数据预算的仿真机器人运动任务中,MFPG-PPO在几乎所有设置下优于仅用HF数据训练的PPO;在最难任务、最小HF预算下,其性能稳定匹敌使用16倍HF数据训练的PPO;而多数使用LF的基线仅在LF到HF直接迁移成功时表现良好。MFPG-PPO还支持在物理Franka机械臂上稳定学习,每次更新仅需4条真实机器人轨迹且无需人类示范。

Conclusion: MFPG-PPO为现代actor-critic提供了一种无偏、方差可控的多保真度策略梯度方法,显著提升HF数据效率与训练稳定性,并成功从仿真推广到真实机器人,验证了控制变量式LF利用与预算感知采样的有效性。

Abstract: Policy gradient methods for on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) can become unstable when expensive, scarce target-domain data yield noisy gradient estimates. We address this challenge by complementing limited high-fidelity (HF) target-domain data with abundant, cheap, but biased low-fidelity (LF) data, e.g., from a simplified simulator. Most existing methods directly optimize biased objectives based on LF data. In contrast, the recently introduced multi-fidelity policy gradient (MFPG) framework uses LF data solely to construct a control variate that reduces variance and improves HF data efficiency without biasing the policy gradient estimator. However, published work on MFPG is limited to REINFORCE on small-scale simulation tasks. We develop MFPG for modern actor-critic learning in GPU-parallel simulation and on a physical robot. Our analysis and experiments show that naive extensions to proximal policy optimization (PPO) can lose cross-fidelity correlation or inflate variance. Our MFPG-PPO addresses these failures by redesigning the sampling, advantage estimation, and control variate construction to preserve cross-fidelity correlation, and by monitoring estimator uncertainty to prevent variance inflation. We also introduce a budget-aware MFPG-PPO to divide a fixed sampling budget among high- and low-fidelity data sources. Across simulated robot locomotion tasks of varying LF-to-HF transfer difficulty and HF data budgets, MFPG-PPO improves upon PPO trained on HF data alone in nearly all settings, and consistently matches the performance of PPO trained with 16x more HF data on the hardest task at the smallest HF budgets. In contrast, most baselines that use LF data perform well only where direct LF-to-HF transfer succeeds. MFPG-PPO enables stable learning on a physical Franka arm using only 4 real-robot episodes per update and no human demonstrations.

</details>


### [174] [Test-time Multi-agent Coordination by Decomposed Value Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02554)
*Dongsu Lee,Haoran Xu,Amy Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCOUT 是首个将生成式基座模型与学习价值函数通过测试时动作精炼结合的离线 MARL 框架，用 Stein 变分梯度下降将行为样本输运至高价值区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线多智能体强化学习存在持续权衡：表达力强的生成式策略能刻画多模态协同，却无法辨别高价值区域；价值优化策略能利用学到的 Q 函数，却会坍缩为单一主导模态。单智能体模态坍缩会破坏联合协同，多智能体同时漂移则会把联合策略推入未见动作空间。

Method: 提出 SCOUT：训练两个解耦组件——流匹配行为先验与分解式价值函数；测试时通过 Stein 变分梯度下降将行为样本输运至高价值区域。输运步数控制自适应测试时缩放，取代固定正则化系数。在 IGM 原则下证明联合软价值差的单项 KL 界，该界随输运收敛而消失，残余不可约加性项与 IGM 违背程度成正比。

Result: 在离散与连续离线 MARL 基准上取得最佳平均性能，并在所有离线到在线配置中均有性能提升。

Conclusion: SCOUT 通过测试时输运精炼统一了生成式表达能力与价值优化，理论上给出收敛性保证，实验上在离线及离线到在线场景均一致优于基线。

Abstract: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces a persistent trade-off. Expressive generative policies can represent multi-modal coordination in the data, but cannot distinguish high-value regions, while value-optimized policies exploit the learned Q-function but collapse the multi-modal into a single dominant mode. A single agent's mode collapse can break joint coordination, and simultaneous drift across agents can push the joint policy into unseen regions of the action space. We propose scalable coordination via optimal unified transport (SCOUT), the first offline MARL framework to combine a generative foundation model with a learned value function through test-time action refinement. SCOUT trains two decoupled components: a flow-matching behavioral prior and a decomposed value function. At test-time, it transports behavioral samples toward high-value regions via Stein variational gradient descent. The number of transport steps controls adaptive test-time scaling, replacing a fixed regularization coefficient. Under the individual-global-max (IGM) principle, we prove a single-term KL bound on the joint soft-value gap that vanishes as transport converges, with an irreducible additive residual proportional to the IGM violation. Empirically, SCOUT achieves the best average performance across discrete and continuous offline MARL benchmarks and yields performance improvements in all offline-to-online configurations.

</details>


### [175] [Mind the Refinement Gap: When Safe High-Level Robot Plans Produce Unsafe Executions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02662)
*Stabak Das,Priyesh Ranjan,Xiangfang Li,Lijun Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计语言机器人系统中"轨迹完备性假设"：安全监控器所检查的高层动作序列是否真实反映执行中由导航和隐式动作效应产生的轨迹。以 RoboGuard 为对象，在相同 LTL 规约下比较其对表层计划与图精化轨迹的判定。28 个受控案例（5 类动作抽象族）加 14 个端到端案例（SPINE 由自然语言生成计划，RoboGuard 生成场景落地安全规约）显示：12 个目标抽象案例全部出现预测的表层—精化差异，16 个对照全部符合预期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言驱动的机器人系统常将语义图规划与时序逻辑安全监控器结合，但隐含一个"轨迹完备性假设"：监控器验证的高层动作序列被认为足以代表执行中实际发生的导航移动与隐式动作效应。若该假设不成立，安全监控器可能对真实执行轨迹给出错误的安全判定。本文旨在系统审计这一假设。

Method: 以 RoboGuard 为审计对象，在同一 LTL 规约下对比两套判定：一是对表层计划（surface plan）的监控结论，二是对图精化轨迹（graph-refined trace）的监控结论，从而检测二者是否出现差异。评估分两部分：28 个受控案例覆盖 5 类动作抽象族，其中 12 个为目标抽象案例、16 个为对照；14 个端到端案例中由 SPINE 依据自然语言指令生成计划，RoboGuard 生成场景落地的安全规约。

Result: 受控评估中，全部 12 个目标抽象案例均呈现预测的表层—精化判定差异；全部 16 个对照案例行为符合预期。该结果支持以基于图的轨迹精化作为轻量级缓解手段，并可作为物理 AI 安全监控器的诊断工具。

Conclusion: 轨迹完备性假设在涉及动作抽象的情形下并不普遍成立：监控器对表层计划的判定可能偏离执行中实际诱导的导航与隐式效应。基于图的轨迹精化既能缓解该问题，也有潜力充当物理 AI 安全监控器的诊断工具，值得进一步在端到端场景中验证。

Abstract: Language-enabled robot systems increasingly combine semantic-graph planning with temporal-logic safety monitors. We investigate a trace-completeness assumption in these systems: whether the high-level action sequence checked by a monitor represents the navigation and implicit action effects induced during execution. We audit this assumption in RoboGuard by comparing its verdict on a surface plan with its verdict on a graph-refined trace under the same Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) specification. Our evaluation comprises 28 controlled cases spanning five action-abstraction families and 14 end-to-end cases in which SPINE [1] generates plans from natural-language instructions while RoboGuard generates scene-grounded safety specifications. In the controlled evaluation, all 12 targeted abstraction cases exhibit the predicted surface-versus-refined discrepancy while all 16 controls behave as expected, motivating graph-based trace refinement as a lightweight mitigation and a diagnostic tool for physical-AI safety monitors.

</details>


### [176] [How to Find and Reuse Policies for Continuous Adaptation in Lifelong Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03119)
*Saptarshi Nath,Inish M. D'Souza,Antonio Carta,Soheil Kolouri,Andrea Soltoggio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AMSC 通过在线经验估计任务相似度，周期性地选择并加权已有策略以组成新任务的先验，在 CT-graph 与 MiniGrid 上取得更高的平均性能与前向迁移且无遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终身强化学习中，仅保留已学策略不足以有效迁移到新任务：有用知识可能分散在多个既有策略中，且其相关性会随学习经验而变化。作者假设任务相似度可用于持续学习场景，以寻找并组合先前学到的策略。

Method: 提出自适应掩码选择与组合（AMSC）：利用来自状态-动作-奖励样本的非参数 Wasserstein 任务嵌入，从在线经验中估计任务相似度；对相似度分数做 z-score 归一化后取 sparsemax，得到可变大小的支撑集，据此周期性地选择策略并加权，构成学习新任务时的先验。

Result: 在 CT-graph 与 MiniGrid 上，AMSC 的平均性能与前向迁移均高于所评估的模块化组合基线，且不产生遗忘。Continual World 上的结果表明，识别相关先验知识并确定其分层组合方式可能需要额外的分层调优。消融实验显示，选择相关来源与确定复用强度是性能提升的关键；独立测得的成对迁移与任务嵌入相似度呈正相关。

Conclusion: 任务相似度可作为终身强化学习中为复用而选择并加权特定知识的有效准则。

Abstract: In lifelong reinforcement learning, retaining previously learned policies is not sufficient for effective transfer to a new task. Useful knowledge may be distributed across several prior policies, and its relevance may change as the learner acquires experience. One hypothesis is that task similarity can be effectively used in a continual learning setting to find and combine previously learned policies. To test it, Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition (AMSC) is designed to estimate similarity from online experience via non-parametric Wasserstein task embeddings from state-action-reward samples. The z-score-normalized sparsemax of the similarity scores are used to derive a variable-size support to periodically choose and weight policies to form a prior when learning a new task. On CT-graph and MiniGrid, AMSC achieves higher mean performance and forward transfer than the evaluated modular composition baselines while exhibiting no forgetting. Results on Continual World suggest that identifying relevant prior knowledge and determining its layer-specific composition may require additional layer-specific tuning. Ablations show that selecting relevant sources and determining how strongly to reuse them are central to these gains. Independently measured pairwise transfer is also positively associated with task-embedding similarity. These results indicate that task similarity can be an effective criterion to select and weight specific knowledge for reuse in lifelong reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [177] [Bidirectional Voronoi-biased Exploration Curriculum for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03395)
*Juri Pfammatter,Kaixian Qu,Clemens Schwarke,Victor Klemm,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BVER——一种双向Voronoi偏置探索课程，从起点与目标两端同时扩展，用于稀疏奖励长时程目标条件强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程稀疏奖励任务中，从初始状态出发的策略难以到达目标，缺乏学习信号；参考动作、人工课程与塑形奖励需演示或任务特定设计，而自动课程多从单侧扩展，须独自跨越全部距离。

Method: 受双向RRT规划启发，BVER从目标端向外生长起点状态、从初始分布向外生长目标，将两者偏向未探索任务空间并相互引导，在两端数据上训练同一个目标条件策略。

Result: 在点质量迷宫、四足机器人攀箱、机械臂环-销转移任务上，BVER比所有对比的无参考课程学习更快；攀箱任务中约少65%迭代达到0.4 m箱95%成功率，是唯一学会攀爬0.7 m箱的方法，且策略对起点、目标与偏航变化鲁棒；无演示时在0.4 m箱与环-销任务上接近基于参考课程的样本效率。

Conclusion: 消融实验表明双向扩展优于任一单向扩展，BVER有效缓解长时程稀疏奖励探索瓶颈。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks with sparse rewards pose an exploration bottleneck for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning: a policy started from the initial state rarely reaches the goal and receives no learning signal. Reference motions, hand-designed curricula, and shaped rewards supply this signal but require demonstrations or task-specific engineering; automatic start-state and goal curricula avoid this but typically expand from one side only, so the full distance to the target must be covered from that side. We propose the Bidirectional Voronoi-biased Exploration curriculum for Reinforcement learning (BVER), which expands from both ends at once. Inspired by bidirectional RRT planning, BVER grows start states outward from the goal and goals outward from the initial state distribution, biases both toward unexplored task space, and steers them toward each other, training one goal-conditioned policy on both. On point-mass mazes, quadrupedal box climbing, and robot-arm ring-on-peg transfer, BVER learns faster than all compared reference-free curricula. On box climbing, it reaches 95% success on a 0.4 m box in roughly 65% fewer iterations than the best of them, is the only one of them to learn to climb a 0.7 m box, and yields a policy robust to start, goal, and yaw variation. Without a demonstration, it approaches the sample efficiency of reference-based curricula on the 0.4 m box and on ring-on-peg transfer. Ablations show that expanding from both ends outperforms either direction alone.

</details>


### [178] [UniIntervene++: An Adaptive Intervention Agent for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03620)
*Yudong Lin,Haoyuan Deng,Zhuoxuan Yuan,Zaijia Yang,Yuanjiang Xue,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 UniIntervene++，一种在线 RL 中的自适应干预智能体，统一建模"何时干预、如何干预、何时交还控制权"，在五项真实操作任务上平均成功率达 89.67%，人工干预降至 0.77%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线强化学习依赖物理交互提升机器人策略，但策略能力在不断演化，其所需的人类辅助程度也随之改变。基于离线估计或固定决策规则的现有干预策略会与当前策略能力失配，导致干预时机与方式不恰当。

Method: 将演化中的 RL 策略、轨迹纠正（trajectory correction）与任务结构化的 CodePolicy 统一建模为半马尔可夫决策过程（semi-MDP）中的 Options，并在线上学习其相对价值；在此基础上引入能力自适应干预（competence-adaptive intervention），通过无辅助执行周期性探测 RL 策略，使控制权分配随能力变化而调整；再通过耦合经验学习（coupled experience learning），让辅助行为改进 RL 策略，而策略演化结果反过来重塑后续干预决策，从而联合决定何时干预、如何干预以及何时交还控制。

Result: 在五个真实世界操作任务上，UniIntervene++ 平均成功率为 89.67%，比所有基线高出至少 6 个百分点；人工干预比例为 0.77%，相比最佳基线相对降低至少 94.6%。

Conclusion: UniIntervene++ 通过将异构辅助行为纳入统一的 Options 价值学习框架，并结合能力自适应探测与耦合经验学习，有效解决了干预策略与演化中 RL 策略失配的问题，在保证高任务成功率的同时大幅减少人类干预。

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables robot policies to improve through physical interaction, but the assistance they require changes as their competence evolves. Existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed decision rules can therefore become mismatched to the current policy. To address this, we propose UniIntervene++, an adaptive intervention agent that learns to allocate control between autonomous execution and heterogeneous assisted behaviors during online RL. Specifically, UniIntervene++ first formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process and learns their relative values online. Building on this, competence-adaptive intervention periodically probes the RL policy through unassisted execution, keeping control allocation responsive to its evolving capability. Finally, coupled experience learning allows assisted behaviors to improve the RL policy, whose evolving outcomes in turn reshape future intervention decisions. In this way, UniIntervene++ jointly determines when to intervene, how to intervene, and when to return control as the RL policy improves. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, UniIntervene++ achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points, while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}.

</details>


### [179] [Does Every User Need a Private LoRA? Decoupling Personalization from Per-User Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02353)
*Songyuan Sui,Srikanth Malla,Chiho Choi,Joon Hee Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LINEUP，将个性化能力分解可复用的共享低秩因子、用户条件召回与查询相关校准，并把每个目标用户的适配限制在8个标量上，在6个个性化任务12项指标上全部领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个人化LLM通常为每个用户维护完整的适配状态，随用户规模增长而难以扩展。作者从“个性化容量分配”视角重新审视该设计，探究可跨用户共享的适配容量有多少、共享容量应如何组成、以及多少必须保留为用户特定部分。

Method: 基于三项实证发现（独立用户适配器存在大量跨用户可复用结构；可复用方向的有效性取决于用户相关性与跨查询变化；用户历史提供可迁移信号用于紧凑个体校正），提出LINEUP：学习一组可复用低秩个性化因子库，通过用户条件召回与查询相关校准进行组合，并将目标用户适配限制为共享校正空间上的极小用户码；每个目标用户仅优化8个标量，共享组件保持冻结。

Result: 理论上给出有限步、有限历史的风险界以及用户码细化优于历史初始化的充分条件。在覆盖个性化分类、预测与生成的六个任务、12项指标上，LINEUP在三次独立运行均值均领先（如LaMP-3 RMSE相对最强基线降低11.4%），并在历史有限的条件下保持优势。对照的private-LoRA配置每用户需419万参数。

Conclusion: 丰富的个性化主要由可复用、条件组合的共享容量支撑，独立用户适配可被压缩为极小的校正状态，从而实现个性化能力与每用户可训练状态的解耦。

Abstract: Personalized large language models often require a complete adaptation state for each user. However, this paradigm scales poorly as the user population grows. We revisit this design through the lens of personalization capacity allocation: how much adaptation capacity can be shared across users, how the shared capacity should be composed, and how much must remain user-specific. We answer them through three complementary empirical analyses. We find that independent user adapters contain substantial cross-user reusable structure, that the utility of reusable directions reflects both user relevance and variation across queries, and that user histories provide transferable signals for compact individual correction. Motivated by these findings, we propose LINEUP. It learns a bank of reusable low-rank personalization factors, composes them through user-conditioned recall and query-dependent calibration, and restricts target-user adaptation to a tiny user code over a shared correction space. This design decouples expressive personalization capacity from per-user trainable state. Each target user optimizes only eight scalars, while all shared components remain fixed. By comparison, the evaluated private-LoRA configuration uses 4.19 million per-user parameters. Our theoretical analysis gives a finite-step, finite-history risk bound and sufficient conditions for user-code refinement to improve on history initialization. Across six tasks spanning personalized classification, prediction, and generation, LINEUP leads on all 12 metrics, each averaged over three independent runs (e.g., reducing LaMP-3 RMSE by 11.4% relative to the strongest baseline). It maintains advantages under limited history. These results show that rich personalization can be supported primarily by reusable, conditionally composed shared capacity, while independent user adaptation remains confined to a tiny correction state.

</details>


### [180] [Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02359)
*Doseok Jang,Jon Ander Campos,Youran Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出词典序多目标同策略蒸馏（LMOPD），用显式优先级整合多个奖励专家策略，在数学基准上比基线更有效地保留高优先级能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR通常只优化答案正确性，但有用的模型行为还需高质量推理与简洁回答。现有多奖励后训练方法多采用奖励标量化或专家拼接，未显式保护奖励优先级顺序；当权衡不对称时（如简洁性不应以牺牲正确性为代价）会产生问题。

Method: LMOPD是一种多教师方法：对每条学生 rollout，选择第一个被门控判定为存在缺陷的目标所对应的专家，再将其中心化 log-policy 修正进行局部投影，去除与更高优先级专家相冲突的分量。

Result: 在30B-A3B MoE Transformer、3个数学基准上评测。双专家设置下，点估计完整保留准确率与推理质量增益，并获得46.9%的简洁性增益；四专家设置下保留约90%的准确率增益与推理正确性增益，而次优基线仅约57%。四专家消融显示词典序路由优于随机路由，投影进一步强化最高优先级能力。

Conclusion: 在两个规模上，LMOPD比所评估的现有基线更有效地保留最高优先级能力，证明在专家整合中引入显式优先级的价值。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually optimizes answer correctness, yet useful language-model behavior also requires high-quality reasoning and concise responses. Existing multi-reward post-training methods typically scalarize rewards or combine specialists without explicitly protecting a reward priority order. This is problematic when trade-offs are asymmetric: conciseness, for example, should not improve at the cost of correctness. We introduce Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation (LMOPD), a multi-teacher method for integrating reward-specialized policies under explicit priorities. For each student rollout, LMOPD selects the specialist for the first objective whose gate detects a deficiency, then locally projects its centered log-policy correction to remove components that oppose higher-priority specialists. We evaluate 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer models in two- and four-expert settings on three math benchmarks, measuring retained specialist gains. With two experts, LMOPD's point estimates fully retain the accuracy and reasoning-quality gains while acquiring $46.9\%$ of the conciseness gain. With four experts, it retains $\approx90\%$ of both the accuracy gain and reasoning-correctness gain, compared to only $\approx57\%$ by the next best evaluated baseline. Matched four-expertablations show that lexicographic routing outperforms random routing and that projection further strengthens both top-priority capabilities. Across both scales, LMOPD preserves the highest-priority capabilities more effectively than the existing baselines we evaluate, demonstrating the value of explicit priorities for specialist integration.

</details>


### [181] [Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02391)
*Zeyong Zhang,Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Tengfei Ma,Mengjia Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双曲熵引导（HEST），在庞加莱球中嵌入隐状态，仅在下一词熵超阈值时沿测地线最陡下降方向修正隐状态，用Busemann读出时可提升数学推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法在每一个token处都加同一个固定的欧氏向量，但数学解题过程本质上是分层的树状结构，多数token已由上下文决定，只有少数高熵分支点才需要干预，均匀干预既冗余又可能有害。

Method: 用轻量探针把隐状态嵌入庞加莱球，探针的监督标签仅为模型自身的下一词熵；当熵超过阈值时，沿探针读出的最陡下降测地线移动嵌入状态，再映射回隐状态。理论上证明对学习到的理想点的Busemann读出，固定长度的一步在任意状态下都降低相同幅度。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math与Llama-3.1系列的三个指令微调模型上，使用Busemann读出的HEST在六个设置中的五个上提高了MATH-500和GSM8K的贪心准确率，最高提升1.8个点；而每token都加对比引导向量反而降低准确率。在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct上，同样训练的欧氏探针则没有这一增益。增益集中在模型频繁犹豫的问题上，其余问题准确率几乎不变。

Conclusion: 结果表明推理过程的树状结构更适合用双曲几何建模，基于熵阈值的稀疏、几何感知引导优于全token均匀欧氏干预，且增益来源确实依赖双曲表示而非探针训练方式。

Abstract: When a large language model solves a mathematical problem, its reasoning is largely hierarchical, and the solution often branches at a few tokens where the next-token entropy is high. Such tree-like structure embeds in hyperbolic space with far lower distortion than in Euclidean space. Activation steering, however, usually edits the hidden states of a pretrained model by adding one fixed Euclidean vector at every token, even though most tokens of a solution are already determined by the context. We propose Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST), which embeds the hidden states in the Poincaré ball with a lightweight probe whose only label is the model's own next-token entropy. Where this entropy exceeds a threshold, HEST moves the embedded state along the geodesic of steepest descent of a readout of the probe and maps the change back to the hidden state. For the Busemann readout of a learned ideal point, we prove that a step of fixed length lowers it by the same amount at every state. On three instruction-tuned models from the Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 families, HEST with the Busemann readout improves greedy accuracy on MATH-500 and GSM8K in five of six settings, by up to 1.8 points, whereas a contrastive steering vector added at every token lowers accuracy. With a Euclidean probe trained in the same way, this gain disappears on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct. The gains are largest on problems where the model hesitates often, and accuracy on the remaining problems is almost unchanged.

</details>


### [182] [Trained Agentic Context Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02404)
*Bryce Sandlund*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练一个仅含"自我调用"与"读取输入区间"两个工具的最简harness的模型，仅8K上下文即在OOLONG-synth超40K文档上匹敌1M上下文的GPT-5.4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文建模的主流做法要么原生训练长上下文，要么设计复杂的外部harness；前者成本高，后者工程复杂，作者希望用最简的递归工具增强方式获得长上下文能力。

Method: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，用极简harness微调：仅提供两个工具——以任意prompt自我调用、读取输入上下文中指定token区间；训练数据为多样化的合成数据集。

Result: 在OOLONG-synth基准上，当文档长度超过40K token时，仅8K上下文的该小模型性能与拥有1M上下文的GPT-5.4相当。

Conclusion: 递归自我调用加区间读取的工具化harness，能以极小的上下文窗口实现高效长上下文能力，是原生长上下文训练与复杂harness之外的一条低成本替代路径。

Abstract: We study long context language models. Instead of training long context natively, or designing a long context harness, we train a model over the simplest possible harness: a tool to call itself with any specified prompt and a tool to read tokens in a range from the input context. We finetune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a diverse synthetic dataset using this harness. With only 8,000 tokens of context, our small model is as strong as GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on the OOLONG-synth benchmark when document length exceeds 40K tokens.

</details>


### [183] [Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02438)
*Nickil Maveli,Antonio Vergari,Shay B. Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出将知名算法的代码生成重新定义为"参数化代码检索"，并发布AlgoREval基准（599题、77种经典算法、14领域、7语言、4种图输入表示），对15个模型进行零样本评测，揭示跨语言与输入表示的检索差异，并对比提示增强、SFT与GRPO的改进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码生成流程不透明，未显式区分"召回算法知识"与"推理如何应用"两个环节。作者主张：对规范实现已广泛存在于预训练语料中的知名算法，代码生成更应被视为参数化代码检索（从内部知识复现命名算法），而非合成新算法。因此需要一个能隔离测量该能力的基准，并警示无系统验证地部署AI生成算法代码的风险。

Method: 构建AlgoREval基准：599道题，覆盖14个领域的77种经典算法、7种编程语言、4种图输入表示。在零样本设定下评测15个模型（7B–34B参数）。此外考察三类改进手段：检索代码片段或结构化算法提示的提示增强、监督微调（SFT）、以及GRPO强化学习，比较其增益模式。

Result: 即便对文档充分的算法，检索准确率在不同编程语言与图输入表示间也存在显著差异。提示增强（检索代码片段/结构化算法提示）对复杂算法的准确率提升明显；SFT带来更广泛的语言层面增益；GRPO在特定语言上取得更大的单语言增益。

Conclusion: 参数化代码检索是一种独立且可测量的能力。研究结果不支持在缺乏系统验证的情况下部署AI生成的算法代码。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in code generation, where success depends on both recalling relevant algorithmic knowledge and reasoning about how to apply it. However, existing LLM pipelines are opaque, with no explicit separation between these two components. We argue that for well-known algorithms whose canonical implementations are widely accessible in pretraining corpora, code generation is better measured as \textit{parametric code retrieval}: reproducing a named algorithm from internalised knowledge rather than synthesizing a novel one. We introduce AlgoREval, a benchmark of 599 problems spanning classical 77 algorithms across 14 domains, 7 programming languages, and 4 graph-input representations to evaluate this capability in isolation, and assess 15 models (7B--34B parameters) in a zero-shot setting. We find substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms and show that prompt augmentation with retrieved code snippets or structured algorithmic hints improve accuracy on complex algorithms, while SFT achieves broader language gains and GRPO achieves larger per-language gains on specific languages. Together, our results establish parametric code retrieval as a distinct, measurable capability and caution against deploying AI-generated algorithmic code without systematic validation.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Nickil21/AlgoREval

</details>


### [184] [Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02462)
*Xueqi Cheng,Liang Wu,Kelly Wan,Liangjie Hong,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究LLM压缩（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）的能力下降标度律，建立可预测能力损失的简单关系，并评估其在压缩方法选择中的决策价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM压缩可降低推理成本与内存需求，但方法及配置选择高度依赖经验，因为相近的资源削减可能带来不同的能力损失，缺乏可预测的规律指导选型。

Method: 构建统一框架，在数学、代码生成、问答任务上测量能力损失，并关联模型规模、训练阶段、压缩设置、数据可用性与训练曝光；拟合简单预测关系，检验其精度、测量效率及对未见配置与模型状态的泛化；另做受控蒸馏实验与数值选择决策价值评估。

Result: 在剪枝层级间共享密度响应可将拟合剪枝预测器所需配置测量减半；在新Pythia状态、预注册OLMo-2测试状态及Wanda剪枝下，紧凑关系与全量测量的回归在数学与代码上误差不超过0.020 nats/token（系数按设置重拟合）；蒸馏中大量数据复用的代价在问答分布间反复出现，净收益取决于评估分布；跨两个模型家族的独立评估表明，选择可捕获问答任务大部分跨方法收益，固定方法优先级达到相同regret，而数学与代码机会较小。

Conclusion: 研究明确了能力下降标度律的预测范围及其在压缩方法选择中的适用性，并公开代码。

Abstract: LLM compression reduces inference costs and memory requirements, but selecting a method and configuration remains largely empirical because comparable resource reductions can produce different capability losses. We systematically investigate capability scaling-down laws for LLM compression across pruning, quantization, and distillation. Our framework measures capability loss in mathematics, code generation, and question answering, and relates these measurements to model size, training stage, compression settings, data availability, and training exposure. We develop simple predictive relations and evaluate their accuracy, measurement efficiency, and generalization to unseen configurations and model states. Sharing the density response across pruning levels halves the configuration measurements needed to fit a pruning predictor: on new Pythia states, on pre-registered OLMo-2 test states and under Wanda pruning, the compact relation matches a regression fitted with all measurements on math and code to within 0.020 nats per token, with coefficients refitted for each setting. Controlled distillation experiments show that the cost of heavy data reuse recurs across question-answering distributions, while the net benefit depends on the evaluation distribution. We further evaluate the decision value of these predictions by comparing numerical selection with configuration medians and fixed method priorities. Independent evaluations across two model families show that selection captures most of the available cross-method benefit for question answering within the tested candidate sets, where a fixed method priority attains the same regret, with smaller opportunities for mathematics and code. These results clarify the predictive scope of capability scaling-down laws and their use in compression method selection. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law.

</details>


### [185] [How Causality Bridges the Semantic Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02594)
*Shuhao Zhang,Xuran Zhou,Han Guo,Pengtao Xie,Yujia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结构约束的语义对齐问题及CausalBridge框架：从测量数据中发现含潜变量的因果图，在因果依赖关系约束下求解未命名变量的嵌入（以少量已知名称作为锚点），再用语言模型将嵌入表达为名称。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值测量能刻画系统行为，却常使变量含义不明：部分变量被测量但未标注，另一些完全未被测量。现有方法依赖通用人类知识为这类变量赋予语义，这既会继承人类知识中已有的偏见，又在其缺失之处无能为力。因此需要一个不受人类知识偏见影响的语义来源。

Method: 将问题形式化为结构约束的语义对齐（structure-constrained semantic alignment）：在因果图所蕴含的依赖关系下求解每个未命名变量的嵌入，并以少数已知名称为锚点。据此构建CausalBridge框架：(1) 仅从测量数据中发现因果图（含潜变量）；(2) 在这些依赖关系约束下求解嵌入；(3) 通过语言模型将嵌入表达为名称。

Result: 在5个问卷和3个机器人场景上评估，变量名被遮蔽20%至90%。CausalBridge对观测变量与潜变量语义的恢复精度优于依赖关联的现有方法，且系统被记录得越少其领先优势越大。其发现的因果图给出的变量命名精度与已记录的因果图相当；对新系统可在数分钟内完成命名，成本仅为采样方法的一小部分。

Conclusion: 因果结构反映了生成测量数据的机制，且仅从测量数据本身即可恢复，因而可能是唯一不受人类知识偏见影响的信息来源。一旦语义鸿沟被忠实弥合，机器便能以因果方式理解世界并采取行动。

Abstract: Numerical measurements capture how a system behaves, but often leave the meanings of its variables unspecified. Some variables are measured but never labeled, and others are never measured at all. Existing methods assign semantics to such variables by consulting general human knowledge, but this inherits its biases where that knowledge exists and offers nothing where it does not. We bridge this gap between measurements and their meanings with causal structure instead, reading a variable's semantics from how it acts on other variables. We formalize this as structure-constrained semantic alignment, in which the embedding of each unnamed variable is solved under the dependence relations implied by the causal graph, with the embeddings of a few known names as anchors. Accordingly, we build CausalBridge, a framework that discovers the causal graph from the measurements, latent variables included, solves for the embeddings under those relations, and expresses them as names through a language model. The causal structure reflects the mechanism that generated the measurements and is recovered from the measurements alone, which may make it the one source of information free of bias from human knowledge. We evaluate CausalBridge on five questionnaires and three robotics scenarios, with 20 to 90% of the variable names masked. It recovers the semantics of observed and latent variables more accurately than existing methods that rely on association, and its lead widens as less of the system is documented. The graph it discovers names variables as accurately as the documented one, and a new system is named in minutes and at a fraction of the cost of sampling methods. Once the semantic gap is bridged faithfully, machines can understand the world and take actions causally.

</details>


### [186] [LEAP: Learning Efficient Action Proposals For LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02670)
*Zhen Xu,Qizheng Zhang,Gerry Wan,Shang Zhu,Ce Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出延迟框架分析动作推测（action speculation）的端到端加速来源，并据此设计 LEAP，通过用目标模型的动作序列训练小型 drafter，在保持任务成功率的同时将 agent 端到端墙钟时间最高缩短 60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 逐步骤串行执行，推理与动作选择无法并行，rollout 速度慢。现有动作推测方法依赖现成模型作 drafter：大模型匹配率高但耗时长，小模型快但决策与目标一致性差。作者因此追问：动作推测端到端加速的决定因素究竟是什么。

Method: 建立推测轮次（speculative round）的延迟框架，将收益（drafter 对目标的预测准确度、任务可执行步数）与成本（drafting 开销、等待目标验证、工具执行）进行对比。在该框架指导下提出 LEAP：保持 drafter 规模小（0.6B），但用目标模型的动作序列对其训练以提升准确性；并支持无需预先轨迹收集的在线训练。

Result: 0.6B 的 LEAP 在多数决策上与目标模型一致，使 agent 端到端墙钟时间最高加速 60%，任务成功率无系统性变化。在多种数据集、目标模型与 draft 模型上，该框架能解释大部分实测加速。在线训练可达到与离线训练相当的性能。

Conclusion: 动作推测的加速效果由预测准确度、任务步数与各项延迟成本的权衡决定；训练小型专用 drafter 比直接使用现成大模型更有效，且在线训练使 LEAP 具备实际部署可行性。

Abstract: LLM agents are known to be slow in rollouts. An agent completes a task one step at a time. At each step, it reasons and then chooses an action to execute. The next step and action cannot start until the previous one has finished. Speculative decoding accelerates the rollouts at the reason phase by drafting and verifying the inference tokens. Recent works have also started to apply similar ideas at the action phase. These works use off-the-shelf models, usually large, to draft action proposals for target model to verify. Large drafters match the target more often but take longer to propose, while small off-the-shelf models are fast but rarely make the same decision as the target. We ask a more general question: what determines the end-to-end speedup of action speculation? To answer it, we develop a latency framework for the speculative round. The framework compares what a round gains with what it costs. The gain depends on how well the drafter predicts the target and on how many steps the task can take before it ends. The cost comes from drafting, from waiting for target verification and from executing tools. Guided by the framework, we introduce LEAP (Learning Efficient Action Proposals) which keeps the drafter small and makes it accurate by training it on the target actions sequences. With a small 0.6B model, LEAP agrees with the target on most decisions and makes agents up to 60% faster in end-to-end wall clock time, with no systematic change in task success. Across various datasets, target models and draft models, the framework accounts for most of the measured speedups. We also show the draft model can be online trained with no prior trace collection and match the performance of offline training, making LEAP practical to deploy in the real world.

</details>


### [187] [Learning from Evolving Errors: Adaptive Iterative Repair for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02700)
*Rui Li,Liyang He,Zheng Zhang,Zhenya Huang,Linbo Zhu,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 AIR-OPD，一种面向在线策略自蒸馏的自适应迭代修复框架，通过生成“错误到修复”的引导监督，缓解解条件捷径问题，并在数学推理任务上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）在从学生自身策略采样的轨迹上提供密集的 token 级反馈，信号比强化学习的结果级奖励更丰富。但该反馈来自一个以完整参考解为条件的教师，而学生无法获得参考解。参考解只指明目标，却不说明如何从学生当前错误走向目标，由此产生“解条件捷径风险”（solution-conditioned shortcut risk），即学生可能直接模仿参考答案而缺乏真正的纠错能力。

Method: 提出 AIR-OPD（自适应迭代修复的在线策略蒸馏框架）。给定失败回答，由引导生成器针对当前错误合成修复引导；学生在该引导下进行在线策略重试；若重试仍错误，则生成器针对新出现的错误再生成新引导。每一轮中，固定教师以该引导作为特权上下文，对学生最新失败回答中与错误对齐的区域进行监督。同时采用结果感知的阶段加权（outcome-aware stage weighting），偏向早期修复阶段，并对立即重试通过验证的阶段给予更高权重。研究了两类引导来源：来自当前学生策略的自引导与来自更大模型的外部引导。

Result: 在 DAPO-Math-17K 上训练，于 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 以及分布外的 MMLU-Pro、GPQA 上评测。对 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 两个模型，AIR-OPD 均取得最优的数学推理平均成绩，较最强基线最高提升 3.6 分，同时在分布外基准上保持基座模型性能。

Conclusion: AIR-OPD 通过错误到修复的迭代引导监督，有效缓解了在线策略自蒸馏中的解条件捷径问题，在提升数学推理能力的同时不损害分布外泛化性能，验证了自适应迭代修复框架与结果感知阶段加权的有效性。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies dense token-level feedback on trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, a richer training signal than the outcome-level rewards of reinforcement learning. This feedback comes from a teacher conditioned on a full reference solution unavailable to the student. The reference solution specifies the target but not how to move from the student's current error toward it, creating a solution-conditioned shortcut risk. We introduce AIR-OPD, an adaptive iterative repair framework for on-policy distillation that provides error-to-repair supervision. Given a failed response, a guidance generator synthesizes repair guidance for the current error. The student samples an on-policy retry with this guidance. If the retry remains incorrect, the generator produces new repair guidance for the newly observed error. At each round, a fixed teacher receives the guidance as privileged context and supervises the student on an error-aligned region of its latest failed response. Outcome-aware stage weighting favors early repair stages and credits stages whose immediate retry passes verification. We train AIR-OPD on the DAPO-Math-17K dataset and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, alongside out-of-distribution tests on MMLU-Pro and GPQA. We examine two guidance sources, self-guidance from the current student policy and external guidance from a larger model. For both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, AIR-OPD attains the best mathematical-reasoning averages, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.6 points, while preserving base-model performance on the out-of-distribution benchmarks.

</details>


### [188] [OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02781)
*Xinpeng Wang,Wei Shi,Yu-Chia Chen,Maria Zontak,Yun He,Richard Yuanzhe Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架：先用评分标准作为特权上下文做在线策略蒸馏（RP-OPD），再用评分标准作奖励进行强化学习，在健康与科学任务上取得最优成绩并抑制奖励黑客。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式回复无法用精确结果验证，评分标准（rubric）强化学习虽能对开放回复打分，但奖励在完整回复后才给出，无法直接指出哪些具体决策贡献了最终分数，训练信号缺乏 token 级定位能力。

Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段为评分标准特权在线策略蒸馏（RP-OPD），教师在可访问 rubric 的条件下，于学生自生成前缀上与学生（无 rubric 访问）对齐下一 token 分布，提供密集 token 级监督；第二阶段用 rubric 奖励进行 RL，突破蒸馏平台期。

Result: 在 HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science 上，用开源权重模型比较多种后训练方法并变化 RL 前的 SFT 或 RP-OPD 训练量，两阶段框架得分最高；RP-OPD+RL 在 RubricHub Science 上奖励黑客迹象有限，而 SFT+RL 基线越来越多地靠"声称符合评分标准"而无实际内容获得高奖励。

Conclusion: 支持在应用基于评分标准的 RL 之前，先用评分标准引导在线策略蒸馏，以提供密集 token 级监督并缓解奖励黑客。

Abstract: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.

</details>


### [189] [To Explore The Strange New World Beyond Data Distribution: System Behavior, Causality Tax, and Non-causal Base Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02839)
*Xianzhi Zeng,Jiangneng Li,Gao Cong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出SBD框架，将系统行为$S$作为ELBO中不可约组分，揭示因果性可能并非必要或最优，并通过Green Shell非因果变分族显著降低"因果税"、提升误差界与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型普遍以因果性为事实上的架构基础，但近期研究显示其与因果性存在持续的不匹配与矛盾；这些问题的根源主要在于系统行为$S$（数据空间之外的耦合主导因素），而非数据分布本身。因此作者质疑因果性对LM的必要性与最优性，尝试将系统行为纳入第一性原理建模。

Method: 提出SBD框架，将系统行为$S$作为证据下界（ELBO）的不可约组分加以建模；理论上推导出反直觉的"因果税"（Causality Tax）现象，说明忽略$S$时因果性沦为带额外结构误差的次优近似。针对潜变量分析难题，采用隐式测量、理论界引导的控制实验以及神经正切核（NTK）评估来验证SBD对$S$影响的预测。进一步构造Green Shell（GSH）——一种非因果变分族，用分治划分替代$S$组分的序列依赖链。

Result: 在惰性训练（lazy-training）区制下的NTK谱分析表明，GSH始终取得比因果性显著更紧的误差界，信噪比提升达$7dB$以上；在惰性训练相对后期，GSH进一步带来更优泛化，多尺度拟合能力提升达$20\%$。

Conclusion: SBD将系统行为确立为独立于因果性和分布拟合的互补理论抽象，论证了因果性对LM既非必要也非最优，为LM基座模型的设计与优化开辟了新研究方向。

Abstract: We show that the causality of language models (LMs) may not be necessary nor optimal. This is the case when system behavior (denoted as $S$) is incorporated as a first-principle Bayesian feature. Here, $S$ refers to extra dominant factors beyond the data space, and they involve coupled effects. Despite being the de facto foundation of modern architecture, recent studies indicate persistent mismatches and contradictions with causality. These issues largely stem from system behavior rather than the data distribution. We therefore propose the SBD framework, which incorporates $S$ as an irreducible component of the evidence lower bound (ELBO). SBD theoretically reveals a counter-intuitive Causality Tax phenomenon, where causality emerges as a suboptimal approximation with an additional structural error, due to the obliviousness to $S$. To address the challenge of latent variable analysis, we validate the SBD-predicted impact of $S$ via implicit measurements, theoretical-bound-guided controls, and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluations. In particular, we construct Green Shell (GSH) to show the possibility of reducing Causality Tax. GSH is a non-causal variational family, and it replaces the sequential dependency chain of $S$ components with a divide-and-conquer partition. NTK spectra in the lazy-training regime confirm that GSH always achieves significantly tighter error bounds than causality, with $7dB+$ improvement in signal-to-noise ratio. In the relatively later stage of lazy-training, GSH further leads to superior generalization (up to $20\%$ richer multi-scale fitting capabilities). Taken together, SBD establishes system behavior as a complementary theoretical abstraction besides causality and distribution fitting, opening new research avenues such as designing and optimizing LM base models.

</details>


### [190] [Probe the Harness: Setup Checks for Stale-Data RL Comparisons in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02911)
*Taiheng Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，在过时样本上训练语言模型的方法比较极易受实验框架细节影响；作者提出 PTH（Probe The Harness）检查清单，揭示四个框架细节如何逆转 SAN 与 TIS 的排名，并在核查后得到更可靠的对比结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练语言模型处理过时样本的方法，通常通过与重要性校正基线对比来评判优劣，但这类比较默认实验框架本身无偏。作者认为框架实现中的隐性细节可能系统性地影响比较结果，因此需要一个使框架“可见”的检查方法，以避免误导性的方法排名。

Method: 作者以无行为方法 SAN 与截断重要性采样（TIS）为案例，在 verl 框架和单 GPU 训练器两种环境下进行比较。通过 PTH（Probe The Harness）的一组检查，逐项审查实验框架。结果显示四处细节改变了比较：PPO 比率使用学习器自身重算的概率；数据种子未传入 TIS 分支；回放队列连续 33 次更新复用首批数据；两个损失归一化器与其描述不符。作者给出每个细节的特征及其对比较的影响。

Result: 在未核查框架时，SAN 在两种环境下均领先。修正上述四个细节后，TIS 在 verl 上与 SAN 持平；在单 GPU 训练器中 TIS 稳定学习，而 SAN 保持一定优势。此外，作者还提供了采样器滞后下 TIS 与未校正 GRPO 的参考结果。

Conclusion: 实验框架细节足以逆转方法排序，仅凭日志中看似一致的指标不足以保证比较有效。研究者应使用 PTH 检查清单使框架透明化，从而获得更可信的方法对比结论。

Abstract: Methods for training language models on stale samples are judged by comparisons against importance-corrected baselines. We show that details of the experimental harness can reverse the observed ranking of methods, and we introduce PTH (Probe The Harness), a set of checks that makes the harness visible. Our case is a comparison between SAN, a behaviour-free method, and truncated importance sampling (TIS) on verl and in a single-GPU trainer, in which SAN first finished ahead in both stacks. Four details of the harness changed this comparison: the PPO ratio was taken against the learner's own recomputed probabilities, the data seed did not reach the TIS arm, the replay queue reused its first batch for 33 updates, and two loss normalisers differed from their description. In each case the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup, while the quantity that defines the comparison went unchecked. With the harness checked, TIS matches SAN on verl, and in the trainer TIS learns steadily while SAN keeps a margin. We contribute the signature of each detail and its effect on the comparison, reference results for TIS and uncorrected GRPO under sampler lag, and the PTH checklist.

</details>


### [191] [Understanding Trajectory Heterogeneity in Federated World Model Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02957)
*Yipan Wei,Zhaokun Yan,Ziming Hong,Jiaqi Wu,Lixu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以MIMIC-IV八个疾病队列的小时级动作条件临床预测为基准，研究联邦学习中轨迹时间上下文被所有权边界切分的问题，覆盖4087万条transition成员关系与32种疾病—划分配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型依赖轨迹中的状态演化，需访问时间上下文；联邦学习可利用分布式记录，但轨迹内部的所有权边界会限制每个客户端可构造的样本，导致跨时间训练需求与数据隔离之间存在张力。

Method: 设定基于严重度的客户端所有权、患者分离构建、本地历史与未来窗口规则，以及1至32小时的成对rollout评估；在五轮、每轮10%参与率下，用十种联邦算法矩阵覆盖32种疾病—划分配置。

Result: 第一，客户端所有权与参与率共同限制长窗口覆盖，疾病平均仅7.55%–21.36%的池化可用32步窗口具备训练中被访问的本地完整锚点。第二，16组配对比较中15组显示更细严重度划分伴随更高FedAvg误差，算法增益小且依赖预测时域，FedProx平均误差降低0.56%，32步无一致改善。第三，算法标签掩盖了不同更新行为，包括非活跃外推与更新尺度的数量级差异；缓存更新性能在同一协议下也随轨迹划分显著变化。

Conclusion: 结果表明，时间访问、参与覆盖、优化行为与按时域分解的预测，应作为评估联邦临床世界模型的互补维度。

Abstract: World models learn state evolution from trajectories, making access to temporal context a central training requirement. Federated learning can use distributed records, while ownership boundaries within a trajectory restrict the examples each client can construct. Our study benchmarks this cross-time setting through hourly action-conditioned clinical prediction on eight MIMIC-IV disease cohorts, comprising 40.87 million transition memberships. We specify severity-based client ownership, patient-separated construction, local history and future-window rules, and paired rollout evaluation from one to 32 hours. A matrix of ten federated algorithms covers 32 disease--partition configurations under five rounds of ten-percent participation. Three findings emerge from existing results and training logs. First, client ownership and participation jointly restrict long-window coverage: only 7.55\%--21.36\% of pooled-available 32-step windows have a locally complete anchor visited during training, averaged across diseases. Second, finer severity partitions accompany higher FedAvg error in 15 of 16 paired comparisons, while algorithm gains are small and horizon-dependent: FedProx reduces mean error by 0.56\%, with no consistent improvement at 32 steps. Third, algorithm labels conceal distinct update behavior, including inactive extrapolation and orders-of-magnitude differences in update scale. Cached-update performance also varies strongly across trajectory partitions under the same benchmark protocol. These results establish temporal access, participation coverage, optimization behavior, and horizon-resolved prediction as complementary dimensions for evaluating federated clinical world models.

</details>


### [192] [Sentry: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02994)
*Changxiu Ji,Amy Lu,Qizheng Zhang,Kunle Olukotun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出失败知识本质上是条件性知识，应仅在与失败情境匹配时才暴露给智能体，并据此设计了运行于智能体之外的失败管理层 Sentry（检测失败时检索外部手册中的匹配经验、无奖励地验证恢复、仅在成功恢复后写入新经验），在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体常因无效工具调用、重复动作或推理缺乏依据而任务中途失败，从失败中学习是提升可靠性的途径。作者发现"失败知识如何到达智能体"与"其内容本身"同样重要：失败经验具有条件性，若常驻上下文，在对应失败缺席时会产生误触发，将其从持续演化的 playbook 中移除反而提升性能；而运行时干预虽只在失败发生时生效，却不从修复过程中学习。因此需要一种"条件性暴露"的失败知识管理机制。

Method: Sentry 是一个与智能体并行运行的失败管理分层模块。当检测到失败时，它从外部 playbook 检索匹配的经验来指导恢复；随后在无法获取任务奖励的条件下验证智能体是否真正恢复；仅当确认恢复成功时，才将新经验写入 playbook。整个 playbook 从不进入智能体上下文，实现失败知识的按需、条件性暴露。

Result: 在多个智能体基准上，Sentry 在每个基准均优于最强的运行时干预基线，平均提升 37%；在两个同时评估两者的基准上，比最强的上下文演化基线提升 39%；将 Sentry 与上下文演化结合可带来进一步提升。学到的经验能迁移到留出任务；受控实验表明，即使相关经验仍可按需获取，把完整 playbook 暴露给智能体也会降低性能。

Conclusion: 失败知识是条件性知识，应当条件性暴露。将失败管理剥离为智能体之外的分层、按需检索并经过验证的写入机制，比常驻上下文或仅做运行时干预更有效，且能与上下文演化方法互补。

Abstract: LLM agents often fail mid-task due to invalid tool calls, repeated actions, or poorly grounded reasoning, and learning from these failures is a path to reliability. We find that how failure knowledge reaches the agent matters as much as what it contains. Failure lessons are conditional: kept in the agent's context, they misfire when their failure is absent, and removing them from an evolving playbook improves performance. Runtime interventions, in contrast, act only when a failure occurs but do not learn from their repairs. We argue that failure knowledge is conditional knowledge and should be conditionally exposed, and instantiate this principle in Sentry, a failure-management layer that runs alongside the agent. When Sentry detects a failure, it retrieves matching lessons from an external playbook to guide recovery, verifies without access to task rewards whether the agent recovered, and stores a new lesson only if it did; the full playbook never enters the agent's context. Across multiple agentic benchmarks, Sentry outperforms the strongest runtime-intervention baseline on every benchmark, by 37\% on average, and the strongest context-evolution baseline by 39\% on the two benchmarks where both are evaluated; combining Sentry with context evolution yields further gains. Learned lessons transfer to held-out tasks, and controlled experiments show that exposing the full playbook to the agent lowers performance even when relevant lessons remain available on demand.

</details>


### [193] [Tailoring the Quantization Space for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03027)
*Minsoo Cheong,Donghyun Son,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TaSQ 通过查询引导的通道加权、跨头归一化和协方差感知的通道分组来定制 KV 缓存向量量化的目标空间，在 1-bit 极端压缩下显著优于现有低位 KV 缓存 VQ 基线，并保持传统 VQ 查找结构、开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存成为主要内存瓶颈，对内存容量和带宽造成巨大压力。向量量化（VQ）是激进的 KV 缓存压缩的有前景方法，但现有 VQ 方法在 1-bit 区间性能严重退化：在此极端压缩下，每个码本需用有限质心表示更多通道，有效利用码本容量愈发困难。

Method: 提出 TaSQ，通过定制 VQ 目标空间来更好反映缓存激活的误差敏感性和统计结构，具体结合三项技术：查询引导的通道加权、跨头归一化、协方差感知的通道分组。这些变换与 RoPE 兼容，可轻松合并进投影权重和码本，因此保留传统 VQ 查找结构，服务开销可忽略。

Result: 在通用、长链思维推理和长上下文检索基准上，TaSQ 一致优于现有低位 KV 缓存 VQ 基线，同时保持推理稳定性。在单张 RTX 6000 Ada GPU 上，其 SGLang 实现支持高达 14 倍的批大小，峰值吞吐量比 BF16 基线高 1.87 倍。

Conclusion: TaSQ 通过针对误差敏感性和统计结构定制 VQ 目标空间，解决了 1-bit 极端压缩下 KV 缓存 VQ 性能退化问题，在保持推理稳定性和低服务开销的同时，显著提升压缩效率与推理吞吐，具备实用部署价值。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache becomes a major memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, placing substantial pressure on memory capacity and bandwidth. To mitigate this bottleneck, vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising approach for aggressive KV cache compression. However, existing VQ methods degrade substantially in the 1-bit regime. At such extreme compression, each codebook must represent a larger group of channels with a limited set of centroids, making effective use of its capacity increasingly challenging. To address this, we introduce $\textbf{TaSQ}$, which tailors the VQ target space by combining query-guided channel weighting, cross-head normalization, and covariance-aware channel grouping to better reflect the error sensitivity and statistical structure of cached activations. Since these transforms are RoPE-compatible and can be easily merged into projection weights and codebooks, TaSQ preserves the conventional VQ lookup structure and adds negligible serving overhead. Across general, long-chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval benchmarks, TaSQ consistently outperforms existing low-bit KV cache VQ baselines while preserving reasoning stability. On a single RTX 6000 Ada GPU, its SGLang implementation supports up to $14\times$ larger batch sizes and achieves $1.87\times$ higher peak throughput compared to the BF16 baseline.

</details>


### [194] [Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03199)
*Jungseob Lee,Seungyoon Lee,Sugyeong Eo,Hyeonseok Moon,Jaehyung Seo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出用任务向量跨专家的方差（称为"干扰"）来预测并校准模型合并中的性能崩溃，并给出预合并评分指标。基于该评分，作者提出PRISM算子：先平均任务向量，再按每层干扰水平进行软阈值处理，无需数据或调参即可修复破坏性合并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从共享基座微调的多个大语言模型可通过平均其任务向量进行合并，但部分合并会严重崩塌至远低于基座模型，而现有合并算子在下游评估前无法给出任何预警信号。已有算子常关注专家间的符号冲突，但该统计量对崩溃缺乏预见性。

Method: 论文指出平均操作所移除的"功率"等于任务向量跨专家方差，将其定义为干扰度量。在一个工作噪声模型下，合并注入的扰动量随合并系数和干扰增大，由此导出预合并评分。基于该分析提出PRISM算子：先对任务向量求平均，再对每一层按其干扰水平设定阈值进行软阈值处理，过程无需数据或调参；仅在评分超过阈值时启用PRISM，低于阈值时保留朴素平均。

Result: 在来自四个模型家族的22种合并配置上，只有破坏性合并的评分超过阈值；符号冲突统计量被证明是反预测性的。作者在评估前预测了14次合并结果，其中12次预测正确，包括因持续预训练而被推过阈值的专家对所产生的破坏性结果。PRISM使全部5个破坏性合并保持在阈值之上，与基座模型的差距在评估噪声范围内，而朴素平均则至少低14.4分甚至完全崩塌；对全部15个无害合并不做改变。

Conclusion: 任务向量跨专家方差既是合并崩溃的预测指标，也是其修复的校准依据。基于该度量的PRISM算子无需数据与调参即可在阈值以上修复破坏性合并，同时保留阈值以下的朴素平均，提供了一种低成本、可预警的模型合并方案。

Abstract: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.

</details>


### [195] [AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03223)
*Xin Wang,Wenhao Wu,Menghao Zhang,Zhi Wang,Kun Shao,Jian Luan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaStep 提出一种自适应步级信用权重方法，通过收缩系数控制局部优势对轨迹级信号的修正强度，无需 critic、额外 rollout 或额外推理，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上以低计算开销获得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程 LLM agent 通常仅使用稀疏的结果奖励进行训练，轨迹级目标过于粗糙，无法区分单个决策的贡献；而步级信用分配虽提供更细粒度监督，但其估计不可靠，因为观测回报还受后续动作、环境转移和轨迹长度影响。

Method: 将步级信用的加权建模为潜步级优势的均方误差估计问题，在显式条件采样假设下推导出最优的逐状态收缩系数。该系数具有信噪比（信号占总方差比例）解释：当回报变异可归因于所选动作时保留局部信用，当变异由下游随机性主导时则抑制。方法仅需轻量标量计算。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 三个环境、三种模型骨干上，相比基线取得一致改进，且计算成本低。

Conclusion: AdaStep 以极低开销有效缓解了步级信用估计的不可靠性问题，实现了更精确的步级监督，提升了长时程 LLM agent 的训练效果。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.

</details>


### [196] [Divergence controls entropy in distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03529)
*Nicolas Zucchet,Scott W. Linderman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从熵的视角研究知识蒸馏目标中散度与数据性质对学生模型熵的影响，证明前向KL会抬高学生熵、反向KL会压低学生熵，并将其解释为隐式熵正则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练的核心基础操作，但其理论性质尚不清晰。作者希望从熵的角度理解：蒸馏所用散度和数据如何决定学生模型熵的变化，从而为蒸馏目标设计与超参选择提供原理性解释。

Method: 采用熵理论分析：推导不同散度（前向KL、反向KL及二者插值）下学生熵与教师熵、学生-教师差距之间的关系；将交叉熵训练视为前向KL特例；并通过预训练与监督微调的定量实验予以验证；进一步对照on-policy蒸馏与token级反向KL，以及自蒸馏中特权信息条件化的熵效应。

Result: 前向KL会将被蒸馏学生的熵抬高至教师熵之上，交叉熵训练作为特例满足可定量验证的熵恒等式；反向KL则压低熵，直到学生-教师差距过大；二者插值时熵在训练早期平滑变化、收敛时突变。on-policy蒸馏的低熵来自token级反向KL而非on-policy采样。自蒸馏中特权信息条件化压低熵，表现最优的散度超参恰能补偿该熵降低。

Conclusion: 散度本身充当隐式熵正则器，熵视角为理解蒸馏行为、解释on-policy蒸馏熵特性及自蒸馏超参选择提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.

</details>


### [197] [Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03665)
*Seo Hyun Kim,Sunwoo Hong,Younwoo Choi,Chen-Hao Chao,Se-Young Yun,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pivot-SD是一个高效的离线自蒸馏框架，针对掩码扩散语言模型（dLMs）的信用分配难题，仅对高影响"关键token"（pivots）进行监督，用200个问题和4次rollout即超越全序列SFT与同等预算的扩散RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLMs）作为自回归模型的并行替代方案，在复杂推理上有潜力，但存在独特的信用分配挑战：去噪过程中少数几次"承诺"会大幅降低其余掩码位置的不确定性，并显著决定最终回答。现有dLMs后训练方法未利用该信号——它们在最终文本上训练或将奖励分配给整个去噪步骤，而非选择真正决定回答的单个承诺。

Method: 提出Pivot-SD，一种高效离线自蒸馏框架，只监督高影响承诺（pivots）。用信息增益指标（衡量对其余掩码位置不确定性的降低程度）来选择pivots。成功轨迹中的pivots用交叉熵训练；失败轨迹中的pivots用定向unlikelihood训练，失败轨迹的其余部分保持不变。

Result: 仅使用200个问题、每个问题4次rollout，Pivot-SD在数学与代码基准上使LLaDA-8B-Instruct优于全序列SFT以及预算匹配的扩散RL基线。

Conclusion: 按信用分配粒度选择性地监督关键承诺，是提升扩散语言模型后训练效率与效果的有效方向，可在极小数据预算下取得优于常规SFT与RL方法的性能。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [198] [Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02249)
*Ling Min Serena Khoo*

Main category: cs.LG
