We analyze the architecture of Armv7E-M, explain the underlying principles behind the performance advantages of 16-bit approaches, and evaluate the empiric quantization errors for regression and classification tasks, as well as empiric time- and energy consumption in MCU deployment. We observe ca.\ 10 times lower quantization errors compared to 8-bit quantization schemes while achieving similar or better inference times and energy consumption.

</details>


### [338] [AIBL: Augmented Instance-Based Learning with Structured Memory and Neural Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03413)
*Radha Poovendran,Andrea Stocco,Linda Bushnell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AIBL（Augmented Instance-Based Learning），将实例学习理论（IBLT）的符号化情境匹配推广到神经嵌入向量空间，并引入active/forgotten/surprise三类记忆存储与观察驱动的graduation机制，以应对高维、分布变化与概念漂移场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IBLT虽提供了基于实例的原则性框架（情境-决策-效用存储、部分匹配、激活与blending），但其依赖字典式的符号知识表示与人工指定的匹配规则，难以适用于文本、图像、交易向量和用户-物品历史等高维数据，这些场景需要学习得到的相似度而非手工规则。因此需要一种在学习向量空间中表述的实例学习模型。

Method: 提出AIBL模型：1) 将符号化情境匹配泛化为神经嵌入的相似度匹配，同时保留实例存储、激活加权检索和效用blending；2) 将记忆组织为active、forgotten和surprise三种存储，surprise记忆将弱匹配、可能分布外或边角案例与active记忆分离，以减少对最近可用案例的强制拟合；3) 采用观察驱动的graduation算法，将反复出现的surprise实例提升为active记忆，使记忆能吸纳概念漂移下重复出现的新颖模式。实验在5个机器学习任务和3个受控仿真任务上进行，并与经典IBLT变体及任务特定基线对比。

Result: AIBL将准确率提升了6至17个百分点。结果揭示了向量空间检索相对于符号匹配的优势所在，以及新增记忆机制在测试协议下如何影响新颖性检测、冷启动处理、漂移适应与奖励学习。

Conclusion: AIBL通过将实例学习置于学习到的向量空间并加入active/forgotten/surprise记忆与graduation机制，在保持IBLT核心思想（存储、激活加权检索、效用blending）的同时，有效应对高维输入、分布变化与概念漂移；实验表明其相较经典IBLT变体与任务特定基线具有稳定提升，并明确了向量检索与记忆机制的适用边界。

Abstract: Sequential learning systems often make decisions from accumulated experience while receiving high-dimensional inputs whose distribution may change over time. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides a principled case-based framework for such settings through stored situation-decision-utility instances, partial matching, activation, and blending. IBLT relies on symbolic knowledge representation in dictionary-like formats, but text, images, transaction vectors, and user-item histories often require learned similarity rather than hand-specified matching rules. In this paper, we introduce AIBL (Augmented Instance-Based Learning), an instance-learning model formulated in a learned vector space for high- dimensional sequential data. AIBL generalizes symbolic situation matching to neural embedding similarity while retaining instance storage, activation- weighted retrieval, and utility blending. The AIBL model organizes memory into active, forgotten, and surprise stores. Surprise memory separates weakly matched, possible out-of-distribution, or corner-case observations from active memory, reducing forced fitting to the nearest available cases. An observation-driven graduation algorithm promotes recurring surprise instances to active memory, allowing the memory to incorporate repeated novel patterns that may arise under concept drift. We evaluate the same implementation on five machine learning tasks and three controlled simulation tasks, comparing AIBL with classical IBLT variants and task-specific baselines where appropriate. AIBL improves accuracy by 6 to 17 percentage points. The results show where vector-space retrieval improves over symbolic matching and how the added memory mechanisms govern novelty detection, cold-start handling, drift adaptation, and reward learning under the tested protocols.

</details>


### [339] [Rethinking Epistemic Uncertainty in Node Classification through Information Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03418)
*Emma Meneghini,Francesco Ferrini,Bruno Lepri,Andrea Passerini,Veronica Lachi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个研究认知不确定性在信息增长下可约性的统计框架，指出现有图EDL方法无法保证一致性，并提出图自举集成作为候选的一致认知预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知不确定性应随预测器获得更多关于数据生成过程（DGP）的信息而降低。然而现有面向节点分类的图证据深度学习（EDL）方法通常从图特有属性构造认知不确定性，并在分布外检测等下游任务上评估，这些评估并未检验其在DGP信息增长下的可约性。因此需要一个能让可约性被直接检验的统计框架。

Method: 提出一个在信息增长下研究认知不确定性的统计框架，包含信息增长实验协议与认知预测器的一致性判据，并使用投影图DGP确保不断增长的图构成对同一底层过程的一致观测。在此框架下分析现有EDL方法，并提出图自举集成（graph bootstrap ensembles），通过图重采样与随机化训练同时刻画数据不确定性与过程不确定性。

Result: 分析表明EDL方法并未显式估计来自单个有限图观测的数据不确定性，而是通过模型超参数调节认知不确定性，从而无法满足一致性，受控信息增长实验证实了这一点。在图自举集成方面，相同实验协议下其认知不确定性下降幅度超过标准深度集成。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持将自举集成作为信息增长下候选的一致认知预测器。

Abstract: Epistemic uncertainty should decrease as additional information about the data-generating process (DGP) becomes available to the predictor. Yet, existing graph evidential deep learning (EDL) methods for node classification typically construct epistemic uncertainty from graph-specific properties and evaluate it on downstream tasks such as out-of-distribution detection, which do not test its reducibility as information about the DGP increases. To make reducibility directly testable, we introduce a statistical framework for studying epistemic uncertainty under information growth. Our framework specifies an information-growth experimental protocol and a consistency criterion for epistemic predictors, while using projective graph DGPs to ensure that growing graphs, which in general need not provide increasing information about the same DGP, constitute coherent observations of the same underlying process. We show that EDL methods do not explicitly estimate data uncertainty arising from a single finite graph observation and instead regulate epistemic uncertainty through model hyperparameters, precluding consistency, as corroborated by controlled information-growth experiments. As an alternative, we propose graph bootstrap ensembles, capturing both data and procedural uncertainty through graph resampling and randomized training. Under the same experimental protocol, these ensembles exhibit epistemic uncertainty reduction beyond standard deep ensembles. These findings support bootstrap ensembles as candidate consistent epistemic predictors under information growth.

</details>


### [340] [Deep Bayesian REFoCUS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03419)
*Simon Penninga,Ruud van Sloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将超声多基地恢复从任意发射序列建模为贝叶斯推断问题，用深度生成先验解决REFoCUS线性解码器的秩亏问题，提出Deep Bayesian REFoCUS，性能优于线性基线并能表达不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典线性REFoCUS解码器在秩亏（rank-deficient）情形下失效，仅能提供点估计，无法表达不确定性，因此需要新的解码框架来应对秩亏与噪声。

Method: 将多基地恢复表述为贝叶斯推断问题；在多基地数据集上训练深度生成先验以处理秩亏情形，形成Deep Bayesian REFoCUS方法。

Result: 在所有秩亏程度与噪声水平下均优于线性基线；当反演精确时退化为线性解码；能在采集的零空间中表达不确定性；在仿真与在体（in-vivo）采集间的分布偏移下无需微调或自适应即表现出显著泛化能力。

Conclusion: Deep Bayesian REFoCUS为超声多基地恢复提供了优于线性基线的贝叶斯解码方案，兼具不确定量化与跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: In this work we formulate ultrasound multistatic recovery from arbitrary transmit sequences as a Bayesian inference problem. To that end, we train a deep generative prior on multistatic data sets to tackle the rank-deficient regime in which classical linear REFoCUS decoders fail. This appproach, which we term Deep Bayesian REFoCUS, outperforms the linear baselines for all regimes of rank-deficiency and noise levels, and regresses to linear decoding when inversion is exact. The model also expresses uncertainty in the null space of the acquisitions, whereas the linear REFoCUS decoders only provide point estimates. Finally, we analyze the impact of distribution shift between simulation and in-vivo acquisitions, showing remarkable generalization ability without any fine-tuning or adaptation.

</details>


### [341] [OptiSelect: How does the Optimizer Shape Data Curriculum?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03432)
*Simin Fan,Alireza Abdollahpoorrostam,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将在线数据选择形式化为优化器感知范式 OptiSelect，首次系统研究优化器如何影响数据选择，提出选择增益原理并给出最优过采样率推导，理论与124M/720M预训练实验一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线数据选择通过在每批次内训练最有价值的候选样本，为LLM预训练带来显著效率提升。由于候选样本的价值最终通过有效的模型更新体现，而优化器步骤会在更新参数前重塑原始梯度，因此有原则的选择应当考虑优化器。现有工作缺乏对优化器如何塑造数据选择的系统研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 形式化"优化器感知选择"（OptiSelect）范式；建立"选择增益原理"，即在线选择的优势由优化器诱导效用分数的可判别性决定；理论分析不同优化器预条件子的可判别性；推导最优候选过采样比例的定量结果；在124M和720M模型上进行预训练实验，并测试数据改写条件下的表现。

Result: 理论证明：Lion和Muon的符号型与极坐标-切向预条件子会遭遇"可判别性坍塌"，从而限制OptiSelect可获得的增益上限；而AdamW、Sophia等对角自适应优化器则享有严格更优的上界。124M和720M模型的预训练实验与理论分析一致，表明即便使用Muon作为优化器，AdamW的对角自适应评分几何仍是最强的评分几何。此外，OptiSelect在数据改写（现代数据处理流水线常用技术）下仍保持收益。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM预训练中优化器与数据选择的协同设计提供了理论基础和实践指导，揭示了选择增益受优化器诱导效用分数可判别性支配的机制，并给出了最优过采样率等可操作建议。

Abstract: Online data selection has demonstrated substantial efficiency gains for LLM pretraining by training on the most valuable candidates within each batch. Since a candidate's value is realized through its effective model update, principled selection should account for the optimizer step, which reshapes the raw gradient before it updates model parameters. We formalize this optimizer-aware selection paradigm as OptiSelect and present the first systematic study of how the optimizer shapes data selection. Our theory establishes a selection gain principle in which the advantage of online selection is governed by the discriminability of the optimizer-induced utility scores. We prove that sign-based and polar-tangential preconditioners of Lion and Muon would suffer from a discriminability collapse which caps attainable gains from OptiSelect, whereas diagonal-adaptive optimizers such as AdamW and Sophia admit strictly better upper bounds. The proposed principle also yields a quantitative derivation of the optimal candidate oversampling ratio. Pretraining experiments on 124M and 720M models are consistent with our theoretical analysis and show that AdamW's diagonal-adaptive scoring geometry remains the strongest scoring geometry even with Muon as optimizer. We further demonstrate that OptiSelect retains its benefits under data rephrasing, a technique used in modern data processing pipelines. Our findings provide theoretical foundations and practical guidance for co-designing optimizers and data selection in LLM pretraining.

</details>


### [342] [Causal Representation Learning with Instantaneous and Lagged Relations via Nonstationarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03452)
*Tatsuya Yamada,Hiroshi Morioka,Yoshinobu Kawahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出iCReN框架，在非平稳时间序列中利用辅助变量实现潜状态及其瞬时与滞后因果结构的可识别性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列因果表征学习需同时建模区间间的滞后因果与区间内的瞬时因果，并处理非平稳性，但现有方法难以联合处理这些问题，且缺乏相应的可识别性理论保证。

Method: 利用与转移噪声分布变化相关的观测辅助变量（如时间或条件标签），建立潜状态在分量置换与分量级可逆变换下、以及其瞬时和滞后因果结构在相同置换下可识别的充分条件；基于此提出iCReN，采用对比学习结合离散或连续辅助变量来学习潜表征并估计两类因果结构。

Result: 在合成数据上能够准确恢复潜状态以及瞬时和滞后因果结构；在真实数据上，所学表征对下游预测任务具有实用价值。

Conclusion: 通过辅助变量刻画非平稳性变化，可在联合建模瞬时与滞后因果的同时获得潜状态与因果结构的可识别性，iCReN验证了该理论的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Causal representation learning for time-series data aims to identify latent states and their causal relations from observations. In this setting, an important challenge is to model both lagged causal relations across observation intervals and faster causal effects that appear as instantaneous relations within an interval, while accounting for nonstationarity in time-series data. However, methods that jointly handle these causal relations and nonstationarity remain limited. To address this gap, we establish sufficient conditions for identifying latent states up to component permutation and component-wise invertible transformations, and their instantaneous and lagged causal structures up to the same permutation, using an observed auxiliary variable, such as time or a condition label, associated with changes in transition-noise distributions. Based on these results, we propose iCReN, a framework that uses contrastive learning with discrete or continuous auxiliary variables to learn latent representations and estimate their instantaneous and lagged causal structures. Experiments demonstrate accurate recovery of latent states and both instantaneous and lagged causal structures on synthetic data and the utility of the learned representations for downstream forecasting on real-world data.

</details>


### [343] [Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03454)
*Eeshaan Jain,Linus Bleistein,Bart Deplancke,Charlotte Bunne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ECHO-k，一种任务无关、自监督的模态获取原则：利用基础模型内部预训练表示作为跨模态信息代理目标，在未知下游任务时顺序选择信息量高的模态，并给出理论保证与 RL 策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试阶段获取全部特征或模态代价高昂且常存在冗余，而当下游任务或预测目标未知时，顺序选择信息量大的模态变得十分困难。

Method: 将深度模型（如基础模型）内部的预训练表示作为汇总跨模态信息的代理目标，在简化的线性设定下提供理论保证，并据此设计强化学习（RL）策略进行顺序模态选择。

Result: 在与任务无关、无标签的获取基线对比中，ECHO-k 在多种基础模型后端上持续提升受预算约束的下游性能。

Conclusion: 该方法为成本感知的测试时部署提供了有原则的路径，适用于测量昂贵、时间受限且下游任务先验未知的多模态系统。

Abstract: Recent progress in multimodal, high-dimensional learning has enabled foundation models to process heterogeneous, large-scale data. However, at test time, acquiring all features or modalities can be prohibitively costly and often redundant. Sequentially selecting informative modalities is therefore critical, yet challenging when the downstream task or prediction target is unknown. To this end, we introduce ECHO-$k$, a task-agnostic and self-supervised learning principle for modality acquisition: we use a deep model's internal pretrained representations (e.g., from a foundation model) as proxy targets that summarize cross-modal information. We provide theoretical guarantees in a stylized linear setting that motivate a reinforcement learning (RL) policy for sequential modality selection. Across task-agnostic and label-free acquisition baselines, ECHO-$k$ consistently improves budgeted downstream performance across diverse foundation-model backends. Our method provides a principled route to cost-aware test-time deployment, with implications for any multimodal system where measurements are expensive or time-constrained, and downstream tasks unknown a priori.

</details>


### [344] [Beyond Random Splits: Evaluating Drug-Target Affinity Models Under Chemically and Biologically Motivated Distribution Shifts Copy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03456)
*Minjae Chung,Clara Li,Malar Paavai Muthukumaran,Shaunna Wang,Aniket Ramkrishnan Iyer,Shaun Qien Yeau Tan,Harinishree Sathu,Micky C. Nnamdi,J. Ben Tamo,Benoit Louis Marteau,May Dongmei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究基于718,800个药物-蛋白对，系统比较了13种DTA预测架构在四种分布偏移（scaffold、fingerprint-cluster、protein-cluster、dual OOD）下的表现，发现模型排序高度依赖外推类型，因此DTA基准测试应匹配部署时预期的化学与靶点偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DTA预测模型通常仅在单一数据划分下比较，但实际部署常需外推到新化学系列、新蛋白靶点或两者兼有。作者质疑：评估所用的分布偏移形式是否会改变"最佳架构"的结论，即架构选择是否被基准设置所误导。

Method: 从ChEMBL和BindingDB整理出718,800个唯一药物-蛋白对。以Morgan指纹+蛋白CNN为基线，构建12种受控架构，组合4种药物表征与3种ESM-2交互模式。在scaffold、fingerprint-cluster、protein-cluster及dual四种OOD划分下评估，并采用留出评估、重复随机种子、分组感知bootstrap及规模匹配对照加以验证。

Result: 平均验证RMSE由scaffold和fingerprint-cluster OOD的0.950、0.945上升至protein-cluster和dual OOD的1.299、1.321。模型排序在两种化学偏移间高度一致（tau=0.79），但与scaffold OOD的一致性在protein OOD下下降（tau=0.39），并在dual OOD下发生反转（tau=-0.55）。

Conclusion: 架构选择取决于外推形式，而不仅取决于平均误差或训练集规模。DTA基准测试应匹配部署时预期的化学和靶点偏移，而非仅报告单一划分下的平均性能。

Abstract: Drug-target affinity (DTA) prediction is widely used to prioritize candidate compounds before costly experimental screening. DTA models are often compared under a single data split, even though deployment may require extrapolation to new chemical series, new protein targets, or both. We ask whether the distribution shift used for evaluation changes which architecture appears best. We curate 718,800 unique drug-protein pairs from the ChEMBL and BindingDB datasets. We compare a Morgan-fingerprint + protein-CNN baseline with 12 controlled architectures that combine four drug representations with three ESM-2 interaction modes. Mean validation RMSE increases from 0.950 and 0.945 under scaffold and fingerprint-cluster OOD to 1.299 and 1.321 under protein-cluster and dual OOD. Model rankings are similar across the two chemical shifts (tau = 0.79), but agreement with scaffold OOD falls under protein OOD (tau = 0.39) and reverses under dual OOD (tau = -0.55). Held-out evaluation, repeated seeds, group-aware bootstrap analysis, and a size-matched control support the same conclusion: architecture selection depends on the form of extrapolation, not only on average error or training-set size. DTA benchmarks should therefore match the chemical and target shifts expected at deployment.

</details>


### [345] [Single or Multiple Policies for Phase-Structured Reinforcement Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03475)
*Guilhem Loussouarn,Nancy Nayak,Kin K. Leung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究非平稳强化学习中"多策略（按阶段分解）"与"单一状态增广策略"的优劣：理论上共享策略可达多策略性能，但实际取决于函数逼近、学习优化与样本效率；提出基于瞬态/准平稳期时长的regime阶段分解方法判断何种策略更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳RL问题可分解为具有各自转移概率和奖励函数的阶段。阶段序列已知时，常用做法是把阶段信息增广到状态中以满足马尔可夫性，再用标准RL。但已有工作发现针对不同阶段的多策略方法可优于共享的单一增广策略，其原因尚不清楚，需要理论澄清与判定准则。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明共享的单一策略在理论上能够达到任意多策略解的性能；2) 指出实际差异来源：函数逼近、学习与优化过程，以及多策略所需的样本效率和策略切换时的连续性损失；3) 提出regime-based阶段分解方法，依据瞬态系统动力学持续时间与准平稳期持续时间的相对关系，判定应采用单策略还是多策略；4) 用不同非平稳RL问题做数值实验。

Result: 实验验证了四个主要假设：(a) 阶段持续时间越长越有利于多策略；(b) 阶段间异质性越大，单一策略负担越重；(c) 多策略需要每阶段有充足数据；(d) 阶段间与环境相关的转移动力学会影响何种策略更可取。

Conclusion: 单策略与多策略并无绝对优劣：共享策略理论上不劣，但实践中受逼近与学习因素制约。提出的基于瞬态/准平稳时长的regime分解方法可作为选择策略分解粒度的依据。

Abstract: Many reinforcement-learning (RL) problems are non-stationary yet structured and can be decomposed into phases, each with its own transition probabilities and reward functions. When the phase sequence is known, the common solution augments the state with information to satisfy the Markovian property and applies standard RL techniques. However, prior work finds that the multi-policy approach for different phases can outperform a single state-augmented policy shared among the phases, for reasons that remain unclear. In this work, we first show that the shared policy can theoretically achieve performance of any multi-policy solution. However, whether a multi-policy solution can perform better than the corresponding single shared policy in practice depends on function approximation, learning and optimization processes, as well as, for multi-policy solutions, the sample efficiency and loss of continuity from one policy to another. We propose a regime-based phase decomposition method to identify which policy can provide better performance. The method is based on consideration of the duration of transient system dynamics relative to the duration of the quasi-stationary period. Numerical experiments are conducted with different non-stationary RL problems to validate our four major hypotheses: (a) longer phase durations favor multi-policies, (b) the heterogeneity between phases increases the burden on single policy, (c) multi-policies need sufficient data for each phase, and (d) environment-specific transition dynamics between phases can affect which policy is preferable.

</details>


### [346] [Metropolis-Hastings Dominates Importance Resampling for Policy Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03480)
*Alexey Kurennoy,Ramil Yarullin,Fergal Reid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析了解码时策略组合中的独立性Metropolis-Hastings（MH）修正方法，证明其在任意 rollout 预算下，以所有凸 f-散度衡量均至少与同等预算的 SIR 一样接近目标分布，并给出了相较未修正解码器的一致性改进下界及两种渐近机制下的采样误差刻画，辅以可枚举与LLM规模实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练LLM常需权衡多奖励，为每个权衡重新训练代价高昂；解码时策略组合可在推理阶段通过合并奖励特定策略调整权衡。然而标准实现直接组合下一 token 概率，会对完整响应的加权乘积目标引入采样偏差，因此需要分析修正方法的正确性与效率。

Method: 分析一种基于独立性 Metropolis-Hastings（MH）的迭代修正方法，用以纠正标准解码时组合的采样偏差。从理论上以凸 f-散度比较 MH 与采样重要性重采样（SIR）的偏差，推导 MH 相对未修正解码器在一致性目标上的改进下界，并在两种渐近机制下刻画修正的采样误差：奖励特定策略趋于一致时，以及目标与未修正解码器概率之间对数比波动增大（如长响应）时。

Result: 主要结果表明：对任意 rollout 预算，MH 产生的输出分布以所有凸 f-散度衡量，至少与同等预算的 SIR 一样接近目标；给出 MH 相对未修正解码器在一致性目标上的改进下界；并对两种渐近机制下的采样误差进行刻画。实验覆盖可枚举设置与LLM规模设置。

Conclusion: 独立性 MH 修正在理论上优于同等预算的 SIR，并能保证相对未修正解码器的改进，为解码时多奖励策略组合提供了有理论依据的偏差校正方案；其在策略趋同和长响应等不同机制下的采样误差具有可刻画的行为。

Abstract: Post-training a large language model (LLM) often requires exploring trade-offs between multiple rewards, but retraining for each trade-off is expensive. Decoding-time policy composition allows these trade-offs to be adjusted by combining reward-specific policies at inference time. This composition targets a weighted product of the policies' probabilities over complete responses, but standard implementations combine their next-token probabilities, generally introducing sampling bias. We analyze a known iterative correction based on independence Metropolis-Hastings (MH). Our main result shows that, for every rollout budget, MH produces an output distribution at least as close to the target as sampling-importance-resampling (SIR) with the same budget, as measured by every convex f-divergence. We also derive a lower bound on MH's improvement over the uncorrected decoder in a consensus objective measuring agreement with the supplied policies. We further characterize the correction's sampling error in two asymptotic regimes: when the reward-specific policies approach agreement, and when the log ratio between target and uncorrected-decoder probabilities fluctuates increasingly widely, as can happen for long responses. We complement our analysis with experiments in enumerable and LLM-scale settings.

</details>


### [347] [Dual-Context Analog Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03491)
*Jung Min Choi,Ngoc Son Le,Ibram Abdelmalak,Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi,Lars Schmidt-Thieme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DuoTS，一种双上下文时间序列预测模型：先用并行 patch 编码器与线性预测头给出基础预测，再逐 patch 精化，每次融合“当前上下文”（近期 token 动态）与“细节上下文”（检索到的相似历史片段及其后续轨迹），从而在长时程预测中取得 SOTA，且精化机制与模型无关、可即插即用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期时间序列预测模型通常将回看窗口一次性直接映射到整个预测时域，虽高效，但未显式识别哪些历史状态与不同未来片段最相关，也未利用这些状态之后的真实演化。类比预测（analog forecasting）通过检索与当前相似的历史状态并利用其后续观测来弥补，但单一最近邻匹配不可靠，且重叠 patch 会产生冗余候选。因此需要一种既利用检索证据、又不完全依赖检索结果的方法。

Method: DuoTS 采用两阶段设计。第一阶段：由并行 patch 编码器与线性预测头生成基础预测。第二阶段：按未来 patch 逐步精化，每个 patch 的修正融合两种视图——当前上下文（current context）关注近期 token，刻画最新动态；细节上下文（detail context）提供彼此相异的检索类比样本及其后续轨迹。逐 patch 精化使模型能在整个预测时域上权衡两种视图，并按各未来片段与当前的时间距离匹配相应证据。该精化机制仅需编码后的回看窗口与未来 patch 位置，因而与具体模型无关。

Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，DuoTS 达到 state-of-the-art 性能；消融实验证实了当前上下文与细节上下文各自的贡献。

Conclusion: DuoTS 通过双上下文逐 patch 精化，在保留单次映射高效性的同时引入可靠的检索证据，兼顾最新动态与相似历史轨迹，实现了长时程预测的 SOTA。其精化机制模型无关，只需编码回看窗口与未来 patch 位置，可集成进现有预测模型。

Abstract: Most long-term time-series forecasting models map the look-back window directly to the full horizon in a single pass. While efficient, this design does not explicitly identify which historical states are most relevant to different future segments or exploit what followed those states. Analog forecasting addresses this by retrieving past states similar to the present and using their observed continuations, but single nearest matches can be unreliable and overlapping patches may produce redundant candidates. We propose DuoTS, a Dual-Context Time Series forecasting model that uses retrieved evidence without relying on it exclusively. DuoTS first produces a base forecast with a parallel patch encoder and linear prediction head, then progressively refines it one future patch at a time. Each refinement combines two views: a current context that attends to recent tokens and captures the latest dynamics, and a detail context that provides distinct retrieved analogs together with their subsequent trajectories. Patch-wise refinement allows the model to balance these views across the forecast horizon and associate each future segment with evidence appropriate to its temporal distance from the present. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that DuoTS achieves state-of-the-art performance, while ablations confirm the contribution of each context. The refinement mechanism is also model-agnostic, requiring only an encoded look-back window and the future-patch position, and can therefore be integrated into existing forecasting models.

</details>


### [348] [Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03494)
*Jung Min Choi,Ngoc Son Le,Ibram Abdelmalak,Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi,Lars Schmidt-Thieme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MARO（Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering）将回看窗口按“从最新patch到最旧patch”的顺序递归处理，以最近patch为锚点初始化并条件化隐状态，复用单一共享模块扩展扫描深度而不增加参数，并通过保留中间状态让预测头分别加权短期与长期历史，在多个真实时序数据集上取得长/短期预测的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期预测模型对回看窗口内所有patch采用相同的固定堆叠与同等计算深度，无法区分靠近预测时刻的近期证据与较远的上下文，而二者对预测的贡献本不相同，这种“一刀切”处理使近期性未被架构显式表达。

Method: 提出MARO，按由新到旧的顺序扫描回看窗口：最新patch作为锚点，负责初始化隐状态并对后续每一步进行条件化，使较旧patch被折叠进一个始终以近期证据为中心的表示；每一步复用同一共享模块，因此向更早历史扩展不引入额外参数；扫描中保留的中间状态供预测头对历史的短程与长程部分分别赋权。

Result: 在多个真实世界时间序列数据集上的大量实验表明，MARO在长期与短期预测任务上均达到state-of-the-art性能；消融实验进一步检验了各主要架构组件的贡献。

Conclusion: 通过递归精炼的顺序（以最近patch为锚）而非统一深度堆叠，MARO以无额外参数的参数化方式显式表达近期性偏好，并借助中间状态实现多尺度历史加权，验证了“顺序即归纳偏置”的有效性。

Abstract: Long-term forecasting models commonly process all patches in a look-back window using the same fixed stack. Older contextual patches and recent evidence therefore receive the same computational depth. Yet the information closest to the forecast and the more distant context do not contribute equally. Uniform processing leaves this distinction unexpressed in the architecture. We propose MARO, a Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering model that processes the look-back window from the most recent patch to the oldest. The most recent patch serves as the anchor. It initializes the latent state and conditions each subsequent step, so older patches are folded into a representation that remains centered on recent evidence. A single shared module is reused at every step, so extending the scan further into the past introduces no additional parameters. Intermediate states retained during the scan allow the forecast head to weigh short and long portions of the history separately. This expresses recency through the order of recurrent refinement. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world time series datasets show that MARO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both long-term and short-term forecasting tasks.Ablation studies examine the contribution of the main architectural components.

</details>


### [349] [Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03502)
*Md Sazid Uddin,Md. Khairul Alam Mazumder,M. F. Mridha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对机制编辑行为效果的可验证认证，证明在连续输入区域内编辑既能移除一种技能又能保留另一种技能，并说明有限黑盒测试无法认证移除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机制编辑（消融、权重编辑、激活引导）仅通过测试验证效果，无法覆盖连续输入区域；已有可解释性-验证边界工作认证的是模型描述，而非编辑的行为效果，因此需要认证编辑本身对某一技能移除与另一技能保留的保证。

Method: 从玩具ReLU网络到标准softmax+LayerNorm Transformer，认证机制编辑的行为效果：在连续嵌入空间区域内证明禁用某电路会移除一项技能并保留另一项技能，形成信息流安全意义上的特征非干扰保证；使用可靠界传播替代精确求解器以扩展可处理输入扰动维度，并给出有限确定性黑盒测试无法认证移除的证明。

Result: 在连续嵌入空间区域上证明了技能移除与保留；相比精确求解器可处理约9倍的输入扰动维度；构造出能通过穷尽测试但在任意小的幸存者口袋上可证明失败的编辑；保证在小型标准架构网络上成立。

Conclusion: 机制编辑的效果可以被形式化认证，而非仅依赖测试；但此类移除保证以目标技能存在可判定规范为前提，真实世界危害可能不具备该性质。

Abstract: Mechanistic edits (ablations, weight edits, activation steering) are the standard tools for unlearning a harmful capability from a neural network while preserving useful ones. Current approaches validate their effects only by testing, which can never cover an entire continuous region of inputs. Prior work at the interpretability-verification boundary certifies descriptions of a model: what a circuit computes, or whether it faithfully explains the whole. We instead certify the behavioral effect of an edit: that disabling a circuit removes one skill and provably preserves another, for every input in a region; a feature non-interference guarantee in the information-flow-security sense. We demonstrate such certified edits from toy ReLU networks up to a standard softmax + LayerNorm transformer, proving removal and preservation over continuous embedding-space regions and reaching roughly 9x the input-perturbation dimension an exact solver can handle by switching to sound bound propagation. Furthermore, we prove that no finite deterministic black-box test can certify removal, exhibiting an edit that passes exhaustive testing yet provably fails on a survivor pocket that can be made arbitrarily small. Guarantees hold on small, standard-architecture networks and, like any removal claim, presuppose that the target skill admits a decidable specification, a property which real-world harms may not have.

</details>


### [350] [Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03503)
*Liam Moroy,Jean-François Giovannelli,Yoann Altmann,Steve McLaughlin,Frédéric Champagnat,Guillaume Bourmaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种离线自动调节引导权重的策略，将条件去噪/流匹配目标视为最小二乘问题，无需重训练即可提升逆问题后验采样性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练后验采样（Plug-and-Play）方法多依赖引导权重平衡先验信息与测量一致性，但这些权重通常靠启发式设定，缺乏系统性调节方法，影响性能与稳定性。

Method: 观察到每步的条件去噪分数匹配（扩散）或条件流匹配（流模型）目标是二乘目标；当条件预测表示为无条件网络输出与测量引导项的加权和时，权重优化化为二维线性最小二乘问题；据此可在给定测量算子、噪声水平和采样器下，用一个采样轨迹小批量离线优化时间相关引导权重，无需重训练或微调预训练生成模型，并以Tweedie测量一致性项实例化。

Result: 在扩散与流匹配方法中取得最先进重建性能；优化后的引导权重可将扩散采样步数从1000降至50而重建质量无显著下降。

Conclusion: 提供了一种简单且有原则的离线引导权重自动调节方案，提升后验采样质量并显著降低采样步数，代码将公开。

Abstract: Training-free posterior sampling methods, also known as Plug-and-Play methods, leverage pretrained unconditional diffusion or flow-matching models to solve inverse problems. Most existing approaches rely on guidance weights to balance, at each time step, prior information from the unconditional score or velocity network with measurement consistency, yet the tuning of these weights is often not discussed and is largely left to heuristics. We introduce a simple and principled offline strategy for automatically tuning these guidance weights. Our key observation is that, at each time step, the conditional denoising score-matching objective for diffusion models, or the conditional flow-matching objective for flow-matching models, is a least-squares objective. Therefore, when the conditional prediction is expressed as a weighted sum of the unconditional network output and a measurement-guidance term, optimizing over these weights reduces to a two-dimensional linear least-squares problem. The resulting time-dependent guidance weights can be optimized offline for a given measurement operator, noise level and sampler at the cost of a single minibatch of sampling trajectories, without retraining or fine-tuning the pretrained generative model. Instantiated with the standard Tweedie-based measurement-consistency term, our approach improves posterior sampling and achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across diffusion- and flow-matching-based methods. Moreover, the optimized guidance weights enable diffusion samplers to reduce the number of sampling steps from 1000 to 50 with no significant degradation in reconstruction quality. Code will be made available.

</details>


### [351] [An Automated and Reproducible Workflow for Crack Identification and Damage Assessment of Fusion Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03505)
*Rinkle Juneja,Viktor Reshniak,Richard K. Archibald,John W. Duggan,Gregory R. Watson,Cory D. Hauck,Gary M. Staebler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个基于Galaxy的自动化SEM裂纹识别与损伤量化工作流，实现聚变材料辐照/热冲击表征的可复现、可移植分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚变材料表征依赖曝光后显微分析，但人工分析难以应对现代实验的高数据量、异质性及多分辨率特性，亟需可扩展的自动化方案。

Method: 在Galaxy科学工作流环境中实现端到端流程：处理SEM图像与实验元数据，输出裂纹掩膜、骨架化裂纹网络、质控可视化及标量损伤描述符；设计为无需图像特定参数调优，可跨钨牌号、显微组织、放大倍率与损伤状态运行。

Result: 在含418张图像、114次实验、5种钨牌号与3种组织状态的稀疏电子束热冲击数据集上验证；定义裂纹密度描述符，为下游机器学习预测与物理裂纹模拟提供标准化输入。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是端到端、可共享、计算可移植的工作流，串联实验表征、自动图像分析、初步损伤预测与模拟引导的数据采集，预测模块作为可扩展组件保留。

Abstract: Post-exposure microscopy is central to qualification of fusion materials. However, manual analysis does not scale to the volume, heterogeneity, and multiresolution character of modern fusion-materials campaigns. To address this challenge, we present a reproducible workflow, implemented in the Galaxy scientific workflow environment, for automated crack identification and quantitative damage assessment from scanning electron microscopy images. The workflow processes SEM images and experimental metadata to identify cracks, quantify damage, and retain the intermediate products and processing history needed for reproducibility. Outputs include crack masks, skeletonized crack networks, quality-control visualizations, and scalar damage descriptors. The method is designed to operate without image-specific parameter tuning across tungsten grades, microstructures, magnifications, and damage states. We demonstrate the workflow on a sparse electron-beam thermal-shock dataset containing 418 images from 114 experiments spanning five tungsten grades and three microstructural states. We define a crack-density descriptor, which provides standardized inputs for downstream machine-learning prediction and physics-based crack simulation. These predictive components are exposed in the same Galaxy environment and are intentionally treated here as extensible workflow modules. The principal contribution is therefore an end-to-end, shareable, and computationally portable workflow that links experimental characterization, automated image analysis, preliminary damage prediction, and simulation-guided data acquisition for fusion-materials research.

</details>


### [352] [Beyond Trained Models: Compiling GNNs for a Sound Explainer Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03526)
*Steve Azzolin,Francesco Paolo Nerini,Stefano Teso,Francesco Bonchi,Bruno Lepri,André Panisson,Andrea Passerini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出GNN解释器常用的"合理性(plausibility)"评估假设存在缺陷——在多个基准上仅凭度统计即可解题,说明模型未必依赖预设motif;为此提出Gracr编译器,将分级模态逻辑公式编译为GNN权重,使模型行为可构造性地确知,并据此定义精确ground truth;进而构建GracrBench基准,在6个任务、11种解释器上实现细粒度诊断评估,发现多数解释器对间接影响或同一公式的替代实现不鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN解释器通常以"合理性"评估,即解释能否恢复数据中预设的ground truth(如植入的motif)。该协议隐含假设:GNN确实依赖该motif。已有工作质疑此假设,但该评估方式仍被广泛使用。作者首先验证该假设在常用基准上不成立,例如度统计即可完成任务,存在混淆因素。

Method: 提出Gracr,首个将分级模态逻辑(graded modal logic)公式编译为GNN权重的编译器,用编译替代训练,使模型行为由构造已知;由此可形式化定义并精确计算ground truth解释。在此基础上构建GracrBench基准,包含编译得到的GNN与精确ground truth,用于评估后置解释器。

Result: 在11种解释器、6个任务上的实验表明GracrBench能进行细粒度诊断评估;尤其发现多数解释器对间接影响(indirect influences)以及同一公式的替代实现均不鲁棒。

Conclusion: GracrBench为图后置可解释性提供了新颖且严格的评估设置,克服了传统合理性评估的混淆问题。

Abstract: Explainers for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are commonly evaluated by their plausibility, i.e., how well their explanations recover a predefined ground truth, such as a motif planted in the data. This protocol implicitly assumes that a GNN trained on such data relies on the intended motif. Although prior work has questioned this assumption, plausibility remains widespread. First, we show that the assumption is violated on several widely used benchmarks, where, e.g., degree statistics alone suffice to solve the task. Then, we remove this confounder by replacing training with compilation. We achieve this by introducing $\mathsf{Gracr}$, the first compiler translating graded modal logic formulas into GNN weights, yielding models that replicate the behaviour of the corresponding formulas. Since the behaviour of the model is now known by construction, we can define its ground truth explanation formally and compute it exactly. Building on this, we introduce $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$, a benchmark of compiled GNNs for the evaluation of explainers against this exact ground truth. Experiments on eleven explainers across six tasks show its effectiveness for fine-grained diagnostic evaluation: notably, we discover that most explainers are not robust to indirect influences or alternative implementations of the same formula. These results position $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$ as a novel, rigorous evaluation setting for graph post-hoc explainability.

</details>


### [353] [ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03546)
*Yubo Wang,Jingying Ma,Xinliang Zhou,Yangxuan Zhou,Jiquan Wang,Sha Zhao,Yiyuan Yang,Yi Ding,Ziyu Jia,Chenyu Liu,Cuntai Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZeroMAG提出零样本多模态适配器生成框架，在不使用目标标签与目标端优化的前提下，将冻结的EEG基础模型扩展到含伴随生理信号的多模态记录，平均性能逼近有监督多模态适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型（EFM）虽能从大规模EEG数据中捕获可复用知识，但许多EEG记录还包含可提供互补信息的伴随生理信号。核心难题在于：如何在保留预训练知识的同时，仅依赖无标签目标数据推断出的适配方式，将纯EEG接口的EFM扩展到异构多模态记录。

Method: 提出ZeroMAG零样本多模态适配器生成框架：冻结EEG编码器与预测头；围绕配置不变的适配器组织伴随模态；由无标签记录与任务上下文构造“模态—被试—任务”条件；在从源适配器学习到的函数约束隐空间中生成适配器权重；整个过程无需目标标签和目标端优化，目标数据集在训练与模型选择阶段完全留出。

Result: 在6个留出目标数据集与3种EFM骨干网络上，ZeroMAG的平衡准确率较纯EEG推理提升7.22个百分点，较直接权重回归提升4.89个百分点，平均仅落后有监督多模态适配0.50个百分点。消融实验表明，去除表示学习或条件生成中的任一函数监督都会削弱生成适配器的性能，验证了两个组件的贡献。

Conclusion: ZeroMAG证明可通过函数约束的隐空间适配器生成，在零样本、无目标标签条件下有效扩展EEG基础模型至多模态场景，性能接近有监督多模态适配，且其表示学习与条件生成中的功能监督均为必要组件。

Abstract: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.

</details>


### [354] [Objects Without Morphisms: What LLMs for Mathematics Do Not Represent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03551)
*Yanli Wang,Suijin Wang,Xiaopeng Yuan,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究考察LLM在无外部判据情境下的表现：跨子领域方言翻译中，模型系统性地倾向于扩大而非缩小量化域，且这一不对称与模型能力无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在竞赛数学上的专家级表现主要依赖大量采样加外部筛选判据，这只改善了留存结果，未触及模型内部表征本身。作者希望在无外部判据可用的任务（跨数学子领域方言的忠实翻译）中检验模型是否真正习得了理论间的对应关系。

Method: 引入一套评测工具，将真值、内容与适用范围分别编码于独立的盲队列中，并采用无判官（judge-free）指标衡量改写是否陈述了源文本隐含的假设，同时用植入式阳性对照（planted-positive control）验证工具灵敏度。实验覆盖四个家族共七个模型，并设置向一般化框架与向具体化框架两个翻译方向。

Result: 向一般化框架翻译时，60.6%的改写扩大了量化域，无一条缩小；向具体化框架翻译时，28.3%缩小、0.3%扩大。应被补出的假设在模型改写中出现率为21.6%，在人类陈述中仅4.2%。该不对称出现在所有被测模型中，能力最强者反而扩大程度最小。结论在预注册规则划出的留出集和数学家撰写的陈述上均可复现。指令要求模型陈述其所需全部假设可提高该比例，但不提升对翻译方向的敏感性。

Conclusion: 这些系统习得了子领域词汇之间的对象层面对应，却缺乏"理论间翻译应将假设映射为假设"这一约束，因而在涉及泛化层级的忠实性上存在系统性缺陷。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have reached expert-level performance on competition mathematics largely through the volume of search placed around them: candidate solutions are sampled in quantity and retained only when an external criterion accepts them. Such a procedure improves the outcome that survives it while leaving untouched what the model represents. We examine that question where no external criterion exists: translating statements between the dialects of neighbouring subfields, where fidelity turns on the level of generality at which content is asserted. The source leaves that level implicit in its vocabulary, so a faithful translation must recover it from the relation between the theories. We introduce an instrument that codes truth, content and scope in separate blind queues, with a judge-free measure of whether a rewrite states the hypothesis implicit in its source, and establish its sensitivity with a planted-positive control. Across seven models from four families, translating towards the general framing widens the domain of quantification in 60.6% of rewrites and narrows it in none; translating towards the concrete framing narrows it in 28.3% and widens it in 0.3%. The hypothesis that would prevent it is stated in 21.6% of model rewrites and 4.2% of human statements. Capability does not govern the asymmetry: it appears in every model tested, and the most capable widens least. It replicates on the half of the benchmark held out by a pre-registered rule, and on statements written by mathematicians. Instructing a model to state every hypothesis it requires raises that rate but not its sensitivity to direction. We argue that these systems have acquired an object-level correspondence between subfield vocabularies without the constraint under which a translation between theories carries hypotheses to hypotheses.

</details>


### [355] [Get a GRIP, this will be a long TRIP: A Quantifiable Long-Range Framework for Verifying Over-squashing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03556)
*Ferran Hernandez Caralt,Simon Heilig,Adrián Bazaga,Asja Fischer,Moshe Eliasof,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出长程图基准缺乏严格刻画，提出四条可验证公理（Predictability、Tightness、Strictly k-Range、Topology-Invariance），并据此构造TRIP/GRIP：(1) k=1时，只需任意图$G$、非负的range矩阵$R$（$R_{uv}$即 $d(u,v)=1$的二元指示）；(2) k>1时，对任意图$G$和整数$k\ge1$，先取$G^k$，再对每个$k$距离节点对$(c,c')$经映射$\phi_c(x)=\mathrm{Unif}(d(c,c'),\mathrm{supp}(supplied\ distribution))$生成$d_c$；$\Phi$以$R^k_{uv}$逐元素乘$(\phi_u(x)\cdot\phi_v(x))$，即$\Phi(G,k)=\mathbf{1}^\top(R^k\odot(\phi(x)\phi(x)^\top))\mathbf{1}$，从而把任意图转化为可证明长程任务，并提供闭式逐range MLE oracle与首个逐range测试误差下界。实验审计4个常用长程基准、发现常见曲率度量与GNN性能不相关、并展示新基准的oversquashing度量还受纯长程性以外因素影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经验性长程交互研究依赖基准，但事实标准Long Range Graph Benchmark及合成替代被证明可由调参的短程模型饱和或绑定特定拓扑，因而缺乏任意图上可证明长程性的证书。根本原因是缺少对长程图基准的精确刻画，导致过度压缩与长程交互之间的经验结论不可信。

Method: 提出四条必须满足的可验证公理：Predictability、Tightness、Strictly k-Range、Topology-Invariance；形式化证明违反任一条都会引入削弱结论的失败模式。基于公理构造TRIP（Truly Ranged Interactions Problem）及其推广GRIP（Generally Ranged Interactions Problem）：对$k=1$，用任意图$G$和非负range矩阵$R$（$R_{uv}$指示$d(u,v)=1$）生成任务；对一般$k\ge1$，先取$G$的$k$次幂$G^k$，对每个$k$距离节点对$(c,c')$，以映射$\phi_c(x)=\mathrm{Unif}(d(c,c'),\mathrm{supp}(supplied\ distribution))$从稳定分布抽取特征$d_c$，令$\Phi(G,k)=\mathbf{1}^\top(R^k\odot(\phi(x)\phi(x)^\top))\mathbf{1}$，即用$R^k$逐元素乘特征内积。构造保证GRIP存在闭式逐range最大似然oracle，给出任意基准上首个先验的逐range测试误差下界。框架下进行三类实验：(i)用公理审计4个常见长程基准并识别其失败模式；(ii)在TRIP实例化拓扑上检验曲率与GNN性能关系；(iii)分析新基准的oversquashing度量。

Result: (i)审计4个常用长程基准，识别其相对公理的失败模式；(ii)在TRIP实例化拓扑上，发现流行的曲率概念与GNN性能不相关，支持拓扑瓶颈与计算瓶颈的区分；(iii)展示一个新基准的over-squashing度量还反映了纯长程性以外的因素。GRIP提供闭式逐range MLE oracle，并给出首个任意基准可用的逐range测试误差先验下界。

Conclusion: 该工作通过四条公理为长程图基准提供了精确可验证刻画，并用TRIP/GRIP把任意图构造为可证明长程任务，同时给出闭式MLE oracle与逐range测试误差下界。对常用基准的审计、曲率-性能不相关发现以及对oversquashing度量的分解，表明长程性声明需以公理合规为前提；代码已开源：https://github.com/ferranhernandezc/graph-grip。

Abstract: Empirical claims about the connection between over-squashing and long-range interactions in GNNs, can only be trusted if the benchmarks used to validate them genuinely require long-range interactions. The de-facto standard, the Long Range Graph Benchmark, has been repeatedly shown to be saturated by tuned short-range models, with existing synthetic alternatives being tied to specific topologies. As such, there is a lack of principled certificate of long-rangedness on arbitrary graphs. This state reflects the absence of a precise characterization of long-ranged benchmarks. We address this fundamental gap by introducing four verifiable axioms: Predictability, Tightness, Strictly $k$-Range, and Topology-Invariance, that any task claiming to test $k$-hop interactions must satisfy. We formally prove that violating any one of them admits failure modes that undermine conclusions drawn from the task. Based on these axioms, we introduce TRIP (Truly Ranged Interactions Problem) and its generalisation GRIP (Generally Ranged Interactions Problem), constructive procedures that turn any graph into a provably long-ranged task by drawing features from stable distributions. Moreover, by construction, GRIP admits a closed-form, per-range Maximum-Likelihood oracle that yields the first a priori per-range lower bound on test error available on any benchmark. Using our framework, we: (i) audit 4 common long-range benchmarks and identify their failures modes with respect to our axioms; (ii) on TRIP-instantiated topologies, we find a popular notion of curvature is uncorrelated with GNN performance, supporting topological-vs-computational bottleneck distinction; and (iii) we show that a novel benchmark's over-squashing measures factors beyond pure long-rangedness. Code to use the framework and reproduce experiments is released https://github.com/ferranhernandezc/graph-grip.

</details>


### [356] [Cephalonauts One: A deep fMRI dataset for decoding naturalistic speech in the human brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03558)
*Antoine Collas,Louis Jalouzot,Géraud Ilinca,Corentin Caris,Romain Valabrègue,Ahmed Hassayoune,David Goncalves,Madeleine Hueber,Thaddée Delebarre,Julien Savatovsky,Clara Fonteneau,Charles Maussion,Bertrand Thirion,Alexis Thual*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发布Cephalonauts One数据集：3名健康被试在3T fMRI下收听母语音频播客，每人30小时数据，是目前使用自然语音刺激的最深fMRI数据集，并提供音频片段检索式脑解码基准、标准化划分、评价指标、基线解码器及数据规模缩放分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有fMRI数据集在自然语音刺激下的单被试数据量有限，难以支撑深度脑解码模型的训练与数据规模效应研究。

Method: 采集3名健康被试在3T fMRI下收听母语播客的多轮扫描数据，每轮含5个15分钟run；同步提供播客音频、转录标注与派生刺激嵌入；构建音频片段检索式脑解码任务，给出标准化数据划分、评价指标与基线解码器，并进行训练数据量的缩放分析。

Result: 每名被试获得30小时fMRI数据，为当前自然语音刺激下最深fMRI数据集；解码性能随单被试训练数据量增加而持续提升。

Conclusion: 该数据集与基准为自然语音脑解码研究提供了大规模、可复现的资源，并揭示了数据规模对解码性能的持续增益。

Abstract: Cephalonauts One is a whole-brain 3 Tesla (3T) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) dataset recorded while subjects listened to audio podcasts. Three healthy subjects underwent multiple scanning sessions, each consisting of five 15-minute runs, while listening to podcasts in their native language. With 30 hours of fMRI data per subject, the current release is the deepest available fMRI dataset using naturalistic speech stimuli. The dataset pairs brain activity with the corresponding podcast audio, transcript annotations, and derived stimulus embeddings. Furthermore, we introduce a brain decoding benchmark formulated as audio segment retrieval: given fMRI activity from a held-out session, the decoder must identify the corresponding time-aligned podcast audio segment among candidate segments. We provide standardized splits, evaluation metrics, and baseline decoders for this task. Finally, a scaling analysis shows that decoding performance improves continuously with the amount of training data per subject.

</details>


### [357] [A Path Integral Surrogate for Multi-Step Gradient Inversion in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03597)
*Agnivo Ghosh,Saumik Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PI-SME，将FedAvg累积更新视为梯度场的路径积分，用Gauss-Legendre求积在可学习Bézier路径上多点近似，从而更准确地进行梯度反演攻击。在CIFAR-100与FEMNIST上多指标优于最强代理基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端仅上传模型更新而非原始数据，隐私保护依赖更新泄露信息远少于训练样本这一前提。梯度反演攻击通过从单次更新重建私有图像直接挑战该前提。FedAvg下客户端更新累积了多步本地训练，服务器只能看到隐藏权重轨迹的两个端点；近期攻击虽在两端点间路径上拟合代理模型，但仍仅在单点读取梯度，信息利用不充分。

Method: 提出Path-Integral Surrogate Model Extension（PI-SME）：将FedAvg的累积更新建模为梯度场沿权重轨迹的路径积分，用Gauss-Legendre求积在可学习Bézier路径的多个节点上进行近似，替代单点梯度读取，从而更完整地刻画整个隐轨迹。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和FEMNIST图像上，覆盖多种轨迹长度与类别受限批次设置，PI-SME在多项反演指标及匹配损失上均比最强代理基线更忠实地重建私有输入。

Conclusion: 多节点路径积分近似优于单点代理，验证了利用隐权重轨迹整段信息对梯度反演的价值，也表明FedAvg的累积更新比此前认为的泄露更多隐私信息。

Abstract: Federated learning lets many clients train a shared model together without ever sending their private data to a central server. Each client shares only a model update, and this update should reveal far less about the client than its raw training examples would. This premise is what protects the privacy of the clients. Gradient inversion attacks challenge it directly by trying to reconstruct a client's private input images from the single update it shared. Under FedAvg, a client's update accumulates several local training steps, so the server sees only the two endpoints of a hidden weight trajectory. Recent gradient inversion attacks fit a surrogate model along the path between these two endpoints but they still read its gradient at a single point. We propose the Path-Integral Surrogate Model Extension (PI-SME) which treats the accumulated update as a path integral of the gradient field and approximates it by Gauss--Legendre quadrature over several nodes along a learnable Bézier path. On CIFAR-100 and FEMNIST images across a range of trajectory lengths and class-restricted batches PI-SME reconstructs the private inputs more faithfully than the strongest surrogate baseline on several inversion metrics and the matching loss.

</details>


### [358] [Mastering Atari 2600 Games with Discovered Options](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03604)
*Erik M. Lintunen,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We present Wayfarer, a general, domain-agnostic, online deep RL agent that discovers options through Laplacian representation learning from high-dimensional observations and leverages them for control.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Temporal abstractions, often instantiated as options, have long been regarded as a mechanism for accelerating credit assignment, facilitating exploration, and enabling generalisation in reinforcement learning (RL). However, developing general option discovery methods that are effective in large-scale, high-dimensional domains remains a fundamental challenge. Existing option discovery methods are either confined to relatively simple domains, depend on handcrafted or quasi-symbolic representations, or offer little improvement over learning without options.

Method: Wayfarer learns Laplacian representations from high-dimensional observations to discover options online, and leverages these options for control in a domain-agnostic manner.

Result: The resulting options simultaneously improve exploration, accelerate credit assignment, and generalise effectively to unseen settings, enabling substantially faster learning of complex policies. Wayfarer achieves state-of-the-art performance among single-stream agents on the most challenging Atari 2600 games, with the largest gains in games that require long-horizon exploration and strategic behaviour, such as Montezuma's Revenge and Private Eye.

Conclusion: Wayfarer is a general, domain-agnostic, online deep RL agent that discovers options through Laplacian representation learning from high-dimensional observations and leverages them for control.

Abstract: Temporal abstractions, often instantiated as options, have long been regarded as a mechanism for accelerating credit assignment, facilitating exploration, and enabling generalisation in reinforcement learning (RL). However, developing general option discovery methods that are effective in large-scale, high-dimensional domains remains a fundamental challenge. Existing option discovery methods are either confined to relatively simple domains, depend on handcrafted or quasi-symbolic representations, or offer little improvement over learning without options. We present Wayfarer, a general, domain-agnostic, online deep RL agent that discovers options through Laplacian representation learning from high-dimensional observations and leverages them for control. We show that the resulting options simultaneously improve exploration, accelerate credit assignment, and generalise effectively to unseen settings, enabling substantially faster learning of complex policies. Wayfarer achieves state-of-the-art performance among single-stream agents on the most challenging Atari 2600 games, with the largest gains in games that require long-horizon exploration and strategic behaviour, such as Montezuma's Revenge and Private Eye.

</details>


### [359] [IDRF: Inverse-Distilled Reward Fine-tuning of Masked Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03641)
*Vladislav Gromadskii,David Li,Samson Gourevitch,Yazid Janati,Eric Moulines,Maxim Panov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IDRF框架，用于少步掩码离散扩散生成器的奖励微调，通过逆蒸馏正则替代不可解的序列级KL惩罚，结合有限时域MDP与裁剪策略梯度优化，在DNA、图像、文本任务上以最多少32倍去噪步数实现高奖励并缓解奖励劫持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码离散扩散模型是自回归生成的有前景替代，但迭代采样成本高，且序列似然不可解使得奖励微调困难。现有方法难以在少步生成条件下兼顾奖励优化、分布约束与样本质量。

Method: IDRF从标准反向KL正则目标出发，用逆蒸馏正则(auxiliary denoiser)替代不可解的序列级KL惩罚，证明在最优辅助去噪器下逆蒸馏损失的总体值上界参考分布序列级KL散度。方法优化该损失的轨迹代理目标，无需参考模型rollout，使学生保留自身少步采样器；并将少步生成建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，对轨迹用裁剪策略梯度目标优化奖励。

Result: 在DNA、图像和文本生成任务上，IDRF获得高奖励，去噪步数较参考模型最多减少32倍，同时缓解奖励劫持(reward hacking)并保持样本质量。

Conclusion: IDRF为少步掩码离散扩散生成器提供了可行的奖励微调框架，兼顾高效采样、奖励对齐与分布保持，适用于多模态离散生成场景。

Abstract: Masked discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, but iterative sampling can be costly, and intractable sequence likelihoods complicate reward fine-tuning. We introduce IDRF, a framework for reward fine-tuning of few-step masked discrete diffusion generators. Starting from a standard reverse-KL-regularized objective, IDRF replaces the intractable sequence-level KL penalty with inverse-distillation regularization. With an optimal auxiliary denoiser, we prove that the population inverse-distillation loss upper-bounds the sequence-level KL divergence to the reference distribution. IDRF optimizes a trajectory-based surrogate of this loss without reference-model rollouts, so the student keeps its own few-step sampler. We view few-step generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and optimize reward with a clipped policy-gradient objective over the student's trajectories. Across DNA, image, and text generation, IDRF achieves high reward with up to $32\times$ fewer denoising steps than the reference while mitigating reward hacking and preserving sample quality.

</details>


### [360] [On the Convergence of Success Conditioning for Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03642)
*Matthew Brun,Xu Andy Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究成功条件化（success conditioning）策略的极限行为与收敛速率，证明其在广泛MDP类上收敛到最优策略，并给出折扣MDP与单周期MDP的收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成功条件化是随机环境中改进决策策略的常用策略，广泛应用于强化学习，但其极限行为和收敛速率尚缺乏理论理解。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 通过理论分析，在广泛的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）类上研究成功条件化的收敛性；针对折扣MDP推导达到ε-最优策略的迭代次数上界，并分析单周期MDP的收敛速率。成功条件化通过提高导致成功结果的动作概率来更新策略。

Result: 成功条件化在广泛MDP类上收敛到最优策略。折扣MDP中，在O(1/ε^p)次迭代内收敛到ε-最优策略，其中指数p取决于问题数据；单周期MDP中，在O(log(1/ε))次迭代内获得该策略。

Conclusion: 成功条件化具有向最优策略收敛的理论保证，且在折扣MDP和单周期MDP中分别具有多项式和对数级收敛速率，为其在强化学习中的应用提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Success conditioning is a strategy for improving decision-making policies in stochastic environments; it updates a policy by increasing the probability of taking actions that yield successful outcomes. Success conditioning is common to many reinforcement learning applications, yet its limiting behavior and convergence rates are not well understood. In this work, we demonstrate that success conditioning converges to an optimal policy on a broad class of Markov decision processes (MDPs). We also derive convergence rates in some common settings. For discounted MDPs, we prove convergence within $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$ iterations to an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy, where the exponent $p$ depends on problem data. For single-period MDPs, such a policy is obtained within $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.

</details>


### [361] [Forecasting from Counterfactual Simulator Rollouts: A Sim2Real Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03662)
*Angel Wang,Dominique Perrault-Joncas,Alvaro Maggiar,Dean Foster,Carson Eisenach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 新决策策略上线导致预测模型冷启动问题。本文用仿真器滚动生成反事实轨迹训练预测模型，再迁移到真实场景并持续校准；两个真实库存控制部署验证了该方法在冷启动预测上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署新决策策略时，预测模型面临冷启动：历史观测反映旧策略，新策略下的真实观测尚不可得，导致目标依赖策略动作的预测模型缺乏训练数据。

Method: 提出仿真到现实（Sim2Real）迁移流程：仿真器在新目标策略下跨反事实场景 rollout，生成轨迹以学习系统对控制的响应；用仿真数据训练预测器，再通过历史部署的真实观测进行回测，并随新策略真实观测积累进行轻量校准。从仿真器保真度、零样本迁移、适应性三角度评估。

Result: 两个真实库存控制部署中，仿真器训练预测器的点估计MAPE低于同架构用历史真实数据训练的模型：研究1降低1.2–3.1个百分点，研究2降低12.5–18.7个百分点；部署后利用早期真实观测的轻量校准进一步降低误差最多2.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 仿真生成的反事实数据可为新策略下的冷启动预测提供支持，且随真实部署数据积累模型可进一步精化，为Sim2Real在策略切换场景的应用提供实证依据。

Abstract: Deploying a new decision policy creates a cold-start problem for prediction models whose targets depend on the policy's actions: historical observations reflect earlier policies, while real observations under the new policy are not yet available. Simulation offers a way to address this gap by rolling out the target policy across counterfactual scenarios and using the resulting trajectories to learn how the system responds to those controls. The simulation-to-reality (Sim2Real) transfer of this simulator-trained model can then be backtested by evaluating it against real observations from past deployments. Using two real-world inventory-control deployments, we evaluate this process from three angles: simulator fidelity, zero-shot transfer to real behavior, and adaptation as real target-policy observations accumulate. The simulator-trained forecaster achieves lower point-estimate mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) than the same architecture trained on historical real data, reducing MAPE by 1.2-3.1 percentage points in Study 1 and 12.5-18.7 points in Study 2. After deployment, lightweight calibration using early real observations further reduces error by up to 2.5 percentage points. These results provide empirical evidence that simulator-generated counterfactual data can support cold-start forecasting under a new policy, and the resulting model can be further refined as real deployment data become available.

</details>


### [362] [LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03702)
*Lyuxin David Zhang,Eric Wong,Surbhi Goel,Anton Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LESSER：用输出层梯度替代全参数梯度进行数据选择，仅需前向传播即可完成，在 SFT 和 RL 基准上将特征提取 FLOPs 分别降低 9.7 倍和 3.0 倍，同时保持与全梯度方法相当的下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于梯度的数据选择通常依赖全参数梯度与小型验证集梯度对齐度来为训练样本排序，但全参数梯度需要对每个样本进行昂贵的反向传播，候选池规模较大时计算不可行。因此作者希望以更低成本近似全梯度特征。

Method: 作者发现输出层梯度就足以进行有效的数据选择，且只需成本更低的前向传播。基于此实现 LESSER，作为选择方法的即插即用封装器，用输出层梯度特征替代全参数梯度特征。

Result: LESSER 将特征提取的 FLOP 成本在 SFT 上降低 9.7 倍、在 RL 基准上降低 3.0 倍，同时在下游任务上跟踪全梯度方法的性能。实验还发现，即使输出层梯度与全梯度对单样本的排序不同，二者选出的批次梯度仍是对齐的。

Conclusion: 输出层梯度可作为全梯度的廉价且有效的代理用于数据选择，LESSER 在显著降低计算成本的同时保持下游性能，说明按批次对齐而非单样本排序是选择有效性的关键。

Abstract: The choice of post-training data for large language models substantially affects downstream performance. Gradient-based data selection is a popular approach that ranks training data by how well their gradients align with those of a small validation set. However, ranking with full-parameter gradients requires an expensive backward pass on every sample, making computation intractable for large candidate pools. This raises a natural question: can we approximate full-gradient features at a fraction of the cost? Conveniently, we find that output-layer gradients suffice for effective data selection, yet require only the cheaper forward pass. We implement this as LESSER, a drop-in wrapper for selection methods that reduces the feature-extraction FLOP cost by $9.7\times$ for SFT and $3.0\times$ for RL benchmarks, while tracking full-gradient performance on downstream tasks. Empirically, we find that even when output-layer and full gradients rank individual samples differently, they select batches with aligned gradients.

</details>


### [363] [RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03712)
*Yiming Huang,Lennart Bastian,Hanqun Cao,Luis Vollmers,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出标准化RNA分子动力学基准RNADynBench（含2585条质控100 ns全原子轨迹及防泄漏划分）与统一模型RNADynNet，可在共享骨干上同时实现轨迹生成与动力学指纹提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RNA功能依赖构象变化，静态结构难以刻画；但大规模标准化RNA动力学数据稀缺，且现有方法将"轨迹生成"与"动力学理解"割裂为两个独立目标，缺乏统一框架。

Method: 构建RNADynBench：2585条质控100 ns全原子MD轨迹，采用防泄漏数据划分。在其上提出RNADynNet：共享骨干网络，融合坐标去噪、单帧到轨迹对齐（single-frame-to-trajectory alignment）及物理约束（physical grounding），实现全原子轨迹生成与动力学表示学习的耦合。

Result: 物理约束同时提升生成轨迹质量与指纹中可恢复的物理信息。在包括高柔性挑战集在内的两个测试集上，生成轨迹RMSF相关性达0.875与0.766；单构象预测与MD动力学结果具有可比一致性。

Conclusion: RNADynBench与RNADynNet共同为RNA动力学的生成与理解提供了标准化基准和统一建模框架。

Abstract: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we develop RNADynNet, a unified model for RNA dynamics learning that uses a shared backbone for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction from a single conformer. It combines coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding to connect all-atom trajectory generation with dynamics representation learning. Physical grounding improves both generated dynamics and the physical information recoverable from these fingerprints. Across both test sets, including the high-flexibility challenge set, the generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766, while single-conformer predictions show comparable agreement with MD-derived dynamics. RNADynBench and RNADynNet together establish a benchmark and unified modeling framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [364] [World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02508)
*Fei Zhang,Zhaochong An,Duncan Frost,Yikai Wang,Pengfei Liu,Ya Zhang,Michal Drozdzal,Amir Bar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProWAM 是一种渐进式世界动作模型，通过联合预测动作与稀疏有序视觉子目标序列，为长时程机器人控制提供显式视觉引导，实现了高效的闭环操作与更强的分布外鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在长时程预测中效率低下：生成密集视频推演代价高昂；而仅预测单张未来帧的方法又忽略了对目标推进过程的引导。因此需要一种兼顾效率与全局规划（进度索引）的视觉前瞻机制。

Method: 提出 ProWAM：联合预测动作与一组有序的稀疏视觉子目标，作为显式视觉锚点引导整套任务执行中的动作生成。子目标预测可从大规模无动作视频中学习，从而让视频骨干网络分担复杂视觉规划，动作策略专注控制。推理时仅执行一次视频骨干前向以缓存稀疏子目标特征，避免迭代式全视频生成，重规划阶段只需轻量级动作去噪。

Result: 在仿真基准上取得新 SOTA：LIBERO-Plus 85.8%，随机化 RoboTwin 75.7%，相对最强基线提升最高 +35.9%；RoboCasa365 成功率 48.1%，困难 Composite-Unseen 子集 18.2%，总排名第 4。零样本真实世界实验中成功率达 70.0%，比最强基线高 +15.0（55.0%→70.0%，相对提升 +27.3%），并在新颖场景中表现出优越的 OOD 鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 结果表明“进度索引的视觉前瞻”（progress-indexed visual foresight）对闭环控制具有重要价值，ProWAM 在效率、泛化与真实部署上均具优势。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in https://sii-ferenas.github.io/ProWAM-page.

</details>


### [365] [Low-Cost Video--Time Priors as a Strong Baseline for EEG--fNIRS Emotion Regression on Familiar Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03618)
*Minghao Kong,Jiurun Chen,Ying Gao,Xiangbin Meng,Rongjie Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究熟悉视频场景下的连续情绪回归，发现视频时间先验（video-time prior）是强且低成本的基线，而EEG-fNIRS仅作为可选的残差信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续情绪回归需估计观看视频时逐帧的效价与唤醒度评分；在熟悉视频部署中，需检验生理信号是否能在被试特定响应基础上提供额外残差校正。

Method: 采用五折被试留出评估（24名被试），比较“先验主导的固定融合”策略：融合被试特定的训练响应基线与EEG-fNIRS生理信号，并做来源显式消融（video identity、within-video time）。

Result: 融合模型相对基线在内部与外部评估中MAE差分别为0.05与0.32；消融显示视频身份与视频内时间贡献了大部分性能下降，EEG-fNIRS增益较小且因人、因视频而异。

Conclusion: 视频时间先验是熟悉视频情绪回归的强基线，EEG-fNIRS应定位为可选的残差信号，而非主要信息来源。

Abstract: Continuous emotion regression estimates moment-to-moment valence and arousal while a viewer watches a video. In familiar-video deployment, responses fron training participant-specific estimate, and prior-dominating fixed fusion tests whether physiology adds residual correction. In five-fold subject-held-out evaluation on 24was within 0.05 and 0.32 MAE of fusion in the internal and external evaluations, respectively. Source-explicit ablations showed that video identity and within-video tine accounted for most of the reduction, while EG-FNIRS gains were smaller and varied across participants and videos. These results identify the video-time prior as a strong, low-cost baseline and position EEG-fNIRS as an optional residual signal for familiar-video emotion regression.

</details>


### [366] [On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02510)
*Sidney Shapiro,Joshua Lindemann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍 CourseChat：一个面向本科商科教育的本地化多课程 RAG 助教系统，部署于校园网关之后并拟嵌入 Moodle。系统以课程注册号（CRN）隔离六门课程，依托双边缘 AI 主机运行 FastAPI、本地向量库与 Ollama 本地 LLM。研究通过两轮生成模型对比、固定证据的来源忠实度比较及对话与测验审计，发现大模型未通过课堂速度门槛，12B 与 7B 模型达标，MoE 候选模型带来新的事实与连贯性错误，故暂保留 8B 生产模型。结论强调模型选择、证据选择、服务兼容性与产品设计应作为联合工程决策，尚未证明学习增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 校园 AI 助教需满足两项约束：答案必须基于指定课程材料（RAG grounding），且教材与学生对话须保留在校内基础设施上（数据不出校、隐私与合规）。现有方案多为云端通用模型，难以同时满足本地化部署、多课程隔离与课堂响应速度要求，因此需要一套面向本科商科教学的本地化多课程 RAG 助教系统及其实证评估方法。

Method: 构建 CourseChat：本地化多课程 RAG 助教，部署于校园 Web 网关之后，面向嵌入 Moodle 使用。六个相互隔离的课程实例各以自己的 CRN 为键，共享双边缘 AI 主机，运行 FastAPI 服务、本地向量数据库，以及由 Ollama 服务的本地 LLM。评估方法包括：两轮生成模型 bake-off（含课堂速度门槛测试）、一项独立的固定证据来源忠实度（source-fidelity）比较，以及对话与测验审计。此外还统计了软件改动对后续话题解析的影响，并构建了 65 个模块、435 道预制题以将练习与实时生成解耦。

Result: 若干更大的模型未能通过课堂速度门槛；一个 12B 模型与一个 7B 备选模型通过。一个单独的混合专家（MoE）候选模型改进了部分纠错，但引入了新的事实性错误与连贯性错误。因此保留 8B 生产模型，等待其整体性能被证明有提升，而非宣称 8B 普遍最优。软件改动改善了后续对话的话题解析能力，同时保持课程范围不越界；435 道预制题覆盖 65 个模块，将练习与实时生成解耦。

Conclusion: 结果支持将模型选择、证据选择、服务兼容性与产品设计视为一项联合工程决策，而非彼此独立的优化项。研究未建立学习增益：教师评分、峰值负载容量以及完整的公共网关验收仍属于需要单独评估的议题。

Abstract: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.

</details>


### [367] [MRVQ: One Resident Index for Dimension- and Rate-Elastic Vector Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03651)
*Sean Culatana,Shang-En Huang,Kang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization (MRVQ)，一种针对冻结嵌入的事后残差量化器，其最高速率码可从残差阶段和嵌入坐标两个方向截断，单个常驻产物即可服务多种 (维度, 速率) 组合，在评估的所有设计中内存占用最低，但每速率质量略逊于单独训练的 QINCo2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集检索服务需要随延迟、质量和内存预算的变化，在嵌入前缀维度与索引比特率之间切换。为每个速率单独调优量化器虽质量最优，但检索层需同时保存多份码流与量化器状态，内存开销大。因此需要一种单一常驻产物即可覆盖多种 (维度, 速率) 配置的低内存方案，同时寻找构建成本更低的替代设计，并检验若干假设与训练稳定性问题。

Method: 提出 MRVQ：对冻结嵌入进行事后残差向量量化，其最高速率码支持双重截断——丢弃残差阶段降低速率，丢弃嵌入坐标降低维度，从而以单份常驻产物覆盖所有评估的 (维度, 速率) 组合。在 FiQA 与 NFCorpus 两个数据集、四类嵌入族、{4, 8, 16} 字节码上，与三种单独训练的 QINCo2 索引、精简共享模型基线、PQ、OPQ、AdANNS-OPQ 对比。另评估一种低构建成本的 PCA-标量设计，并与 RaBitQ 及其扩展比较。最后报告两项负结果：高训练速率下 QINCo2 崩溃，以及排序界假设未达预设验收标准。

Result: MRVQ 是所评估设计中内存最低的方案：比三个单独训练的 QINCo2 索引少用 17.8–22.0 倍内存，比精简共享模型基线少用 1.89–2.02 倍。代价是每速率 QINCo2 在 FiQA 上 nDCG@10 高出 0.026–0.107。但在匹配码大小时，MRVQ 优于 PQ、OPQ 和 AdANNS-OPQ。PCA-标量设计质量与 RaBitQ 及其扩展相当，中位构建速度快 420 倍。

Conclusion: MRVQ 是面向弹性检索的低内存工作点，而非普适的质量最优方案；其以牺牲少量每速率质量换取显著的内存节省和单产物多配置覆盖能力。同时，高训练速率下 QINCo2 崩溃与排序界假设未通过验收，提示相关方向存在局限。

Abstract: Dense-retrieval services must switch among embedding-prefix dimensions and index bit rates as latency, quality, and memory budgets change. Tuning a quantizer separately for each rate gives the best quality, but the retrieval tier then holds several code streams and quantizer states at once. We introduce Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization (MRVQ), a post-hoc residual quantizer for frozen embeddings. Its maximum-rate code can be truncated two ways: dropping residual stages lowers the rate, and dropping embedding coordinates lowers the dimension. One resident artifact therefore serves every (dimension, rate) pair we evaluate. Across FiQA and NFCorpus, four embedding families, and {4, 8, 16}-byte codes, MRVQ is the lowest-RAM design we evaluate. It uses 17.8-22.0x less memory than three separately trained QINCo2 indices, and 1.89-2.02x less than a lean shared-model steelman. The saving is not free: per-rate QINCo2 is 0.026-0.107 nDCG@10 better on FiQA. But MRVQ beats PQ, OPQ, and AdANNS-OPQ at matched code size. We also evaluate a low-build-cost PCA-scalar design that attains quality comparable to RaBitQ and its extension while fitting 420x faster at the median. Finally, we report two negative results: QINCo2 collapses when trained at high rates, and a ranking-bound hypothesis misses its pre-specified acceptance criteria. MRVQ is therefore a low-memory operating point for elastic retrieval, not a universal quality winner.

</details>


### [368] [VIGOR: Zero-Shot Visual Generalization via Latent-Space Consistency in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02801)
*Mingyu Park,Samyeul Noh,Hyun Myung,Donghwan Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VIGOR框架，通过在隐空间施加一致性强约束，实现基于模型强化学习对未见视觉扰动的零样本泛化，同时保持样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）虽具样本效率优势，但在未见视觉扰动（背景变化、光照变化、相机位移）下性能显著下降。与无模型RL仅受单步预测扰动不同，MBRL存在两级脆弱性：视觉扰动首先使编码器输出偏离分布，随后误差在规划时域的递归隐状态推演中不断累积放大。

Method: VIGOR包含三个相互依赖的组件：(i) 非对称弱到强增强，在同一批次内配对"仅弱增强"与"弱到强"两种隐表示视图；(ii) 动力学级一致性，通过直接隐空间回归强制转移预测对增强不变；(iii) 编码器级稳定化，抑制由动力学级一致性所施加的跨增强监督导致的编码器漂移。

Result: 在DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) 与Robosuite上，VIGOR优于当前最优的无模型与基于模型基线，在DMC上超出次优基线3.4%，在Robosuite上超出43.6%。消融实验表明其鲁棒性与增强方式无关：替换为其他扰动族的增强手段仍保持强泛化能力，说明驱动鲁棒性的是隐空间一致性而非增强选择。

Conclusion: VIGOR通过隐空间一致性有效缓解了MBRL中编码器分布外偏移与递归推演误差累积的两级脆弱性，实现了对未见视觉扰动的零样本泛化，且该鲁棒性来源于一致性机制本身而非特定增强策略，具备增强无关的通用性。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) achieves strong sample efficiency by planning within learned latent dynamics, yet its performance degrades substantially under unseen visual distractions such as background variations, lighting changes, or camera shifts. Unlike model-free RL, where encoder perturbations affect only single-step predictions, MBRL suffers from a two-level vulnerability: visual distractions first push encoder outputs out of distribution, and these errors then compound through recursive latent rollouts over the planning horizon. We propose visual generalization via latent-space consistency in model-based RL (VIGOR), a framework that enables zero-shot generalization to unseen visual distractions while retaining the sample efficiency of its MBRL backbone. VIGOR integrates three interdependent components: (i) asymmetric weak-to-strong augmentation, which pairs weak-only and weak-to-strong latent views within a single batch; (ii) dynamics-level consistency, which enforces augmentation-invariant transition predictions through direct latent regression; and (iii) encoder-level stabilization, which prevents encoder drift under the cross-augmentation supervision imposed by dynamics-level consistency. Evaluations on the DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) and Robosuite show that VIGOR outperforms state-of-the-art model-free and model-based baselines, surpassing the second-best baseline by 3.4% on DMC and 43.6% on Robosuite. Ablations further show that VIGOR's robustness is augmentation-agnostic: replacing the default augmentation with alternatives from distinct perturbation families preserves strong generalization, confirming that latent-space consistency, not the augmentation choice, drives robustness.

</details>


### [369] [Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02267)
*Jiawei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对开放权重模型Laya与托管模型Jev两个System-1决策模型在11个智能体决策点进行配对评估（7,283基础样本+6,640鲁棒性变体），并审计自身流水线中的分析错误与设计混淆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体框架每个任务需做大量小型类型化决策（选模型、选工具、判断检索相关性、判断注入），System-1决策模型用单次前向传播输出类别概率，理论上比调用LLM更省成本与延迟，但缺乏严谨的配对评估与对评估流水线自身的审计。

Method: 构建来自18个公开来源的11个决策点，含7,283基础案例与6,640鲁棒性变体；采用字节级相同输入、配对检验、跨硬件与跨天可复现性检查；同时审计分析流水线，发现3处分析错误与1处设计混淆。

Result: Jev在11个决策点中的9个显著更准（+10.8至+46.0个百分点）；两模型在零样本模型路由上均不优于随机，在RAG相关性门控上打平；Laya在选项顺序反转时改变30%答案，候选多或相似时性能骤降（50个最近邻工具时31%，Jev在唯一正确工具项上98%）。审计发现：遗漏前置筛选成本（报告23.9%节省，实际4.3%）、门控准确率被当作端到端质量（58% vs 98%）、样本内阈值（目标5%，留出集漏检达17%）、以及随通道原生内容消失的注入误报"通道效应"；另两处疑似混淆未改变结论。

Conclusion: System-1决策模型相比LLM调用有潜力，但当前表现高度依赖具体决策点与候选复杂度；部署收益常被评估流程中的成本遗漏、指标错位和阈值问题系统性高估，需严格配对评估与自我审计。所有案例、原始输出与分析代码均已开源。

Abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

</details>


### [370] [Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02492)
*Harry Lyu,Neil Thompson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 O*NET-BENCH 审计基准，发现 LLM 评判者虽然在响应排序上与工人评分一致，但在接受率与职业层面聚合估计上存在严重偏差，排序一致性不足以支撑职业测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 评判者被越来越多地用于评估 AI 输出是否满足职场要求，但现有验证多聚焦于排序一致性，未检验其能否复现工人对接受率和职业层面聚合的判断。

Method: 构建 O*NET-BENCH 审计套件，源自 45,796 条工人评分的调查，在 4,501 条测试评分上评估 33 种预训练评判者配置（涵盖 6 个模型家族），并与响应-only TF-IDF 基线、逐点/捆绑少样本/列表式协议及交叉验证校准进行比较。

Result: 25 种配置达到至少 0.60 的平局感知配对准确率，但 TF-IDF 基线几乎追平最强评判者；评判者估计的接受率为 3.0%–97.9%，而职业匹配工人为 61.1%；在某一微调谱系中，从逐点打分切换到捆绑少样本/列表式协议虽改善排序，却降低任务与职业层面的均值一致性，且该反转在预设标准下于任务-工人不相交验证集上复现；校准基本消除均值偏差，但校准分数最多解释 8.5% 的个体工人评分方差；预测辅助估计在研究的标注预算下仅带来微弱精度增益。

Conclusion: 仅凭排序一致性不足以支持职业测量，评判者应针对其分数将被用于估计的接受率与聚合指标进行验证。

Abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.

</details>


### [371] [VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02616)
*Zekai Wang,Yingqiang Ge,Zekun Wang,Hai Wang,Yuhui Xu,Joshua Frandsen,Shancong Fu,Ashia C. Wilson,Chandan K. Reddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究优化器能否通过自我进化（改进自身的诊断、编辑与验证流程）来更有效地改进另一智能体的 harness，并提出 VERSE——一个带"基于执行的验证"机制的自我进化优化器，在 SWE-rebench 与 OOD 任务上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 harness 进化方法只优化执行智能体的提示、工具与工作流，而优化器自身的工具与流程保持固定，限制了其诊断失败、制定编辑与检验效果的能力。作者希望验证：让优化器同时改进自己的优化流程是否能更有效地改进另一个智能体。

Method: 基于两个观察设计：(1) 受控实验表明，缺少基于执行的验证时优化器自我进化无法提升性能，而具备验证时效果最佳；(2) 跨五种执行器，自我进化优化器会自行构建失败分析、验证、训练审计与工作流控制的工具。据此提出 VERSE：允许优化器在提交前试跑草稿编辑、回放失败案例、扰动疑似步骤，并跨轮次追踪修复与回归。优化器据此同时修订执行器 harness 和自身的提示、技能、工具、钩子与笔记，而优化器与执行器模型权重保持冻结。评测采用训练/验证/测试任务互不相交的共享协议。

Result: 在 SWE-rebench 留出任务与五种语言的更新分布外任务上，VERSE 提升了全部四个被测 harness 优化器。经验证集选择的最佳 harness 分别达到 42.3% 和 37.7% 准确率，而最强基线为 39.2% 和 29.3%。

Conclusion: 优化器自我进化要见效，关键在于基于执行的验证机制；在此前提下，同时进化"被执行智能体的 harness"与"优化器自身的流程/工具"能比仅进化前者带来更优且更具泛化性的结果，且无需更新任何模型权重。

Abstract: Harness evolution improves an LLM agent's prompts, tools, and workflow, while the optimizer's own tools and procedures often remain fixed.
