We study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. Two observations guide our design. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Across five executors, self-evolving optimizers build their own tools for failure analysis, verification, training audits, and workflow control. Motivated by these findings, we introduce VERSE, a Verified Self-Evolving optimizer for agent harnesses. VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. Using this feedback, the optimizer revises both the executor harness and its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes, while the weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed. Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages. Its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7% accuracy, respectively, against 39.2% and 29.3% for the strongest baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE.

</details>


### [372] [Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02684)
*Min Zeng,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将"纵向信念更新"确立为LLM可靠性的独立维度，通过ICU匹配轨迹评估发现：模型基于先前判断更新时往往增加而非减少预测误差，并存在对恶化证据过度反应、受先前信念因果影响两大失效模式，提示无法可靠恢复更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被探索用于临床推理，但患者证据随时间演变时，模型能否恰当修正判断仍不明确，缺乏对纵向信念更新的系统评估。

Method: 利用电子健康记录中匹配的重症监护轨迹，评估多个LLM的纵向信念更新；设置对照干预区分失效模式：固定先前评估以检验对恶化vs改善呼吸证据的响应不对称性（并经headroom归一化）；固定当前证据、将先验风险从10%提升至90%以检验先前信念的因果影响；并测试提示工程及EVLU策略。

Result: 在多个LLM中，以先前判断为条件时，估计变化反而更多增加而非降低预测误差，并在第二终点上复现；对恶化证据的响应强于匹配的改善证据，该不对称在中强证据水平经headroom归一化后仍存在；先验风险从10%升至90%使估计偏移26.2个百分点，显示先前信念的因果影响；提示无法恢复可靠更新；EVLU识别出更少但更可靠的修正，展现可靠性-覆盖率的权衡。

Conclusion: 纵向信念更新是LLM可靠性的一个独立维度；当前模型在证据演变下存在系统性更新缺陷，提示工程不足以修复，EVLU等验证机制以牺牲覆盖率换取可靠性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.

</details>


### [373] [ROUTEAUDIT: Interaction-Aware Identification for Budgeted Multi-Verifier Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02808)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Tianshu Fu,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将多验证器路由重新表述为"契约条件识别问题"，提出ROUTEAUDIT协议，在匹配策略坐标下实现可归因、路径敏感可量化的比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多验证器系统的比较通常仅依据"质量-成本"端点差距，但当验证器目录、可用性、资源记账、信息过滤或评分方式随策略变化时，这种比较会混淆策略效应与其他坐标效应，导致归因不成立。

Method: 将验证器路由形式化为契约条件识别问题：契约记录请求支持、验证器目录、实际可用性、资源记账、在线过滤与后验评分；匹配路由对比仅改变策略坐标。ROUTEAUDIT引入三个可测量对象：(1) 契约格，在所有可容许桥接序上对坐标增量取平均，报告归因及其路径敏感性；(2) 策略无关的响应带，用于在自适应策略暴露不同观测时识别配对序贯对比；(3) 针对不完全匹配的请求级界，利用仍可观测的潜在结果给出尖锐的有限总体区间。协议在oracle连接之前承诺付费观测与账本事件，并为每次比较返回归因证书。

Result: 在两个留出原始尾部缓存上，匹配静态SF+SA与级联相等，将相对全静态的表观增益0.1797与0.1250归因于验证器集合边缘。在1,319个留出任务请求上，学习策略与RLVR研究报告质量0.9522与0.9553，匹配静态为0.9484；RLVR-静态配对差为+0.0068，请求配对区间[0.0015,0.0122]，训练种子×请求分层区间[0.0006,0.0131]。受控归因恢复的路由MAE为0.0011，端点重建误差为0.0004。因子、桥接序及随机提供者研究评估了证书接口；RLVR在同一识别契约下提供学习策略压力测试。

Conclusion: ROUTEAUDIT通过契约条件识别实现了可归因、路径敏感可量化的验证器路由比较，证明部分表观增益实为验证器集合边缘而非策略效应，并在学习与RLVR策略下提供带证书的配对区间。

Abstract: Adaptive multi-verifier systems are commonly compared through endpoint quality-cost gaps, even when the verifier catalog, availability, accounting, information filtration, or scorer changes with the policy. We formulate verifier routing as a contract-conditioned identification problem. The contract records request support, verifier catalog, realized availability, resource accounting, online filtration, and post-trace scoring; a matched route contrast changes only the policy coordinate. ROUTEAUDIT adds three measurable objects to this contract. A contract lattice averages coordinate increments over every admissible bridge order and reports the resulting attribution together with its path sensitivity. A policy-independent response tape identifies paired sequential contrasts when adaptive policies reveal different observations. For incomplete matching, request-level bounds use whichever potential outcome remains observed and give a sharp finite-population interval. The protocol commits paid observations and ledger events before the oracle join and returns an attribution certificate for each comparison. On two held-out raw-tail caches, matched static SF+SA equals the cascade, assigning the apparent gains of 0.1797 and 0.1250 over full static to the verifier-set edge. On 1,319 held-out task requests, the learned and RLVR studies report quality 0.9522 and 0.9553 versus 0.9484 for matched static; the RLVR-static paired difference is +0.0068 with a request-paired interval $[0.0015,0.0122]$ and a training-seed-by-request hierarchical interval $[0.0006,0.0131]$. Controlled attribution recovery yields route mean absolute error 0.0011 and endpoint reconstruction error 0.0004. Factorial, bridge-order, and stochastic-provider studies evaluate the certificate interface; RLVR supplies a learned-policy stress test under the same identification contract.

</details>


### [374] [FSPO: Policy-Consistent Risk and Pareto-Feasible Control for Budgeted LLM RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02828)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FSPO，一个面向预算化LLM强化学习后训练的反馈状态控制器，联合解决风险估计、校准与多资源可行性三个耦合问题，取得优于PB2的准确率与校准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应LLM RL后训练会在线调整多个训练执行器（rollout温度、组大小、裁剪、KL正则、验证器分配、更新预算），但存在三个耦合未解问题：由行为轨迹训练的未来风险模型未必能估计即将部署控制器所诱导的风险；基于日志状态-动作对校准的分数在选择性动作选择后可能失准；各资源独立的最小成本一般无法证明存在可行的多资源续行方案。

Method: FSPO学习策略一致的风险-to-go模型，其Bellman目标遵循与未来决策相同的冻结控制器，并配以长时程效用模型；提出决策条件轨迹校准（DCTC），在由临时控制器所选动作生成的交叉拟合轨迹上校准风险；提出帕累托资源续行证书（PRCC），仅当非支配的累计预留量在剩余时程内可行时才准入动作。

Result: 在匹配GRPO资源包络下，FSPO取得66.11%留出与59.43% OOD准确率，优于最强自适应基线PB2的64.47%与57.03%；三个配对训练种子较上下文多臂老虎机在留出与OOD上分别提升+2.42与+3.19个百分点。高行为-部署失配下，策略一致风险将所选决策ECE从0.108降至0.053；DCTC在相同接受率下由0.039降至0.022；PRCC在18动作目录上消除虚假可行准入（0.197→0.000）；因子消融中三者同时启用使轨迹失败率从0.181降至0.083。

Conclusion: FSPO通过将风险建模与部署控制器保持一致、按决策条件校准风险、并以多资源帕累托可行性证书约束动作选择，联合缓解了自适应LLM RL后训练中的风险失配、校准漂移与可行性误判，在准确率、校准与鲁棒性上均优于基线。

Abstract: Adaptive LLM reinforcement-learning post-training changes multiple training actuators online, including rollout temperature, group size, clipping, KL regularization, verifier allocation, and update budget. Three coupled issues remain unresolved. A future-risk model trained from behavior trajectories need not estimate the risk induced by the controller that will be deployed; a score calibrated on logged state-action pairs can become miscalibrated after selective action choice; and independent per-resource minimum costs do not in general certify a feasible multi-resource continuation. We introduce FSPO, a feedback-state controller for budgeted LLM RL post-training that addresses these issues jointly. FSPO learns a policy-consistent risk-to-go model whose Bellman target follows the same frozen controller used for future decisions, together with a long-horizon utility model. Decision-conditioned trajectory calibration (DCTC) calibrates risk on cross-fitted trajectories generated by actions selected by provisional controllers. A Pareto resource continuation certificate (PRCC) admits an action only when a non-dominated cumulative reservation remains feasible over the residual horizon. Under a matched GRPO resource envelope, FSPO reaches 66.11% held-out and 59.43% OOD accuracy, compared with 64.47% and 57.03% for PB2, the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline. Three paired training seeds give gains of +2.42 and +3.19 percentage points over the contextual bandit on held-out and OOD evaluation. Under high behavior-deployment mismatch, policy-consistent risk lowers selected-decision ECE from 0.108 to 0.053; DCTC lowers it from 0.039 to 0.022 at matched acceptance; PRCC removes false-feasible admissions on an 18-action catalog ($0.197\rightarrow0.000$); and enabling all three components reduces trajectory failure from 0.181 to 0.083 in a factorial ablation.

</details>


### [375] [Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02945)
*Junyi Zhang,Jinxi Yu,Eric Hanchen Jiang,Jiachen Lu,Zhi Zhang,Xinjie He,Hyunsik Chae,Ethan Ji,Alexander K Taylor,Vigyan Sahai,Yiwen Kou,Kai-Wei Chang,Raghu Meka,Nanyun Peng,Amit Sahai,Terence Tao,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ansatz，一个以"持续图记忆"（Continual Graph Memory）为核心的数学研究智能体，通过图结构组织长时程证明搜索过程并跨问题复用探索知识，在十个 First Proof Second Batch 问题上全部完成证明，并独立解决了 Jamison 毛虫猜想及多个 Erdős 开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用前沿智能体框架攻克数学研究问题已成为推进数学的有效手段，但前沿数学问题往往需要大量智能体长时间并行工作来构造证明，从而产生海量中间证明结果。如何在整个长时程证明搜索过程中组织这些中间结果、并复用以往探索所获得的知识，仍是主要挑战。

Method: 构建以持续图记忆为中心的数学研究智能体 Ansatz。其统一图记忆将全部中间探索结果（事实、计划、反例）表示为节点，并以显式边刻画其间关系；配合依赖感知检索提供精准的局部上下文，证据敏感的策展器（curator）更新研究前沿并从先前尝试中提炼经验教训，以及范围化召回（scoped recall）在局部重现证明时呈现早期陈述与否定性发现，而非不加批判地复用。实验覆盖全部十个 First Proof Second Batch 问题及四项组件研究。

Result: Ansatz 在全部十个研究任务上均报告完成（closure），显示出维持与恢复长时程数学搜索的能力；此外在无人干预下给出 Jamison 毛虫猜想以及 Erdős 问题 289、348、488 的解答，并在若干开放问题上取得部分进展。

Conclusion: 图结构的可演化跨问题记忆能够有效组织长时程证明搜索并复用探索知识，Ansatz 在批量基准任务上表现稳定，并具备独立求解开放数学研究问题的较强能力。

Abstract: Using frontier agent harnesses to tackle mathematical research problems has emerged as an effective means of advancing mathematics. However, solving frontier problems in mathematics may require a massive number of agents working in parallel for extended periods to construct proofs, thereby generating an enormous volume of intermediate proof results. Organizing these intermediate results throughout a long-horizon proof-search process and reusing knowledge gained from prior explorations remain major challenges. We present Ansatz, a mathematical research agent built around Continual Graph Memory, a graph-based, evolvable, cross-problem mathematical research memory system that explicitly organizes the entire proof search process and reuses information from exploration trajectories of previous problems. Specifically, we develop a unified graph memory that represents all intermediate exploration results, including facts, plans, and counterexamples, together with edges that explicitly represent the relationships among them; dependency-aware retrieval supplies precisely targeted local context; an evidence-sensitive curator updates the research frontier and distills lessons from prior attempts; and scoped recall surfaces earlier statements and negative findings for local re-proving rather than uncritical reuse. Experiments cover runs across all ten First Proof Second Batch problems, together with four component studies. Ansatz reports closure on all ten research tasks, demonstrating its ability to sustain and resume long-horizon mathematical search. Beyond these problems, Ansatz also produces solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488 without human intervention, and makes partial progress on several open problems, illustrating its strong ability to solve open mathematical research problems.

</details>


### [376] [Personalized Automatic Speech Recognition for a Dysarthric and Tracheostomic Speaker using Artificial Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03017)
*David Nadrchal,Monorama Swain,Florian Schmid,Gerhard Widmer,Paul Primus*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该工作为一名带有永久气管造口且患重度构音障碍的捷克语者构建了个性化ASR系统，公开33小时标注语音数据集，并采用基于Whisper Base的多阶段训练流程，在接近实时的三类场景下相对降低50%字符错误率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该说话者的语音对未受训练的听者完全不可懂，严重阻碍沟通。研究旨在验证：即使对于重度受损语音，也能构建出实用的个性化ASR系统，从而为这类群体恢复有效的语音交互能力。

Method: 发布包含33小时标注语音的公开数据集，采集采用新的"人工对话"协议以保证高参与度与对话真实性。基于Whisper Base提出多阶段训练流程：先在标准捷克语语音上微调，再在声学模拟的气管造口语音上微调，最后在该说话者数据上微调。

Result: 在脚本对话、问答和自发对话三种接近实时的场景下评估，相比Whisper Base基线，字符错误率相对降低50%，并在孤立话语的声学识别上超过其助手们的平均识别准确率。

Conclusion: 定量结果与说话者本人的反馈共同表明，对重度受损语音构建有帮助的ASR系统是可行的，为极端语音障碍者的个性化语音识别提供了可行路径与公开数据资源。

Abstract: This work presents an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system personalized for a Czech speaker with a permanent tracheal stoma and severe dysarthria rendering their speech unintelligible to untrained listeners. We release a public dataset containing 33 annotated hours of the speaker's speech, collected using a novel "artificial conversation" protocol designed for high engagement and dialogue realism. We propose a multi-stage training pipeline based on Whisper Base: fine-tuning on standard Czech speech, acoustically simulated tracheostomic speech, and the speaker's data. We evaluate the system across three near real-time scenarios: scripted conversations, question answering, and spontaneous dialogue, achieving a 50\% relative reduction in Character Error Rate compared to Whisper Base baseline and surpassing the average recognition accuracy of their assistants in acoustic recognition of isolated utterances. We demonstrate that even for severely impeded speech, a helpful ASR is achievable, as evidenced by the quantitative results and the feedback from the speaker.

</details>


### [377] [Verifiable, Articulable, and Tacit Components of Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03025)
*Alexander Spangher,Sheldon Huang,Andreas Haupt,Noah D. Goodman,Diyi Yang,Daniel E. Ho,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文构建了包含2.8M文本、317M人类偏好判断、覆盖7个创意领域的偏好数据集CreativePreferences，提出度量"可表述性差距(VAT-VA)"与"可验证性差距(VAT-V)"的方法，发现两者在所有领域普遍存在且随参与人数增加而扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "抓人""有新闻价值""优雅"等偏好构念具有部分默会(tacit)属性，难以表述与验证；而当前AI对齐主要依赖明示化的宪法、评分量表与验证器(RLAIF、RLVR)，对偏好中的默会成分研究不足，需量化这种默会成分带来的差距及其后果。

Method: 构建大规模标注偏好数据集CreativePreferences(2.8M文本、317M人类偏好判断、7个创意领域、42个基准任务)；用三类建模方式刻画标签——可执行程序(V)、评分量表库(rubric bank, A)与密集训练模型(VAT)；以VA与VAT之差估计"可表述性差距"，V与VAT之差估计"可验证性差距"；提出新测量方法：发现可表述与可验证指标、识别伪变量、并用捕获-再捕获(capture-recapture)估计未发现指标的价值，从而给出差距的上下界。

Result: 在所有领域均观察到稳健的可表述性差距(VAT-VA)与可验证性差距(VAT-V)；差距同样出现在通常被认为完全可验证的领域，包括以正确性为中心的数学与软件工程，以及以主张与新颖性为中心的新闻、专利与同行评审；差距大小随领域变化(同行评审与创意写作的可表述性差距最大)，并随参与判断人数增加而增大(与Collins的集体默会知识一致)。此外发现两点后果：(1)对人类生成内容，完整模型更贴合人类偏好，且常与明示准则相矛盾；(2)类比古德哈特定律，明示化偏好会使其偏离默会维度。

Conclusion: 可表述性与可验证性差距具有实质影响，不能忽略；据此给出建议：判断任务何时可直接用提示词完成、学习机制应如何改进、以及何时应将判断保留给人类。

Abstract: What makes a short story gripping; a news article newsworthy; or a math proof elegant? These constructs resist articulation or verification; their meaning is at least partially tacit. However, modern AI models are improved primarily via articulated constitutions, rubrics and verifiers (i.e. in RLAIF and RLVR); tacit components of preferences are typically understudied. We introduce a large, labeled preference dataset CreativePreferences, containing 2.8M texts labeled by 317M human preference judgments across 7 creative domains, with 42 benchmark tasks. We model these labels with executable programs, rubric banks and densely trained models (V, A and VAT, respectively). We observe robust articulability gaps, VAT-VA; and verifiability gaps, VAT-V; we estimate upper and lower bounds for each gap with a novel measurement approach that discovers articulable and verifiable metrics, identifies spurious variables and estimates the value of undiscovered metrics using capture-recapture. These gaps occur across all domains, even in domains traditionally treated as fully verifiable: correctness-centered domains (i.e. mathematics and software engineering) and claim- and novelty-centric domains (i.e. news, patents, peer review). The size of the gap varies based on domain (e.g. peer review and creative writing have the largest articulability gaps) and widens as more people take part in the judgment, consistent with Collins' collective tacit knowledge. We show two consequences: (1) on human generations, the full model more closely matches human preferences, often in disagreement with articulated criteria, and (2) in an analogy to Goodhart's law, articulating preference shifts it away from the tacit dimension. Articulability and verifiability gaps are consequential; we give recommendations on when tasks can be prompted; how learning mechanisms might improve; and when to leave judgments with humans.

</details>


### [378] [Peer Influence across Heterogeneous AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03095)
*Frida Nøhr Laustsen,Marie Haahr Petersen,Victoria Popa,Ariel Flint,Romualdo Pastor-Satorras,Andrea Baronchelli,Luca Maria Aiello*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在多智能体交互中，说服效果显著且高度依赖模型配对：说服力既不由模型规模决定，也不由独立决策的确定性预测，且听者的易感性比说者的说服力更能决定态度转变幅度，小模型可推翻大模型判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多智能体系统日益融合不同家族与规模的模型，当两个AI智能体意见不一致时，谁说服谁将直接决定哪些判断能在交互中存留下来。因此需要厘清说服的动态规律，判断能否从模型个体属性推断交互行为。

Method: 将说服量化为"单次与持异议同伴交流后智能体决策的概率偏移"，选取七个开源权重模型，在三个语言理解任务上进行测试，考察模型自身确定性与模型规模对说服动态的预测能力，并分析配对（说话者—听者）异质性对说服的影响。

Result: 说服效应很强，意见分歧时听者常放弃原有判断；但独立决策的确定性与模型规模均无法可靠预测说服动态——孤立状态下决策几乎完全一致的模型也可能极易被说服，小模型作为说服者及抵抗影响的能力可与大模型相当；态度转变幅度更多取决于听者易感性而非说者说服力；说服模式因模型配对而异，异质性在部分组合中放大、在另一些组合中抑制说服，使小模型提出的异议能推翻大模型的判断。

Conclusion: 交互模型的行为无法由其个体属性推断，必须在实际组合中加以评估，即说服是多智能体系统组合层面的涌现属性，模型评估与部署需以配对为单位进行。

Abstract: When two AI agents disagree, who persuades whom? As multi-agent systems increasingly combine language models of different families and sizes, the answer can determine which judgments survive interaction. Measuring persuasion as the probabilistic shift in an agent's decision after a single exchange with a dissenting peer, we test seven open-weight models across three language understanding tasks. We find that persuasion is strong: when models disagree, receivers often abandon their initial judgment after seeing a peer's answer and explanation. Surprisingly, however, neither standalone certainty nor model scale reliably predicts persuasion dynamics. Models producing almost perfectly consistent decisions in isolation can be among the most susceptible to persuasion, and small models can match larger ones as persuaders and resist their influence just as effectively. Furthermore, we show that the size of the shift depends more on the susceptibility of the listener than on the persuasiveness of the speaker. Persuasion patterns are therefore specific to each model pairing, with heterogeneity amplifying persuasion in some combinations and suppressing it in others, allowing a dissenting agent running a small model to overturn the judgments of a much larger one. These findings show that the behavior of interacting models cannot be inferred from their individual properties but must be evaluated in the combinations in which they will operate.

</details>


### [379] [Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03185)
*Han Cui,Jianhao Yan,Yun Luo,Hongbo Zhang,Zhizhang Fu,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从强化学习视角解释on-policy蒸馏（OPD）的双重结果：性能提升与退化崩溃，指出教师模型隐式奖励其中意的学生行为是根源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD是语言模型后训练的重要方法，虽有性能收益，但也会崩溃为过度冗长和重复生成，其内在机制尚不清楚，作者旨在解释这种分化结果。

Method: 将OPD置于强化学习框架下分析，提出教师隐式地奖励学生行为（即使教师自身很少产生这些行为）；通过实验验证该视角，并测试掩码不健康响应与SFT初始化等干预措施。

Result: OPD能在不扩展学生能力的情况下提升性能：当隐式奖励模型可靠时，使正确响应更易被采样；当偏好与质量错位时发生reward hacking，隐式奖励模型放大冗长重复的学生rollout，即使教师自身很少生成此类文本。掩码不健康响应和SFT初始化均能有效缓解崩溃。

Conclusion: OPD放大教师隐式反馈所偏好的学生行为，研究重点应从"教师生成得多好"转向"教师评估学生rollout有多可靠"。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an important approach to language model post-training. However, despite its performance gains, OPD can also collapse into excessively long and repetitive generation, and the mechanism underlying these divergent outcomes remains poorly understood. We explain these outcomes through a reinforcement learning perspective: the teacher implicitly rewards student behaviors, even those it rarely exhibits itself. From this perspective, our experiments show that OPD improves performance without expanding the student's capabilities. When the implicit reward model is reliable, OPD makes correct responses easier to sample. In contrast, when the preference misaligns with quality, reward hacking happens: the implicit reward model amplifies overlong, repetitive student rollouts, even though it rarely generates such text itself. Guided by this diagnosis, we find that masking unhealthy responses during training and using SFT initialization can each effectively mitigate the collapse. Together, these findings show that OPD amplifies student behaviors favored by the teacher's implicit feedback, shifting the focus from how well the teacher generates to how reliably it evaluates student rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/HancCui/opd_hacking.

</details>


### [380] [KV$^2$: A Self-Refining KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03198)
*Johannes Wesch,Danni Liu,Jan Niehues*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KV$^2$ 提出一种基于"选择性重建"的查询无关 KV 缓存压缩方法：先用轻量代理打分器筛选信息量大的上下文 token，再仅对子集重算最终淘汰分数，从而在紧预算下大幅优于基线且开销低于全上下文重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文模型中 KV 缓存显存占用限制实用部署，尤其在"一次预填充、多查询复用"场景下，缓存成本主导总开销。查询无关压缩需在成本与质量间权衡：轻量估计器便宜但精度低，全上下文重建评分更准却需重处理整个 prompt。因此本文追问：可复用的 KV 压缩是否必须重处理全上下文。

Method: KV$^2$ 采用两阶段选择性重建：第一阶段用轻量代理打分器（proxy scorer）识别上下文中信息量较高的 token；第二阶段仅对该子集进行重处理，计算最终淘汰（eviction）分数。以此在保留重建精度优势的同时避免全提示重处理。

Result: 在 RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 LongBench 上，KV$^2$ 相对基线的优势随预算收紧而扩大：RULER 16K 在 2% KV 缓存预算下，平均分比次优基线高出 40 个百分点以上；LongBench 上在 2%–10% 各档预算均取得最高平均分，且压缩阶段运行时间与峰值显存均低于全上下文重建。

Conclusion: 可复用的 KV 缓存压缩无需重处理完整上下文；通过"轻量筛选 + 子集重建"即可在紧预算下兼顾质量与效率。代码已开源。

Abstract: The memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache constrains the practical use of long-context models, and it dominates cost when one prefilled context must later serve many different queries. In this reusable setting, query-agnostic compression trades cost against quality: lightweight estimators are cheap but less accurate, whereas full-context reconstruction scoring is more accurate yet reprocesses the entire prompt. We introduce KV$^2$, a query-agnostic KV-cache compression method based on selective reconstruction. KV$^2$ first uses a lightweight proxy scorer to identify informative in-context tokens, then reprocesses only this subset to compute final eviction scores. On RULER, Needle-in-a-Haystack, and LongBench, KV$^2$'s margin over baselines widens as the budget tightens: on RULER 16K at a 2% KV-cache budget it improves the average score over the next-best baseline by more than 40 percentage points, and on LongBench it attains the highest average across 2%-10% budgets at lower compression-stage runtime and peak memory than full-context reconstruction. Reusable KV-cache compression thus does not require reprocessing the full context. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97.

</details>


### [381] [Multilingual GSM-Symbolic: What determines capability transfer across languages?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03367)
*Kenneth Enevoldsen,Riley Herchert,Sofie Mosegaard,Dan Saattrup Smart,Simon Enni,Isaac Chung,Sofie Bruun,Ayush Sunil Munot,Max Müller-Eberstein,Adnan El-Assadi,Elisa Bassignana,Gianluca Barmina,Hafsteinn Einarsson,Iben Nyholm Debess,Linda Freienthal,Lukas Galke Poech,Mike Zhang,Nicolas Legrand,Vladimir Salnikov,Yevhen Kostiuk,Zafar Hussain,Sagandeep Kaur,Agnes Toftgård,Marie Mattson,Kristoffer Nielbo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出可扩展的多语言数学数据集Multilingual GSM-Symbolic（3万条配对问答、15种语言），联合量化跨语言能力迁移的决定因素，并给出仅需少量目标语言模板即可预测模型表现的分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前对"一种语言中获得的能力如何迁移到另一种语言"以及"由什么因素决定这种迁移"理解甚少：现有评测依赖不可比、易饱和的数据集，且很少联合考察迁移的决定因素。识别可预测迁移的因素，可避免对所有语言对进行穷尽评测，并使开发者能针对限制低资源语言表现的因素进行优化。

Method: 构建Multilingual GSM-Symbolic：一个可扩展的多语言数学数据集，包含30,000条题目配对（item-matched）的问答样本，覆盖15种语言；采用符号化模板生成题目，以防过拟合并保证泛化——单个样本可生成数百万个高质量变体。基于该数据集，采用联合估计的方式量化语言能力的主要决定因素（模型规模、语言资源水平、推理、类型学距离），并分析各因素对语言间性能差距的调节作用；此外提出用少量目标语言模板的测量值来预测未见语言上的表现。

Result: 能力的主要决定因素及效应量为：模型规模（β=1.77）、语言资源水平（β=0.77）、推理（β=0.67）、类型学距离（β=-0.25）。这些因素可相互换算：例如32B模型在马拉地语上的表现约等于10B模型在英语上的表现。模型规模与推理能缩小低资源与高资源语言之间的性能差距（β=-0.27和β=-0.20），而类似手段对类型学上距离较远的语言几乎无效果。整体框架可解释92%的语言间变异，但仅解释23%的"模型×语言"变异；对未见语言的性能预测误差在6.0pp以内（r=.96），仅引入目标语言10个模板的测量即可将误差降至4.19pp。

Conclusion: 跨语言能力迁移可由少量关键因素联合刻画，并实现因素间相互换算；符号化模板数据集支持低成本的跨语言评测与泛化检验。研究结果对模型开发者具有直接意义：规模与推理有助于缓解资源水平带来的差距，但难以弥补类型学距离造成的影响。分析框架能以极小的下游数据成本（甚至无需下游数据集）对未见语言的表现做出较准确估计。

Abstract: We understand little about how capabilities acquired in one language carry over to another, or what governs this transfer: evaluations rely on incomparable, saturation-prone datasets and rarely examine its determinants jointly. Identifying what predicts transfer would let us avoid exhaustive evaluation across all language pairs and let developers target the factors that limit performance in low-resource languages. To evaluate cross-lingual capability transfer, we introduce Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, an extensible multilingual mathematical dataset covering 30,000 item-matched question-answer pairs and spanning 15 languages. It utilises symbolic templates to prevent overfitting and ensure generalisation by allowing generation of millions of high-quality variations from a single sample. Using Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, we quantify the largest determinants of capability as model size ($β= 1.77$), language resource level ($β= 0.77$), reasoning ($β= 0.67$) and typological distance ($β= -0.25$). This joint estimation allows these determinants to be expressed in terms of one another: a 32B model evaluated in Marathi performs like a 10B model in English. Our findings have important implications for model developers, showing that model size and reasoning narrow the performance gap between low- and high-resource languages ($β= -0.27$ and $β= -0.20$, respectively), while similar levers have little or no effect on typologically distant languages.
  Overall, our analysis framework explains 92% of between-language variation, but only 23% of the model-by-language variation, and predicts a model's performance on an unseen language within 6.0pp (r=.96). Incorporating measurements from just 10 templates in the target language reduces this to 4.19pp, enabling reasonable estimates of performance with little or no downstream dataset.

</details>


### [382] [Benchmarking Candidate Coverage in Typed Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03387)
*Jiawen Lu,Tongtong Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出成对候选覆盖基准协议，评估Laya与Jev在缺失参考答案时的拒答行为，发现拒答率与误拒率差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类型化决策模型在候选齐全时的准确率，无法证明其能识别参考答案缺失或避免误拒有效候选，需专门测量拒答行为。

Method: 设计成对候选覆盖基准协议：输入相同冻结文本与请求，300条校准、589条测试文本，每模型23,932次预测；构造"存在/缺失"配对，候选数与名称变体受控。

Result: TREC五候选自然名称下，Laya检出97.2%缺失答案但误拒69.7%有效对照，Jev为24.8%与0.0%；仅用校准none阈值后变为33.9%/3.7%与45.0%/1.8%。DBpedia上Jev覆盖分数AUROC支持更优工作点，两模型在Emotion完整集准确率均弱。

Conclusion: 分类、分数排序与拒答策略需分开测量；该初始基准仅描述性、限于参考标签缺失，不构成自然域外泛化、因果机制或新拒答方法。

Abstract: Typed decision models return choices or distributions over answer options supplied at request time. Accuracy with complete options does not establish whether a model recognizes that a reference answer is missing or avoids rejecting valid candidates. We present a paired candidate-coverage benchmark protocol and an initial evaluation of Laya and Jev across AG News, DBpedia, Emotion, and TREC. The models receive identical frozen texts and requests: 300 calibration and 589 test texts yield 23,932 predictions per model. Present/absent pairs match ordinary candidate count, and name variants preserve descriptions, members, and order. Native rejection behavior differs sharply: at five TREC candidates with natural names, Laya detects 97.2% of missing-answer cases but falsely rejects 69.7% of present controls; Jev's rates are 24.8% and 0.0%. Calibration-only none-score thresholds change these rates to 33.9%/3.7% and 45.0%/1.8%, respectively. On DBpedia, Jev's high coverage-score AUROC supports a stronger operating point, whereas both models have weak complete-set accuracy on Emotion. Competence-conditioned analysis, probability-precision sensitivity, and interface audits show why classification, score ranking, and rejection policies need separate measurement. This initial benchmark is descriptive and limited to reference-label omission; it does not establish natural out-of-scope generalization, causal mechanisms, or a new rejection method.

</details>


### [383] [A Near-Zero Monitor Readout Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03458)
*Zhe Zhou,Tianhua Tao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 低监控读数（含域内激活探针与提前提交惩罚）不能证明行为受控：同一配置下零中位训练得分仅因随机种子即可从低作弊率跨越到近乎纯奖励作弊，因此离线判别力与低读数均不足以作为行为控制证据，需带外行为检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的后训练会诱发奖励作弊，因此研究者希望把监控器直接嵌入训练目标而非仅用于离线审计。但"监控读数低"是否等同于"行为已被控制"此前缺乏检验，本文即针对这一等价假设提出质疑。

Method: 在主导性漏洞在推理轨迹开头即可利用的代码生成环境中，训练策略对抗三种通过同一离线门控的监控器：域内激活探针，以及两种以策略多早提交自身最终答案为条件的惩罚。比较训练得分与文本级分析，并做多种子对比与前缀失败模式分析。

Result: 探针分数从首个记录训练步起就在数值下限，所有前缀训练运行在终点处训练得分中位数均为零。在固定配置下，中位数为零的前缀训练运行仅由种子差异即可从低作弊占比的混合状态跨到接近纯奖励作弊。所有探针运行均落入作弊状态，但其下限读数源于探针验证位置与训练读取位置不匹配，而非第二种歧义。文本分析发现前缀失败模式：通用规划与填充外壳把漏洞推迟到截断点之后，但未从最终输出中消除。各监控器读数估计的是不同量，未比较其尺度；但在同一监控器家族内，低值不构成行为控制。

Conclusion: 离线判别力与监控对齐的低读数不足以证明行为受控，必须辅以带外行为检验。低测量提交度无法区分低作弊占比与延迟提交漏洞。本文刻画的是终点读数，而非其演化过程。

Abstract: Post-training with verifiable rewards can induce reward hacking, motivating the use of monitors within the training objective rather than solely for offline auditing. We show that a low monitor readout does not identify whether such an intervention controls behavior. In a code-generation environment whose dominant exploit is available at the start of the reasoning trace, we train policies against three monitors that pass the same offline gate: an in-domain activation probe and two penalties conditioned on how early the policy commits to its own final answer. The probe score is at its numerical floor from the first recorded training step, and the trained-score median is zero for every prefix-trained run at the endpoint. These readouts estimate different quantities, and we do not compare their scales; within each monitor family, however, low values do not establish behavioral control. Within one fixed configuration, prefix-trained runs with the same zero-median trained score range, by seed alone, from a mixed regime with a low hacking share to near-pure reward hacking. All probe runs reach the hacking regime, but their floor-level readout reflects a mismatch between the position where the probe was validated and the position where it was read during training, not a second instance of this ambiguity. Text-level analysis identifies a prefix failure mode: generic planning and filler shells postpone the exploit past the cut without eliminating it from the final output. Low measured commitment therefore does not distinguish a low hacking share from delayed commitment to the exploit. Offline discrimination and low monitor-aligned readouts are insufficient evidence of behavioral control; an out-of-band behavioral check is required. We characterize the endpoint readout, not its evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/zhezhou1106/spoof-cost.

</details>


### [384] [DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02351)
*Ajay Vohra,Tao Chen,Neeti Narayan,Caron Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeReAct 通过将动作校验与完成判定外置为 Critic 和 Context Manager 两个模块化门控策略，解耦 ReAct 代理中单一 LLM 策略的行为，从而提升弱模型的任务完成率与轨迹的接地性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReAct 类代理依赖单一 LLM 策略同时负责提出动作、与环境交互并判定任务完成，这种耦合导致动作授权与完成控制难以独立约束，错误会逐级传播，且缺乏环境支持的"完成"声明会过早终止执行。

Method: 提出模块化代理架构 DeReAct，外置两个门控策略：Critic 在执行前校验候选动作；Context Manager 重建由环境支持的 State 并认证任务完成。

Result: 在 GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，DeReAct 对能力较弱的 Brain 模型提升最大：Qwen3-Coder-480B 提升 6.5–7.0 分，Claude Sonnet 4.5 提升 4.2–5.2 分；随 Brain 能力增强收益递减。使用 Claude Opus 4.5 时 Pass@1 与 ReAct 相当，但轨迹在证据完整性与约束满足度上更优。

Conclusion: 外部门控在目标失败足够普遍且门控策略本身充分时有效；DeReAct 在增强较弱代理的同时，随模型增强仍保留接地性收益，即完成控制可用较早终止换取更强接地。

Abstract: ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion.
  Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.

</details>


### [385] [How to Have a Sensitive Debate: An Instance-Optimal Protocol for AI Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02557)
*Jiawei Li,Zhiyang Xun,Lijie Chen,Jonah Brown-Cohen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将AI辩论协议设计形式化为计算复杂性理论问题，针对具有稳定子问题分解结构的问题类，提出一种新辩论协议，在正确性保证、均衡概念和最优性下界三方面超越既有工作，其核心手段是把稳定分解与查询复杂性中的分数块敏感性建立联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着强AI系统在多种高认知负荷任务上达到甚至超过人类专家水平，如何对其输出进行准确监督（oversight/supervision）成为紧迫问题。AI辩论（AI debate）是一种有前景的思路：利用两个强AI之间的辩论，把复杂问题逐步分解为监督者能直接判断的简单主张。已有理论研究用计算复杂性理论刻画这一直觉，目标是设计辩论规则（协议），在有限监督能力下为复杂问题解的正确性提供严格保证。目前最优协议仅对存在"稳定子问题分解"的问题类有效，但它在正确性、均衡稳健性和最优性方面存在不足，因此需要改进。

Method: 作者针对与既有工作相同的"具有稳定分解"的问题类，重新设计了一个辩论协议。技术路线上，论文将"稳定问题分解"这一概念与查询复杂性（query complexity）中的"分数块敏感性"（fractional block sensitivity）建立联系，并借助该联系构造协议并分析其性质。分析内容包括：协议正确性的最坏情况保证、双方辩论者策略的均衡性质，以及在该问题类上的黑盒下界（black-box lower bound）证明。

Result: 新协议在三方面优于先前工作：第一，正确性在最坏情况（worst-case）意义下成立，而非仅平均情况（average-case）成立；第二，对双方辩论者而言，"诚实且正确"是占优策略均衡（dominant-strategy equilibrium），而此前仅为斯塔克尔伯格均衡（Stackelberg equilibrium）；第三，作者证明了黑盒下界，说明新协议是逐实例最优（instance-wise optimal）的——即对该问题类，任何只对人工判断做黑盒查询的协议都无法超越本协议。

Conclusion: 通过将稳定问题分解与查询复杂性中的分数块敏感性相关联，论文为"稳定可分解"问题类给出了一个更优的AI辩论协议：它提供最坏情况正确性保证、诚实正确作为占优策略均衡，并达到逐实例黑盒最优。这表明在有限监督下监督强AI系统的问题上，基于辩论的协议设计在理论保证层面取得了实质性进展，同时分数块敏感性等查询复杂性工具可作为分析此类协议的有力框架。

Abstract: As powerful AI systems reach and sometimes surpass the abilities of human experts across a range of cognitively demanding tasks, the problem of accurate oversight and supervision of these systems has become increasingly urgent. One promising approach is AI debate, which seeks to leverage a debate between two powerful AIs to break complex questions down into simpler claims that can be easily judged directly. Theoretical work on debate has formalized this intuition in the language of computational complexity theory, where the goal is to design protocols (i.e., rules of the debate game) that provide rigorous guarantees on correctness for judging solutions to complex problems with limited supervision. Specifically, the current best protocol has been shown to work for all problems that have sufficiently stable decompositions into subproblems. In this paper, we design a new protocol for this same class of problems that improves on the prior work in several ways. First, correctness holds in a worst-case rather than an average-case sense. Second, being honest and correct is a dominant-strategy equilibrium for both debaters, rather than a Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we prove black-box lower bounds, showing that our new protocol is instance-wise optimal. That is, no protocol for this class of problems can outperform ours while making only black-box queries to human judgments. We obtain these results by relating the notion of stable problem decompositions to the concept of fractional block sensitivity from query complexity.

</details>


### [386] [Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02687)
*Yehya Farhat,Michael Desmond,Anastasios Kyrillidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出上下文优化的统一形式化框架，将智能体记忆系统更新视为对模型上下文的优化过程，并据此设计轻量级图结构记忆GraphMemory，通过检索相关子图实现在线上下文自适应，在保持竞争性下游性能的同时减少约81-85%的记忆构建token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在企业、科学和医疗等场景中需注入领域知识并从经验中学习。上下文工程无需更新权重即可改善模型行为，但在线调整上下文通常依赖昂贵的试错过程，且查询多被独立处理，经验难以复用。现有记忆系统通过持续向共享上下文追加信息来缓解该问题，却面临token成本上升、上下文窗口受限以及上下文膨胀导致性能退化等瓶颈。

Method: 论文首先给出上下文优化的统一形式化表述，论证智能体记忆系统的更新可被解释为对模型上下文的优化更新过程，从而为记忆设计及其效率研究提供理论框架。在此基础上提出GraphMemory：一种轻量级图结构记忆，用于累积、精炼、组织并连接可复用的策略；对每个查询仅检索相关子图，使模型无需接触全部记忆即可完成在线上下文自适应。该设计保证在有界检索下，已检索记忆量随处理样本数增长而保持恒定。

Result: 实验表明，GraphMemory取得具有竞争力的下游性能，同时相较于基线方法减少约81-85%的记忆构建token开销。

Conclusion: 将记忆更新纳入上下文优化的理论框架，有助于系统性地理解记忆机制及其效率；GraphMemory以图结构组织与按需检索的方式，在性能与成本之间取得更优权衡，验证了该框架的实用价值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise, scientific, and medical applications, where agents must incorporate domain-specific knowledge and adapt from experience. Context engineering offers a practical alternative to weight updates by improving model behavior through instructions, strategies, and evidence supplied at inference time. However, adapting context online typically requires a costly trial-and-error process, while queries are often processed independently, preventing useful experience from carrying forward. Memory systems address this limitation by retaining information across interactions, but approaches that continually append information to a shared context face increasing token costs, context-window limits, and performance degradation as the context expands. We introduce a unified formulation of context optimization and show that an agent memory system update can be interpreted as an optimization update procedure over the model's context. This perspective attempts to provide a principled framework for studying memory design and its efficiency. We then propose GraphMemory, a lightweight graph-based memory that accumulates, refines, organizes, and connects reusable strategies. For each query, GraphMemory retrieves only the relevant subgraph, enabling online context adaptation without exposing the model to the entire memory. Under bounded retrieval, the amount of retrieved memory remains constant as the number of processed examples grows. Experiments show that GraphMemory achieves competitive downstream performance while using approximately 81-85% fewer memory-construction tokens than our baselines.

</details>


### [387] [Frequency Is Not Sensitivity Identifying Safety-Sensitive Experts in Sparse MoE LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02910)
*Md Nurul Absar Siddiky,Liuwan Zhu,Yingfei Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出用"路由器梯度敏感度"（序列损失对选择专家的门控权重的敏感度）替代激活频率来挑选需抑制的专家，在5个MoE架构、各500条良性/恶意提示上实验，发现在等专家数与等恶意路由流量两种预算下，梯度选择在25个条件中的24个比激活频率更有效地降低拒绝率，且在OLMoE上拒绝率从34/100降至9/100。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE模型中，抑制少量被路由的专家即可在不重训练的情况下削弱其安全行为，因此"该抑制哪些专家"是一个安全问题。常规做法是按激活频率排序，但频率衡量的是"使用程度"而非"影响程度"，作者认为这一指标可能选错专家，故寻找更能反映安全影响的替代信号。

Method: 定义路由器梯度敏感度：序列损失对用于选择某专家的门控权重的敏感度。在5种MoE架构上，用该信号与激活频率分别在500条良性和500条恶意提示上对专家排序；在100条留出的恶意提示上测量拒绝率，采用两种预算：等专家数量、等名义恶意路由流量（1%–5%）。此外进行逐层专家数匹配的对照、与10次随机选择的均值比较，以及跨模型的探索性相关分析。

Result: 在两种预算下，梯度选择在25个条件中的24个比激活频率带来更大的拒绝率下降，并在全部25个条件中优于10次随机试验均值。最大效应出现在OLMoE：拒绝数从34/100降至9/100（相对下降73.53%），且未出现生成质量退化，表明是实质性顺从而非生成崩坏。逐层匹配专家数后，梯度选择仍在25个条件中的23个优于激活频率（2个打平）。探索性跨模型分析显示，恶意与良性路由集中度差距越大，峰值梯度效应越强（rho=0.90；双侧精确p=0.083，n=5）。

Conclusion: 在所测试的两种预算下，结果支持使用路由器梯度敏感度而非激活频率来选择需抑制的专家；逐层匹配与随机基线进一步增强了该结论的稳健性，但跨模型相关性仅为探索性（n=5，p=0.083），结论的适用范围限于所测试的预算与模型。

Abstract: Suppressing a small set of routed experts can weaken the safety behavior of a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model without retraining. Which experts to suppress is therefore a security question, and the usual answer is activation frequency, but frequency measures use, not influence. We test an alternative: router-gradient sensitivity, the sensitivity of the sequence loss to the gate weights that select an expert. Across five MoE architectures, we rank experts by each signal on 500 benign and 500 malicious prompts and measure refusal on 100 held-out malicious prompts under two budgets: equal expert counts and equal nominal malicious routing traffic (1%-5%). Under each of the two budgets, router-gradient selection reduces refusals more than activation in 24 of 25 conditions, and more than a ten-trial random mean in all 25. The largest effect is in OLMoE, where refusals fall from 34 to 9 of 100 prompts (73.53% relative) with no degraded outputs, indicating substantive compliance rather than broken generation. After matching expert counts in every layer, gradient selection still produces greater refusal reduction than activation in 23 of 25 conditions, with two ties. An exploratory cross-model analysis links larger malicious-versus-benign concentration gaps to greater peak gradient effects (rho = 0.90; exact two-sided p = 0.083, n = 5). Together, the results support gradient selection under the tested budgets.

</details>


### [388] [Predictor-Guided Latent Space Codon Optimization for Maximizing Protein Expression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03098)
*Alberto Caron,Tianyu Cui,Dmytro S. Lituiev,Mangal Prakash,Artem Moskalev,Amina Mollaysa,Bo Zhai,Hirsh Nanda,Daniel M. Poole,Zhongyin Liu,Iman Farasat,Robert Davidson,Nikolay V. Manyakov,Tommaso Mansi,Scott Oloff,Rui Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出隐空间密码子优化（LSCO），将离散的密码子优化问题重铸为连续优化问题，借助预训练 mRNA 语言模型的隐空间实现基于梯度的搜索，并在真实湿实验抗体表达数据集上超越频率类与深度生成类基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密码子优化对治疗性蛋白生产与 mRNA 疫苗至关重要，但仍是难题：设计空间离散且组合规模庞大，无法使用梯度方法；现有工具依赖启发式代理指标（如密码子适应指数 CAI、GC 含量），难以准确刻画真实表达水平。

Method: LSCO 将序列映射到预训练 mRNA 语言模型的隐空间，从而把离散优化转为连续优化并支持梯度搜索。方法包含四个组件：(1) 来自不确定性感知预测器的数据驱动表达目标；(2) 用于结构稳定性的最小自由能（MFE）正则项；(3) 来自蛋白到密码子回译模型的自然度先验；(4) 保证蛋白保真度的约束解码。

Result: 在真实湿实验抗体表达数据集上，LSCO 在预测表达水平上优于简单频率基线与现代深度生成基线，同时保持合适的生物物理性质。

Conclusion: 将密码子优化从离散空间迁移至连续隐空间，并结合表达预测、结构稳定性、自然度先验与约束解码，是一种有效且可行的密码子优化范式。

Abstract: Codon optimization, the process of selecting synonymous codons to improve mRNA translation efficiency and protein expression, is central to therapeutic protein production and mRNA vaccines, yet it remains a hard problem. The design space is discrete and combinatorially large, precluding gradient-based methods, and existing tools rely on heuristic proxies (e.g., Codon Adaptation Index or GC-content) that poorly capture true expression. We introduce Latent-Space Codon Optimization (LSCO), which recasts this discrete problem as a continuous one by mapping sequences into the latent space of a pretrained mRNA language model, enabling efficient gradient-based search. LSCO combines four components: a data-driven expression objective from an uncertainty-aware predictor, a Minimum-Free-Energy regularizer for structural stability, a naturalness prior from a protein-to-codon back-translation model, and constrained decoding for protein fidelity. On a real-world, wet-lab antibody expression dataset, LSCO outperforms simple frequency-based, as well as modern deep generative baselines in predicted expression, while retaining suitable biophysical properties.

</details>


### [389] [JOVE: Joint Execution and Verification for Resource-Aware LLM Task Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03296)
*Haoran Zhang,Dongjun Kim,Seohyeon Cha,Kevin S Chan,Ananthram Swami,Gustavo De Veciana,Haris Vikalo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JOVE是一个在线框架，将复杂推理查询分解为有向无环任务图并跨异构LLM分配，同时联合决定执行器选择与付费验证输出，在长期预算和每查询延迟约束下优化执行与验证的权衡，实现亚线性质量学习后悔并显著降低成本和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂推理查询可分解为有向无环任务图并行执行以降低延迟，并让较小模型承担复杂任务。但实践中LLM对特定子任务的适配性先验未知，且仅凭执行无法判断输出正确性，因此需要引入验证并解决执行开销与后续学习之间的长期权衡问题。

Method: JOVE将每个查询的执行与验证决策建模为一系列混合整数线性规划（MILP）求解；通过在线学习基于验证反馈更新任务相关的LLM质量估计；在分配决策中加入信息增益奖励项以纳入学习的价值；在随机且初始未知的服务质量、调用成本和执行时间下，于长期预算与每查询延迟约束内优化执行与验证的权衡。

Result: 在自然假设下证明了JOVE具有亚线性的质量学习后悔界。在四个推理基准上，JOVE在准确率上可与标准推理基线竞争，同时将平均成本和延迟至少降低3.17倍。

Conclusion: 将执行器分配与付费验证选择联合在线优化，可在预算和延迟约束下有效平衡当下执行开销与未来学习收益，为异构LLM任务图调度提供了理论保证与实证高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Complex reasoning queries can be decomposed into directed acyclic task graphs and distributed across heterogeneous LLMs, reducing latency through parallelism and enabling smaller models to solve complex tasks. In practice, however, the suitability of an LLM for a given subtask may be a priori unknown, and execution alone does not reveal output correctness. We propose JOVE, an online framework that jointly assigns executor LLMs and selects intermediate outputs for paid verification. Verification runs asynchronously and is used to improve future allocations, so the system must balance spending on execution now against learning for later. We study how to optimize this trade-off under a long-term budget and a per-query latency constraint, with stochastic, initially unknown LLM service quality, invocation costs, and execution times. JOVE makes execution and verification decisions by solving a sequence of per-query mixed-integer linear programs. Online learning updates task-dependent estimates of LLM quality based on verification feedback, while an information-gain bonus incorporates the value of learning into allocation decisions. Under a natural set of assumptions, we establish sublinear quality-learning regret for JOVE. Across four reasoning benchmarks, JOVE achieves competitive accuracy against standard inference baselines while reducing average cost and latency by at least 3.17 times.

</details>


### [390] [From Benchmarks to Production: A Text-to-SQL System for Complex Financial Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03524)
*Arijit Sehanobish,Bruno Gomes Coelho,Guillaume Michel,Sophia Zhi,Valerie Faucon-Morin,Kristen Howell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FLINT 是一个面向生产金融数据库的领域专用 Text-to-SQL 系统，通过查找代理、查询模板检索和外键链模式链接三个组件，解决了开放域金融数据库中概念以不透明整数键存储、需多表连接与 ID 过滤导致的性能瓶颈，在 359 道生产金融模式问题上超越同 LLM 的主流基线并已上线部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用 Text-to-SQL 系统在 Spider、BIRD 等学术基准上表现优异，但这些基准的模式较浅、列值通常为人类可读字符串。在生产金融数据库中，概念以不透明的整数键存储，即使是简单查询也需要多次连接，过滤条件引用不透明 ID，导致通用方法准确率低于 50%。论文旨在弥合这一领域鸿沟。

Method: FLINT 包含三个核心组件：(1) 查找代理（lookup agent），将自然语言概念动态解析为针对具体问题的引用表约束；(2) 基于嵌入的检索，从一个小型专家编写的查询模板库中检索结构相似的查询模板；(3) 模式链接，通过遍历外键链将大型表模式裁剪为相关子集，而非仅依赖名称相似度。

Result: 在两个数据集、共 359 道基于生产金融模式的问题上进行评估，FLINT 在使用相同 LLM 的情况下优于多种最先进的基线方法。该系统已作为金融数据检索服务的一部分部署到生产环境。

Conclusion: 针对生产金融数据库的特殊性（不透明整数键、复杂连接、ID 过滤条件），领域专用设计（概念解析、模板检索、外键链模式裁剪）能有效弥补通用 Text-to-SQL 方法的不足，且具备实际生产部署价值。

Abstract: General-purpose Text-to-SQL systems achieve strong performance on academic benchmarks like Spider and BIRD, where schemas are relatively shallow and column values are often human readable. In production financial databases, where concepts are stored as opaque integer keys rather than human-readable strings, these methods fall below 50%, as even simple queries require multiple joins and filter predicates reference opaque IDs. We present Financial LINking Text-to-SQL (FLINT), a domain-specialized Text-to-SQL system that closes this gap through three key components: (1) a lookup agent that dynamically resolves natural-language concepts to question-specific reference table constraints, (2) embedding-based retrieval of structurally similar query templates from a compact, expert-authored bank, and (3) schema linking that prunes a large table schema to the relevant subset by traversing foreign-key chains, rather than relying on name similarity alone. We evaluate on two datasets totaling 359 questions over production financial schemas. FLINT outperforms various state-of-the-art baselines using the same LLM. The system is deployed in production as part of a financial data retrieval service.

</details>


### [391] [HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03574)
*Alham Fikri Aji,Faiz Rizki Ramadhan,Zayd M. K. Zuhri,Seung Hun Eddie Han,Ryandito Diandaru,Qinrong Cui,Jan Christian Blaise Cruz,Badrinath Chandana,Peerawat Chomphooyod,Ahmed Attia,Jonibek Mansurov,Emilio Villa-Cueva,Canh Duong Nguyen,Imran Turganov,Minghao Wu,Peerat Limkonchotiwat,Irina Nikishina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperBrowseComp，一个多语言、多模态的浏览基准，包含 423 道人工编写并验证的问题，覆盖 13 种语言，用于评估模型在开放网络中进行持续信息检索的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览类基准难以充分检验模型在开放网络中发现并连接多步骤、多模态线索的能力；需要构建一个难度极高、答案可公开验证的测试平台，以区分模型是否依赖参数化知识。

Method: 由母语者或高熟练度者人工编写 423 道跨 13 种语言的问题，并在无互联网条件下用模型过滤掉较易题目；采用统一的 agent 协议，使用提供商原生搜索与共享的外部检索框架评估多个模型；同时对部分问题进行人工评估以校准模型表现与投入程度。

Result: 问题解答需定位冷门证据、追踪多步线索链，或检视视频、扫描文档、图像、地图等异构来源；在统一协议下评测了多个模型，并通过人工评估提供了性能与努力的参照对比，表明该基准具有高度挑战性。

Conclusion: HyperBrowseComp 为跨语言、跨证据模态的持续信息检索提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，其难度主要来自在开放网络上发现并连接证据的过程。

Abstract: We introduce HyperBrowseComp, a multilingual and multimodal browsing benchmark comprising 423 manually authored and human-validated questions across 13 languages, written by native or highly proficient speakers. Questions are designed to be extremely challenging. Each question targets a concise, publicly verifiable answer whose discovery requires locating obscure evidence, following multi-step clue chains, or inspecting heterogeneous sources such as videos, scanned documents, images, or maps. Easier questions are filtered out by evaluating them with models without internet access to reduce the likelihood that they can be answered with parametric knowledge alone. We evaluate several models using provider-native search and a shared external retrieval harness under a common agent protocol. To contextualize model performance and effort, we also conduct a human evaluation on a sample of the questions. HyperBrowseComp provides a challenging testbed for persistent information seeking across languages and evidence modalities, with difficulty arising from discovering and connecting evidence on the open web.

</details>


### [392] [MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02260)
*Yesom Park,Kelvin Kan,Qifan Chen,Thomas Flynn,Hayden Schaeffer. Xihaier Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MintFlow 提出一种无需训练的约束采样框架，将约束满足表述为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预，通过伴随公式获得扰动的闭式解，并自适应选择干预时刻，在满足约束的同时更好地保持预训练分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配模型在生成建模中表现优异，但许多下游任务要求样本满足预设约束（如观测测量、物理定律）。现有约束采样器面临一个权衡：强制满足约束往往会使样本显著偏离预训练数据分布。因此需要一种既能满足约束又能最小化分布偏离的方法。

Method: MintFlow 是一个免训练的约束采样框架，将约束执行视为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预。它寻找对中间流状态的最小扰动，使得该状态在预训练流场下后续演化后能满足目标约束；通过保持预训练流场不变、仅最小扰动流状态，在满足约束的同时最小化偏离预训练分布。作者采用伴随（adjoint）公式推导出该扰动的闭式表达，从而避免昂贵的迭代优化。此外，MintFlow 自适应选择干预时刻，以平衡所需扰动的幅度与其在剩余流中被放大的程度。

Result: 在生成式视觉与物理系统建模的多类任务上，MintFlow 在约束满足度上具有竞争力，同时在保持预训练生成分布方面显著优于当前最先进的约束方法。

Conclusion: MintFlow 通过最小干预与闭式扰动解，有效缓解了约束满足与分布保持之间的权衡，为流匹配模型提供了一种高效、免训练的约束采样方案，兼顾约束满足与预训练分布保真度。

Abstract: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.

</details>


### [393] [The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02281)
*Bart Jaworski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建两阶段LLM分类流水线，对1,362家英国上市公司2020-2025年（含部分2026年）的9,821份年报进行大规模处理，以检验年报能否提供企业AI响应披露的有效信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会韧性研究依赖可用且可操作的数据，这引出核心研究问题：经LLM大规模处理的年报，能否为企业如何披露其AI响应提供有用信号。

Method: 采用可复现的两阶段分类流水线处理9,821份年报（1,362家英国上市公司，2020-2025年，含部分2026年数据）；先用474条人工标注段落验证方法，再开发"实质性"（substantiveness）分类以评估披露质量。

Result: 方法验证显示高召回率、标签级一致性中等。三项实证发现：(i) 提及AI风险的报告占比从2020年2.8%升至2025年41.2%，AI采用披露从13.8%升至45.2%，指名供应商提及集中于以微软为首的少数主要提供商；(ii) 披露情况因关键国家基础设施部门和市场板块差异显著，AIM报告AI风险披露率远低于主板报告，能源与数据基础设施等部门落后；(iii) 危害披露几乎缺失（全语料仅7份报告）。

Conclusion: 多数AI风险披露缺乏实质性：2025年41.2%的报告提及AI为风险，但仅4.3%包含被归类为实质性的AI风险披露。

Abstract: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.

</details>


### [394] [Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02300)
*NaHyeon Park,Minhyun Lee,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的安全防护方法CALM，用提示局部反事实校正替代全局不安全信号移除，缓解覆盖-选择性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练文本到图像安全防护假设存在可复用的全局不安全信号（不安全方向或全局有害子空间），并跨提示统一应用。该文对其进行受控几何分析，发现存在稳定的覆盖-选择性权衡：紧凑的不安全子空间无法覆盖异构的不安全语义，而更宽泛的聚合又会日益扭曲安全邻近的良性提示。

Method: CALM（Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation）：以匹配的不安全-良性锚点为参照，为每个提示路由到其活跃的不安全类别，仅对违规token表示进行最小化编辑使其偏向安全侧，并抑制正向对齐的不安全残差成分，从而以提示局部反事实校正取代统一的全局移除。

Result: 在广泛评测中，CALM显著提升不安全内容抑制效果，同时保持良性提示的实用性。

Conclusion: 局部反事实校正比全局不安全信号移除更具选择性，为免训练文本到图像安全防护提供了新思路。

Abstract: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.

</details>


### [395] [Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02330)
*Yu Li,Zheng Zhang,Xin Liu,Shengtian Yang,Guangfeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 CITA，通过训练比较推理模型（CIM）来估计下一步工具调用的长程价值，在三个工具使用基准和多个骨干 LLM 上一致提升 Tool F1 与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程工具调用中，仅靠最终结果的奖励难以对长交互轨迹进行有效信用分配；而逐步奖励通常依赖人工或 LLM 判断，或需要额外 rollout 来估计中间决策的下游影响，代价高且不稳定。因此需要在不执行动作前就评估候选工具调用的长程价值。

Method: 提出 CITA（Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents）。其核心是训练比较推理模型 CIM，利用三类配对信号：已观测到的工具行为、来自贝叶斯工具图模拟器的可扩展监督、以及基于 LLM 比较的语义判断。CIM 学习在当前上下文下估计某个可能的下一步工具调用支持最终任务成功的可能性。

Result: 在三个工具使用基准和多个骨干 LLM 上，CITA 一致提升 Tool F1 和任务成功率；额外分析表明 CIM 能学习到针对比较性工具选择的准确逐步价值估计。

Conclusion: 在相同上下文下对备选工具调用进行比较性监督，是获得可靠逐步价值信号的有效途径；CITA/CIM 为长程工具使用智能体提供了可行的价值估计与信用分配方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

</details>


### [396] [World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02331)
*Max Ku,Nok-Kan Law,Yu-Chien Tang,Shih-Ying Yeh,Ping Nie,Andy Zheng,Tat Hei Lai,Fei-Yueh Chen,Nikko Yu,Wei-Chieh Sun,Suzy Huang,Chiao-Wei Hsu,Chih-Chuan Huang,Chak-Wing Mak,Ho Yin Sam Ng,Edisy Kin Wai Chan,Min-Hung Chen,Ho Kei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将"世界编辑"形式化为对已有可执行世界的干预，提出干预深度这一维度，并通过游戏模组（Minecraft、Terraria）实例化，构建IGMWorld与IGMBench基准，系统评测前沿编码智能体的编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型已能生成环境并在其中行动，但对已有可执行世界进行有意编辑仍研究不足，且世界编辑与生成、交互是不同的能力，缺乏系统评测。

Method: 将世界编辑形式化为在保留应不变属性的前提下对已有世界进行干预，提出"干预深度"轴以描述编辑对世界实体、动力学与系统的耦合强度；通过工业级游戏模组实例化该能力，构建IGMWorld，并提出IGMBench——涵盖Minecraft和Terraria的110个任务、超过1.1K条可执行状态与行为标准，任务覆盖属性、实体、动力学和系统四类干预，采用确定性可执行性、行为、保持性和视觉四类检查进行评估。

Result: 最强配置在严格任务级标准下解决78.2%任务，标准级性能达94.8%；可靠性随干预深度增加普遍下降，且在评估标准数量相近的任务中依然存在该规律；多数失败编辑仍能成功构建与加载，说明主要难点在于使编辑后的世界按请求行为运行；视觉一致性是独立短板，所有配置的联合视觉通过率均低于50%。

Conclusion: 世界编辑是与世界生成和交互不同的一项独立能力，可执行游戏为研究该能力提供了实用的测试平台。

Abstract: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

</details>


### [397] [A Multi Method Importance and Performance Efficiency Analysis of Topological Metrics for Natural Visibility Graph Based Cyber Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02342)
*Ali Melih Kanca,Ilker Turker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估21个自然可见图(NVG)拓扑指标，通过SHAP、分组置换重要性、Boruta和RFE四种方法进行共识排序，构建紧凑指标子集。在CICIDS2018数据集上用CNN和分层5折交叉验证测试，Top3配置达到97.148%准确率和0.9675 MCC，优于Full21的95.999%和0.9549，同时运行时间减少96.06%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVG分析通过拓扑描述符刻画网络流量结构特征，但并非所有描述符对网络攻击分类贡献相同，且提取大规模指标集会增加计算成本。因此需要探究能否用紧凑子集在保持分类能力的同时提升计算效率。

Method: 评估21个NVG衍生拓扑指标，整合SHAP、分组置换重要性、Boruta和递归特征消除(RFE)四种重要性分析方法，通过共识排序策略生成指标重要性排名。基于该排名构建Full21、Top15、Top10、Top7、Top5和Top3六种配置，在CICIDS2018数据集上使用CNN分类器和分层5折交叉验证进行评测。

Result: 排名前三的指标为avg_clustering_coeff_median、avg_clustering_coeff_std和avg_clustering_coeff_mean。Top3取得最高观测平均性能：准确率97.148%、加权F1为97.055%、MCC为0.9675，而Full21分别为95.999%、95.521%和0.9549。Top3还将总运行时间从14,961.39秒降至589.22秒，减少96.06%。

Conclusion: 在受评设定下，重要性引导的指标约简能够提供紧凑的NVG表示，在获得更高观测平均预测性能的同时显著降低计算成本。

Abstract: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) based analysis characterizes network traffic through topological descriptors reflecting different structural properties. However, not all descriptors contribute equally to cyber-attack classification, and extracting a large metric set can increase computational cost. This study evaluates 21 NVG derived topological metrics and investigates whether a compact subset can preserve classification capability while improving computational efficiency. Four importance analysis methods SHAP, grouped Permutation Importance, Boruta, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) are integrated through a Consensus Ranking strategy. Based on this ranking, Full21, Top15, Top10, Top7, Top5, and Top3 configurations are evaluated using the CICIDS2018 dataset, a CNN classifier, and stratified 5 fold cross validation. The three highest ranked metrics are avg_clustering_coeff_median, avg_clustering_coeff_std, and avg_clustering_coeff_mean. Top3 achieved the highest observed mean performance, with 97.148% accuracy, 97.055% weighted F1 score, and an MCC of 0.9675, compared with 95.999%, 95.521%, and 0.9549 for Full21, respectively. It also reduced total runtime from 14,961.39 s to 589.22 s (96.06%). These results indicate that importance guided metric reduction can provide a compact NVG representation with higher observed mean predictive performance and substantially lower computational cost under the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [398] [Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02372)
*Kevin Zhai,Siva Rajesh Kasa,Soumya Roy,Sumit Negi,Mubarak Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将文本到图像生成建模为"满足式"(satisficing)问题：每张图像须满足奖励下限，整批图像须满足多样性阈值，并提出免训练推理时方法SatisDive在Pareto前沿上遍历。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一提示词生成的多样图像要对用户有用，需同时满足两点：单张图像符合用户偏好（由学习到的奖励衡量）且彼此视觉上保持多样性。现有方法存在局限：或将奖励与多样性分开处理，或将其合并为单一聚合分数，导致高多样性可抵消低奖励。

Method: 将生成形式化为满足式问题：要求每张候选图满足奖励下限(reward floor)，整批图满足多样性截断(diversity cutoff)；奖励下限控制最差候选奖励与批多样性的权衡，改变该下限可定义一条Pareto前沿。为遍历该前沿，提出免训练、推理时方法SatisDive，采用批相对奖励截断(batch-relative reward cutoff)区分低/高奖励候选：对截断以下的候选强调奖励提升，对截断以上的候选强调多样性。

Result: 在Pick-a-Pic上，相同DreamSim条件下，SatisDive相比FK steering将最差候选奖励最多提升0.43（FLUX.1-dev为基座模型、HPSv3为奖励），最多提升0.70（SANA-1.6B为基座模型、ImageReward为奖励）。在重叠的DreamSim区间内，各设置下SatisDive的满足度-多样性曲线均Pareto支配FK steering曲线。

Conclusion: 通过满足式建模与批相对奖励截断，SatisDive在免训练条件下实现了奖励与多样性的更好权衡，其满足度-多样性曲线Pareto支配现有基线方法。

Abstract: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.

</details>


### [399] [THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02378)
*Meng Liang,Guanbo Feng,Haozhuang Chi,Shilong Zhao,Zhixin Xiong,Yuhang He,Wenfeng Han,Tianhao Zhao,Zhihong Ma,Ying Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出THPL生成式投喂决策框架：用Fishsort提取轨迹并计算摄食强度活动系数(AC)，经分层行为编码器(HBE)生成显式物理与隐式软双证据token，结合环境参数、元数据与专家规则通过LoRA微调LLM，并用反事实多模态mDPO强化因果推理；在虹鳟RAS中决策准确率由33.33%(纯文本)提升至96.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环水养殖系统(RAS)中的精准投喂对降低成本、提升鱼类福利至关重要，但现有方法缺乏鱼类行为与管理知识之间的认知对齐，导致难以转化为可执行、可解释的投喂决策。

Method: 面向虹鳟(Oncorhynchus mykiss)提出THPL生成式决策框架：1) Fishsort提取轨迹并构建活动系数(AC)量化摄食强度；2) 分层行为编码器(HBE)用Temporal Transformer与Set Transformer建模个体时序演化与群体动态，将轨迹张量转为显式物理token与隐式软token的双证据表示；3) 将双token与环境参数、元数据、专家规则融合，经LoRA微调LLM，再用反事实多模态直接偏好优化(mDPO)强化因果推理。

Result: AC与专家标注摄食强度呈显著单调正相关(Spearman ρ=0.925, p<0.001)。消融显示引入双证据token后决策准确率由33.33%(纯文本基线)升至93.33%，表明连续时空token为LLM提供必要物理 grounding。相较标准LoRA，反事实mDPO将准确率由93.33%提升至96.67%，METEOR由58.10%升至85.30%，Self-BLEU-2由58.79%降至52.88%，Distinct-3由6.68%升至7.81%，抑制模板化与执行偏差，增强因果一致性与操作安全性。

Conclusion: 通过将连续运动学与LLM推理相结合，本研究为精准水产养殖提供了新的决策支持范式，实现了鱼类行为与养殖管理知识的认知对齐，并给出可执行、可解释且安全一致的投喂决策。

Abstract: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $ρ= 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.

</details>


### [400] [FlashSinkhorn 2: Block-Sparse Entropic Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02395)
*Felix X. -F. Ye,Yu Chin Fabian Lim,Naigang Wang,Davis Wertheimer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 FlashSinkhorn 2 (FS2)，一种面向低维点云平方欧氏代价的单 GPU 熵正则最优传输求解器，通过"粗粒度重心阶段 + 块稀疏精修阶段"两阶段耦合，避免每次 Sinkhorn 迭代都计算全部 n×m 点对，在 A100 上以不到 2.5 小时求解 1.34×10^8 粒子规模的离散 EOT 问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式 GPU 求解器（如 FlashSinkhorn）虽不存储稠密核矩阵，但在每次 Sinkhorn 迭代中仍需评估全部 n×m 个点对，因而在大规模离散 EOT 问题上计算代价过高，难以在单卡上于可接受时间内求解超大规模问题。

Method: 采用两阶段耦合框架：(1) 粗粒度阶段在单元质心上求解，将势函数提升到所有点，并通过采样边际校验判断是否拒绝提升；若被拒绝则继续在质心上迭代，以替代大多数点级更新；(2) 块稀疏精修阶段消除粗粒度更新无法处理的重心误差。使用 Morton 序分块以支持筛选（screening）与融合的张量核执行，并由块质量设定阈值，从而界定每个被省略块对任意行与列的贡献上界。

Result: 在合成基准上，FS2 在全部 32 个问题上达到目标边际残差，而 GeomLoss 多尺度方法仅在 10 个问题上达标。在单块 A100 上，FS2 在熵模糊尺度等于平均粒子间距的条件下，将来自宇宙学 N-body 模拟的两个 1.34×10^8 粒子测度之间的离散 EOT 求解至全粒子边际残差低于 0.01，耗时不足 2.5 小时。

Conclusion: FS2 实现了迄今（据作者所知）在数小时内求解到该精度的最大规模离散 EOT 问题，并开源了实现（https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn）以保证可复现性。

Abstract: Streaming GPU solvers for entropic optimal transport (EOT), such as FlashSinkhorn, avoid storing the dense kernel but still evaluate all $n\times m$ point pairs in every Sinkhorn iteration. We present \textbf{FlashSinkhorn~2} (FS2), a solver for squared-Euclidean cost on low-dimensional point clouds that solves large discrete EOT problems to a prescribed marginal residual on a single GPU by coupling two stages. A coarse stage solves on cell centroids, lifts the potentials to every point and, when a sampled marginal check rejects the lift, continues on the centroids, replacing most point-level updates. A block-sparse fine stage then removes the centroid error that coarse updates cannot. Its Morton-ordered blocks support screening and fused tensor-core execution, and a threshold set by the block masses bounds each omitted tile's contribution to every row and column. On synthetic benchmarks, FS2 reaches the target residual on all 32 problems and GeomLoss multiscale on 10. On one A100, FS2 solves discrete EOT between two $1.34\times10^8$-particle measures from a cosmological $N$-body simulation, at an entropic blur equal to the mean interparticle distance, to an all-particle marginal residual below 0.01 in under 2.5 hours. To our knowledge, it is the largest discrete EOT problem solved to this accuracy within hours. For reproducibility, we release an open-source implementation at https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn

</details>


### [401] [When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02405)
*Xi Qin,Isabel Kurth,Xin Cui,Elin Park,Alexander Schaefer,Yaad Oren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出现有利用前沿模型作为元智能体生成终端任务与验证器的流程存在可靠性缺口，识别出基准无效、测试框架脆弱、奖励错位三类失败，并提出以可解性区间校准、验证器审计和基础设施错误核算作为一等评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用Claude Opus等前沿模型作为元智能体生成终端任务与验证器用于RL训练已渐成主流，但可运行的Docker镜像与可执行测试套件并不能保证端到端流程的忠实性，作者正是针对这一缺口展开研究。

Method: 提出一套元智能体流水线，诊断三类失败：基准无效性、测试框架脆弱性、奖励错位。通过提示重设计与上下文扩展提升基线可解性，并对比在Claude Opus生成任务上9B模型的表现，以及加入困难任务后的变化。

Result: 提示重设计与上下文扩展使基线可解性提升5.6倍；但9B模型在Claude Opus生成任务上、20步内即饱和于81.3%的平均pass@2。在不改变训练配置的情况下加入困难任务，平均pass@2降至20.6%，有力表明可解性区间是模型特有的。

Conclusion: 元智能体的可靠性要求将可解性区间校准、验证器审计与基础设施错误核算作为一等评估标准，而非事后诊断手段。

Abstract: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. Prompt redesign and context extension raise baseline solvability 5.6 times, but a 9B model saturates at 81.3% mean pass@2 within 20 steps on Claude Opus-generated tasks. Adding hard tasks reduces mean pass@2 to 20.6% without changing the training configuration, a strong evidence that the solvability band is model-specific. These findings demonstrate that meta-agent reliability requires solvability-band calibration, verifier audits, and infrastructure error accounting as first-class evaluation criteria, not post-hoc diagnost.

</details>


### [402] [Reinforcement Learning Techniques for the Optimization of Target Polarization in Nuclear Physics Scattering Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02452)
*Armen Kasparian,Torri Jeske,Monibor Rahman,Chris Keith,James Maxwell,Thomas Britton,Malachi Schram,David Lawrence*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该工作提出结合代理模型与强化学习的数据驱动控制框架，用于动态极化靶的微波频率自动调优，基于APOLLO低温靶运行数据建模，并在仿真环境中训练RL智能体，实现约2倍于人工操作的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态极化靶在核物理实验中需持续调节微波频率以补偿辐射损伤与材料属性变化，传统上依赖专家人工试错，效率低且难以规模化，亟需自动化、数据驱动的控制方法。

Method: 使用APOLLO低温靶系统的运行数据，训练多层感知机（MLP）与高斯过程回归（GPR）模型，以微波频率、束流和累积辐射剂量为输入预测极化度；对比两者在不确定性校准与分布外识别上的表现；引入高斯过程近似并构建标准化仿真环境，将代理模型嵌入其中，采用下置信界（LCB）奖励公式训练强化学习智能体以平衡性能与不确定性。

Result: 高斯过程模型能够给出校准良好的不确定性估计，并可靠识别训练分布外区域；MLP对分布偏移敏感性有限。在各目标样本间实现迁移学习与控制，RL智能体性能较操作员人工操作提升近2倍。

Conclusion: 代理模型与强化学习结合可为动态极化靶提供自动化、可迁移的频率控制方案，高斯过程的不确定性建模是安全探索的关键，该方法有望替代人工试错并提升核物理实验运行效率。

Abstract: The operation of dynamically polarized targets in nuclear physics experiments relies on continuous tuning of the microwave frequency to compensate for radiation damage and evolving material properties, a task that is traditionally performed through manual trial-and-error by expert operators. This work presents a data-driven control framework that combines surrogate modeling with reinforcement learning to optimize the target polarization. Using operational data from the APOLLO cryogenic target system, we train and evaluate multilayer perceptron and Gaussian process regression models to predict polarization as a function of microwave frequency, beam current, and accumulated radiation dose. We show that Gaussian process-based models provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and reliably identify regions outside the training distribution, while MLPs exhibit limited sensitivity to distributional shift. To enable learning and control across multiple target samples, we introduce a Gaussian process approximation and embed the surrogate model within a standardized simulation environment. A reinforcement learning agent is trained using a lower-confidence-bound reward formulation that balances performance maximization against uncertainty. We are able to show an almost 2x improvement on the operators actions utilizing our RL agent.

</details>


### [403] [Tropical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02478)
*Arip Asadulaev,Aladin Djuhera,Karim Salta,Holger Boche,Fakhri Karray,Martin Takac*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Tropical Reinforcement Learning，用"取最大值"（热带半环）替代传统 RL 中"概率求和"的期望回报，并给出训练算法 TROPIC，在四个智能体任务上比最强 on-policy 基线最高提升 16 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 RL 最大化期望回报，通过累加所有成功轨迹概率来训练大语言模型。但求和式目标只能报告策略"多常成功"，无法指出"哪个解真正有效"；且因概率归一，强化某一解会使模型遗忘其他未被证伪的解。这对组合式推理尤为不利——此类任务的正确解需要由分散在不同（多为失败）尝试中的推理步骤拼装而成，模型极少一次性完整产出。

Method: 作者对 RL 的代数结构做根本改变：不用概率求和，而取最大值，从而引入热带半环。此时状态价值定义为其"最可能已验证解"的对数概率，并附带一条可回放、可复用的显式路径。由此实现真正的组合——在共享状态处相遇的最优前缀与最优后缀可以拼接，即便二者来自不同 rollout。落地上提出 TROPIC，一种面向确定性、可重置且结果可验证环境的训练算法。

Result: 在四个智能体任务（Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop）上，TROPIC 优于最强 on-policy 基线，最高提升 16 个百分点。

Conclusion: 改变强化学习的"代数"（而非仅其估计器）能显著提升语言模型的组合式推理能力，说明目标函数的代数结构本身是被此前工作忽视的关键设计维度。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models typically maximizes expected return, adding up the probabilities of all successful trajectories. However, the classical sum formulation can only report how often the model policy succeeds, not which solution actually worked, and because probabilities sum to one, reinforcing one solution can make the model forget another that was never shown to be wrong. This makes expected return a poor fit for compositional reasoning, where a solution must be assembled from reasoning steps that the model produces in separate, often failed, attempts but rarely produces together. To address this, we propose Tropical Reinforcement Learning, which rests on a simple change of algebra: instead of adding the probabilities of alternative solutions, we take their maximum, which yields the tropical semiring. The value of a state then becomes the log-probability of its most likely verified solution, together with an explicit path that can be replayed and reused. This enables true composition, since the best prefix and the best suffix meeting at a shared state can be joined even when they come from different rollouts. To put this into practice, we introduce TROPIC, a training algorithm for deterministic, resettable environments with verifiable outcomes. On four agentic tasks (Sokoban, Countdown, FrozenLake, WebShop), TROPIC outperforms the strongest on-policy baselines by up to 16 percentage points. Changing the algebra of reinforcement learning, not just its estimators, can thus substantially improve compositional reasoning in language models

</details>


### [404] [MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02480)
*Yuyang Cheng,Raghav Kaushik Ravi,Srivarshinee Sridhar,Sriparna Saha,Akash Ghosh,Chirag Agarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体框架MEA，通过Proposer选择解释工具、Actor端到端优化忠实性，将ML解释转化为自然语言，在表格、文本、视觉三种模态上均超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
