Result: 在所有系统与攻击上，不安全响应率从基线条件下的11.08%上升至越狱条件下的18.65%，平均韧性缺口为7.57%。可获取系统（accessible systems）的平均缺口更大；攻击有效性在不同攻击类别与危害类别间差异显著。基准还分析了评估器可靠性与测量误差来源。

Conclusion: Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 不仅给出评测结果，还为比较性越狱评测及未来在系统、攻击、危害与评估方法上的扩展建立了可复现的方法学基础。

Abstract: Modern AI systems are designed to refuse hazardous requests. A jailbreak is a prompt crafted to bypass those safeguards and elicit outputs that the system would normally refuse to provide. The MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 provides an end-to-end methodology for evaluating the robustness of large language models to single-turn, text-based jailbreak attacks. It combines criteria-driven system and attack selection, paired baseline and adversarial evaluation, human annotation, automated evaluator calibration, scoring, grading, and risk-calibrated disclosure within a single benchmarking pipeline. The benchmark evaluates eight open-weight systems using 264 seed prompts spanning eleven hazard categories and representative attacks drawn from the MLCommons Jailbreak Taxonomy. Responses are assessed using the AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4, and robustness is measured through the Resilience Gap: the change in safety performance between baseline and adversarial conditions. Across all evaluated systems and attacks, the unsafe-response rate increased from 11.08% under baseline conditions to 18.65% under jailbreak conditions, producing an average Resilience Gap of 7.57%. Accessible systems showed a larger mean gap, while attack effectiveness varied substantially across attack categories and hazards. The benchmark also examines evaluator reliability and sources of measurement error. Beyond reporting results, Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 establishes a reproducible methodological foundation for comparative jailbreak evaluation and for future expansion across systems, attacks, hazards, and evaluation methods.

</details>


### [438] [AMBER: Multi-View Adaptive Budget Allocation for Listwise Vision-Language Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02831)
*Wenteng Chen,Jiachen Zhu,Rong Shan,Tianyi Xu,Yuxiang Chen,Congmin Zheng,Teng Wang,Junjie Wu,Weiwen Liu,Changwang Zhang,Weinan Zhang,Jun Wang,Jianghao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AMBER是一个在线、有预算约束的多视图重排序框架，通过Elo更新维护全局排序状态并动态分配VLM调用资源，在同等调用预算下取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）作为多模态检索的listwise重排序器效果强大，但推理成本高，只能评估小范围局部候选视图。现有多轮调用策略依赖固定调度，把昂贵的VLM调用浪费在无信息量的候选对和简单查询上。

Method: 提出AMBER框架：将碎片化的listwise VLM输出视作局部锦标赛，用连续Elo更新维护轻量级全局排序状态；在此基础上进行两级计算分配——动态构建高分歧义度的候选视图，并对查询进行调度以最大化期望信息增益。理论上有两点支撑：每个Elo更新对应Bradley-Terry对数似然上的随机梯度上升步；查询级分配策略具有子模性的信息论动机。

Result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和PhotoBench上实验表明，在可比的VLM调用预算下，AMBER在对比的多轮调用VLM重排序方法中取得最强整体性能，且在更低预算设置下仍保持有效性。代码已公开。

Conclusion: AMBER通过在线、预算感知的全局资源分配，缓解了固定调度导致的VLM调用浪费问题，验证了Elo状态维护与信息增益导向查询调度的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are powerful listwise rerankers for multimodal retrieval, but high inference costs restrict them to evaluating small local candidate views. Existing multi-call strategies rely on fixed schedules, wasting expensive VLM calls on uninformative candidate pairs and easy queries. To address this, we propose Adaptive Multi-view Budgeted Elo Reranking (AMBER), an online, budgeted multi-view reranking framework that dynamically optimizes global resource allocation. AMBER treats fragmented listwise VLM outputs as local tournaments, using continuous Elo updates to maintain a lightweight global ranking state. Building on this, it allocates computation at two levels: dynamically constructing candidate views with high score ambiguity, and scheduling queries to maximize expected information gain. We show that each Elo update corresponds to a stochastic gradient ascent step on the Bradley-Terry log-likelihood, and provide a submodular information-theoretic motivation for the query-level allocation strategy. Experiments on CIRR, CIRCO, and PhotoBench demonstrate that AMBER achieves the strongest overall performance among the compared multi-call VLM reranking methods under comparable VLM-call budgets, while remaining effective in lower-budget settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wnlfc/AMBER.

</details>


### [439] [DNAlign: Dynamic Null-Space Safe Alignment for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02844)
*Jisheng Dang,Yushuo Zhao,Dewei Liu,Junfeng Fang,Bimei Wang,Tiantian Rao,Hong Peng,Bin Hu,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DNAlign轻量对齐框架，结合控制论优化与零空间投影，将扰动限制在有害相关子空间，在降低有害输出的同时保持流畅性、事实性与生成多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型安全可靠部署面临挑战。现有安全对齐方法或计算开销高，或无意破坏模型核心知识，导致良性任务上的流畅性与事实准确性下降，暴露出安全性与可用性之间的持续权衡。

Method: DNAlign将LLM视为动态系统，引入可控扰动引导生成走向安全行为；核心投影模块将扰动限制在由中性隐藏状态导出的有害相关子空间中，以保留通用知识与回复质量；并使用基于人类偏好数据训练的价值函数自适应优化控制信号，使其符合人类安全偏好。

Result: 在多个LLM骨干模型上的大量评测表明，该框架持续减少有害输出，同时保持流畅性、连贯性与事实可用性；相比既有对齐基线取得更优的综合表现，且未牺牲生成多样性。

Conclusion: 该框架为安全的LLM对齐提供了一种有效且可实际部署的解决方案，代码已开源于指定匿名链接。

Abstract: Ensuring the safe and reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs) remains a fundamental challenge. Existing safety alignment approaches either incur high computational cost or unintentionally disrupt the model's core knowledge, leading to degraded fluency and factual accuracy on benign tasks. This reveals a persistent trade-off between safety and utility. We propose DNAlign, a lightweight alignment framework that integrates control-theoretic optimization with null-space projection. By treating the LLM as a dynamic system, the proposed framework introduces controllable perturbations to steer generation toward safe behavior. A key component is the projection module, which restricts these perturbations to the harmful-related subspace derived from neutral hidden states, thereby preserving general knowledge and response quality. A value function trained on human preference data adaptively optimizes the control signals to align with human safety preferences. Extensive evaluations across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently reduces harmful outputs while maintaining fluency, coherence, and factual utility. It achieves superior overall performance compared to prior alignment baselines without sacrificing generation diversity. These results indicate that the proposed framework provides an effective and practically deployable solution for safe LLM alignment. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DNAlign.

</details>


### [440] [Bounded Reachability & Jailbreak Detection via Contraction-Constrained State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02853)
*Omanshu Thapliyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于状态空间模型(SSM)的安全头(state space model-based safety head)在嵌入空间有界扰动下的形式化鲁棒性认证。核心结论：当状态转移矩阵的无穷范数满足收缩条件‖A‖∞<1时，可进行严格的区间界传播(IBP)认证；否则输出区间随序列长度指数增长，认证不可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全头是附加在预训练语言模型上的轻量分类器，用于在生成前标记有害输入。其实证检测性能已被广泛研究，但其形式化鲁棒性性质基本未被探索。作者希望回答：SSM-based安全头何时能被认证为在嵌入空间有界扰动内的所有输入产生相同预测。

Method: 作者针对线性时不变(LTI)分类器证明：认证能力取决于单一条件——状态转移矩阵的无穷范数‖A‖∞<1（收缩条件），该条件使精确的区间界传播(IBP)认证成立。当收缩成立时，可达输出区间具有有界稳态宽度；当收缩失败时，区间随序列长度指数增长。作者使用hinge惩罚强制收缩，并在有害评论数据上验证理论预测的经验相变。

Result: 强制收缩后，认证比例从41%提升至59%，并在‖A‖∞=1处出现与理论吻合的明显经验相变。将收缩正则化的S4安全头应用于JailbreakBench上的越狱检测，实现零样本迁移至AdvBench(DR=0.994)与HarmBench(DR=0.988)。在均值池化的Mamba-130M嵌入上进行逻辑回归，在所有检测指标上匹配或超越S4安全头，说明有害意图在嵌入空间中已线性可分。

Conclusion: S4安全头的贡献不在于更优的判别能力（线性探针已足够），而在于提供任何基于探针的方法都无法给出的形式化认证保证。收缩条件是SSM安全头可认证性的关键。

Abstract: Safety heads are lightweight classifiers attached to pretrained language models for flagging harmful inputs before generation. Their empirical detection performance has been studied, but their formal robustness properties remain largely unexplored. We ask when a State Space Model (SSM)-based safety head can be certified to produce the same prediction for all inputs within a bounded embedding-space perturbation. We prove that the answer turns on a single condition: the $l_\infty$ norm of the state transition matrix must satisfy $\norm{A}_\infty<1$ (the \emph{contraction condition}), which enables exact interval bound propagation (IBP) certification for linear time-invariant classifiers. When the contraction condition holds, the reachable output interval has bounded steady-state width and examples can be certified as robustly classified. When it fails, the interval grows exponentially with sequence length and certification is impossible at any practical perturbation radius. We enforce contraction with a hinge penalty and show on toxic comment data that certified fraction improves from 41\% to 59\%, with a sharp empirical phase transition at $\norm{A}_\infty=1$ matching the theory. Applying a contraction-regularized S4 head to jailbreak detection on JailbreakBench, we achieve a zero-shot transfer to AdvBench (DR=0.994) and HarmBench (DR=0.988). A logistic regression on mean-pooled Mamba-130M embeddings matches or exceeds the S4 head on every detection metric, confirming that harmful intent is already linearly separable in the embedding space. The S4 safety head's contribution is not superior discrimination but the formal certification that no probe-based approach provides.

</details>


### [441] [Harness-Aware Distillation for Small Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02858)
*Moonseok Choi,Taehong Moon,Giung Nam,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD)，将蒸馏重点放在教师模型在 harness 之外所提供的能力上，通过动作偏好对比与有效性检查改进学生智能体，在多个长程智能体基准上超越同 harness 的 on-policy 蒸馏基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体部署时附带 harness（管理上下文、工具与反馈的外部软件）。当教师智能体被蒸馏到更小的学生模型时，harness 保持不变，因此学生主要需要学习 harness 无法提供的教师特有能�力，例如正确利用 harness 信息采取行动。但标准蒸馏模仿教师完整输出，将 harness 视为输入的一部分，导致学生浪费容量去模仿 harness 已能提供的部分，无法有效获取教师超越 harness 的关键能力。

Method: HAD 在 on-policy 蒸馏基础上增加两个组件：(1) 动作偏好（action preference），在同一教师的动作间进行对比，一组带 harness 信息、一组不带，并在学生自身推理之后打分，从而提炼教师超越 harness 的增量信息；(2) 有效性检查（validity check），剔除偏好动作与 harness 记录相矛盾的偏好对。该方法不需要任务奖励、成功标签或未来信息。

Result: 在多个长程智能体基准和模型上，HAD 在相同固定 harness 下优于 on-policy 蒸馏基线。分析显示，HAD 相比基线进入无效循环更少、从错误中恢复更频繁，并表明其能够自适应地将可学习的反馈保留在权重中，同时从 harness 读取状态信息。

Conclusion: 对照实验表明，该对比为学生提供了单纯模仿教师无法提供的额外信息；HAD 无需任务奖励、成功标签或未来信息即可实现更优蒸馏，使学生智能体更有效地利用固定 harness，减少无效循环并提升错误恢复能力。

Abstract: Language model agents are deployed with a harness, the software around the model that manages its context, tools, and feedback. When such an agent is distilled into a smaller one, the harness stays in place, so the student mainly needs the teacher-specific abilities that the harness cannot provide, such as acting correctly on harness information. Standard distillation, however, imitates the teacher's full outputs and treats the harness as part of the input. We propose Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD), which focuses distillation on what the teacher adds beyond the harness. HAD complements on-policy distillation with two components: an action preference that contrasts the same teacher's actions with and without the harness information, scored after the student's own reasoning, and a validity check that drops preference pairs whose preferred action contradicts the harness records. We show that the contrast gives the student information that imitating the teacher alone cannot provide, and HAD needs no task rewards, success labels, or future information. Across multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks and models, HAD outperforms on-policy distillation baselines with the same fixed harness. Our analysis shows that HAD enters fewer unproductive loops and recovers from errors more often than the baselines, and suggests that it adaptively keeps learnable feedback in its weights while reading state information from the harness.

</details>


### [442] [TACD: Distilling Efficient Text-to-Motion Models via Terminal Amplification Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02867)
*Wei-Jin Huang,Yuan-Ming Li,Kun-Yu Lin,Wang Luo,Yinlin Zhu,Yue Yu,Shenghao Ye,Junbin Yuan,Fa-Ting Hong,Qing Zhang,Wei-Shi Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TACD：面向文本到运动生成的分段on-policy流蒸馏方法，通过将最新教师查询与student步长绑定，约束clean-motion空间的损失权重，实现少步高质量生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到运动模型虽提升质量与指令跟随能力，但多步去噪和大模型组件导致部署慢、内存消耗大；且无真实运动数据条件下需从预训练教师蒸馏高效生成器。

Method: 提出Terminal-Amplification-Controlled Distillation (TACD)，基于分段on-policy流蒸馏，在student生成轨迹上监督clean-motion预测；发现固定监督网格上的速度匹配会在去噪终点附近反复放大误差的失败模式，TACD将最新教师查询与student步长绑定以约束clean-motion空间有效损失权重，推理阶段不变。

Result: HumanML3D与KIT-ML上few-step生成提升，八步HY-Motion student相对无约束蒸馏FID降低58%；对扩散教师，endpoint-matching形式TACD使四步student在HumanML3D上FID低于50步教师且检索匹配或更优；HY-Motion与Kimodo上八步student端到端加速7.7-11.9x，峰值GPU内存降低3.8-6.7x。

Conclusion: TACD通过终端放大控制有效缓解少步蒸馏终点误差权重失衡问题，在无需真实运动数据的条件下实现少步、低内存、高质量的文本到运动生成。

Abstract: Recent text-to-motion models have improved motion quality and instruction following, yet many-step denoising and large model components make deployment slow and memory-intensive. We present Terminal-Amplification-Controlled Distillation (TACD), an on-policy approach for training efficient motion generators from text prompts and pretrained teachers, without real-motion training data. Building on segmented on-policy flow distillation, we supervise clean-motion predictions along student-generated trajectories. We identify a failure mode in which velocity matching on a fixed supervision grid repeatedly overweights errors near the denoising endpoint, degrading few-step generation. TACD ties the latest teacher query to the student's step size, bounding the effective loss weights in clean-motion space without changing inference. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate improved few-step generation, including a 58% reduction in eight-step HY-Motion student FID relative to distillation without this bound. For diffusion teachers, the endpoint-matching form of TACD yields four-step students with lower FID and matched or improved text-motion retrieval relative to their 50-step teachers on HumanML3D. On HY-Motion and Kimodo, eight-step students with compact components achieve 7.7-11.9x end-to-end speedups and reduce peak GPU memory by 3.8-6.7x relative to their teachers. Project page: https://vkgo.github.io/TACD/

</details>


### [443] [PsyEvo: A Personalized Counseling Agent That Self-Evolves at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02885)
*Yuting Yan,Shihao Xu,Junhao Yu,Mingcong Zuo,Lu Chen,Nan Xiang,Haiyang Geng,Dongjie Tao,Minghao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PsyEvo 是一个基于大语言模型的心理咨询框架，通过层级贝叶斯技能策略、会话间列表偏好优化与状态条件序数信用分配三个组件，实现测试时的来访者个性化与响应策略改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康障碍影响全球大量人群，但受训从业者持续短缺，多数人无法获得充分照护。基于大语言模型的心理咨询师有望提供可扩展的对话式心理支持。然而仅靠离线训练难以适应个体来访者，也无法在测试时从持续的治疗互动中学习。

Method: PsyEvo 包含三个组件：(1) 层级贝叶斯技能策略（HBSP），通过维护基于会话反馈更新的每位来访者技能后验，个性化决定施加何种干预；(2) 会话间列表偏好优化（LiPO），利用跨来访者偏好证据更新共享响应适配器，改进所选技能的表达方式；(3) 状态条件序数信用分配（SOCA），通过一致性校验的比较与序数投影，为前两个组件提供候选偏好与轨迹信用。

Result: 在共享在线队列适应的模拟来访者评测中，PsyEvo 在 PsychEval 上取得 7.684 的 Overall 分数，并在三次匹配运行中均超过所有组件变体。在共享配置下，移除任一组件会使平均总体得分下降 0.138–0.171，支持各组件在完整框架内的条件性贡献。

Conclusion: PsyEvo 通过测试时的来访者个性化与响应策略自适应，为可扩展的对话式心理支持提供了有效方案；消融结果表明显式构建的组件在完整框架中各自具有条件贡献。代码已开源于 https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo。

Abstract: Mental health disorders affect a substantial proportion of the global population, yet a persistent shortage of trained practitioners leaves the majority without adequate care. Large language model (LLM)-based counselors present a promising direction for delivering scalable conversational psychological support. Offline model training alone leaves limited room to adapt to individual clients or to learn from ongoing therapeutic interaction at test time. We introduce PsyEvo, an LLM-based counseling framework that enables both client-specific personalization and response-policy improvement at test time through three components: Hierarchical Bayesian Skill Policy (HBSP) personalizes what intervention to apply by maintaining a per-client skill posterior updated from session feedback; Inter-session Listwise Preference Optimization (LiPO) improves how the selected skill is expressed by updating a shared response adapter from cross-client preference evidence; and State-conditioned Ordinal Credit Assignment (SOCA) supplies candidate preferences and trajectory credit to the two components through consistency-checked comparisons and ordinal projection. In simulated-client evaluation with shared online cohort adaptation, PsyEvo obtains 7.684 Overall on PsychEval and exceeds every component variant in each of three matched runs. Removing individual components lowers mean overall score by 0.138--0.171 under the shared configuration, supporting conditional contributions within the complete scaffold. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo

</details>


### [444] [Interpreting at Write Time: A Policy Ablation for Multi-Goal Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02897)
*Albert Sadowski,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 长时运行助手无法保存全部历史，只能摘要，而摘要具有目标依赖性。论文研究当记忆需同时服务多个长期目标时摘要策略应如何"写"：无目标中立摘要、覆盖所有目标的单一摘要、以及每目标各写一份摘要并合并读取。固定读取步骤后比较发现：为不同目标写的摘要彼此重叠度低于同一摘要与其自身重写；每目标摘要策略在相关性、完整性、准确性上最优，全目标摘要甚至不如预算更低的中立摘要。结论：写时进行目标解释有收益，但只对后续真正提问的目标有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时运行助手的历史记录超出可重读长度后，摘要将取代原始流，被舍弃的内容即永久丢失。摘要并非中立：保留什么是基于"记录用途"的判断，且该判断在写入时一次性做出，而此时并不知道哪个用户长期目标会来提问。多个长期目标对"发生了什么"意见一致，却对"哪些部分值得占用空间"存在分歧，因此需要研究面向多长期目标的记忆应摘要什么。

Method: 作者提出三种写入策略并对比：(1) 无目标视角的中立摘要；(2) 一个覆盖所有目标的统一摘要；(3) 每个目标各写一份摘要、读取时合并。实验在多个模型与多个事件流上进行，并固定读取(read)步骤，仅让写入(write)策略变化，从而隔离写入环节的影响。

Result: 目标确实会使摘要分化：为不同目标写的摘要彼此重叠度，低于一份摘要与其自身重写版本的重叠度。每目标摘要(per-goal)在相关性、完整性和准确性上均胜出；全目标摘要(all-goal)表现最差，甚至不及以极小预算写成的中立摘要。

Conclusion: 在写入阶段进行目标解释(interpreting at write)是有回报的，但收益仅限于是后来真正提问的那个目标，无法同时惠及所有潜在目标。因此面向多长期目标的记忆宜采用每目标独立摘要并在读取时合并的策略。

Abstract: A long-running assistant cannot keep everything it has seen, so it summarises. Summarising is not neutral: what is kept is chosen against some notion of what the record is for, and that choice is made once, before anyone knows which of the user's standing goals will ask. Goals rarely disagree about what happened. They disagree about which parts of it were worth the space. Once the history is too long to re-read, the summary replaces the stream, and whatever it left out is gone. We ask what a memory should summarise for when it serves several standing goals at once. Three policies answer differently: summarise with no goal in view, write one summary covering every goal, or write one summary per goal and read them together. We compare them across several models and event streams, holding the read step fixed so that only the write differs. The goals do pull apart: summaries written for different goals overlap each other less than a summary overlaps a rewrite of itself. Per-goal summaries win on relevance, completeness and accuracy, and the all-goal summary loses even to the neutral one written at a fraction of its budget. Interpreting at write pays off, but only for the goal that later asks.

</details>


### [445] [LUMOS: Tracing Parametric Knowledge from Training Data to Behavioral Outputs in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02902)
*Seoyeon Ye,Gayoung Kim,Jiyoung Hong,Sookyung Kim,Hyunsoo Cho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 LUMOS 诊断框架，沿"训练数据曝光→行为输出"因果链追踪大模型参数知识，揭示内部编码与行为表达之间的检索鸿沟，并呼吁将训练数据维度纳入标准知识评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对大模型参数知识的分析大多以输出为中心，仅凭回答结果推断模型"知道什么"，而不核验模型实际训练过什么。这导致"正确回答源于真正泛化还是死记硬背"等根本问题只能停留在推测层面，缺乏证据支撑。作者希望引入训练数据这一维度，把推测性诊断转化为可验证的论断。

Method: 提出 LUMOS 诊断框架，利用训练语料完全透明的 OLMo 2 模型，沿"训练数据曝光→内部编码→行为输出"的因果链追踪知识，从而在已验证曝光的基础上分析模型的知识编码与表达。

Result: 模型内部能以高可分性（84%）编码罕见事实，但行为上仅能表达其中 54%，存在检索鸿沟，且该鸿沟随模型规模扩大而收窄；在自我反思任务上，模型对训练过的内容表现可靠（83%），但对未见内容降至随机基线水平（49%）；这一崩溃在思维链提示下依然存在，思维链反而抬高了置信信号而非改善校准。

Conclusion: 将训练数据轴纳入大模型评估，能把推测性诊断转化为可验证的结论；作者主张训练数据维度应成为大模型知识评估的标准组成部分。

Abstract: Current analyses of LLMs' parametric knowledge are largely output-centric, drawing conclusions about what a model knows without verifying what it was actually trained on. This leaves fundamental questions, such as whether a correct response reflects genuine generalization or rote memorization, grounded in speculation rather than evidence. To resolve these ambiguities, we introduce LUMOS, a diagnostic framework that traces knowledge along the causal chain from training-data exposure to behavioral output, leveraging OLMo 2 with its fully transparent training corpus. By grounding analysis in verified exposure, we reveal that models internally encode rare facts with high separability (84%) yet fail to express them behaviorally (54%), though this retrieval gap narrows with scale. Furthermore, when models are asked to self-reflect on their own answers, they perform reliably on trained content (83%) but drop to random-baseline levels (49%) on unseen content. This collapse persists even under chain-of-thought prompting, which inflates confidence signals rather than improving calibration. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that incorporating the training-data axis into LLM evaluation transforms speculative diagnoses into verifiable claims, and we advocate that this axis should be a standard component of knowledge assessment in LLMs.

</details>


### [446] [HASTE: Evolving Agent Harnesses Against Emerging Attacks Using Sparse Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02920)
*Xiqiao Xiong,Moxin Li,Zhixin Ma,Ouxiang Li,Wenjie Wang,Fuli Feng,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HASTE是一个多智能体框架，通过安全规范生成与攻击案例生成之间的对抗性交互，从稀疏威胁证据中演化智能体防护外壳（harness）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体防护外壳通过执行安全约束防止不安全行为，但新出现的攻击速度超过人工适配能力，需要自动化演化；然而，可用于演化的信号往往稀疏，如威胁报告和预印本中的简短描述或少量攻击示例。

Method: 提出HASTE多智能体框架，构建安全规范生成与攻击案例生成之间的对抗性交互：安全规范引导防护外壳更新以应对已识别的安全漏洞，攻击案例在每次更新后探查残余漏洞，并将评估结果反馈至两个过程，从而实现超越初始证据的演化。

Result: 在多种骨干模型、攻击类型和证据形式的实验结果表明，HASTE在保持良性任务效用的同时，持续降低攻击成功率。

Conclusion: HASTE能够从稀疏威胁证据中有效演化智能体防护外壳，应对新兴攻击，兼顾安全性与良性任务效用，代码已开源。

Abstract: Agent harnesses play a critical role in defenses by enforcing safety constraints to prevent unsafe actions. However, rapidly emerging attacks outpace manual harness adaptation, motivating automated harness evolution. Yet the signals available for harness evolution are often sparse, such as brief descriptions or a few attack examples in threat reports and preprints. To address this limitation, we introduce HASTE, a multi-agent framework that evolves agent harnesses from sparse threat evidence through an adversarial interplay between safety-specification generation and attack-case generation. Safety specifications guide harness updates toward addressing identified safety vulnerabilities, while attack cases probe for remaining safety vulnerabilities after each update. By feeding evaluation outcomes back into both processes, HASTE enables harness evolution against emerging attacks beyond the initially observed evidence. Experimental results across multiple backbone models, attack types, and evidence forms show that HASTE consistently reduces attack success rates while preserving benign-task utility. The code is available at https://github.com/xxiqiao/HASTE.

</details>


### [447] [Positive-Unlabeled Learning for Agent Safety False Alarm Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02925)
*Xichen Yan,Chongyang Gao,Kezhen Chen,Guangyi Zhang,Jiaqi Wu,Lixu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两阶段PU排序框架，在无报警安全标签条件下审计安全监控器的误报，显著优于八种PU基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全监控器误报多、消耗复核资源并削弱告警可信度；误报与真实告警在原始分数中交织，可靠阈值仍需大量人工核验。实际中仅有少量已核实安全的未报警轨迹，报警样本无标签，误报审计自然可建模为正例-未标注（PU）排序问题。核心难点是监控器导致的样本选择偏差：观测到的安全参考被监控器接受，而真正关注的隐藏安全误报恰是被错误标记者，导致观测正例对目标正例代表性差。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段含Trust-aware PU Supervision，将安全参考向报警域适配并对合理误报施加负例压力保护；以及Reliability-gated Rank Distillation，将多个PU参考模型的一致排序偏好蒸馏到单一学生模型。第二阶段用Consensus-guided Structural Refinement，借助层次化安全参考支持、报警关系与预测参考一致性优化学生排序。全程不需报警安全标签，且不修改底层监控器。

Result: 在主流安全监控器上宏AUPRC达0.6444，较八种PU基线高5.27–16.98个百分点；相比最强基线PULDA，在5%复核预算下多召回33.3%的误报。

Conclusion: 将误报审计形式化为受监控器选择偏差影响的PU排序问题，所提框架无需报警安全标签即可有效排序误报，提升误报召回并减少人工核验负担，同时保持监控器不变，具备良好实用性。

Abstract: Safety monitors help safeguard language-model agents interacting with external tools and environments, but conservative monitoring can generate many false alarms, consuming extensive review resources and weakening trust in alerts. Because false and genuine alarms often remain interleaved in native monitor scores, obtaining a reliable cutoff still requires substantial manual verification. In practice, a small set of verified-safe non-alarmed trajectories may be available while alarms remain unlabeled, naturally casting false-alarm auditing as a positive-unlabeled (PU) ranking problem. The key challenge is monitor-induced selection, since observed safe references are accepted by the monitor, while the hidden safe alarms of interest are precisely those it incorrectly flags, making the observed positives poorly representative of the positives to be recovered. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage framework in which Trust-aware PU Supervision adapts safe references toward the alarm domain and protects plausible false alarms from excessive negative pressure, while Reliability-gated Rank Distillation consolidates consistent ordering preferences from multiple PU reference models into a single student. Consensus-guided Structural Refinement then improves the student ranking using hierarchical safe-reference support, alarm relations, and predicted reference consensus. The framework requires no alarm safety labels for fitting and leaves the underlying monitor unchanged. Across mainstream safety monitors, our method achieves a macro AUPRC of $0.6444$, outperforming eight evaluated PU baselines by 5.27--16.98 absolute percentage points; compared with PULDA, the strongest evaluated PU baseline, it recovers 33.3% more false alarms at a 5% review budget.

</details>


### [448] [When to Compile a Computer-Use Agent? Measuring Payback and Making Compilation Decisions for Token Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02932)
*Yulong Ming,Jie Xu,Zihan Wu,Xiaohua Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PACE系统，通过测量协议与在线编译算法，解决GUI程序编译成本不确定与未来复用未知问题，实现成本感知的编译决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将代理重复执行的GUI流程编译为程序可降低token成本，但付费回收期与编译时机决策面临两大挑战：编译成本不确定（可能需修复甚至失败），未来复用未知（任务可能停止或GUI漂移导致程序失效）。

Method: PACE包含测量协议与在线编译算法。测量协议记录成功与失败的编译成本，在匹配任务输入上对比代理与程序执行成本，估计单次节省与回收次数；在线算法基于历史任务到达与编译结果，比较估计未来节省与含失败尝试的编译成本，并在允许执行或编译前，将执行与编译开销与由观测任务到达确定的累积预算进行校验。

Result: 在既定动作成本假设下，每次任务到达后的总成本不超过全程使用代理成本的1+ε倍。成功编译尝试的估计回收次数（不含源代理运行）为2-16次。使用记录任务到达的模拟中，当ε=0.25时，PACE相比ReAct平均降低token成本17.3%，相比AutoRPA适配降低24.9%，相比ToolPro适配降低17.3%。

Conclusion: PACE通过显式建模编译不确定性与复用不确定性，在理论保证与实证收益上均验证了成本感知在线编译的有效性。

Abstract: Compiling GUI procedures that agents execute repeatedly into programs can reduce their token costs. However, measuring payback and deciding when to compile have two challenges. First, compilation costs are uncertain because attempts can require repair and still fail to produce a usable program. Second, future reuse is unknown because tasks may stop arriving or GUI drift may stop the program from working. To address these challenges, we propose PACE (Payback-Aware Compilation from Experience), a system with a measurement protocol and an online compilation algorithm. The measurement protocol records successful and failed compilation costs, and compares agent and program execution costs on matched task inputs to estimate per-use savings and payback counts. Using these measurements, the online algorithm compares estimated future savings with compilation costs, including failed attempts, based on past task arrivals and compilation outcomes. It checks execution and compilation charges against a cumulative budget determined by observed task arrivals before allowing either action. Under stated action-cost assumptions, total cost after each arrival is at most $1+ε$ times the cost of running every task with the agent. For successful compilation attempts, estimated payback counts excluding source agent runs are 2-16 uses. In simulations using recorded task arrivals, PACE reduces token costs by 17.3% compared with ReAct, 24.9% with the AutoRPA adaptation, and 17.3% with the ToolPro adaptation on average ($ε=0.25$).

</details>


### [449] [Reasoning with Evidence, Not Merely Rationales: Verifiable Preference Proofs for LLM-Based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02968)
*Yu Hou,Nathaniel Kang,Pengkai Wang,Hua Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PROVE-REC 框架，通过两阶段架构与验证目标，解决 LLM 推荐中偏好理由与证据/排序脱节的"grounding-influence gap"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 虽能从交互历史与评论中推断用户偏好，但其生成的理由未必反映真实用于推荐的信息：偏好主张可能缺乏所选证据支撑，或对最终排序几乎无影响。作者将此双重失效命名为 grounding-influence gap。

Method: PROVE-REC 采用两阶段（two-pass）架构：Pass A 将完整的目标前历史转换为紧凑偏好证明，包含正面与规避两类主张，并链接到选定证据条目；Pass B 仅依据该证明及证据预测下一物品，防止推荐器绕过推理路径。验证上，通过对比"掩蔽所选证据"与"掩蔽可比对照条目"来检验证据到证明的 grounding；通过移除某偏好主张并测量目标物品排序边际的下降来检验证明到推荐的 influence；并引入排序保持（ranking-preservation）目标以保留完整历史中的有用信息。

Result: 在广泛的真实世界数据集上，PROVE-REC 一致优于强序列、生成式及 LLM 增强基线，提升最高达 7.45%；受控消融实验证实两阶段架构与验证目标的有效性。

Conclusion: PROVE-REC 生成的偏好主张在历史证据中更具支撑性、对推荐更具影响力，同时保持排序质量，为 LLM 推荐提供了可验证的偏好推理范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can infer user preferences from interaction histories and reviews, yet the rationales they generate may not reflect the information actually used for recommendation. A preference claim may be weakly supported by its selected evidence, or may have little effect on the final ranking. We refer to these two failures as the grounding-influence gap. We introduce PROVE-REC, a general framework for verifiable preference reasoning in LLM-based recommendation. Pass A converts the complete pre-target history into a compact preference proof consisting of positive and avoidance claims linked to selected evidence entries. Pass B predicts the next item using only the proof and its selected evidence, preventing the recommender from bypassing the reasoning path. To verify evidence-to-proof grounding, we compare the effect of masking selected evidence with masking a comparable control entry. To verify proof-to-recommendation influence, we remove a preference claim and measure the resulting decrease in the target item's ranking margin. A ranking-preservation objective further retains useful information from the complete history. Comprehensive experiments on wide-ranging real-world datasets demonstrate that PROVE-REC consistently outperforms strong sequential, generative, and LLM-enhanced baselines, with improvements of up to 7.45%. Controlled ablations confirm the effectiveness of the two-pass architecture and verification objectives. Moreover, PROVE-REC produces claims that are more strongly grounded in historical evidence and more influential to recommendation while preserving ranking quality.

</details>


### [450] [CreateScore: Domain-Theory-Informed Bayesian Routing for LLM-Based CV Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02972)
*Rupsa Roy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CreateScore 是一个领域理论指导的贝叶斯网络路由器，在简历逐条准则评分中把低不确定性决策交给本地8B模型、把高不确定性决策升级给120B模型，降低65.2% token消耗，但其不确定性信号无法有效定位8B模型的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对每份简历、每条准则都调用高能力LLM成本过高，需要一种按准则级别进行模型路由的成本削减机制，同时保持评分质量并支持可审计性。

Method: 构建手工指定、因果动机的DAG，节点条件概率表为Dirichlet-多项式，将简历证据转为后验不确定性；图虽具因果动机，但系统仅执行标准贝叶斯条件推断而非因果推断。以训练折标定升级阈值（目标本地解决70%）后冻结。低不确定性由本地8B模型裁决，高不确定性升级至120B参考模型。

Result: 在200份合成数据科学简历（139训练/61测试，5条准则）上，77.7%的准则决策（305中的237）本地解决。相对120B全量裁决的参照条件，路由升级使token用量降低65.2%，并将精确分数一致率从8B单独运行的32.8%提升至42.6%（95% CI 31.0–55.1%），但n=61时提升统计上不可区分。不确定性信号未能识别8B出错的决策：与参考模型的不一致率在升级项为16.2%、本地解决项为19.4%（AUROC 0.47，95% CI 0.39–0.56），不优于随机选择。另记录了早期评估因截断的推理模型输出被静默替换为本地标签而失效，并建议为级联评估设置防护措施。

Conclusion: CreateScore 可作为一种可审计的成本削减机制，但尚不能作为针对性错误检测器，也不是自主招聘系统。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can support rubric-based screening of CVs, but applying a high-capability model to every candidate and criterion is costly. We present CreateScore, a domain-theory-informed Bayesian network for criterion-level LLM routing. A hand-specified directed acyclic graph with Dirichlet-multinomial conditional probability tables converts CV evidence into posterior uncertainty; low-uncertainty decisions are resolved by a local 8B model and uncertain ones are escalated to a 120B reference model. The graph is causally motivated, but the system performs standard Bayesian conditioning, not causal inference. The escalation threshold is calibrated on a training fold (target: 70% resolved locally) and then frozen. On 200 synthetic Data Science CVs (139 training and 61 test candidates, five criteria), 77.7% of criterion decisions were resolved locally (237 of 305). Relative to a reference condition in which the 120B model adjudicated every criterion, routed escalation reduced token use by 65.2% and raised exact score agreement from 32.8% (8B alone) to 42.6% (95% CI 31.0-55.1%); at n = 61 the gain was not statistically distinguishable. The uncertainty signal did not, however, identify the decisions on which the 8B model erred: disagreement with the reference was 16.2% among escalated and 19.4% among locally resolved decisions (AUROC 0.47, 95% CI 0.39-0.56), no better than random selection. We also document how an earlier evaluation was invalidated when truncated reasoning-model outputs were silently replaced by local labels, and we recommend safeguards for cascade evaluation. CreateScore is supported as an auditable cost-reduction mechanism, not yet as a targeted error detector, and is not an autonomous hiring system.

</details>


### [451] [Reliable Self-Evolution with Imperfect Proxy Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02975)
*Kangjun Noh,Soyu Kim,Kyungwoo Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CISE（Conformal Interval-Driven Self-Evolution），通过条件共形推断和逐迭代在线密度比估计为候选构造候选特定的奖励区间，以保守区间奖励引导自演化搜索，并仅在全部性质区间完全落入可行域时返回候选，从而在低保真代理奖励场景下避免假阳性污染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的自演化搜索在科学发现中极具前景，但部分领域对每个候选进行高保真评估代价过高，系统只能依赖低成本但有缺陷的代理奖励。这类代理奖励可能给不可行候选打高分，产生假阳性，进而污染最终输出和用于指导后续生成的反馈。因此需要统计上经过校准的奖励区间，以提升自演化搜索的可靠性。

Method: 提出CISE方法：利用条件共形推断（conditional conformal inference）结合逐迭代在线密度比估计（iteration-wise online density-ratio estimation），为每个候选构建候选特定的奖励区间；在演化反馈中使用保守的区间奖励；仅当所有必需的性质区间完全落在各自可行区域内时才返回候选。并在独立性与协变量偏移的显式假设下推导了固定迭代的覆盖性结果。

Result: 在材料科学的三个自演化搜索任务上进行评估：CISE返回的所有候选在高保真评估下均为真阳性，而基线方法虽返回更多候选却包含假阳性。结果表明在下游验证预算有限时，规模更小但更精确的候选清单具有重要价值。

Conclusion: 通过统计校准的奖励区间替代点估计代理奖励，可有效抑制自演化搜索中的假阳性传播；CISE以更小、更精确的候选集换取更高的可靠性，适用于验证预算受限的科学发现场景。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving search is a promising approach to scientific discovery. However, high-fidelity evaluation of every candidate is prohibitively expensive in some domains. Self-evolving systems in such settings therefore rely on low-cost but imperfect proxy rewards, which may assign high scores to infeasible candidates. These false positives may contaminate both the final output and the feedback used to guide subsequent generations. This motivates statistically calibrated reward intervals for more reliable self-evolving search. We propose Conformal Interval-Driven Self-Evolution (CISE), which constructs candidate-specific reward intervals using conditional conformal inference and iteration-wise online density-ratio estimation. CISE uses conservative interval-based rewards for evolutionary feedback and returns candidates only when all required property intervals lie entirely within their respective feasible regions. We derive fixed-iteration coverage results under explicit assumptions of independence and covariate shift. We evaluate CISE on three self-evolving search tasks in materials science. In our experiments, all candidates returned by CISE are true positives under high-fidelity evaluation, whereas the baselines return more candidates but include false positives. These results highlight the value of a smaller, more precise shortlist when downstream validation budgets are limited. Our repository is available at https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/CISE.git.

</details>


### [452] [Relevant Evidence Decoding for Audio-Visual Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02976)
*Hyunjae Ra,Aecheon Jung,Jungin Park,Sungeun Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的相关证据解码（RED），通过点互信息量化音频、视频及交互成分对预测的支持，并按问题所需证据类型选择性增强，缓解音视频大模型跨模态幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音视频大模型易出现跨模态幻觉，即一种模态错误影响另一模态的预测。对比解码虽在视觉语言模型中有效，但直接迁移到音视频大模型时忽略了关键问题：不同问题需要不同感知证据（音频、视频或二者交互）。作者观察到联合音视频推断反而可能削弱预测——模型本可仅凭单一信息充分的模态得出正确答案，却在加入另一模态后被干扰（如音频正确识别为小提琴，加入吉他视频后置信度下降）。

Method: RED 是免训练方法，用于识别与问题相关的证据并选择性增强其贡献。它用点互信息（PMI）量化音频和视频在问题之外提供的预测支持，将二者的联合贡献分解为音频、视频和残差交互三部分；再通过一次仅问题的推断确定所需证据类型，随后用对应的 PMI 贡献增强原始音视频预测。

Result: 在三个音视频幻觉基准和三个音视频大模型上，RED 相比标准解码提升准确率：CMM 最高提升 7%，AVHBench 提升 6.3%，SVHalluc 提升 3.8%，首 token 相对时间平均为标准解码的 1.5 倍。

Conclusion: RED 通过区分问题所需证据类型并选择性融合音频、视频及交互的 PMI 贡献，有效缓解音视频大模型跨模态幻觉，在多个基准与模型上取得一致提升，代价仅为约 1.5 倍的首 token 延迟，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AV-LLMs) remain prone to cross-modal hallucinations, where one modality incorrectly affects predictions about another. Although contrastive decoding reduces hallucinations in vision-language models, its direct extension to AV-LLMs overlooks a key challenge: different questions require different perceptual evidence, including audio, video, or their interaction. Notably, we observe that joint audio-visual inference can weaken the prediction even when a model can recover the correct answer from a single informative modality. For example, when asked which instrument is heard, a model may correctly predict violin from the audio alone. Once a video showing a guitar is added, its confidence in violin may drop. In this paper, we introduce Relevant Evidence Decoding (RED), a training-free method that identifies question-relevant evidence and selectively strengthens its contribution. RED uses pointwise mutual information to quantify the predictive support provided by audio and video beyond the question alone. It decomposes their joint contribution into audio, video, and residual interaction components. A question-only inference pass determines the required evidence type, after which the model augments the original audio-visual prediction with the corresponding PMI contribution. Across three audio-visual hallucination benchmarks and three AV-LLMs, RED improves accuracy over standard decoding by up to 7% on CMM, 6.3% on AVHBench, and 3.8% on SVHalluc, with an average relative time to first token of 1.5x standard decoding.

</details>


### [453] [RASPER: Reward-Aligned Summarization of Clinical Notes for EHR Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02979)
*Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam,Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi,Chen Chen,Dongjie Wang,Zijun Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RASPER，一种面向EHR预测任务、通过下游预测反馈强化学习优化的可调LLM摘要器，将结构化编码转为软提示以提供患者纵向背景，从而抽取对预测有决定性作用的出院记录证据。在MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV的再入院预测和用药推荐任务上，RASPER均优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康档案中非结构化的出院记录常包含结构化医疗编码无法捕捉的患者特异性证据，但这些信息埋在冗长嘈杂的文本里，且并非为特定临床预测而写。通用摘要以流畅度为目标，往往遗漏决定性证据，保留看似合理却无信息量的细节。因此需要一种直接面向下游临床任务的摘要方法。

Method: RASPER是一个用于EHR预测的奖励对齐摘要器。它使用可调的LLM摘要器从出院记录中抽取任务相关证据，并以强化学习方式、依据下游预测器的损失构造奖励进行训练。为提供接地信息，一个纵向编码器将结构化编码转换为软提示，把每位患者的临床背景注入摘要过程。通过奖励所产生的多模态预测质量，促使摘要器保留能补充而非重复结构化编码所捕获信息的患者特异证据。

Result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV两个数据集上，针对再入院预测与用药推荐两项任务，RASPER均持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 直接针对下游临床任务优化EHR文本摘要、并结合结构化编码提供的患者纵向背景，能够有效提升多模态预测性能，验证了任务对齐摘要与软提示接地的有效性。

Abstract: Unstructured discharge notes in Electronic Health Records (EHRs) often carry signal complementary to structured medical codes, holding patient-specific evidence that standardized cohort-level codes alone cannot capture. However, this evidence in notes is frequently buried in lengthy, noisy text that is not intentionally written with any specific clinical prediction in mind. Summarization is an obvious mitigation, but generic summaries, tuned for fluency rather than the outcome, routinely omit decisive evidence while retaining plausible but uninformative detail. To this end, we propose RASPER, a Reward-Aligned Summarizer for Prediction in EHR, that optimizes note summarization directly against the downstream clinical task. RASPER employs a tunable LLM-based summarizer to extract task-relevant evidence from discharge notes and trains it via reinforcement learning from prediction feedback, using a reward derived from the downstream predictor's loss. To ground the summarizer, a longitudinal encoder converts structured codes into soft prompts that incorporate each patient's clinical context into note summarization. By rewarding the quality of the resulting multimodal prediction, RASPER encourages the summarizer to retain patient-specific evidence that complements, rather than duplicates, information captured by structured codes. RASPER consistently outperforms strong baselines on both readmission prediction and medication recommendation across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.

</details>


### [454] [Safeguarding Mutual Correction in Source-Free Domain Adaptation via Cut Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02981)
*Seongjun Lee,Changhee Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeCut，利用 cut statistic 作为无标签的预测可靠性度量，对源预训练模型与视觉语言模型之间的跨模型监督进行门控，实现安全互纠正，在多个 SFDA 基准上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期单模型 SFDA 方法依赖自精炼，易受确认偏差影响，难以纠正自身系统性错误；近期引入视觉语言（ViL）模型作为外部知识，但多为单向监督范式（ViL 监督源模型），忽略了两个模型失效模式不同、可互为纠正的潜力。然而无真实标签时难以判断哪个模型在某样本上正确，直接交换预测会导致错误传播。

Method: 提出 SafeCut：以 cut statistic 作为无标签的预测可靠性度量，对跨模型监督进行门控；依据模型间的相对可靠性，动态控制监督的方向与强度，在样本级别选择性放大真实纠正、抑制误纠正。理论上证明了该可靠性门控机制可保证净正向的纠正信号。

Result: 在多个多样化的 SFDA 基准上进行了大量实验，SafeCut 取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: 通过 cut statistics 保障 SFDA 中的互纠正（mutual correction）是有效的，为源预训练模型与视觉语言模型之间的双向知识利用提供了可靠、无标签的实用方案。

Abstract: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) aims to adapt a source-pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without access to the original source domain. While early single-model approaches rely on self-refinement, they are inherently susceptible to confirmation bias and struggle to correct their own systematic errors. To overcome this limitation, recent methods introduce Vision-Language (ViL) models as external knowledge sources. However, these approaches operate in a largely unidirectional paradigm, using the ViL model primarily to supervise the source-pretrained model. This overlooks a key structural property: the two models exhibit distinct failure modes -- where one produces an incorrect prediction, the other may produce a correct one, creating a natural opportunity for mutual correction within the target domain. Yet, without ground-truth labels, identifying which model is correct on any given sample is non-trivial, and naively exchanging predictions risks propagating errors across models. To address this challenge, we propose SafeCut, a novel approach that leverages the cut statistic as a label-free measure of prediction reliability to gate cross-model supervision. Our approach dynamically controls both the direction and strength of supervision based on relative reliability, selectively amplifying true corrections while suppressing miscorrections on a per-sample basis. We further provide theoretical justification showing that this reliability-gated mechanism guarantees a net-positive correction signal. Extensive experiments across diverse SFDA benchmarks demonstrate that SafeCut achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the effectiveness of safeguarding mutual correction in SFDA via cut statistics.

</details>


### [455] [PLCWorld: Benchmarking LLM-Generated PLC Programs in Closed-Loop Plant Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02982)
*Yunji Kim,Yunseok Lee,Hyunwoo Seo,Jaerim Choi,Woojin Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出PLCWorld——一个将结构化文本（ST）PLC程序执行与仿真对象响应、传感器反馈耦合的闭环执行环境与基准，包含100个合成任务、473个任务-条件对，并分别报告任务成功率与安全违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估LLM生成的PLC程序是否满足任务需求与安全约束，必须观察其控制命令如何影响设备与工件状态，而缺乏可控、可复现的闭环执行环境与统一评测协议。

Method: PLCWorld基于工业PLC程序与工程文档中的控制关系构建，涵盖Motion Control与Material Handling，按控制依赖范围定义难度；采用统一协议分别报告Task Success与Safety Violation；验证手段包括从业者评审、参考与替代程序、针对性反例、规范-评估器一致性检查及与独立ST运行时的对比。

Result: 参考与替代程序均满足其适用用例，542个针对性反例均至少在一个注册条件下触发指定评估器规则；执行差距（Execution Gap）将提交配置的接受与后续任务失败或安全违规关联；GPT-5.5在Easy用例任务成功率82.70%，Hard仅25.10%；对六个LLM与四种生成-验证工作流的评测揭示了完成度、安全性与生成成本间的差异。

Conclusion: PLCWorld提供了可公开获取的代码、仿真环境、基准任务与基线实现，为LLM生成PLC程序建立闭环、可分离任务成功与安全违规的评测标准，并揭示生成能力与安全保障之间的显著落差。

Abstract: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) coordinate industrial equipment by reading sensor inputs and issuing control commands. Evaluating whether large language model (LLM)-generated PLC programs satisfy task requirements and safety constraints requires observing how their commands affect device and workpiece states. We introduce PLCWorld, a common closed-loop execution environment and benchmark that couples Structured Text (ST) execution with simulated plant responses and sensor feedback. Grounded in control relations identified in industrial PLC programs and engineering documentation, PLCWorld contains 100 synthetic tasks and 473 registered task-condition pairs across Motion Control and Material Handling, with difficulty defined by control-dependency scope. A common protocol reports Task Success and Safety Violation separately. Validation combines practitioner review, reference and alternative programs, targeted counterexamples, specification-evaluator alignment checks, and comparisons with independent ST runtimes. Reference and alternative programs satisfy their applicable cases, while all 542 targeted counterexamples activate their designated evaluator rules under at least one registered condition. Execution Gap relates submission-profile acceptance to subsequent task failure or observed Safety Violation. Across the constructed task groups, direct GPT-5.5 achieves 82.70% Task Success on Easy cases but 25.10% on Hard cases. Evaluations of six LLMs and four adapted generation-and-verification workflows further expose differences between completion, safety, and generation cost. Our code, simulation environment, benchmark tasks, and baseline implementations are publicly available at https://yunji0516.github.io/PLCWorld/.

</details>


### [456] [DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03020)
*Yifei Tao,Xinyu Zhong,Henry Hengyuan Zhao,Fanyi Wang,Tengda Guo,Wentao Qiu,Ying Wang,Liujian Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 DyadMem 基准与 User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM) 新定义，联合标注用户侧记忆与关系型智能体记忆，覆盖 3,065 个 episode、50,961 个 session、61,210 个 QA，并揭示现有模型在完整流水线下的显著性能落差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆基准主要监督用户事实、偏好或跨用户可复用经验，忽略了"智能体应如何与该特定用户协作"这一关系特异性记忆；同时多数工作仅以长历史下的最终答案 QA 进行评估，评测不完整且不可靠，因此需要新的记忆定义与细粒度全流水线基准。

Method: 提出 URAM（User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory）定义，构建 DyadMem 基准：在同一多会话轨迹上联合标注用户侧记忆与 URAM，形成 6 类记忆；包含 3,065 episode、50,961 session、61,210 QA；提供 session 级 Capture/Update 金标、query 级 Recall 支持，以及 Gold-Memory 与 Full-Pipeline 两种 QA 设置；在 16 个开源与 4 个闭源模型上评测，并设计实验验证 URAM 的有效性。

Result: 20 个模型中 Gold-Memory QA 表现普遍较强，但 Full-Pipeline QA 大幅下降，印证细粒度评测设计的必要性；定量结果还暴露前沿 LLM 存在 Capture 召回低、Recall 不完整及不安全删除等问题；验证实验显示 URAM 对全部 20 个模型均有正向效果。

Conclusion: DyadMem 是一个双域、全流水线、标注充分的记忆基准，通过显式建模 URAM 弥补关系型智能体记忆的评测空白，可推动该领域发展。

Abstract: Long-term agents must remember not only what is true about a user, but also how a particular agent should work with that user as their shared history evolves. Existing benchmarks primarily supervise user facts and preferences or experience reusable across users, leaving this relationship-specific agent memory implicit. Additionally, most prior works measure the model solely with final-answer QA over long interaction histories, making the assessment still incomplete and unreliable. To this end, we introduce DyadMem with the proposed new definition User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM). DyadMem jointly annotates user-side memory and URAM along the same multi-session trajectories, resulting in 6 memory categories. To summarize, it includes 3,065 episodes, 50,961 sessions, and 61,210 QA instances, with extensive session-level Capture and Update gold annotations, query-level Recall support, and two QA settings: Gold-Memory and Full-Pipeline. Across 16 open-weight and 4 proprietary models, Gold-Memory QA is consistently strong, yet Full-Pipeline QA drops sharply. Such a gap explicitly supports our fine-grained evaluation design. Additionally, several quantitative results further reveal low Capture recall, incomplete Recall, and unsafe-deletion issues arising from even the frontier LLMs. We further conduct a rigorous experiment to validate the effectiveness of our URAM and observe the positive effects for all 20 models. In summary, DyadMem is a dual-domain, full-pipeline memory benchmark with extensive annotation efforts for advancing the domain's development.

</details>


### [457] [SoftGene: Protein Language Model-Enhanced Soft Prompting for Interpretable Gene Set Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03029)
*Drew Ross,Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam,Dongjie Wang,Xiaoyu Zhang,Zijun Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SoftGene框架，利用基因集的层级结构与蛋白质序列信息进行LLM基因集注释，在GO和MSigDB上验证了蛋白质序列表征结合文本上下文能提升注释效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因集分析是功能基因组学的基石，但现有方法劳动密集，高度依赖人工整理与专家生物学解释。现有基于LLM的方法多依赖符号化基因名称，无法捕捉领域特异的生物学结构，尤其是决定分子活性、相互作用与下游基因功能的蛋白质序列信息。

Method: SoftGene框架分两步：一是基于ESM（蛋白质语言模型）构建层级注意力编码器，用蛋白质级氨基酸序列信息表征每个基因集；二是构建混合提示方案，将基因集嵌入得到的软提示与LLM生成的辅助上下文硬提示相结合，输入本地LLM进行注释。

Result: 在Gene Ontology (GO) 和Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB) 两个基准数据集上评估，结果表明整合蛋白质序列表征与文本上下文总体提升了基因集注释性能；分领域分析显示蛋白质嵌入的贡献在不同生物学领域间存在差异。

Conclusion: 将蛋白质序列级信息与文本上下文结合可有效改善基于LLM的基因集注释，但蛋白质嵌入的作用具有领域依赖性，提示未来需针对不同生物学领域进行差异化建模。

Abstract: Gene set analysis is a cornerstone of functional genomics, yet it remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on manual curation and expert biological interpretation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for genomic reasoning and annotation, most existing approaches rely on symbolic gene names and fail to capture domain-specific biological structure, particularly protein sequence information that governs molecular activity, interactions, and downstream gene function. In this work, we propose SoftGene, a novel framework for LLM-based gene set annotation that leverages the hierarchical structure of gene sets. First, we use a hierarchical attention-based encoder built on ESM, a protein language model, to represent each gene set using protein-level amino acid sequence information. Second, we construct a hybrid prompting scheme that combines soft prompts derived from gene set embeddings with hard prompts containing auxiliary context generated by an LLM, and feed the resulting prompt into a local LLM for annotation. We evaluate our framework on two benchmark datasets: Gene Ontology (GO) and the Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB). Our results show that integrating protein-sequence representations with textual context improves gene set annotation overall, while per-domain analyses reveal that the contribution of protein embeddings varies across biological domains.

</details>


### [458] [When Numbers Start Talking: Numerical Signalling and Strategic Behaviour Among LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03033)
*Alessio Buscemi,Daniele Proverbio,Alessandro Di Stefano,The Anh Han,German Castignani,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文考察不同消息类型（自然语言、数值信号、随机序列）及智能体人格对LLM多智能体策略博弈中合作水平与最终收益的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益在具有策略互动的多智能体系统（MAS）中运行，但不同类型消息是否以及多大程度影响策略博弈结果尚不清楚；同时这一空白也关系到对AI智能体间协调行为的监测需求。

Method: 基于四种主流LLM构建AI智能体，让其在具有不同合作均衡的四种博弈中进行对战，比较自然语言、数值信号与随机序列三类消息对合作水平的影响，并考虑智能体被赋予的人格差异；同时分析智能体生成数值消息的随机性与符号分布特征。

Result: 结构化消息在多数博弈与LLM上改变了最终收益，但无一致可预测的模式，这动摇了"AI智能体无论如何都能收敛到稳定均衡"的假设。智能体生成的数值消息偏离随机性，在明确要求沟通时尤为显著且稳定；其符号分布多与收益结构相关，且随重复而趋于集中，但整体难以被人类理解。

Conclusion: 在有约束通道中监测AI智能体的协调，应优先采用跨模型可泛化的消息层"指纹"，而非不能泛化的行为决策。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly operate in multi-agent systems (MAS) characterised by strategic interaction. However, little is known about whether, and to what extent, different types of messages affect the outcomes of strategic games. By investigating AI agents based on four popular LLMs, playing four games with different cooperation equilibria, we study whether messages of different kinds (natural language, numerical signals, or random sequences) significantly modify the levels of cooperation in each game, also depending on the agents' assigned personalities. We observe that structured messages alter the final payoffs for most games and LLMs, but without a predictable pattern; this challenges the assumption that AI agents can converge to stable equilibria regardless of additional capabilities. Moreover, we observe that agent-generated numerical messages depart from randomness, most strongly and consistently when agents are explicitly instructed to communicate; however, they introduce an additional interpretability challenge, as their symbol distributions are mostly associated with the payoff structure and typically become more concentrated with repetition, but are overall difficult for humans to interpret. Monitoring for coordination of AI agents through restricted channels should thus prioritise message-level fingerprints, which generalise across models, over behavioural decisions, which do not.

</details>


### [459] [hacktrace: behavior-supervised detection of reward hacking during code generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03055)
*Hao Jiang,Xin Li,Annan Wang,Yichi Zhang,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发布173,561条多轮编程轨迹，提出HACKTRACE行为监督监控器，利用智能体生成代码时的内部状态检测奖励黑客行为，平均AUC达0.997，开销仅8毫秒，并可作为强化学习廉价监控信号，将作弊占比从82-91%降至1-5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编程智能体可通过修正代码或删除暴露bug的测试来获得及格，后者即奖励黑客。检测此类作弊需识别包括失败的捷径尝试，而现有监控方法依赖重新运行模型回答诚实性问题，成本高且滞后。论文旨在探究监督目标与监控证据来源对检测与训练信号有效性的影响。

Method: 发布173,561条来自Qwen3-8B的多轮编程轨迹并标注行为；提出HACKTRACE行为监督监控器，直接复用智能体生成代码时已计算的内部状态，实现回合完成前监控，无需额外语言模型token或前向传播；将内部证据与最终文件的静态特征结合。

Result: 平均每题AUC达0.997，监控开销仅8毫秒，在准确率和延迟上均优于需重新运行模型回答诚实性问题的监控器。作为强化学习信号时，强GRPO惩罚下作弊占及格解比例从82-91%降至1-5%，同时保留诚实正确解，且随策略演化维持高检测精度。

Conclusion: 监督目标（独立于利用成功与否的捷径行为）与监控证据来源（生成时内部状态）对将准确检测转化为有用训练信号均至关重要。

Abstract: A coding agent can earn a passing grade by fixing its code, or by deleting the test that exposes the bug. Detecting such reward hacking requires recognizing attempted shortcuts, including those that fail. We release 173,561 annotated multi-turn coding trajectories from Qwen3-8B and show that supervising shortcut behavior independently of exploit success substantially improves detection. We introduce HACKTRACE, a behavior-supervised monitor that reads the internal states the agent already computes while generating code. Reusing these states enables monitoring before a turn is complete, without additional language-model tokens or passes. Combining this evidence with static features of the final files achieves a mean per-problem AUC of 0.997 with 8 ms of monitoring overhead, improving both accuracy and latency over monitors that run the model again on an honesty question and answer. The same generation states also provide an inexpensive monitoring signal for reinforcement learning. With strong GRPO penalties, HACKTRACE reduces the cheating share of passing solutions from 82-91% to 1-5%, while retaining honest, correct solutions and maintaining high detection accuracy as the policy evolves. Our results show that both the supervision target and the source of monitoring evidence matter for turning accurate detection into a useful training signal.

</details>


### [460] [MOF-VERIFY: A Failure-Aware Agentic Harness for MOF Hypothesis Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03056)
*Donghyun Lee,Taehoon Lee,Geonhee Ahn,Jieun Kim,Jihyun Park,Suyeon Cho,Yoona Kim,Chaerim Shin,Hoi Ri Moon,Jonggeol Na,Sukho Hong,Jihwan Oh,Soo Kyung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用于AI材料协同科学家推理可靠性的诊断基准（四个任务族）与失效感知智能体框架MOF-Verify，显著提升MOF假设验证性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型日益成为AI材料协同科学家的推理组件，但其验证流程可靠性不明；MOF场景存在同一结构多标识符、合成结果依赖实验条件、证据跨异构来源分布、部分假设需计算而非文献支撑等挑战。

Method: 构建含四个任务族的诊断基准：结构锚定、合成条件验证、证据充分性验证与基于MLIP的计算验证；T-MOF-1-3在闭卷、检索增强与oracle-evidence三种设置下评估以定位知识获取、证据获取与推理环节的失效，T-MOF-4单独评估计算验证。据此提出失效感知智能体框架MOF-Verify，针对结构、文献、证据充分性与计算瓶颈进行干预后再给出最终判定。

Result: 在多种骨干LLM上，MOF-Verify相比直接推理与检索基线显著提升假设验证性能。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了可定位失效环节的诊断基准与失效感知智能体方案，提升材料假设验证可靠性，并在GitHub发布基准数据集。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as reasoning components in AI-driven materials Co-Scientists, yet the reliability of the resulting verification pipeline remains unclear. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) provide a particularly challenging setting because structures may appear under different identifiers, synthesis outcomes depend strongly on experimental conditions, evidence is distributed across heterogeneous sources, and some hypotheses require computation rather than literature alone. We introduce a diagnostic benchmark with four task families covering structural grounding, synthesis-condition verification, evidence-sufficiency verification, and MLIP-based computational verification. T-MOF-1-3 are evaluated under closed-book, retrieval-enabled, and oracle-evidence settings to localize failures in knowledge access, evidence acquisition, and reasoning, while T-MOF-4 separately evaluates computational verification. Guided by these diagnosed failure modes, we develop MOF-Verify, a failure-aware agentic harness that targets structural, literature, evidence-sufficiency, and computational bottlenecks before producing a final verdict. Across multiple backbone LLMs, MOF-Verify substantially improves hypothesis-verification performance over direct inference and retrieval-based baselines. Benchmark datasets are released at https://github.com/IMMS-Ewha/MOF-Verify-Benchmark.

</details>


### [461] [RIFAR: Reliability and Forgetting-Aware Replay for Continual Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03079)
*Zirong Song,Zheng Lu,Haoran Liao,Wanqi Zhong,Yunhe Ni,Lijie Wang,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RIFAR是一种面向具身智能体持续学习的世界-动作模型生成式回放方法，通过可靠性筛选与漂移感知回放选择，在仅保留极少历史数据的前提下超越此前最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实具身智能体需将连续真实世界经验转化为持久、可迁移的技能，这要求持续学习在新任务、新环境中融合新能力且不侵蚀旧知识。经验回放可缓解遗忘，但随任务累积，存储完整演示代价高昂。世界-动作模型（WAM）提供生成式替代方案，通过联合预测动作与未来观测来重建过往经验，但视觉连贯的展开轨迹中可能包含无法实现所预测状态转移的动作，且新任务适应过程会破坏已学行为。

Method: RIFAR将可靠性筛选与漂移感知回放选择相结合。它从紧凑的演示前缀重建轨迹，并利用冻结的逆动力学模型评估动作-视觉一致性；训练首先将当前演示与筛选出的最高质量轨迹结合；随后在相同历史输入上比较适应前后的动作预测，从同一筛选池中重新选择归一化漂移更大的轨迹用于继续训练。

Result: 在三个LIBERO套件及真实世界实验中，RIFAR均超过WAM生成式回放的前最优方法。在LIBERO-Goal上取得90.97 AUC，同时每个任务仅保留320个历史时间步，约为使用50个演示回放所保留步数的4.9%。

Conclusion: RIFAR通过逆动力学一致性筛选与动作漂移度量驱动的回放重选，在显著降低历史数据存储开销的同时有效缓解持续学习中的遗忘与行为破坏，验证了质量与漂移双重准则在WAM生成式回放中的有效性。

Abstract: Genuine embodied agency requires robots to turn continuous real-world experience into lasting, transferable skills. This demands continual learning that integrates new capabilities without eroding prior knowledge as tasks and environments evolve. Experience replay mitigates forgetting, but storing complete demonstrations becomes costly as tasks accumulate. World-action models offer a generative alternative, reconstructing past experience through joint predictions of actions and future observations. However, visually coherent rollouts may contain actions that cannot realize the predicted transitions, while new-task adaptation can disrupt previously learned behavior. RIFAR therefore combines reliability screening with drift-aware replay selection. It reconstructs trajectories from compact demonstration prefixes and uses a frozen inverse-dynamics model to assess action-visual consistency. Training first combines current demonstrations with the highest-quality screened trajectories. RIFAR then compares action predictions before and after this adaptation on identical historical inputs, reselecting trajectories with larger normalized drift from the same screened pool for continued training. Across three LIBERO suites and real-world experiments, RIFAR surpasses the previous state of the art in WAM-based generative replay. On LIBERO-Goal, it achieves 90.97 AUC while retaining only 320 historical time steps per task, approximately 4.9% of the steps retained using 50-demonstration replay.

</details>


### [462] [Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03128)
*Chaoqun Yang,Qian Wang,Fengbin Zhu,Xinyu Lin,Bingsheng He,Roger Zimmermann,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TradeGrad 是一个经验引导的文本梯度框架，用于稳健量化交易策略优化，在 A 股与美股、截面与时序四类任务中均取得最优样本内外表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化交易策略设计可视为黑箱程序优化问题。基于 LLM 的文本梯度能提供显式优化方向以迭代精炼策略，但直接应用存在两个问题：(1) 优化短视，未充分利用历史评估经验；(2) 聚合回测反馈忽视时序稳健性，可能偏向仅在特定市场阶段有效的策略。

Method: 提出 TradeGrad：利用累积的优化经验估计文本梯度，并采用多尺度修订进行策略探索与精炼；同时引入跨期稳健目标（Cross-Period Robust Objective, CPRO），强调在不利历史时期的表现以提升时序稳健性。

Result: 在中国 A 股与美股市场的截面与时序策略设计四类设置中，样本内与样本外表现均为最优。其中 A 股截面策略实现 27.99% 年化收益、12.19% 最大回撤、Sharpe 比率 1.63，较沪深 300 基准约高 68%。消融分析验证了各组件有效性，优化过程中样本内外表现持续提升。代码已开源。

Conclusion: TradeGrad 通过经验引导的文本梯度与跨期稳健目标，有效缓解优化短视与时序稳健性不足，实现了稳健且高性能的量化交易策略优化。

Abstract: Quantitative trading strategy design aims to discover trading programs from historical data that remain effective in future markets, which can be viewed as a black-box program optimization problem. LLM-based textual gradients offer a promising approach by providing explicit optimization directions for iterative strategy refinement. However, directly applying textual gradients faces two challenges: (1) optimization is myopic, underutilizing experience from previous evaluations; and (2) aggregate backtest feedback overlooks temporal robustness, potentially favoring strategies that perform well only in specific market periods. To address these challenges, we propose TradeGrad, an experience-guided textual-gradient framework for robust trading strategy optimization. TradeGrad leverages accumulated optimization experience to estimate textual gradients and employs multi-scale revisions for both strategy exploration and refinement. It further introduces the Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO), which emphasizes performance in unfavorable historical periods to promote temporal robustness. Experiments on cross-sectional and time-series strategy design in Chinese A-share and U.S. equity markets show that TradeGrad achieves the best in-sample and out-of-sample performance across all four settings. Notably, its Chinese cross-sectional strategy achieves 27.99% annualized return, 12.19% maximum drawdown, and a Sharpe ratio of 1.63, approximately 68% higher than the CSI 300 benchmark. Further analyses validate the proposed components and show consistent improvements in both in-sample and out-of-sample performance throughout optimization. The code is available at https://github.com/transcend-0/TradeGrad.

</details>


### [463] [Keeping JEPA World Models Plannable When Little of the Frame Moves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03137)
*Florian Strohm,Patrick Wagner,Jannik Schwab,Marco Huber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了SLIM推物基准，发现基于潜在世界模型的规划失败源于编码器对动作不敏感，通过逆动力学辅助损失修复后显著提升成功率，并实现语言目标规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言作为规划目标的接口优于目标帧，但需要能区分多个物体的场景来测试。现有世界模型（如LeWM）在PushT上成功，但无法处理需要语言区分的复杂场景，需要定位并解决其失败原因。

Method: 构建SLIM基准（含多个小物体、成对的视觉与语言目标）。诊断LeWM编码器失败原因。引入逆动力学辅助损失，作用于编码器潜在和通过共享头预测的潜在（测试时丢弃该头）。

Result: LeWM在SLIM上成功率<1%，而脚本控制器全通过。探针显示编码器潜在几乎与动作无关。加入辅助损失后，所有探针恢复，成功率从0.003升至0.35（困难推物层0.16，而无目标策略为0）。在PushT上两倍训练视野下也有提升。修复归因于流入编码器的梯度。动作敏感性探针可作为必要条件：低于阈值的配置均规划失败。修复后的潜在上，语言目标头在导航达0.84（视觉目标oracle为1.00），能跟随命名区域，对未见名词优雅退化。单句目标难以完成推物，但用阶段句子序列时，中等和困难推物层成功率从0.04升至0.25，与目标帧oracle相当。

Conclusion: 编码器对动作的敏感性是世界模型规划的必要条件；逆动力学辅助损失能有效修复编码器，使语言目标规划成为可能，并泛化到新任务。

Abstract: Specifying a goal in language rather than as a goal frame is a natural interface for planning with a latent world model, but testing it needs scenes in which language must discriminate between several objects. We build SLIM, a pushing benchmark with several small objects and paired visual and language goals on identical scenes. On SLIM a LeWM world model that solves PushT succeeds on under 1% of trials, although a scripted controller with simulator state solves every tier. Probes locate the failure in the encoder: its latent is nearly action-insensitive, neither pusher nor object positions can be decoded from it, and rollouts are no better than copying the current latent forward. One inverse-dynamics auxiliary loss, applied to encoder latents and to predicted latents through a shared head discarded at test time, restores every probe and raises success from 0.003 to 0.35 (0.16 on the hard pushing tier, where a goal-agnostic policy scores zero), and improves PushT at twice the trained horizon. Controls attribute the repair to the gradient into the encoder, and a response sweep shows that the vanilla model plans once enough of the frame responds to actions. A cheap action-sensitivity probe, computable without environment access, acts as an empirical necessary condition: all configurations below its threshold failed to plan. On the repaired latent, a small language-goal head plans from sentences without retraining the world model: it reaches 0.84 on navigation (visual-goal oracle 1.00), follows the named zone when it is swapped with a decoy, and degrades gracefully to unseen nouns. A single goal sentence rarely completes a push, but given the push as a sequence of stage sentences the head raises success on the medium and hard pushing tiers from 0.04 to 0.25, on par with the goal-frame oracle, also when the switch between stages is read from the latent alone.

</details>


### [464] [Toward SLM-based agentic task-tool intent matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03213)
*Chiara Troiani,Arash Salarian,Majed El Helou,Benjamin Ryder,Jean Diaconu,Hervé Muyal,Marcelo Yannuzzi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究用小语言模型（SLM）对AI代理的每次工具调用进行任务相关性验证，构建基于MCP服务器的多工具任务数据集，并通过提示优化、监督微调和GRPO强化学习对SLM进行优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具型AI代理通过工具调用访问数据并作用于外部系统，横向扩展使交互数量激增，需要低延迟、可本地部署的自动化逐次调用监督。传统授权方案只能判断代理是否被允许调用某工具，无法评估其底层的认知——即工具选择是否是朝向任务意图的合理、相关步骤。因此被允许的调用仍可能偏离任务意图，恶意代理可能偏离调用或诱导其他代理形成违背任务意图的调用组合，故每次调用都需被验证。

Method: 将小语言模型（SLM）用作任务-工具相关性分类器，独立地针对所分配任务评估每个被选择的工具，并输出相关性信号供下游执行环节使用；构建了一个新数据集，其中的多工具任务所需工具跨越不同的MCP服务器；采用提示优化、监督微调以及基于GRPO的强化学习来优化和特化SLM。

Result: 摘要未给出量化结果，仅提及构建了跨多个MCP服务器的多工具任务数据集，并据此通过提示优化、监督微调和GRPO强化学习对SLM进行了优化与特化。

Conclusion: SLM可作为低延迟、可按需本地部署的逐次工具调用相关性验证器，弥补传统授权机制在评估代理认知意图层面的不足，从而对每次工具调用实施更贴合任务意图的监督。

Abstract: Tool-equipped AI agents use tool calls to access data and act on external systems. Horizontal growth of agentic systems increases the number of these interactions, and further motivates the need for automated, per-call oversight that can operate at low latency and/or on-prem. Conventional authorization schemes can determine whether an agent is allowed to invoke a tool, but cannot assess the agent's underlying cognition, specifically, whether the tool selection represents a logical, relevant step toward satisfying the intent of the task or not. Consequently, an allowed call may still deviate from the task's intent: a rogue agent might deviate the calls or nudge other agents to make a combination of calls that would not align with the intent of the task. Therefore, every call needs to be verified. In this study we investigate the applicability of Small Language Models (SLMs) to this purpose: an SLM functions as a task-tool relevance classifier that evaluates every selected tool independently against the assigned task and returns a relevance signal for downstream enforcement. Equipped with a novel dataset with multi-tool tasks whose required tools span distinct Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, we used prompt-optimization, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning through GRPO to optimize and specialize SLMs.

</details>


### [465] [Learning a Fact Is Not Learning How to Retrieve It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03251)
*Chaemin Jang,Jihee Kim,Dongman Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究事实记忆中的"检索"与"学习"分离问题：通过两阶段训练发现，模型可以在学习事实之前先学会某种请求形式的检索方式，且检索效果取决于答案前的上下文状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一事实以不同请求形式（如"The capital of X is"与"The capital of X:"）提问时，模型表现差异显著。作者希望厘清"学习事实"与"检索事实"这两个过程的区别，探究早期请求形式经验如何影响后续事实检索。

Method: 采用两阶段训练。第一阶段（请求形式训练）：一个模型以五种形式接触每个事实，另一个模型仅以陈述形式接触相同事实。第二阶段（目标事实训练）：两模型以完全相同的方式（均为陈述形式）学习新事实。随后比较两者的检索表现，并分析答案前一刻的隐状态（上下文状态），通过改变该状态检验其对检索的因果作用。

Result: 两个模型从陈述形式检索新事实的表现几乎一样好，但在其他请求形式上差异显著。五种形式训练的模型对同一事实的不同请求形式产生更相似的上下文状态。在检索时改变上下文状态能够启用或阻止已学事实的检索，且该效应可跨事实与事实关系（如首都、货币）迁移。仅在目标事实训练阶段改变上下文状态，即可改变后续检索，而无需在测试时干预。

Conclusion: 后续检索能力依赖于早期的请求形式经验以及事实学习过程中的上下文状态，表明检索机制可以独立于事实内容被预先习得，且上下文状态是连接学习与检索的关键中介。

Abstract: A model trained on "The capital of X is Y" may produce "Y" after "The capital of X is" but fail after "The capital of X:". We call these different ways of eliciting the same fact request forms. To separate learning a fact from retrieving it, we train two models in two stages. In the first stage (request-form training), one model sees each fact in five forms and the other sees the same facts only as statements. In the second stage (target-fact training), both receive identical training on new facts, all as statements. Both then retrieve the new facts almost equally well from statements, but differ sharply on other request forms. Thus, a model can learn how to retrieve through a request form before it learns the facts. To understand this difference, we examine the hidden state immediately before the answer, which we call the context state. When given two different request forms for the same fact, the model trained on five forms in stage one produces more similar context states than the model trained on statements alone in that stage. Changing this state at retrieval time can enable or prevent retrieval of an already learned fact, and the same effect transfers across facts and factual relations, such as capitals and currencies. To test its role during learning, we change the context state only during target-fact training. This intervention changes later retrieval without intervention at test time. Together, these results show that later retrieval depends on earlier request-form experience and the context state during fact learning.

</details>


### [466] [EVOL: Simulator-Guided Evolutionary Expert Synthesis for Deployment-Free Learning Path Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03273)
*Geonwoo Bang,Dongho Kim,Moohong Min*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EVOL框架，借助知识追踪模拟器通过进化搜索合成专家演示，并训练免部署（前馈）策略，以不对称actor-critic缓解学习路径推荐中组合爆炸与稀疏奖励问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习路径推荐（LPR）用强化学习面临两个耦合障碍：一是策略需一次性提交L个概念的序列且无中间反馈，搜索空间随L超指数增长、只有终局奖励；二是稀疏奖励本可由专家路径缓解，但教育数据中不存在专家路径，因为学生日志记录的是学习者实际做了什么而非应该做什么。

Method: 借鉴机器人基于模拟器的演示学习范式：用知识追踪模拟器（a）通过进化搜索为每个学习者合成专家演示；（b）训练免部署策略，将演示蒸馏为前馈学习者。EVOL以不对称actor-critic实现：actor进行符合部署现实的"盲规划"（无中间反馈），critic在训练时利用特权模拟器状态。并比较BC、AWR、DAPG三种模仿策略。

Result: 在ASSIST15、Junyi、EdNet三个数据集（39–189个概念）及路径长度L=5、10、20上，EVOL超越涵盖启发式、序列式、RL、图增强RL与LLM增强方法的8个基线。三种模仿策略中，最终性能主要取决于进化专家质量而非具体模仿目标。

Conclusion: EVOL通过引入模拟器生成专家演示并蒸馏为前馈策略，同时缓解组合搜索与稀疏奖励难题，验证了"进化专家质量决定上限"的结论，为LPR提供可部署方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for learning path recommendation (LPR) faces two coupled obstacles. First, the policy must commit to a sequence of L concepts without intermediate feedback, producing a combinatorial search space that grows super-exponentially with L and provides reward only at the final step. Second, expert learning paths would be the natural cure for sparse-reward RL, but they do not exist in educational data, because student logs record what learners did, not what they should have done. We address both obstacles by importing a recipe from simulator-based demonstration learning in robotics: the knowledge tracing simulator is used both to synthesize per-learner expert demonstrations through evolutionary search and to train a deployment-free policy that distills these demonstrations into a feed-forward learner. Our framework, EVOL, instantiates this pipeline with an asymmetric actor-critic where the actor commits to deployment-realistic blind planning while the critic exploits the privileged simulator state during training. Across three datasets (ASSIST15, Junyi, and EdNet; 39-189 concepts) and path lengths L = 5, 10, and 20, EVOL surpasses 8 baselines spanning heuristic, sequential, RL, graph-enhanced RL, and LLM-enhanced methods. We further compare three imitation strategies (BC, AWR, and DAPG) and show that final performance is governed by the quality of evolutionary experts rather than by the particular imitation objective.

</details>


### [467] [Optimal Planning in a Dynamic World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03312)
*Devin Wild Thomas,Solomon Eyal Shimony,Wheeler Ruml,Erez Karpas,Shahaf S. Shperberg,Andrew Coles*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"任意起始时间规划"（any-start-time planning）问题，用复合到达时间函数（cATF）紧凑编码以起始时间为自变量的最优计划，并给出基于启发式图搜索的通用算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当可行状态或动作随时间变化（如移动障碍物下的路径规划、登车动作仅在列车停靠时可行）时，最优计划及其时长依赖执行起始时间。而实践中起始时间往往在规划完成后甚至由其他智能体决定，大多数已有工作却忽略动态性或假设起始时间已知，导致不实用。

Method: 放松"起始时间已知"假设，定义任意起始时间规划设定；提出复合到达时间函数（cATF）数据结构，将最优计划编码为起始时间的函数；给出基于启发式图搜索的通用规划算法，在边上传播函数而非标量代价来组装cATF。

Result: 证明cATF规模至多与问题规模呈线性关系；针对SIPP问题的实现实验表明，在困难问题上依赖重规划的智能体常失败，而使用cATF的任意起始时间算法可在起始时间已知后快速查表得到最优计划。

Conclusion: 通过支持时间相关计划的高效表示与推理，为动态世界中的规划奠定基础。

Abstract: Background: We address the problem of planning when the set of feasible states or actions changes over time. For example, in the problem of path planning among moving obstacles (sometimes known as SIPP), the feasibility of being at a particular location can change as the obstacles move. Or, the action of boarding a particular train is feasible only while it is stopped at the station. This dynamism means that the optimal plan and its duration can change depending on when execution begins. In practice, execution start time is often unknown until planning has completed or another agent gives the go-ahead. However, most prior planning work either ignores dynamism or assumes a known start time. This makes it straightforward to assess state and action feasibility but is impractical for some applications. Objectives: In this paper, we relax the assumption of a known start time. We define the setting of {\em any-start-time planning} and provide algorithms for it. Methods: We present a data structure called a compound arrival time function (cATF) that compactly encodes the optimal plan as a function of start time. We provide general-purpose planning algorithms, based on heuristic graph search, that assemble cATFs by propagating functions along edges instead of scalar costs. Results: We prove that the size of a cATF is at most linear in the problem size. An experimental evaluation of an implementation for the specific problem of SIPP shows that, on difficult problems, agents that rely on replanning often fail, while any-start-time algorithms using cATFs can quickly look up the optimal plan once the execution start time is known. Conclusions: By enabling efficient representations and reasoning for time-dependent plans, this work provides a foundation for planning in dynamic worlds.

</details>


### [468] [Lightweight, Rubric-Guided Trajectory Evaluation for Production AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03315)
*Linh-An Phan,MingXue Wang,Guangyu Wu,Feng Pan,Zhaoyu Pang,Yanbin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LiteTrajEval，一种预算受限的轻量级轨迹评测架构：离线构建领域规则画像，在线对轨迹做预处理、启发式失败信号标记，并在固定全局预算下序列化，交由单次rubric引导的LLM评判器生成结构化诊断报告。在Magentic-One风格与τ-bench风格数据集上，失败定位与人工标注的一致率显著提升（Magentic-One约20–35个百分点，τ-retail最高23个百分点），成本降低约6倍、评测耗时减少8倍以上，并已部署于企业级智能体平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹评测对提升LLM智能体可靠性至关重要，但生产环境中反复评测成本高昂；同时现代智能体产生包含工具调用、观察、重试与外部输出的长轨迹，原始token并非都对诊断有用，因此需要一种在预算约束下高效、精准定位失败的评测方案。

Method: LiteTrajEval采用离线-在线两阶段架构：离线阶段导出紧凑的领域特定规则画像；在线阶段对每条轨迹进行预处理，标记启发式失败信号，在固定全局预算下序列化轨迹，随后调用单次rubric引导的LLM评判器输出结构化诊断报告。

Result: 在公开的Magentic-One风格与τ-bench风格轨迹数据集上，相比AgentRx，LiteTrajEval将失败定位与人工标注的一致性在Magentic-One上提升约20–35个百分点，在τ-retail上最高提升23个百分点；同时成本降低约6倍，评测时间减少8倍以上。该方案已在企业智能体平台中落地部署。

Conclusion: LiteTrajEval通过离线规则画像与在线预算化序列化、启发式信号标记及单次rubric引导评判，在显著降低评测成本与时间的同时提升了失败定位精度，兼具学术有效性与生产可用性。

Abstract: Trajectory evaluation is essential for improving the reliability of LLM-based agents, but production use makes it expensive to run repeatedly. Modern agents generate long traces containing tool calls, observations, retries, and external outputs, while not all raw tokens are equally useful for diagnosis. We present \textit{LiteTrajEval}, a lightweight architecture for budget-bounded trajectory evaluation. LiteTrajEval derives compact domain-specific rule profiles offline, then preprocesses each trajectory online, marks heuristic failure signals, serializes it under a fixed global budget, and invokes a single rubric-guided LLM judge to produce structured diagnostic reports. Evaluated on public Magentic-One-style and $τ$-bench-style trajectory datasets, LiteTrajEval improves failure-localization alignment with human annotations by roughly 20--35 percentage points on Magentic-One and up to 23 percentage points on $τ$-retail compared with AgentRx, while reducing cost by about 6$\times$ and evaluation time by more than 8$\times$. This solution has also been deployed in our enterprise agentic platform.

</details>


### [469] [Multi-Task Evolution for Zero-Shot Cross-Problem Generalization using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03316)
*Zhouliang Xie,Changliang Zhou,Genghui Li,Zhenkun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MECo：一种LLM驱动的多任务进化框架，通过跨任务种群性能的迁移差距引导启发式迁移与重组，并用覆盖度奖励构造紧凑启发式集，实现零样本跨问题泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 启发式设计依赖专家经验与反复搜索；LLM虽可自动化生成与改进启发式，但通常依赖目标任务（被优化问题）的评估反馈，难以仅凭源任务反馈泛化到新问题定义，故需解决零样本跨问题泛化难题。

Method: MECo维护任务条件下的启发式种群；以跨任务种群性能定义的“迁移差距”引导种群交互，实现启发式的迁移与重组；采用互补选择准则，按每个成员对源组合的额外覆盖度进行奖励，构造紧凑启发式集；该集合直接应用于目标任务，无需进一步搜索或适配。

Result: 在车辆路径（VRP）与柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）共32个问题变体上，相同预算下MECo的平均成本低于8种自动启发式设计（AHD）基线；在域外（OOD）问题上优于各问题族最强基线；将MECo框架与不同AHD方法结合，可同时提升其在两族问题上的ID与OOD性能。

Conclusion: MECo能在无目标问题反馈的情况下实现有效的零样本跨问题启发式泛化，并可作为通用框架增强多种AHD方法，支撑跨方法有效性。

Abstract: Designing effective heuristics for diverse combinatorial optimization problems requires substantial expertise and repeated search. Large language models (LLMs) automate heuristic generation and refinement, but heuristic search typically depends on evaluation feedback from the problem being optimized. Generalizing to new problem definitions using only source-task feedback therefore remains a central challenge. We introduce MECo, an LLM-driven multi-task evolutionary framework for zero-shot cross-problem generalization. MECo maintains task-conditioned heuristic populations and uses a transfer gap based on cross-task population performance to guide their interactions. These interactions enable the transfer and recombination of heuristics. A complementary selection criterion then constructs a compact heuristic set by rewarding each member's additional coverage of source combinations. The selected set is applied to target problems without further search or adaptation. Experiments on 32 problem variants across vehicle routing (VRP) and flexible job-shop scheduling (FJSP) show that MECo achieves the lowest mean costs compared with eight automated heuristic design (AHD) baselines under the same budgets. On out-of-domain problems, it outperforms the strongest baseline in each family. Moreover, integrating the framework of MECo with different AHD methods improves their ID and OOD performance in both families, supporting its effectiveness across different methods.

</details>


### [470] [Refinement Buys Intelligibility, Search Buys Identity: What Test-Time Compute Buys in Masked-Diffusion TTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03320)
*Nityanand Mathur,Hamees Sayed,Ayush Pratap Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 扩散式TTS中,推理细化步数对可懂度的收敛效率约为对说话人身份的1.86倍;深度与步数不可互相替换,应分别优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/掩码扩散式TTS同时消耗两类计算:模型深度(参数量)与细化步数(推理预算)。作者质疑二者是否对不同能力(可懂度 vs 说话人身份)具有等效的扩展收益,即"深度与步数是否可互换"这一根本问题。

Method: 训练15个掩码扩散codec-TTS模型(19–133M参数,3个随机种子),数据为2000小时语音;推理时扫描细化步数T∈[1,16]。在174名留出说话人上做零样本评测:ASR词错误率(可懂度)与说话人验证(身份)。以实测下限为基准计算range closure,并用分离式B(d)B(T)与替代式模型做拟合比较(AICc)。额外做最优-of-K搜索、以及对3x/6x训练调度的重训实验。
