Result: 细化步数弥补了86.2%的可懂度差距,但仅弥补46.4%的身份差距,不对称性达1.86倍,且在多误差指标下稳健。3x/6x调度重训将差距由1.84缩小至1.36、1.23倍但未反转,因可懂度随步数饱和而身份持续提升。Best-of-K在四个独立编码器上取得64.6–79.0%胜率,能恢复细化所不能提升的说话人身份。分离式B(d)B(T)拟合显著优于替代式(ΔAICc=+69.3)。剩余身份差距中62%归于codec而非生成器。

Conclusion: 细化与深度针对不同瓶颈:可懂度主要受深度限制、随步数快速饱和,身份则随步数持续获益但部分受限(62%)于codec。二者不可替代,应按能力分别优化推理预算与模型规模。

Abstract: Diffusion language models for text-to-speech combine two forms of computation: model depth (parameters) and refinement steps (inference budget). We ask whether they scale equally across capabilities. We train 15 masked-diffusion codec TTS models varying depth (19-133M parameters, 3 seeds) on 2,000 hours of speech and sweep refinement steps T in [1,16] at inference, measuring zero-shot synthesis via ASR word error rate (intelligibility) and speaker verification (identity) on 174 held-out speakers. Against measured floors, refinement closes 86.2% of the intelligibility range but only 46.4% of the identity range - a 1.86x asymmetry robust across multiple error metrics. Retraining at 3x and 6x schedule attenuates but does not reverse this gap (1.84 to 1.36 to 1.23x), because intelligibility saturates with steps while identity continues improving. Best-of-K search recovers speaker identity where refinement fails, with 64.6-79.0% win rates across four independent encoders. Depth and steps are not interchangeable: separable B(d)B(T) fits significantly better (Delta AICc=+69.3) than substitution models. Analysis shows 62% of remaining identity deficit lies in the codec, not the generator. We conclude that refinement and depth target different bottlenecks and should be optimized separately.

</details>


### [471] [Preserving Mathematical Reasoning in Compressed Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory-Aware Low-Rank Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03326)
*Tian Liang,Zishan Shao,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型（dLLM）压缩中"校准态与推理态不匹配"的问题，提出轨迹感知的低秩目标与 Traj-MC 估计方法，在同等压缩预算下显著提升重构质量并更好保留数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM 压缩面临一个已知矛盾：低秩压缩的校准通常在干净、完全可见的激活上进行，而推理过程却要经过部分掩码的中间状态。这引出两个问题：（1）当近似质量是在轨迹分布的多个状态上度量时，低秩最优性是否仍可刻画；（2）校准状态的选择是否会影响压缩后数学推理能力的保留。简言之，作者希望把低秩最优性从"单点干净激活"推广到"推理轨迹状态分布"上。

Method: 作者将低秩压缩目标形式化为跨越不同"损坏程度（corruption levels）"与"掩码实现（masking realizations）"的轨迹感知低秩目标，使最优性在轨迹分布状态下定义；为高效估计该目标，提出 Traj-MC，通过蒙特卡洛采样估计轨迹二阶矩，并给出采样状态下的精确最优性与总体一致性（population consistency）保证。

Result: 在匹配压缩预算下，与基于干净激活的校准相比，轨迹感知校准在生成轨迹上的重构误差更低；在数学推理基准上，压缩后保留的数学推理能力显著更多。

Conclusion: 研究将轨迹感知的低秩最优性与 dLLM 压缩后所保留的推理能力联系起来，表明校准状态的选择（干净态 vs. 轨迹分布态）对压缩后推理性能有实质影响，为面向推理的 dLLM 压缩提供了新的目标与估计工具。

Abstract: Diffusion language model (dLLM) compression faces a known challenge because calibration is typically performed on clean, fully visible activations, whereas inference traverses partially masked intermediate states. For low-rank compression, this raises two questions. First, can low-rank optimality still be characterized when approximation quality is measured over trajectory-distributed states, and second, does the choice of calibration states affect mathematical reasoning preservation under compression? We address these questions by formulating a trajectory-aware low-rank objective over corruption levels and masking realizations. To estimate this objective efficiently, we propose Traj-MC, which estimates the trajectory second moment through Monte Carlo sampling and yields exact sampled-state optimality and population consistency. Under matched compression budgets, trajectory-aware calibration improves reconstruction over the generation trajectory and preserves substantially more mathematical reasoning than clean calibration on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our results connect trajectory-aware low-rank optimality to the reasoning capability retained after dLLM compression. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Zishan-Shao/traj-mc.git.

</details>


### [472] [ReFract: Benchmarking Perspective Awareness in Language Model Agents with Text World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03356)
*Hainiu Xu,Vítor N. Lourenço,Mohnish Dubey,Yunfei Bai,Yulan He,Caroline Catmur,Aline Paes,Marco Caserta,Akash Chandrayan,Luca D'Angelo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ReFract基准，用于评估LLM智能体的"视角感知"能力——即依据用户角色调整行动与信息，包含150条专家验证样本，基于真实支持对话构建文本世界模型与动作轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体被部署于工业维护、设备故障排查等高风险场景，用户角色多样。智能体需按角色校准行为，遵守其知识与能力边界。此类场景中动作作用于物理设备，错误不可逆（设备损坏、生产损失、人员伤害）。然而现有基准忽视智能体推断角色意图、仅使用该角色被授权工具的需求，即"视角感知"能力。

Method: 构建ReFract基准：150条专家验证条目，智能体须对同一查询依用户角色做出不同响应。条目源自匿名化的领域支持对话，据此构建文本世界模型（Text World Models）以模拟智能体运行环境，并组装视角感知的动作轨迹。

Result: 当前最优LLM最多解决69%的任务，且超过50%的轨迹包含违反视角（越权）的动作尝试。

Conclusion: ReFract揭示了视角感知是智能体评估中一个独立且基本未解决的维度，推动研究不仅校准"如何行动"，还要校准"为谁行动"的智能体。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as industrial maintenance and equipment fault troubleshooting, where workers occupy a variety of roles. A capable agent must therefore act in a way that is calibrated to user's role: taking actions and providing information that respect the role's knowledge and capability boundaries. Unlike coding, where mistakes are usually recoverable, agent responses in these settings are enacted on physical equipment, and can therefore cause irreversible equipment damage, production loss, or personnel harm. Existing benchmarks, however, largely overlook the need for agents to infer what a role intends and acting only through tools that role may legitimately use, a capability which we term Perspective Awareness. To this end, we introduce ReFract, a benchmark of 150 expert-validated entries in which an agent must act differently in response to the same query depending on user's role. Entries of ReFract are grounded in anonymized queries from domain support conversations, against which we construct Text World Models that simulate the agent's operating environments and assemble perspective-aware action trajectories. State-of-the-art LLMs solve at most 69% of the tasks with more than 50% of their trajectories contain attempts of taking perspective-violating actions. ReFract exposes perspective awareness as a distinct, largely unsolved axis of agent evaluation and motivates agents that calibrate not just how to act, but for whom.

</details>


### [473] [Geometry Meets Physics: Data-Efficient Pre-Training for Unstructured Neural PDE Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03363)
*Luis Medrano-Navarro,Giacomo Baldan,Qiang Liu,Benjamin Holzschuh,Jan Hagnberger,Mathias Niepert,Nils Thuerey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种无需磁盘数据的预训练框架，分别针对稳态和瞬态PDE问题，通过几何驱动与物理驱动策略提升神经代理模型的泛化性与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非结构化3D几何上的PDE神经代理模型泛化性差，且大规模训练数据生成成本高；现有在相关PDE动态数据上预训练的策略既耗费算力又耗费数据，因为依赖大量预计算数据。

Method: 面向稳态问题，提出几何驱动策略，利用内在形状描述子学习复杂3D域的表示；面向瞬态问题，提出基于在线生成合成PDE数据的物理驱动方法，实现无需昂贵数据集的规模化预训练。

Result: 多项实验表明，该方法在微调阶段实现更快收敛、更高数据效率和更高精度，尤其在真实的低数据场景下表现突出。

Conclusion: 该方法为面向大规模仿真的数据高效神经仿真器提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Neural surrogate models for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) on unstructured 3D geometries are often limited by poor generalization and the high cost of generating large-scale training datasets. Consequently, pre-training on massive datasets of related PDE dynamics has emerged as a critical alternative to enhance the robustness and scalability of these models. However, this strategy is neither compute- nor data-efficient, as it relies on massive pre-computed data that is very costly to generate. In this work, we introduce a disk-data-free pre-training framework tailored to both steady-state and transient regimes. For steady-state problems, we propose a geometry-driven strategy that leverages intrinsic shape descriptors to learn representations of complex 3D domains. For transient problems, we introduce a physics-driven approach based on online generation of synthetic PDE data, enabling scalable pre-training without reliance on expensive datasets. Across multiple experiments, our approach achieves faster convergence, greater data efficiency, and higher accuracy during fine-tuning, particularly under realistic low-data regimes. This methodology provides a practical pathway toward data-efficient neural emulators for large-scale simulations.

</details>


### [474] [CVE2AP: Automated Generation of PDDL-Encoded Attack Paths via Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03383)
*Lin Cui,Vincenzo Scotti,Raffaela Mirandola*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出CVE2AP，一种基于大语言模型的自动化方法，将自然语言CVE描述自动转换为PDDL编码的攻击路径，并通过结构化提示与错误反馈迭代机制提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 攻击路径（AP）建模是网络安全分析的基础，PDDL被广泛用于将AP编码为形式化、可机器验证的表示，以支持漏洞利用、攻击进展及其影响的形式推理。但现有AP建模方法主要依赖专家手工构建，难以扩展，也无法跟上快速演变的网络威胁。LLM具备丰富预训练知识和推理能力，有望将威胁情报自动转化为形式化表示。

Method: CVE2AP基于LLM，从自然语言CVE（通用漏洞披露）描述自动生成PDDL编码的攻击路径。方法采用结构化提示（structured prompting），并引入错误反馈机制，利用规划器报告的语法错误和可求解性错误迭代地修正生成路径。作者在多个LLM和多种生成配置上进行系统性实证评估，从语法、可求解性和语义三个维度衡量生成质量，并统计token消耗与生成时间。

Result: 实验表明CVE2AP能有效生成高质量的PDDL编码攻击路径，在LLM-as-expert评估下最高达到86.9%语法正确率、78.6%可求解率和93.1%语义正确率。其中GPT-5.5在质量-成本权衡上表现最佳，而错误反馈机制带来最稳定的质量提升。

Conclusion: CVE2AP验证了利用LLM自动将CVE描述转化为PDDL攻击路径的可行性，结构化提示与规划器错误反馈的结合能显著提升生成质量，为可扩展、自动化的攻击路径建模提供了新思路。

Abstract: Attack Path (AP) modeling is fundamental to cybersecurity analysis, where the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) has been widely adopted to encode APs into formal and machine-verifiable representations for automated reasoning about vulnerability exploitation, attack progression, and their potential impacts. However, existing AP modeling approaches largely rely on expert-driven manual construction, limiting their scalability and ability to keep pace with rapidly evolving cyber threats. Large language models (LLMs) are promising candidates, as their extensive pre-trained knowledge and reasoning capabilities enable them to interpret and transform threat intelligence into formal representations. In this paper, we propose \textbf{CVE2AP}, an LLM-based approach for automatically generating PDDL-encoded attack paths from natural language CVE (Common Vulnerability Exposure) descriptions. CVE2AP leverages structured prompting and incorporates an error-feedback mechanism that iteratively refines the generated paths using planner-reported syntactic and solvability errors. We conduct a systematic empirical evaluation across multiple LLMs and generation configurations, assessing generation quality across syntactic, solvability and semantic dimensions, together with token consumption and generation time. The results demonstrate that CVE2AP effectively generates high-quality PDDL-encoded attack paths, achieving up to 86.9\% syntax correctness, 78.6\% solvability, and 93.1\% semantic correctness under LLM-as-expert evaluation, while \texttt{GPT-5.5} offers the best quality-cost trade-off and error feedback yields the most consistent quality improvement.

</details>


### [475] [Becoming Suspicious Across Borders: Algorithmic Extraterritoriality and AI-Driven Financial Surveillance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03425)
*Georgios Pavlidis,Savvas Chatzichristofis,Eleni Gavriil*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"算法域外性"概念，指出AI驱动的金融监控使可疑性从人工法律判断转变为数据驱动过程，导致可疑性的认识论与空间双重转型，并削弱了问责与可争议性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在反洗钱与反恐融资（AML/CFT）中，"可疑性"是允许在未达证明标准时进行干预的关键概念。传统上它被理解为可识别司法管辖区内人类行动者所作的情境化法律判断。但随着AI成为金融监控的组成部分，这一理解已不再充分，亟需重新界定可疑性的生成机制与监管权力运作方式。

Method: 概念性/理论分析。作者批判并重构"可疑性"的传统法律理解，考察AI驱动金融监控依托跨国数据基础设施运作的特征，进而提出"算法域外性"概念，即以数据基础设施为中介、而非以形式化管辖权主张为基础的一种监管权力形式。

Result: 可疑性的生产正从人类情境化判断转向数据驱动的过程，这一转变既是认识论的，也是空间性的。由于监控通过跨国数据基础设施运作，监管触达能力更多取决于行为能否在数据系统中被"可见"，而非行为发生地。同时，个体日益被建构为被数据化的可疑主体，通过分散、不透明的评估过程被治理。

Conclusion: AI介入下的金融监控使可疑性更难被定位、解释与质疑，对问责性与可争议性构成挑战。学界与监管方需要以"算法域外性"为分析框架，重新思考AML/CFT中可疑性、管辖权与责任归属的关系。

Abstract: Suspicion is an important, yet elusive concept in anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CFT), which allows for intervention below the threshold of proof. In its traditional form, suspicion can be understood as a situated legal judgement by human actors within identifiable jurisdictions. It is argued that this understanding is no longer adequate. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes an integral part of financial surveillance, suspicion is increasingly produced through data-driven processes. This transformation is epistemic, but also spatial. Since AI-driven financial surveillance operates through transnational data infrastructures, regulatory reach is less a matter of where conduct occurs than a question of whether such conduct becomes visible within data systems. This article develops the concept of algorithmic extraterritoriality, understood as a form of regulatory power mediated by data infrastructures rather than formal assertions of jurisdiction. Moreover, since individuals are increasingly constituted as datafied subjects of suspicion, they are rendered governable through dispersed and opaque processes of evaluation. This constitutes a challenge for accountability and contestability because suspicion becomes more difficult to locate, explain or contest.

</details>


### [476] [Jumping the Line: Exploiting Length Predictions in LLM Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03430)
*Yuyang Dai,Rana Shahout,Mahmood Sharif*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 JIL，一种针对基于长度预测的 LLM 调度器的对抗攻击，通过优化对抗后缀使输出长度探针低估请求长度，从而抢占调度优先级、缩短完成时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型服务中请求调度对降低完成时间至关重要；基于长度的策略（如 SJF）需依赖预测的输出长度，而真实长度在生成前未知。这种对预测信号的依赖带来潜在安全脆弱性，但此前缺乏针对性研究。

Method: 以 TRAIL 为案例，JIL 优化一个对抗后缀，使轻量级输出长度探针低估请求长度，从而在调度器中获得更高优先级。在 2 个数据集、4 个 LLM 上，覆盖多种请求画像与部署配置进行评估。

Result: 预测输出长度最多降低 83.4%；端到端服务实验中对抗请求平均完成速度最高提升 1.53 倍。预测长度的降幅显著大于实际输出长度变化，表明调度器估计与真实规模存在错配。响应效用因模型和任务而异，体现调度优势与回答质量之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 预测长度与真实长度的错配可被利用以获取调度优势，构成对 LLM 服务的实际威胁。调度器侧防御方面，将长度预测分组为粗粒度区间可削弱 JIL 的调度优势并缓解对良性请求的延迟。

Abstract: Efficient request scheduling is increasingly important for reducing completion time in large language model (LLM) serving. Size-based policies such as Shortest Job First prioritize shorter requests, but output lengths are unknown before generation, so practical schedulers rely on predicted lengths. We introduce JIL, an attack on prediction-based LLM schedulers that manipulates the scheduling signal to obtain higher priority and reduce completion time. Using TRAIL as a case study, JIL optimizes an adversarial suffix that causes a lightweight output-length probe to underestimate a request's length. We evaluate JIL on two datasets and four LLMs across varied request profiles and deployment configurations. JIL reduces predicted output lengths by up to 83.4 percent, and adversarial requests complete up to 1.53 times faster on average in end-to-end serving experiments. The reduction in predicted length is substantially larger than the change in actual output length, revealing a mismatch between the scheduler's estimate and the request's realized size. Response utility varies across models and tasks, exposing a trade-off between scheduling advantage and response quality. We also evaluate scheduler-side defenses and find that grouping length predictions into coarse intervals reduces JIL's scheduling advantage and mitigates delays to benign requests.

</details>


### [477] [Efficient Reasoning Training Does Not Always Harm CoT Faithfulness and Monitorability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03509)
*Samuel Lewis-Lim,Xingwei Tan,Mario Sanger,Zhixue Zhao,Nikolaos Aletras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究高效推理训练对思维链（CoT）忠实性与可监控性的影响，发现长度压力会降低忠实性（主要因模型一致性下降），但对可监控性影响较小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT推理虽提升了可解释性，却增加了推理开销，因此需要训练模型用更少token完成任务。但人们担心这种训练会使模型跳过关键推理步骤，导致CoT不再忠实反映决策。目前不同效率方法对CoT施加长度压力的方式各异，且不同任务忠实解释所需token量不同，因此这一现象是否及何时发生尚不明确。

Method: 微调多种模型，采用三种施加长度压力的方式：固定生成预算、逐样本长度目标、组相对长度奖励；并评估其对CoT忠实性（CoT是否反映相关输入下的模型决策）与可监控性（CoT能否揭示输入干预改变输出）的影响。

Result: 高效推理对忠实性和可监控性的影响不同。忠实性在多数设定下下降，主要原因是训练后模型一致性降低；可监控性更稳健，即使CoT大幅缩短，模型仍会表明其对答案的影响。

Conclusion: 长度压力训练对CoT忠实性与可监控性产生差异化影响：忠实性更易受损，可监控性相对稳健。这提示在设计高效推理方法时需权衡解释质量与推理成本。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows humans to inspect how large language models reach their answers, and oversee model behaviour. This reasoning comes at an increased inference cost, motivating efficient methods that train models to solve tasks using fewer tokens. However, a common concern is that such training may cause models to skip important reasoning steps, so the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the model's decision. It is unclear whether or when this occurs in practice, since different efficiency methods apply length pressure to models' CoT in distinct ways, and faithfully explaining a model's decision takes more tokens on some tasks than others. To understand these dynamics, we fine-tune a variety of models with three methods that apply length pressure differently, namely a fixed generation budget, a per-example length target, and a group-relative length reward. We evaluate how efficient reasoning affects CoT faithfulness (i.e., how well the CoT reflects model decisions on related inputs) and monitorability (i.e., whether the CoT reveals when input interventions alter the output). We find that it affects faithfulness and monitorability differently. Faithfulness falls in most settings, primarily because the trained models are less consistent. Monitorability is more robust, as models keep acknowledging the influence on their answer even when the CoT is much shorter.

</details>


### [478] [Reasoning Models Are Accurate but Unsound on Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03519)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CERTID 形式化识别流水线，用可靠完备的 ID 算法认证因果效应的可识别性，并对返回公式进行 SCM 验证，从而评测推理模型在因果识别中的"假声明"失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型回答"因果效应能否从观测数据恢复"时有两种失败：拒绝可识别查询，或回答不可识别查询。后者更严重，因为没有任何观测数据能验证所声称的公式。但此前评测缺乏可证明不可识别的查询，且字符串匹配无法接受等价形式的正确公式。

Method: 构建 CERTID 形式化识别流水线：使用可靠且完备的因果识别算法 ID，在给定图和查询下认证效应是否可识别；并用干预分布已知精确的结构因果模型（SCM）验证返回公式。此外给出理论结果以缓解结构泄漏、修复不可识别查询并建立评分保证。

Result: 在 4 至 50 个顶点的 1,200 个认证实例上评测三个前沿推理模型（Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro、GPT5.5）。准确率并不能代表可靠性：在相同实例上，不可识别查询的假声明率跨模型相差十七倍。模型在最强模型训练快照之后生成的图上判断可识别性仍达 97–100% 准确率。

Conclusion: 准确率是可靠性的劣质代理指标，必须用可证明不可识别的查询和等价形式容忍的评分来独立评估模型的因果识别可靠性；CERTID 提供了这一认证与验证基础设施。

Abstract: A reasoning model asked whether a causal effect is recoverable from observational data can fail in two ways: it refuses an identifiable query or answers a nonidentifiable one. The latter is more consequential, as no observational data can validate the claimed formula. Measuring this failure requires queries that are provably non-identifiable, which prior evaluations lack, and grading that accepts correct formulas in any equivalent form, which string matching cannot provide. We build CERTID, a formal identification pipeline that addresses both limitations. CERTID uses the sound and complete causal identification algorithm ID to certify whether an effect is identifiable from a given graph and query, and verifies returned formulas against structural causal models whose interventional distributions are known exactly. CERTID further develops theoretical results to mitigate structural leakage, repair non-identifiable queries, and establish grading guarantees. We evaluate three frontier reasoning models (Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and GPT5.5) on 1,200 certified instances spanning 4 to 50 vertices. Accuracy proves a poor proxy for soundness: on identical instances, the false-claim rate on non-identifiable queries varies by seventeen-fold across models. We also find that models decide identifiability with 97-100% accuracy on graphs generated after the strongest model's training snapshot. Instances, the certification procedure, the verifier, and per-instance records are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/certid-D718.

</details>


### [479] [Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Frontier Reasoning Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03548)
*Wenlong Zhang,Zhengbo Jiao,Chenxu Zhang,Lekang Jiang,SiYuan Ma,Qituan Zhang,Guo Chen,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"任务-脚手架协同演化"框架，在推理数据合成中实现递归脚手架自我改进，通过在线与任务后两种自我改进日程持续提升任务难度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成逐步加难的推理问题需要随任务分布演化而自适应调整的合成程序，但现有任务级递归只是把生成的问题当作新种子复用，构建脚手架本身保持不变，限制了难度提升的上限。

Method: 任务-脚手架协同演化框架：在线自我改进将求解器中间失败转化为可复用技能；任务后自我改进在每批次后修订技能、提示与工作流，仅当在成本增幅受限内生成更难的合法任务时才采纳候选。模型权重与验证标准保持固定。

Result: 在数学、编程、科学领域，十四个演化轮次后平均求解器准确率由100.0%降至54.8%；消融表明两种更新日程结合比固定脚手架递归或任一单独日程生成更难任务；合成数据提升下游SFT与GRPO表现，27B学生模型在10K数学样例微调后在APEX上取得62.5% mean-16准确率，与部分前沿模型参考相当。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在任务演化的同时自适应调整合成脚手架，能够生成难度递增且具下游训练价值的数据。

Abstract: Generating progressively harder reasoning problems requires synthesis procedures that adapt as the task distribution evolves. Existing task-level recursion reuses generated problems as seeds but leaves the construction harness unchanged. We present task-harness co-evolution, a framework for recursive harness self-improvement (RSI) in reasoning-data synthesis. Online self-improvement converts intermediate solver failures into reusable skills during generation. Post-task self-improvement revises skills, prompts, and workflows after each batch, adopting candidates only when they generate harder valid tasks within a bounded cost increase. Model weights and verification criteria remain fixed. Across mathematics, coding, and science, mean solver accuracy decreases from 100.0% to 54.8% over fourteen evolution rounds. Ablations show that combining both update schedules produces harder tasks than fixed-harness recursion or either schedule alone. The resulting data improves downstream SFT and GRPO performance. In particular, a 27B student fine-tuned on 10K synthesized mathematics examples achieves 62.5% mean-16 accuracy on APEX, competitive with selected frontier-model references. These results support adapting the synthesis harness alongside the tasks to generate increasingly challenging data with downstream training value.

</details>


### [480] [Knowledge or Calculator? Decomposing the Skill Premium in Verifiable Financial Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03564)
*Jermyn Zhen Yong Bek,Zhuang Qiang Bok,Zhongtian Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出FinSkillBench评测套件（2603个时点情景、12个子任务），通过17820次执行实验发现：人工策划的技能包显著提升金融AI智能体表现（+16.2分），而单情景内生成的技能仅提升+0.5分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融AI智能体不仅要检索事实，还需完成正确的定量计算、可靠使用流程性资源、并产出可审计的结构化结果。现有评测缺乏针对这些能力、带隐藏可再生成真值与确定性验证器的时点化基准，也缺乏对"技能"来源与类型贡献的量化分析。

Method: 构建FinSkillBench：覆盖组合构建、风险管理、基本面分析3大领域12个子任务，共2603个point-in-time情景，配备隐藏可再生真值与任务特定确定性验证器。在9个模型、3种资源条件下执行17820个情景，对其中8个模型做配对分析；进一步将策划技能溢价分解为人工撰写流程文档与可执行领域工具两种资源，并做10种评分变体、聚类bootstrap及独立第二实现harness的稳健性检验。

Result: 策划技能包使平均分从0.366提升至0.528（+16.2分），而单情景内生成的技能仅提升+0.5分，且消耗更多token与轮次。分解结果：仅文档+5.6分，仅工具+19.5分，二者组合呈次可加性。溢价高度依赖工作流：可执行工具在数值密集任务中占优，文档在流程或输出schema指导为瓶颈时更重要，解释性任务两者兼需。效应符号在10种评分变体与聚类bootstrap下稳定；独立第二harness复现方向性模式，但效应幅度取决于工具与数据的暴露方式。

Conclusion: 可测量的"技能溢价"是整个模型—资源—harness系统的属性，而非仅取决于底层模型本身；这意味着评测与部署应把资源形态与执行框架纳入统一考量。

Abstract: Financial AI agents must do more than retrieve facts: investment workflows require correct quantitative execution, reliable use of procedural resources, and auditable structured outputs. We introduce FinSkillBench, an evaluation suite of 2,603 point in time episodes across 12 subtasks in portfolio construction, risk management, and fundamental analysis, with hidden regenerable ground truth and task specific deterministic verifiers. Executing 17,820 episodes across 9 models and 3 resource conditions, the paired analysis across 8 models shows that curated skill packages raise mean scores by +16.2 points (0.366 to 0.528), whereas skills generated within a single episode add only +0.5 points while consuming more tokens and turns. We then decompose the curated premium by granting human authored procedural documents and executable domain tools separately: documents alone add +5.6 points, tools alone add +19.5 points, and their combination is subadditive. The premium is strongly workflow dependent: executable tools dominate numerically intensive workflows, documentation matters more when procedural or output schema guidance is the bottleneck, and interpretive tasks benefit from both. The effects are sign stable across 10 scoring variants and cluster bootstrap analyses, and an independently implemented second harness reproduces the directional pattern while showing that effect magnitudes depend on how tools and data are exposed. Overall, a measured "skill premium" is a property of the full model, resource, and harness system rather than of the underlying model alone.

</details>


### [481] [Learning to Assess Heartbeat Observability for mmWave Heart-Rate Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03570)
*Yuxuan Hu,Shilin Shan,Jianfei Yang,Feng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HEAR，一种双任务Transformer，从毫米波雷达相位谱中学习评估心跳可观测性并联合估计心率，仅用仿真数据训练即可零样本迁移到60/120 GHz真实数据集，支撑选择性预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非接触式毫米波雷达心率感知中，单次测量是否可靠难以判断：即使宏观观测几何相似，多散射体回波的相干叠加也可能抑制心跳分量，因此需要直接从采集测量中评估心跳可观测性，以实现选择性心率估计。

Method: 构建可控多散射体FMCW仿真器以覆盖不同可观测性条件；以心跳频带主峰与已知心率的吻合度自动生成可观测性标签；提出HEAR紧凑双任务Transformer，输入为频谱幅度及相对呼吸基频的频率（提供呼吸谐波上下文），联合预测可观测性分数与心率。

Result: 仅在仿真数据上训练的HEAR零样本迁移到两个公开真实数据集（60 GHz与120 GHz，共134名受试者）；学习到的分数同时支持HEAR心率头与多种已有估计器的选择性预测；在120 GHz数据集上，基于分数选择将心率头MAE从全覆盖率17.9 BPM降至50%覆盖率1.6 BPM；完整流程在边缘设备上端到端延迟50.8 ms。

Conclusion: 直接从测量中学习心跳可观测性可有效支撑选择性心率估计，仿真训练可零样本迁移至真实多频段数据，且模型轻量、可在边缘设备实时部署。

Abstract: Contactless heart-rate sensing with millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires assessing whether individual measurements support reliable estimation. We study learning to assess heartbeat observability, defined as the readability of the heartbeat component in an acquired phase spectrum, for selective heart-rate estimation. Coherent superposition of scatterer returns can suppress this component even under similar macroscopic observation geometry, motivating assessment directly from acquired measurements. To obtain training supervision across different observability conditions, we develop a controllable multi-scatterer frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) simulator. Agreement between the dominant heartbeat-band peak and the known heart rate provides an automatic observability label for each simulated measurement. We propose HEAR (Heartbeat Estimation with Assessed Reliability), a compact dual-task Transformer that jointly predicts an observability score and heart rate. Its input combines spectral magnitudes with frequencies relative to the respiration fundamental, providing context for respiratory harmonics. Trained solely on simulated observations, HEAR transfers zero-shot to two public real-world datasets collected at 60 and 120 GHz from 134 subjects. The same learned score supports selective prediction with both HEAR's own heart-rate head and multiple existing estimators. On the 120 GHz dataset, score-based selection reduces the HR head's mean absolute error from 17.9 BPM at full coverage to 1.6 BPM at 50% coverage. The complete pipeline achieves an end-to-end processing latency of 50.8 ms on an edge device. Project page: https://yuxuanhu9.github.io/HEAR/.

</details>


### [482] [HazardWeaver: Scientific Route Selection for Hazard Analysis Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03591)
*Wangshu Zhu,Xueqi Cheng,Liang Wu,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出状态依赖的科学路径选择问题，并构建HazardWeaver框架，通过知识编译器与能力图实现灾害分析的可执行科学路径选择与动态修正，并发布包含141个实例的Hazard Weaver Benchmark。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害 preparedness 与风险降低需要理解并评估自然灾害。大语言模型推动了用于灾害分析的AI agent研究，但有效自动化要求agent判断哪些科学方法适用于特定事件，且在现有数据与工具下可执行；随着新证据和执行结果出现，这些条件会变化，agent需重新考虑选择。该问题此前未被形式化。

Method: 将问题形式化为状态依赖的科学路径选择（state-dependent scientific route selection）。HazardWeaver包含：Hazard Knowledge Compiler提取与证据关联的、支配科学适用性的条件；Hazard Capability Graph表示可执行的科学能力，并检查其输入输出兼容性；Hazard Weaver Agent基于这两种互补表示选择适用且可执行的路径，执行工作流，并随分析状态变化修正决策。同时构建Hazard Weaver Benchmark，含7个单灾害域和4类多灾害交互共141个实例，支持多条有效科学路径，评估输出正确性、路径有效性与有依据的弃答。

Result: 在该基准上的大量实验表明，HazardWeaver优于现有agent系统，在存在多条合格科学路径的任务上增益最大。

Conclusion: 状态依赖的科学路径选择是灾害分析自动化的关键问题；结合证据条件表示与能力兼容性检查的agent框架能有效提升科学输出与决策质量。代码已公开。

Abstract: Understanding and assessing natural hazards is essential for disaster preparedness and risk reduction. Recent advances in large language models have spurred growing interest in AI agents for hazard analysis, particularly their ability to integrate scientific data, models, and tools into automated workflows. However, effective automation requires agents to determine which scientific methods are appropriate for a given event and executable with the available data and tools. As new evidence and execution results become available, these conditions can change, requiring agents to reconsider their choices. We formulate this problem as state-dependent scientific route selection and introduce HazardWeaver. Specifically, HazardWeaver first leverages the Hazard Knowledge Compiler to extract evidence-linked conditions governing scientific applicability, then its Hazard Capability Graph represents executable scientific capabilities and checks compatibility between their inputs and outputs. Using these complementary representations, the Hazard Weaver Agent component selects applicable and executable routes, carries out their workflows, and revises its decisions as the analysis state changes. To evaluate both the scientific outputs and the decisions that produce them, we introduce the Hazard Weaver Benchmark, comprising 141 instances across seven single-hazard domains and four multi-hazard interaction classes. The benchmark accommodates multiple valid scientific routes and evaluates output correctness, route validity, and justified abstention. Extensive experiments on this benchmark show that HazardWeaver outperforms existing agent systems, with the largest gains on tasks with multiple eligible scientific routes. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/HazardWeaver.

</details>


### [483] [Depth as Time in One-Step Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03626)
*Arnold Caleb Asiimwe,William Yang,Sanghyuk Chun,Esin Tureci,Olga Russakovsky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"深度即时间"（depth as time）的实证观察：一步生成模型把多步扩散的采样轨迹重新组织到单次前向传播的网络深度中，逐层解码可恢复去噪轨迹，且该现象依赖于流图所训练的传输任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步生成模型（蒸馏或学习流图）已能生成高质量图像，但一个自然问题随之而来：当生成被压缩为单次前向传播时，多步扩散原本沿采样步展开的去噪轨迹发生了什么？作者希望探究时间维度的计算是否真的被消除，还是被重新组织到了别处。

Method: 作者用模型自身的输出头解码中间层特征，逐层探测单次前向传播中的去噪计算；并对比不同训练范式（MeanFlow 等带时间索引传输任务的流图 vs. drifting models 等不含时间索引传输任务的生成器）；进一步通过探测更短的传输区间观察去噪与再加噪行为，并将逐层计算显式视为一个 flow，训练单个时间条件化 block 进行跨层去噪以实现压缩。

Result: 多步扩散的逐步去噪计算确实展开在单次前向传播的网络深度中，可通过解码中间层恢复；该深度计算依赖流图所解决的传输任务，MeanFlow 在更短传输区间下于单次网络评估内同时呈现去噪与再加噪（denoise-then-renoise）；而无时间索引传输任务的 drifting models 不具备同样的深度去噪。具备该现象的模型更易跨层压缩，MeanFlow SiT-L/2 可压缩 16.6 倍参数为单个时间条件化 block。

Conclusion: 扩散的时间性计算并未被一步生成所消除，而是被重新组织到网络深度中。作者给出了 denoise-then-renoise 行为的解释，并证明将逐层计算显式视为 flow 时，单个时间条件化 block 即可实现跨层去噪，从而大幅压缩模型参数。

Abstract: The recent wave of one-step generative models, which compress the multi-step trajectory of diffusion via either distillation or learned flow maps, has reached an inflection point where they can generate high-quality images. Here, we ask a natural question that follows from these advances: what happens to the denoising trajectory of multi-step diffusion when generation is compressed into a single forward pass? We offer an empirical observation we call \textit{depth as time}: the denoising computation that multi-step diffusion performs across sampling steps appears to unfold across the depth of a single forward pass, and can be recovered by decoding intermediate layers with the model's own output head. Most interestingly, we show that this depthwise computation depends on the transport task a flow map is trained to solve. The most surprising case is MeanFlow, where probing shorter transport intervals reveals both denoising and renoising within a single network evaluation. In contrast, generators trained without a time-indexed transport task, such as drifting models, do not exhibit the same depthwise denoising. Consequently, we show that models that exhibit the depthwise denoising phenomenon are more compressible across the layerwise computation: a MeanFlow \texttt{SiT-L/2} model can be compressed by $16.6\times$ in parameters into a single time-conditioned block. We offer an explanation for this denoise-then-renoise behavior and show that, when we treat the layerwise computation explicitly as a flow, a single time-conditioned block can be trained to denoise across layers, compressing a MeanFlow \texttt{SiT-L/2} model by $16.6\times$ in parameters. Together, these results suggest that the temporal computation of diffusion is not eliminated by one-step generation, but reorganized across network depth.

</details>


### [484] [NeutronGym: Physics-Graded Neutron Instrument Design for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03631)
*Lijie Ding,Changwoo Do*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 NeutronGym——首个可执行的中子仪器设计环境，用 McStas 物理仿真与无 LLM 判官的层级式评分实现对语言模型"做物理"而非"背物理"的考察，并兼具训练功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准难以区分语言模型是真正进行物理推理还是仅凭记忆复述已有知识，且评分往往依赖易被质疑的 LLM 判官；需要可验证、不可争辩的评测环境。

Method: 构建 NeutronGym 可执行环境：智能体通过校验工具构建仪器，McStas 对构建结果做光线追踪，采用层级递进式评分（语法、运行、结构、科学性），不使用 LLM 判官；用程序化族生成无限实例并设留出参数区间；另设 McStasBench 含 16 个已发表仪器任务，配记忆探针与沙箱；同时在该奖励上进行强化学习训练。

Result: 七个模型最多复现 16 个任务中的 7 个，无一能检索到参考解，也无模型达到改进目标；RL 训练将 Qwen3-8B 在留出实例上从 11% 提升至 77%（另一随机种子 69%），超过未训练的 Qwen3-32B；去掉层级部分给分后性能暴跌 60 分；仅凭奖励训练的模型在智能体仿真预算下接近经典优化器水平（77% vs 81%，该规模下无显著差异），而前沿模型仍达 98-99%。

Conclusion: NeutronGym 提供了可信、可训练的物理设计评测基准；层级部分给分对训练成功至关重要；奖励信号本身足以逼近经典优化器，但未达前沿模型水平；作者公开了识别出四个无模型基线即可解决、因而被弃用任务设计的探针。

Abstract: Designing a scientific instrument tests whether language-model agents can do physics rather than recall it, provided the grading cannot be argued with. We introduce NeutronGym, to our knowledge the first executable environment for neutron instrument design: agents build instruments through validating tools, McStas ray-traces what they build, and a level-resolved ladder grades syntax, runtime, structure and science with no LLM judge. Procedural families supply unlimited instances of a fixed layout whose design parameters the agent must set, with held-out parameter regimes; a curated slice, McStasBench, adds 16 tasks from published instruments behind memorization probes and a sandbox. Seven models reproduce at most 7 of the 16, none retrieves a reference, and none meets an improvement target. The environment also trains. Reinforcement learning on its reward takes Qwen3-8B from 11% to 77% of held-out instances of a family whose targets come from a hidden design (69% at a second seed), past an untrained Qwen3-32B, and the recipe holds, at one seed each, on three further gated families. The analysis says what that gain is. Without the ladder's partial credit it collapses by 60 points. From reward alone the trained model reaches what a classical optimizer reaches, at the agent's simulation budget, only when handed the closed-form physics (77% against 81%, a gap that does not separate at this size), while frontier models still solve 98-99%. Getting a trustworthy result meant failing four task designs that no-model baselines could solve, and we release the probes that found them.

</details>


### [485] [Credit Where It Matters: Dependency-Aware Policy Optimization for Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03634)
*Yu Li,Guangfeng Cai,Long-Fei Li,Shuo Han,Shengtian Yang,Han Luo,Kaibing Yang,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出依赖感知组策略优化（DepGPO），利用终端命令间的读写执行依赖构建依赖图，从验证器检查的资源回溯，将信用分配给相关写操作及其支撑读操作，从而在步骤间重新分配轨迹优势，提升复杂终端任务的表现与训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体在编码、调试等多步任务中，后续命令常依赖先前命令产生的中介结果。现有轨迹级与步骤级信用分配方法未显式追踪命令间的读写依赖，导致训练信号可能被分配到无关操作，削弱了对关键步骤的学习。

Method: DepGPO 从执行轨迹构建命令依赖图，并从任务验证器所检查的资源出发进行反向回溯；沿这些依赖路径，将信用分配给相关的写操作及其支撑的读操作，并据此在步骤间重新分配轨迹优势（advantage）。

Result: 大量对比实验与消融研究表明，DepGPO 在复杂终端任务上提升了任务性能与训练稳定性。

Conclusion: 显式建模命令间的读写执行依赖可提供更精准的信用分配，是改进终端智能体强化学习训练的有效途径。

Abstract: Terminal-using agents benefit from reinforcement learning (RL) in coding, debugging, and other multi-step terminal tasks. In these tasks, later commands often depend on information or intermediate results produced by earlier commands. However, existing trajectory-level and step-level credit assignment methods do not explicitly trace the read-write dependencies through which commands affect the final outcome. Consequently, training signals could still be assigned to irrelevant operations, weakening learning from relevant steps. In this paper, we propose Dependency-Aware Group Policy Optimization (DepGPO), which uses execution dependencies between commands to guide credit assignment for terminal agents. Specifically, we construct a command dependency graph from execution traces and trace backward from the resources inspected by the task verifier. We then assign credit to relevant writes and their supporting reads along these paths, and use it to redistribute trajectory advantages across steps. Extensive comparative experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that DepGPO improves task performance and training stability on complex terminal tasks.

</details>


### [486] [Do Large Language Models Know Colombian Law? A Reliability Benchmark for the Colombian Legal System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03639)
*Rubén Manrique,Michelle Castellanos,Jorge Morales,Juan David Gutiérrez,Antonio Barreto Rozo,Joaquín Vélez Navarro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了经专家验证的哥伦比亚法律体系LLM评测基准（1042题、10个法律领域、3种题型），评测15个模型，发现闭式题准确率最高0.905，但自由文本事实正确性均不超过0.45，且答案相关性与正确性出现背离（rho=-0.46），需专家监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益用于法律实践、教育与研究，但其在美国以外国家法律体系中的可靠性缺乏系统记录，尤其缺少经专家验证的、针对特定法域的评测基准。

Method: 采用human-in-the-loop流程与多阶段专家评审，构建涵盖10个法律领域、3种题型（闭式多选、半开放、开放式IRAC）的1042题基准；对15个当代闭源与开源模型用与题型匹配的指标评测；辅以独立rubric式LLM裁判与盲评人类专家打分进行验证。

Result: 闭式题准确率跨度大（最高0.905，最低0.577）；自由文本事实正确性任何模型均≤0.45（0-1尺度）。相关性与正确性呈负相关（Spearman rho=-0.46），模型"答得像模像样却常常出错"。闭式题准确率与自由文本正确性排名高度相关（rho=0.94），故多选筛测可预测排名但高估绝对可靠性。LLM裁判与盲评专家均复现自由文本排名（rho≥0.88）；模型引用的法条仅约半数正确。可靠性随法律领域系统性变化，并随题目复杂度呈倒U型。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在哥伦比亚法律任务中仍需专家监督；将答案锚定于权威来源是提升可靠性的有前景路径。基准构建流程已公开以支持可复现评测。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support legal practice, education, and research, yet their reliability in national legal systems outside the United States remains largely undocumented. We introduce an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLM reliability on the Colombian legal system. The benchmark comprises 1,042 items spanning ten areas of law and three question formats (closed multiple-choice, semi-open, and open-ended IRAC), built through a human-in-the-loop pipeline with multi-stage expert review. We evaluate 15 contemporary proprietary and open-weight models with format-appropriate metrics. Accuracy on closed questions ranges widely, from 0.905 (Gemini 3.1 Pro) to 0.577, but on free-text legal answers factual correctness never exceeds 0.45 (on a 0-1 scale) for any model. We find a dissociation between answer relevancy and correctness (Spearman rho = -0.46): models reliably sound responsive while frequently being wrong, a pattern of particular concern for non-expert users. Closed-question accuracy and free-text correctness are strongly rank-correlated (rho = 0.94), so cheap multiple-choice screening predicts model ranking but overstates absolute reliability. An independent rubric-based LLM judge and blind human expert scoring both reproduce the free-text ranking (rho >= 0.88). The judge further reveals that only about half of the norms models cite are correct; the rest are wrong or non-existent. Reliability varies systematically by legal area and follows an inverted-U across question complexity. Our results indicate that current LLMs require expert supervision for Colombian legal tasks, and that grounding answers in authoritative sources is a promising path to higher reliability. We release the benchmark construction pipeline to support reproducible evaluation.

</details>


### [487] [Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03693)
*Jungkyu Park,Dhruva Biswas,Joseph Cappadona,Cerise Tang,Ken G. Zeng,Bartosz Machura,Chuwen Liu,Paolo Tarantino,Coral Omene,Francisco J. Esteva,Rohit Bhargava,Marcin Braun,Kamila Paździerz,Jakub Czerwiński,Hanna Romańska-Knight,Albert Grinshpun,Bareket Daniel,Michele Buchinger,Frederick Howard,Piotr Wysocki,Brie Chun,Freya Schnabel,Rich Caruana,Jan Witowski,Krzysztof J. Geras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两阶段AI模型，先由组织病理学推断转录组，再预测乳腺癌新辅助治疗pCR，在1412例多队列中AUROC达0.79。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤学领域标注数据稀缺，制约了深度学习生物标志物的发展。

Method: 两阶段模型：第一阶段用32种癌症类型、8742例患者从组织病理学图像学习转录组，并经病理学家复核及与实测表达的空间一致性验证；第二阶段简化为基于推断表达与临床变量预测pCR。开发集1080例（5队列），评估集1412例（9队列）。

Result: 汇总AUROC为0.79（95% CI 0.73-0.85），可在分子亚型内区分应答者；优于组织病理学生物标志物；对瘤内采样稳定，仅需少量活检组织。消融实验显示全转录组推断优于仅用临床变量或一阶段病理模型，且规避了基因组检测的基因选择限制。

Conclusion: 生物学信息引导的压缩表示可推广至精准肿瘤学中数据稀缺的应用场景。

Abstract: Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Developed using 1,080 patients (five cohorts) and evaluated in 1,412 patients (nine cohorts), the model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.79 (95% CI, 0.73-0.85), discriminating responders within molecular subtypes. It outperforms histopathological biomarkers, remaining stable across intratumoral sampling and with minimal biopsy tissue. Ablations show transcriptome-wide inference improves discrimination over clinical variables alone or one-stage pathology models, and robustness by avoiding genomic assays' gene selection constraints. These results indicate that biologically informed compression may generalize to data-sparse applications in precision oncology.

</details>

### [488] [Evolving Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03220)
*Devroop Kar,Daniel Krutz,Travis Desell*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 将进化式量子电路发现框架EXAQC扩展到图像分类，自动演化参数化量子电路作为混合模型的中间模块，在多个数据集上以更少参数取得competitive精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合量子-经典神经网络性能高度依赖量子电路架构选择，但现有方法多采用手工设计或固定ansatz，需预先指定电路结构、门组成与量子比特连接，无法保证适配任务。图像分类场景尤为突出：量子电路需转换经典网络提取的特征，同时保持足够紧凑以利于训练，通用且任务无关的ansatz难以同时满足这两点。

Method: 扩展EXAQC（面向自动化量子电路发现的进化框架）至图像分类：EXAQC演化PQC作为中间处理模块，保留经典特征提取层与预测层。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上评估，并与量子架构搜索方法及经典网络对比；同时分析编码方式的影响。

Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上分别达到98.42%、90.62%、85.47%精度，门数与其它量子架构搜索方法相当。相比经典网络，演化混合模型以显著更少可训练参数保持相当精度，在CIFAR-10上以比10层CNN少25倍以上参数达到85.68%。编码选择影响显著：旋转类编码（RX、RY、U3）在CIFAR-10上比振幅编码高22-25个百分点。

Conclusion: 自动化电路发现可产生紧凑量子模块，在视觉架构中替代更大的经典组件，同时保持有竞争力的精度。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum classical neural networks integrate parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) with established deep learning architectures, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of quantum circuit architecture, a choice that remains largely manual. Most existing approaches rely on hand-designed or fixed circuit ansätze, requiring circuit structure, gate composition, and qubit connectivity to be specified in advance with no guarantee that they suit the task. This limitation is especially acute in image classification, where quantum circuits must transform features extracted by classical networks while remaining compact enough for practical training, requirements that generic, task-agnostic ansätze are unlikely to satisfy simultaneously. We extend EXAQC, an evolutionary framework for automated quantum circuit discovery, to image classification. EXAQC evolves PQCs as intermediate processing modules while retaining classical feature-extraction and prediction layers. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, EXAQC achieves 98.42%, 90.62%, and 85.47% accuracy, respectively, while using comparable gate counts to other quantum architecture-search methods. Against classical networks, evolved hybrid models maintain comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters, reaching 85.68% on CIFAR-10 with over 25$\times$ fewer parameters than a 10-layer CNN. Encoding choice also matters: rotation-based encodings (RX, RY, U3) outperform amplitude encoding by 22-25 points on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that automated circuit discovery yields compact quantum modules that can replace larger classical components in vision architectures while retaining competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [489] [SEDIMA: Cross-Run Hierarchical Insight Memory for Evolutionary Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02361)
*Amirhossein Abaskohi,Mahdi Mostajabdaveh,Zirui Zhou*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文提出SEDIMA，一种面向大语言模型驱动进化搜索智能体的持久化层次化洞见记忆，将原始搜索轨迹蒸馏为自然语言洞见，通过注意力加权质心聚类并按语义相似度检索，从而在未来变异中注入可迁移知识，突破现有系统"无记忆"的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的进化搜索系统大多无记忆，每次运行都从零开始探索，导致智能体反复重新发现相同的改进、重复遭遇相同的死胡同，无法跨运行、跨问题累积可迁移知识。

Method: SEDIMA将原始搜索轨迹蒸馏为自然语言洞见，使用注意力加权质心按语义相似度进行聚类，并检索相关指导来条件化未来的变异操作，从而在多次运行和多个问题之间累积可迁移知识；该模块为即插即用组件，不修改搜索算子本身。

Result: 在固定100个候选评估预算下，SEDIMA在AlgoTune上平均最终性能提升5.5%，在ALE-Bench LITE上提升6.6%；在OpenEvolve框架下，跨五个评估骨干模型，达到基线最佳性能平均所需迭代次数减少32.3%。

Conclusion: 持久化层次化洞见记忆能有效弥补LLM进化搜索的记忆缺失问题，以即插即用方式显著提升搜索效率与最终性能，并降低达到目标性能所需的迭代次数。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is a powerful paradigm for automated program and algorithm discovery, yet existing systems are largely memoryless: each run explores from scratch, so agents repeatedly rediscover the same improvements and re-encounter the same dead ends. We introduce SEDIMA, a persistent hierarchical insight memory for evolutionary search agents. SEDIMA distills raw traces into natural-language insights, clusters them by semantic similarity using attention-weighted centroids, and retrieves relevant guidance to condition future mutations, accumulating transferable knowledge across runs and problems rather than within a single trajectory. As a drop-in module that leaves the search operators unmodified, SEDIMA improves average final performance by 5.5% on AlgoTune and 6.6% on ALE-Bench LITE under a fixed budget of 100 evaluated candidates. Under OpenEvolve, SEDIMA requires 32.3% fewer iterations on average to reach baseline-best performance across the five evaluated backbones.

</details>


### [490] [Evolutionary Computation for Trustworthy AI: From Attacks and Defenses to Self-Evolving Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02996)
*Junhao Dong,Chenkai Wang,Xuanhui Lin,Mingrong Gong,Siyu Wang,Yuqing Wen,Jiao Liu,Catherine Huang,Gary G. Yen,Xin Yao,Yew-Soon Ong*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该综述从统一的演化视角出发，系统梳理进化计算（EC）在可信AI中的应用，涵盖进化攻击、进化防御与可信自演化AI系统三大方向，并整合评估方法与基准资源，指出挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI已从任务专用模型演进为基础模型与智能体，可信AI的范围从模型级鲁棒性扩展到更广AI系统的可靠性与安全性，攻击面也从单个模型扩展到工具调用、上下文及与环境交互轨迹等系统级交互。在此背景下，维持变化或被人为操纵条件下的可靠安全行为愈发困难；同时，搜索有效攻击与防御常依赖黑盒反馈在离散选择（词、动作、系统组件及其组合）中摸索，且多目标与高代价候选评估限制了可探索空间，因此需要适合此类场景的搜索方法。

Method: 采用综述方法，以"共同演化视角"为主线，将以往分开处理的可信AI、进化计算与自演化系统三条线索加以连接。具体从三个方向组织文献：进化攻击、进化防御、可信自演化AI系统；并针对自演化AI考察可信性如何制约更新的生成与保留，进而影响后续适应过程。同时从可信性与进化搜索两个视角综合评估方法及基准资源。

Result: 指出进化计算凭借基于种群、无梯度搜索以及灵活的变异与选择机制，天然适配上述黑盒、离散、多目标且评估昂贵的场景；并整合了来自可信性与进化搜索双重视角的评估方法与基准资源，形成系统化的文献梳理。

Conclusion: 该综述通过统一演化视角串联可信AI、进化计算与自演化系统，明确了EC在进化攻击、进化防御与可信自演化AI中的定位；最后讨论了关键挑战与未来研究方向，以推动EC在可信AI中更有效、更可靠的应用。

Abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) has evolved from task-specific models to foundation models and agents, the scope of trustworthy AI has expanded from model-level robustness to the reliability and safety of broader AI systems. This evolution has also expanded the attack surface from individual models to broader system-level interactions, including tool use, context, and interaction trajectories with dynamic environments. As a result, maintaining reliable and safe behavior under changing or deliberately manipulated conditions has become increasingly challenging. The search for effective attacks and defenses often relies on black-box feedback to navigate discrete choices among words, actions, system components, or their combinations. Multiple objectives and expensive candidate evaluations further limit what can be explored. Evolutionary Computation (EC), with its population-based, gradient-free search and flexible variation and selection mechanisms, is well suited to these settings. This survey reviews how EC has been applied to trustworthy AI across three directions: evolutionary attacks, evolutionary defenses, and trustworthy self-evolving AI systems. Unlike prior reviews that treat trustworthy AI, EC, and self-evolving systems largely separately, we connect these lines through a common evolutionary perspective. For self-evolving AI, we examine how trustworthiness governs the generation and retention of updates that shape subsequent adaptation. We further synthesize evaluation methods and benchmark resources from both trustworthiness and evolutionary-search perspectives. Finally, we discuss key challenges and future research directions toward more effective and reliable use of EC in trustworthy AI.

</details>


### [491] [Small universal multiset reaction systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03021)
*Andrei Paun,Annemarie-Beatrix Messner*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文在多集反应系统框架下构造了一个小型通用机器，用8个寄存器、23条指令的通用寄存器机编码，需87种不同元素，证明多集反应系统具备模拟通用计算的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨多集反应系统这一自然计算模型的计算能力上限，验证其是否足以支持通用计算。

Method: 以代表寄存器和指令标签的元素编码机器状态，通过要求某指令的反应链仅在该指令对应标签元素出现后才可被激活，从而强制实现顺序执行；在此基础上实现一个含8个寄存器和23条指令的通用寄存器机。

Result: 在基于优先级的模型下，该通用寄存器机的构造需要87种不同元素。

Conclusion: 多集反应系统能够模拟通用计算，其计算能力达到通用性水平。

Abstract: This paper presents a construction of a small universal machine within the framework of Multi-set Reaction Systems. We encode the machine state using elements that represent registers and instruction labels, and we enforce sequential execution by ensuring that reaction chains for a given instruction can only activate after the corresponding label element appears. We implement a universal register machine with 8 registers and 23 instructions, showing that the priority-based model requires 87 distinct elements. The results demonstrate that multiset reaction systems are capable of simulating universal computation.

</details>


### [492] [Learning While Inferring: Local and Parallel Learning for Edge SNNs across Sensing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03149)
*Yanxun Zhang,Yifei Wang,Changze Lv,Jingwen Xu,Yiyang Lu,Xiaohua Wang,Di Yu,Xin Du,Xiaoqing Zheng*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出双向脉冲蒸馏（BSD），一种可在边缘SNN推理过程中同步学习的on-device学习范式，通过解耦前向与逆向计算图实现并发更新，在25个基准上平均仅落后BP基线3.8个百分点，并显著降低训练延迟与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘智能要求模型在严格的算力、能耗与存储预算下实时持续感知并在线适应。SNN虽支持高效的事件驱动推理，但标准代理梯度反向传播（BP）会串行化更新并阻断持续推理，难以满足on-device边推理边学习的需求。

Method: BSD将刺激驱动的前向网络与独立的目标驱动逆向网络耦合，通过局部目标对齐两者的中间表征。由于两条通路在对齐前计算图不相交，前向推理、逆向推理与分阶段更新可并发执行。部署时仅需保留前向分支，并去除了稠密的浮点反向链。

Result: 在覆盖SOUL五种感知模态的25个基准上，BSD平均仅落后匹配的BP基线3.8个百分点；其学习到的表征在无回放的少样本类增量学习中迁移良好；相比BP，投影训练延迟降至0.72倍，估计训练能耗降至0.36倍。

Conclusion: BSD作为一种边推理边学习的on-device学习原理，在保持与BP基线接近精度的同时实现并发训练并大幅降低延迟与能耗，且支持无回放的增量学习与仅前向部署，适合资源受限的边缘SNN场景。

Abstract: Edge intelligence requires models to sense continuously in real time and to keep adapting on-device, all under tight compute, energy, and memory budgets. Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) enable efficient event-driven inference, standard surrogate-gradient backpropagation (BP) serializes updates and blocks ongoing inference. We investigate Bidirectional Spike-Based Distillation (BSD) as an on-device learning principle that lets edge SNNs learn while inferring. BSD couples a stimulus-driven forward network with an independent target-driven reverse network and aligns their intermediate representations through local objectives. Because the two pathways have disjoint computation graphs until alignment, forward inference, reverse inference, and stage-wise updates can run concurrently. On 25 benchmarks spanning the five sensing modalities of SOUL, BSD stays within 3.8 percentage points of matched BP baselines on average, while only its forward branch is needed at deployment. The learned representations also transfer well to few-shot class-incremental learning without replaying past data. By removing the dense floating-point backward chain, BSD reduces the projected training latency to $0.72\times$ and the estimated training energy to $0.36\times$ that of BP.

</details>


### [493] [Aggregate accuracy conceals concentrated temporal vulnerability in a spiking speech classifier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03155)
*İsmail Can Dikmen*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 通过保留725,070个相邻邻域预测，论文刻画了SpikeSCR分类器的局部脆弱性、内部状态变化与执行依赖，弥补了聚合精度无法揭示的细粒度问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合准确率无法揭示哪些话语局部脆弱、在标签稳定时内部活动如何变化，以及脆弱性是否依赖执行路径。

Method: 对冻结的SpikeSCR分类器100个验证样本周边725,070个相邻单计数变化保留全部预测；采用等源期望精度、边缘引导与代理梯度搜索、事后梯度前缀、源匹配轨迹与干净状态干预、双计数读出副本、查询/键源隔离、CPU/GPU配对重放。

Result: 原生GPU单例路径验证精度86.0836%；等源期望精度由84.00%升至84.54%，84个初始正确源中13个存在不利邻居，5个源承载93.21%不利移动；事后梯度前缀以73.45%的初始正确源普查量发现全部13个脆弱源；两副本精度相近但类别变化差达5.21倍且集中于4个源；源隔离消除531个批次顺序标签变化，恢复9,981个验证分数向量的位序不变性；孤立批次预测在9,980/9,981上与填充匹配的单例标签一致；CPU/GPU重放25,820个类别变化邻居标签一致率99.8993%。

Conclusion: 完整的源条件映射可区分脆弱性发生率、集中度、内部变化与执行依赖，这些均无法由聚合精度反映。

Abstract: Aggregate accuracy cannot reveal which utterances are locally vulnerable or how internal activity changes when labels remain stable. We retain every prediction for 725,070 adjacent-bin, one-count changes around 100 validation utterances of a frozen SpikeSCR-based classifier. The canonical native-horizon GPU singleton path reaches 86.0836% validation accuracy. Equal-source expected accuracy under a uniformly chosen neighbor rises from 84.00% to 84.54%, although 13 of 84 initially correct sources admit adverse neighbors. Five sources carry 93.21% of adverse moves. Margin-guided and surrogate-gradient searches miss sparse cases at fixed query budgets; a post hoc gradient prefix finds all 13 at 73.45% of the census of initially correct sources. Source-matched traces and clean-state interventions distinguish internal change from harmful direction and recoverability. Two count-readout replicas have similar validation accuracies but a 5.21-fold class-change gap concentrated in four sources. Controlled query/key source isolation eliminates 531 batch-order label changes and restores bitwise order invariance across all 9,981 validation score vectors. Isolated batch predictions reproduce padding-matched singleton labels on 9,980 of 9,981 inputs. Paired CPU/GPU replay of all 25,820 class-changing neighbors gives 99.8993% label agreement and preserves all 13 vulnerable sources and their fixed witnesses. Complete source-conditioned maps distinguish vulnerability incidence, concentration, internal change, and execution dependence that aggregate accuracy leaves unresolved.

</details>


### [494] [Self-Repairing Recurrent Ensembles for Real-Time Recovery from Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03249)
*Julian Lemmel,Pedro D. Wendel Garcia,Taisuke Kobayashi,Radu Grosu*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种无监督在线自适应方法，使预训练控制器能在传感器漂移/故障/噪声导致的分布偏移下自主恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练控制器部署后会遭遇训练数据中不存在的条件（传感器漂移、传感器故障、累积测量噪声），引发分布偏移，导致原本胜任的策略崩溃，而此时通常没有专家提供纠正标签。因此需要一种在线、无监督的策略恢复方法。

Method: 控制器为循环网络集成，每个成员观测观测向量的随机掩码子集，其高斯输出通过序贯卡尔曼融合，使高置信度成员主导共识动作。部署时将该共识视为自监督标签，朝其微调每个成员，并按成员卡尔曼增益平方的补数缩放其贡献。梯度用RFLO（Real-Time Recurrent Learning的高效且生物学合理的近似）计算，使每个环境步后都进行参数更新，策略能随偏移展开实时响应。该框架还涵盖完全在线交互式模仿学习：有专家时用专家动作替换共识标签，同一更新规则可在遥操作中精炼策略。

Result: 在多种模拟连续控制任务上，该方法在传感器偏移后恢复到接近原始性能，而观测完整向量的集成方法无法恢复。

Conclusion: 无需监督、无需专家的在线自适应框架可有效应对部署期的传感器分布偏移，并可统一扩展到在线交互式模仿学习。

Abstract: Deploying a pretrained controller exposes it to conditions that are absent from its training data. Sensor drift, outright sensor failure and accumulating measurement noise all induce a distribution shift that can collapse an otherwise competent policy; typically at a point in time where no expert is available to supply corrective labels. We present a method that lets a policy recover from such shifts online and without supervision. Our controller is an ensemble of recurrent networks, each of which observes a randomly masked subset of the observation vector, and whose Gaussian outputs are combined through sequential Kalman fusion so that confident members dominate the consensus action. At deployment, we treat this consensus as a self-supervised label and fine-tune each member towards it, scaling each member's contribution proportional to the complement of its squared Kalman gain. Gradients are computed using RFLO, an efficient and biologically plausible approximation of Real-Time Recurrent Learning, so that a parameter update follows every environment step and the policy reacts to a shift as it unfolds. On a range of simulated continuous control tasks, our approach recovers close to the original performance after a sensor shift, while ensembles that see the full observation are unable to recover. The same framework subsumes fully online interactive imitation learning: when an expert is present, the consensus label is replaced by the expert action and the identical update rule refines the policy during teleoperation.

</details>


### [495] [The Investment Acceleration Principle Revisited by means of a Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03282)
*Guido Fioretti*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分解式投资加速器模型，其系数由代表企业决策的Kohonen神经网络权重构成，并借助自组织系统理论区分创新驱动型投资与产能复制型投资。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统投资加速原理仅以消费时间序列启发式地解释投资时间序列，缺乏对企业决策机制与投资异质性的刻画，难以区分不同类型投资的驱动逻辑。

Method: 构建分解式加速器方程，将方程系数设定为Kohonen神经网络的权重，用以表征企业的决策过程；并引入自组织系统理论中的技术，对创新驱动型投资与厂房复制型投资进行解耦识别。

Result: 模型表明，投资的发生源于管理者对新兴技术模式的识别；通过自组织方法可有效分离创新驱动型投资与产能复制型投资两类成分。

Conclusion: 将神经网络的模式识别能力与自组织系统方法结合，可拓展投资加速原理，使其在分解层面反映企业技术认知与投资结构差异。

Abstract: The investment acceleration principle is a heuristic for modelling investment time series out of consumption time series. The model presented herein develops a disaggregated accelerator equation whose coefficients are the weights of a Kohonen neural net that represents firms' decision-making. According to this model, investments take place when managers recognise emerging technological patterns. Furthermore, a technique borrowed from the theory of self-organising systems is used in order to disentangle innovation-driven investments from plant-replication investments.

</details>


### [496] [Parallel Time-Aligned Spiking Self-Attention for Consistent Integer-Valued Training and Spike-Driven Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03291)
*Peng Xue,Wei Fang,Kaiwei Che,Qingyan Meng,Zhengyu Ma,Yonghong Tian,Huihui Zhou*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文识别了压缩脉冲表示下自注意力引入的“时序交互失配”(TIM)问题，并提出PT-SSA与Adaptive PT-SSA方法，在保持训练效率的同时大幅缩小训练-推理差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: I-LIF神经元和SFA通过将脉冲序列表示为发放计数和归一化发放率来降低时序训练成本，但直接将SSA应用于这些压缩的Q/K/V表示会引入推理阶段（脉冲驱动）不存在的跨时间交互，即算子层面的时序交互失配（TIM），导致训练与推理不一致。

Method: 提出并行时间对齐脉冲自注意力（PT-SSA）：从I-LIF计数或SFA发放率重建连续的虚拟脉冲切片，仅在同一时间对齐的切片之间并行计算注意力，再对各步输出求和。针对SFA下注意力输出尺度偏小，进一步提出Adaptive PT-SSA，在输出SFA神经元前学习逐块的正值重缩放，提高发放级利用率。并实现Triton融合训练内核。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1K上显著降低训练-推理失配。CIFAR-100结合I-LIF时，PT-SSA将平均Top-1差距从1.85降至0.29个百分点；ImageNet-1K上Adaptive PT-SSA将Top-1差距从27.78降至0.06个百分点，并达到74.53%的脉冲驱动Top-1准确率；Triton融合PT-SSA训练内核相对循环LIF SSA保持2.91倍吞吐优势。

Conclusion: PT-SSA及Adaptive PT-SSA在保留压缩脉冲表示训练效率优势的同时，有效消除TIM导致的训练-推理失配，兼顾精度与吞吐，为高效脉冲Transformer训练提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Integer-valued leaky integrate-and-fire (I-LIF) neurons and spike firing approximation (SFA) reduce temporal training cost by representing spike trains as firing counts and normalized firing rates, respectively. However, applying spiking self-attention (SSA) directly to these compressed query, key, and value representations introduces cross-time interactions that are absent during spike-driven inference. We term this operator-level discrepancy Temporal Interaction Mismatch (TIM). We propose Parallel Time-Aligned Spiking Self-Attention (PT-SSA), which reconstructs consecutive virtual spike slices from either I-LIF counts or SFA firing rates, computes attention only between time-aligned slices in parallel, and sums the per-step outputs. To accommodate the reduced attention output scale under SFA, we further introduce Adaptive PT-SSA, which learns a positive per-block rescaling before the output SFA neuron to improve firing-level utilization. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1K show that the proposed methods substantially reduce train--inference mismatch. On CIFAR-100 with I-LIF, PT-SSA reduces the mean Top-1 gap from 1.85 to 0.29 percentage points. On ImageNet-1K, Adaptive PT-SSA reduces the Top-1 gap from 27.78 to 0.06 percentage points and achieves 74.53\% spike-driven Top-1 accuracy. A Triton-fused PT-SSA training kernel retains a $2.91\times$ throughput advantage over recurrent LIF SSA.

</details>


### [497] [FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03675)
*Hui Chen,Xuan Qi,James Xu Zhao,Zhaopeng Feng,Shilong Liu,Kuang Xu,Pang Wei Koh,Bryan Hooi*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出 FrugalEvo——一种成本感知的 LLM 进化优化框架，用强模型探索策略、廉价模型实现并迭代精修代码，配合面向缓存复用的演化流程与 BA-AUC 指标，在同等成本预算下以极低成本取得或超越 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 引导的进化方法（如 AlphaEvolve）以固定迭代次数下的性能增益为优化目标，忽略了实际中应最大化"单位成本的收益"。论文主张实用优化应在固定成本预算下衡量解的质量，因此需要成本感知的进化框架与相应的评估指标。

Method: 1) FrugalEvo 框架：强弱模型分工，高成本强 LLM 负责探索解题策略，低成本廉价 LLM 负责实现策略并迭代精修生成代码；2) 缓存高效的进化过程：设计 harness 与 prompt 以最大化不同演化步骤间的前缀共享，提升缓存复用率；3) 提出 Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve（BA-AUC）指标，即预算约束下"最优至今评估分数-累计 LLM 成本"曲线下面积，用于衡量固定成本预算内的解质量。

Result: 在 10 个数学与系统优化任务上，FrugalEvo 在最终解质量上匹配或超越 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX 等 SOTA 基线，并在 9 个任务上取得更高 BA-AUC；在 ALE-Bench-Lite 的 10 个算法优化任务上平均性能也更高。在圆填充任务上，使用 GPT-5.6 Terra 与 Luna 仅花 1.68 美元、使用 GLM-5.3 及其 Flash 变体仅花 0.55 美元即达到新 SOTA，匹配或超越所有基线，包括平均成本约 50 美元的多智能体方法 CORAL 与 SwarmResearch。

Conclusion: 以"单位成本收益"为优化目标的成本感知进化范式是可行且高效的。通过强弱 LLM 分工与缓存高效演化设计，FrugalEvo 在固定成本预算下显著优于以迭代次数为导向的方法，可用极低开销（约基线的 1/30 至 1/90）达到甚至超越昂贵多智能体方案的性能，表明成本感知与缓存复用是提升 LLM 进化优化实用性的关键。

Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only 1.68 USD and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only 0.55 USD, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately 50 USD on average.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [498] [Learning Jazz Pianist Style with Cross-Attention Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02918)
*Drew Edwards,Akira Maezawa,Simon Dixon*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该研究利用预训练符号音乐Transformer的表示识别爵士钢琴家风格，并通过身份嵌入的条件生成与分类器定位标志性乐句。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爵士钢琴家的风格特征虽可被资深听众快速辨识，却难以形式化描述；作者希望借助预训练符号音乐模型的表示能力，客观刻画并生成钢琴家个人风格。

Method: 以预训练符号音乐Transformer为基础，验证其学到的表示可高精度分类钢琴家身份（两个基准）；再引入对钢琴家身份嵌入的交叉注意力，实现按特定艺术家风格的条件生成；设计两种评估协议，并用滑动窗口分类器与仅基于合成数据训练的分类器进行验证；最后复用分类器定位演奏中最具特征的时刻。

Result: 身份分类在两个基准上达到高准确率；滑动窗口分类器能持续将条件续写归因于正确艺术家，显著优于无条件基线；仅用合成生成训练的分类器可在12类中识别真实钢琴家，块级准确率87%、歌曲级准确率95%。

Conclusion: 预训练符号音乐Transformer表示隐含编码钢琴家身份信息，交叉注意力条件生成可捕捉有意义的风格结构，分类器还可定位区分各钢琴家声音的标志性音乐手势。

Abstract: Jazz pianists develop distinctive traits that experienced listeners can often identify within seconds, yet the features underlying this recognition resist formal description. We study jazz pianist style through the lens of a pretrained symbolic music transformer, showing that its learned representations already encode pianist identity well enough for highly accurate classification across two benchmarks. We then augment the transformer with cross-attention over learned pianist identity embeddings, enabling it to generate music conditioned on a specific artist's style. Two evaluation protocols confirm that the generator captures meaningful stylistic structure: a sliding-window classifier consistently attributes conditioned continuations to the correct artist, far above unconditioned baselines; and a classifier trained entirely on synthetic generations identifies real pianists across 12 classes with 87% chunk-level and 95% song-level accuracy. Finally, we repurpose the classifier to locate the most characteristic moments within a performance, surfacing the specific musical gestures that distinguish each pianist's voice.

</details>


### [499] [ParaGeo: Decomposing Paralinguistic Variation into a Shared Latent Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03125)
*Yuhan Liu,Yuxuan Ou,Ruoxi Su,Mohamed Ahmed Zaki,Yunbo Long*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 论文提出ParaGeo框架，在冻结的语音语言模型中分解并度量副语言变异，验证了跨内容共享的低维坐标表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音表达同时受请求的副语言属性与语言内容影响，二者相互纠缠，导致副语言结构难以在统一坐标系中被度量与比较。

Method: 合成音频token在固定聆听提示下重放，汇聚K/V表示并中心化后投影到共享低维空间；使用GLM-4-Voice探头，覆盖8个句子、12个基准族共80个请求控制；采用全局拟合的校准基与条件置换检验；另设10场景×6风格探头，并施加静态、加性与时序干预。

Result: 基于全局校准基、内容留出的质心准确率为9.49%（置换基线1.25%）；同标签跨内容余弦相似度0.285（对照0.017）；两项条件置换检验p=0.001；10场景6风格探头显示跨场景可复现的对比方向；三类干预呈现属性、层与调度依赖的响应模式。

Conclusion: 为副语言结构度量提供了共享坐标表示，并为潜在语音控制提供经验起点；代码已开源。

Abstract: Speech delivery varies with both the requested paralinguistic attribute and the linguistic content. We introduce ParaGeo, a matched-content decomposition of paralinguistic variation in a frozen speech language model. Synthesized audio tokens are replayed with a fixed listening prompt; pooled key/value (K/V) representations are centered and projected into a shared low-dimensional space. Our GLM-4-Voice probe spans 80 requested controls from 12 benchmark families across eight sentences. With a globally fitted calibration basis, content-held-out centroid accuracy using this basis is 9.49% versus a 1.25% permutation baseline; same-label cross-content cosine similarity is 0.285 versus 0.017, and both conditional permutation tests yield p = 0.001. A separate ten-scenario, six-style probe reveals reproducible contrast directions across scenarios. Static, additive, and temporal interventions produce attribute-, layer-, and schedule-dependent response profiles. These results provide a shared coordinate representation for measuring paralinguistic structure and an empirical starting point for latent speech control. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhanlydia/ParaGeo.

</details>


### [500] [DriftTTS: Few-Step Text-to-Speech Without Distillation via Distribution-Matching Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03390)
*Mohammad Nur Hossain Khan,Subrata Biswas,Bashima Islam*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: DriftTTS：一种无需生成式教师、蒸馏或对抗判别的少步梅尔频谱生成器，采用分布匹配漂移目标训练，4步推理即可与Matcha-TTS竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步TTS模型依赖缩短的扩散/流匹配调度，或从预训练多步教师模型蒸馏，存在依赖性问题。本文旨在摆脱这些依赖。

Method: 采用分布匹配漂移（drift）目标，在梅尔域特征空间（原始梅尔+在相同LJSpeech训练集上预训练的冻结掩码自编码器编码器）中训练；使用on-policy rollout让解码器在自身中间状态上训练，推理深度可达训练时的rollout深度。

Result: LJSpeech上，NFE=4时DriftTTS取得3.87 dB MCD和3.7% WER，Matcha-TTS为3.85 dB和3.4%；配对盲听测试中DriftTTS MOS为4.18，Matcha-TTS为3.96，真实语音为4.22。

Conclusion: 结果证明无需预训练生成式教师也能实现有竞争力的少步语音合成，代码已开源。

Abstract: Few-step neural text-to-speech models often rely on short- ened diffusion or flow-matching schedules, or on distillation from pretrained multi-step teachers. To avoid these depen- dencies, we present DriftTTS, a few-step mel-spectrogram generator trained without a generative teacher, distillation, or adversarial discrimination. DriftTTS uses a distribution- matching drift objective in a mel-domain feature space defined by raw mels and a frozen masked-autoencoder encoder pretrained on the same LJSpeech training split. On-policy rollout trains the decoder on its own interme- diate states and supports inference up to the trained roll- out depth. On LJSpeech, DriftTTS at NFE=4 achieves 3.87 dB MCD and 3.7% WER, compared with 3.85 dB and 3.4% for Matcha-TTS. In a fully paired blind listen- ing test, DriftTTS obtains 4.18 MOS, compared with 3.96 for Matcha-TTS and 4.22 for ground truth. These results demonstrate competitive few-step synthesis without a pre- trained generative teacher. Code can be found at https: //github.com/BASHLab/driftTTS.git

</details>


### [501] [Revisiting Input Time-frequency Representations in Multi-pitch Estimation for Vocal Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03656)
*Junyoung Koh,Hao-Wen Dong*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文比较了HCQT与线性STFT在人声合唱多音高估计中的表现，发现线性STFT不仅精度更高，特征提取成本还显著更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人声合唱中歌手音域重叠、基频接近，谐波在时频表示中相互重叠，使多音高估计变得困难。现有方法常用HCQT获得频率自适应分辨率，但训练时实时生成混合信号导致特征提取代价高昂。

Method: 重新审视输入表示设计，将HCQT与线性STFT进行对比：STFT频率bin直接作为模型输入，尽管其频率分辨率固定、缺少与音高对齐的输入网格。

Result: 线性STFT在性能上超过HCQT，同时大幅降低特征提取成本。进一步分析表明：更长的分析窗或更宽的频谱覆盖并未带来额外提升；而将输入限制在预测音高范围内会削弱线性STFT的优势。

Conclusion: 更细的频率分辨率并不必然提升人声合唱MPE性能，较短的分析窗对时变人声音高可能更有效。

Abstract: Multi-pitch estimation in vocal ensembles is challenging because singers occupy overlapping pitch ranges and often sing at closely spaced fundamental frequencies, causing their harmonics to overlap in time-frequency representations. Existing models commonly use harmonic constant-Q transform (HCQT)-based representations to provide frequency-adaptive resolution, at the cost of expensive feature extraction when training mixtures are generated on the fly. We revisit this design and compare HCQT with a linear short-time Fourier transform (STFT), whose frequency bins are directly provided as model inputs. Despite its fixed frequency resolution and the absence of a pitch-aligned input grid, the linear STFT outperforms HCQT while substantially reducing feature-extraction cost. Further analysis shows that a longer analysis window or broader spectral coverage provides no additional improvement, while restricting the input to the predicted pitch range reduces the advantage of the linear STFT. These results suggest that finer frequency resolution does not necessarily improve vocal-ensemble MPE, and that shorter analysis windows can be more effective for time-varying vocal pitches.

</details>


### [502] [LayerIt: Towards a Framework for Time-Aligned, Composable Music Visualizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03428)
*Fernando Azeredo,António Sá Pinto*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出开源Python库LayerIt，用于在统一演奏时间轴上组合乐谱、信号与算法等多源表示，生成保留MEI结构的单一SVG可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐信息检索常需跨坐标系统整合信号、算法与符号信息，但现有可视化通常将乐谱符号与物理时间分离，或依赖手工拼合，缺乏统一、可复用的复合可视化工具。

Method: 输入为经时间扭曲映射到演奏时间的乐谱及音符级对齐信息，LayerIt将多个独立表示层组合到共享的演奏时间轴上，并输出单一SVG文件；该SVG保留乐谱的MEI结构，同时使新增组件保持可识别与可重新样式化。

Result: 作者以具有挑战性的节拍跟踪分析为案例，将跟踪器输出、信号表示与乐谱符号并置检查，从而定位节拍度量分歧及其他错误，并同时对照记谱结构与实际演奏时间。

Conclusion: LayerIt为MIR研究提供了一种开放、可组合的乐谱—时间复合可视化方案，有助于在统一时间框架下诊断与分析算法输出与音乐结构之间的一致性问题。

Abstract: Music information retrieval often relates signal-derived, algorithmic, and symbolic information across different coordinate systems. Existing visualizations typically leave notation separate from physical time, while composites that combine them are assembled by hand. We present LayerIt, an open-source Python library for composing independent representations with notation on a shared performance-time axis. Given a score warped into performance time and a note-level alignment, LayerIt emits a single SVG that preserves the score's MEI structure and keeps added components identifiable and restylable. We demonstrate this through a challenging beat-tracking analysis, in which tracker output, signal representations, and notation can be inspected together to locate metrical disagreement and other errors against both notated structure and performed time.

</details>


### [503] [GAANet: Global-guided Asymmetric Attention Network for Audio-Visual Speech Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02752)
*Zhiyuan Zhang,Jingyuan Xu,Yiming Tang,Liu Liu,Dan Guo*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: GAANet提出非对称多尺度融合与全局引导注意力机制，实现高效音视频语音分离，在LRS2和VoxCeleb2上达到SOTA，仅3.3M参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多尺度音视频语音分离方法建模能力受限，原因在于：1）对不同模态特征采用相同处理方式；2）忽视全局特征的作用。

Method: 提出全局引导非对称注意力网络（GAANet），包含两项核心创新：1）非对称多尺度融合框架，让音频与视觉流在各自最优时间分辨率下提取与交互特征，无需对称时间下采样；2）全局引导注意力机制，将各模态压缩为时间维度为1的紧凑全局token，提供高层语义线索，引导跨尺度的模态内与模态间融合。

Result: 在LRS2和VoxCeleb2上取得SOTA性能，LRS2达16.5 dB SI-SNRi，VoxCeleb2达14.0 dB，同时保持轻量计算：仅3.3M参数、19.8G MACs。

Conclusion: 非对称时间建模与全局引导对高效鲁棒的多模态融合具有显著潜力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-scale design is crucial for efficient audio-visual speech separation, yet effectively modeling multi-scale information for audio-visual feature fusion remains challenging. We argue that the limited capacity of existing approaches primarily arises from: 1) treating features from different modalities in the same manner, and 2) overlooking the role of global features. To address these issues, we propose a Global-guided Asymmetric Attention Network (GAANet). Our model introduces two core innovations: first, an asymmetric multi-scale fusion framework that allows audio and visual streams to extract and interact with features at their respective optimal temporal resolutions, removing the need for symmetric temporal downsampling; second, a global-guided attention mechanism that compresses each modality into a compact global token with a temporal dimension of one, which then provides high-level semantic cues to guide both intra- and inter-modal fusion across scales. Experiments on LRS2 and VoxCeleb2 demonstrate that GAANet achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 16.5 dB SI-SNRi on LRS2 and 14.0 dB on VoxCeleb2, while maintaining a lightweight computational profile with only 3.3M parameters and 19.8G MACs. These results highlight the strong potential of asymmetric temporal modeling and global guidance for efficient and robust multimodal fusion. The source code is publicly accessible at https://github.com/redizzy/GAANet

</details>


### [504] [What Actually Makes Correlation-Based SSL Distillation Noise-Robust? A Mechanistic Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02823)
*Fabian Ritter-Gutierrez,Nancy F. Chen,Eng Siong Chng*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文通过消融实验反驳了先前工作的归因,证明在相关蒸馏中真正带来噪声鲁棒性的是互相关项(尤其其对角部分),而非自相关项;自相关项只重组特征空间、提升干净下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督语音模型精度高但体积大,知识蒸馏可压缩,但学生会丢失教师的噪声鲁棒性。基于相关的蒸馏用互相关对齐师生表示、用自相关去相关学生特征,但原方法与De'HuBERT都未经隔离验证就将噪声鲁棒性归功于自相关项。

Method: 在LibriSpeech-100蒸馏、CHiME-3留出噪声10dB条件下,采用无偏全维探针、Pearson方差分解、同噪声因果控制以及逐维度分析,并跨九项语音与音乐任务进行验证。

Result: 互相关对角项是促成噪声不变性的机制,使噪声分类准确率从76.98%降至55.02%;将自相关项加回后仍为55.55%。自相关项重组特征空间并提升干净下游任务精度,但几乎不带来噪声鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 给出蒸馏设计规则:用互相关项加权以获得噪声鲁棒性,用自相关项调节下游性能,并让师生噪声独立采样。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) speech models are accurate but large. Knowledge distillation compresses them, but the student loses the teacher's noise robustness. Correlation-based distillation addresses this with two terms: cross-correlation aligning student and teacher's representations, and self-correlation decorrelating the student's features. Both the original method and De'HuBERT credited the self-correlation term without isolating it. We show the opposite. On LibriSpeech-100 distillation with held-out CHiME-3 noise at 10\,dB, an unbiased full-dimensional probe, a Pearson-variance decomposition, a same-noise causal control, and a per-dimension analysis identify the cross-correlation diagonal as the mechanism that encourages noise invariance, lowering noise-classification accuracy from 76.98\% to 55.02\%, whereas adding the self-correlation term back leaves it at 55.55\%. The self-correlation term instead reorganises the feature space and improves accuracy on the clean downstream tasks, but removes essentially no noise. Across nine speech and music tasks this yields a concrete design rule for distillation: weight the cross-correlation term for noise robustness, tune the self-correlation term for better downstream performance, and sample teacher and student noise independently.

</details>


### [505] [Correlation-Based Distillation Yields More Mergeable Speech-Music Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02836)
*Fabian Ritter-Gutierrez*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 用相关性损失 \Lcl{} 替换蒸馏损失 \Lkd{}，可使语音与音乐学生模型在权重插值和激活置换两种合并算法下都更好地融合为单一编码器，且语音任务表现一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一紧凑编码器同时处理语音与音乐，可免去按领域分别维护模型。已有两种合并算法（共享初始化下的权重插值、通道置换对齐后平均），但先前工作固定蒸馏损失，未探究损失本身是否影响合并效果。

Method: 保持架构与评测不变，将 DistilHuBERT 的蒸馏损失 \Lkd{} 替换为基于相关性的损失 \Lcl{}，在权重插值和激活置换两种合并流程下分别比较学生模型的可合并性。

Result: 权重插值下，\Lcl{} 学生在 18 组比较中有 17 组更靠近各自更优端点，并在所有插值权重下语音任务领先；激活置换下，三层需重排的通道更少、匹配通道相关性更强，语音任务同样领先。

Conclusion: 两种合并算法机制彼此独立，却在同一损失替换下同时受益，说明增益来源于 \Lcl{} 所产生的表征，而非某一具体合并算法。

Abstract: A single compact encoder for both speech and music removes the need to maintain a separate model per domain. A practical recipe distils a speech teacher and a music teacher into two small students, then merges them into one model. Two merging algorithms exist: interpolating the student weights from a shared initialisation, or permuting their channels into alignment before averaging. Prior work fixed the distillation loss in both, leaving open whether the loss itself affects how well the students merge. We show that it does. Holding architecture and evaluation fixed, we replace the DistilHuBERT loss \Lkd{} with a correlation-based loss \Lcl{}. Under weight interpolation, \Lcl{} students stay closer to their own better endpoint in $17$ of $18$ comparisons and lead on the speech tasks at every interpolated weight. Under activation permutation, they need fewer channels rearranged at three layers, their matched channels correlate more strongly, and they again lead on speech. The two merging algorithms share no mechanism, yet both improve under the same loss substitution. This suggests that the gain lies in the representation \Lcl{} produces rather than in either algorithm.

</details>


### [506] [How Far Back Should a Transformer Look? Repetition and Copying in Music Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02837)
*Amir Fathi*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 在符号音乐自回归建模中，长上下文带来的预测增益主要来自对先前出现过的、与目标16-token历史完全相同的片段的“精确复制”，而非对长程音乐结构的抽象建模；该效应在含有大量重复记号的记谱数据上显著，在重复较少的演奏与乐谱数据上明显减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望厘清两个问题：自回归符号音乐模型的预测性能究竟如何随可用最大上下文长度T变化，以及长上下文模型实际利用了哪些信息。此前有草稿报告性能在16个token即饱和，本文试图通过严格控制变量的实验重新审视上下文长度收益的来源，并揭示可能的方法学偏差。

Method: 训练一个小型因果Transformer，分别在T∈{6, 18, 48, 96, 192, 336}各长度下独立训练，并在相同的目标位置上评估；评估同时在原始token与非重叠二值隐变量码两种表示上进行。为定位增益来源，作者追踪目标16-token历史在上下文中的早前出现：检验“精确复制”的因果作用——覆盖该出现会消除增益，而等量的无关损坏不会；并设置简单复制基线（copy baseline）量化可被复制解释的比例。另用训练好的336-token模型在测试时限制为仅可见近期token，以验证增益是否可被剥夺。最后对早前草稿进行审计。
