Result: 在Nottingham民谣上，token预测器的测试NLL从6到336 token下降71%（0.986 bits/token）；在足够长以覆盖同一扫描范围的O'Neill's曲调（302首测试曲中的129首）上同样下降71%。该长上下文增益大部分由精确复制解释：当目标16-token历史的早前出现进入上下文时增益出现，覆盖该出现即消除增益，而等量的无关损坏不消除增益，简单复制基线可复现94%的下降。训练好的336-token模型在测试时若只能看到近期token，也会失去大部分增益。由于许多重复源自乐谱中被展开的书面反复记号，该结果特定于此种渲染乐谱表示。相比之下，在MAESTRO演奏与MusicNet乐谱上，精确重复明显更少，NLL下降较小（9%与18%），且大部分在96 token即已获得。审计发现早前草稿存在划分泄漏、重叠隐变量感受野、均值预测器与按文件速度网格等问题。

Conclusion: 符号音乐中的长上下文收益在很大程度上并非来自对深层音乐结构的建模，而是对先前出现的重复片段的精确复制；其幅度随数据中精确重复频率而变。因此上下文长度评测需警惕数据划分泄漏、感受野重叠与基线设计等陷阱，并明确所适用的记谱表示。

Abstract: We investigate how predictive performance depends on the maximum context available to an autoregressive model of symbolic music, and what information long-context models exploit. A small causal Transformer is trained separately at each context length T in {6, 18, 48, 96, 192, 336} and evaluated on the same target positions, both over raw tokens and over non-overlapping binary latent codes. On Nottingham folk tunes, the token predictor's test NLL decreases by 71% (0.986 bits per token) between 6 and 336 tokens, and by 71% on the O'Neill's tunes long enough for the same sweep (129 of 302 test tunes). Most of the long-context gain is explained by exact copying: the improvement appears when an earlier occurrence of the target's 16-token history enters the available context; overwriting that occurrence removes the gain, whereas equally large unrelated corruption does not; and a simple copy baseline recovers 94% of the reduction. A trained 336-token model likewise loses most of this gain when its history is restricted to recent tokens at test time. Because many repeats arise from written repeat signs expanded in the score, this result pertains specifically to these rendered score representations. By contrast, on MAESTRO performances and MusicNet scores, where exact repeats are substantially less frequent, the reduction is smaller (9% and 18%) and is largely attained by 96 tokens. Finally, an audit of an earlier draft that reported saturation at 16 tokens identified split leakage, overlapping latent receptive fields, an averaging predictor, and a per-file tempo grid; we present these as methodological checks for context-length measurements.

</details>


### [507] [Harmonic Eigenspace: A Web-based Application for Navigating and Composing Microtonal Harmony](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03398)
*David Dalmazzo,Ken Déguernel*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于"谐波特征空间"（四维、以Sethares粗糙度/不协和度模型为基础）的网页应用，用于导航与创作微分音和声，并包含53-TET调式工作室及MIDI控制器功能，辅以31人听感实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微分音和声缺乏直观的导航与创作工具；需要一种以心理声学为依据、移调不变的空间来组织四音和弦（tetrad），并验证听众对微分音和弦与进行的接受度。

Method: 构建"谐波特征空间"：以Sethares粗糙度/不协和度模型计算四音和弦的频谱不协和度剖面；坐标系移调不变，坐标三元组(α, β, γ)确定上方三音与根音的关系（和弦性质对应空间中的方向，根频率决定尺度）。计算任意音区的不协和度场，其局部极小值位置具有音区不变性（源于分音重合比条件）。空间中100个局部极小值对应纯律音程，构成地标并划分出以最协和四音和弦为中心的"盆地"。将三种调性等分律的四音和弦作为离散格嵌入该连续体。应用含两部分：可导航的3D不协和度体可视化（所有节点可发声）与将调式互换逻辑扩展至53-TET十级音程词汇的Modal Studio；同时作为支持MIDI复音表情（MPE）的MIDI控制器。听感实验31人，先评定孤立53-TET和弦与maj7、m7等熟悉和弦，再评定Modal Studio创作的进行，测量对首次听到的微分音进行的接受/拒绝。

Result: 不协和度场含100个与纯律音程对齐的局部极小值，位置音区不变；四音和弦格嵌入连续体；应用实现3D可视化、Modal Studio与MPE MIDI控制；31名参与者完成对孤立和弦及进行评定的听感研究。

Conclusion: 该工作将心理声学不协和度模型转化为可导航、可演奏的微分音和声创作环境，为微分音和声的组织、创作与评估提供统一框架。

Abstract: This paper presents a web-based application for navigating and composing microtonal harmony, built on the Harmonic Eigenspace, a four-dimensional psychoacoustically grounded space in which tetrad chord types are located by their spectral dissonance profiles, computed with Sethares's roughness/dissonance model. The coordinate system is transposition-invariant: a coordinate triple (α, \b{eta}, γ) locates the three upper notes in relation to the root, so a chord quality corresponds to a direction in the space, the invariant ray along which transposition acts, while the root frequency sets the scale. The dissonance field over these coordinates can be computed at any register; the locations of its local minima are register-invariant, as they arise from partial-coincidence ratio conditions. The dissonance volume contains 100 local minima that align with just-intonation intervals and act as landmarks, organising the space into basins around the most consonant tetrads. We embed tetrads from three tonal equal temperaments as discrete lattices within this continuous volume. The application presents this space through two components: the Harmonic Eigenspace as a navigable 3D visualisation of the dissonance volume in which all nodes are playable, and a Modal Studio that extends modal interchange logic to the ten-gradation interval vocabulary of 53-TET. The application also functions as a MIDI controller with MIDI Polyphonic Expression support, usable in any digital audio workstation that supports this format. A listening study with 31 participants used both scenes of the application: listeners first rated isolated 53-TET chords alongside chords familiar from Western practice, such as the maj7 and the m7; they then rated chord progressions composed in the Modal Studio, measuring their acceptance or rejection of microtonal progressions heard for the first time.

</details>


### [508] [PEACE: Joint Embeddings of DSP Effects Code and Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03405)
*David Braun,Adam Finkelstein*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出 PEACE，首个音频效果代码与输出音频的联合嵌入模型，用共享多模态目标将音频编码器与两种 Faust 代码编码器对齐，实现音效链拓扑与参数的解耦检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频效果处理链的检索与生成缺乏能同时理解"拓扑结构"与"参数设置"的表示，且现有监督方法在有序链拓扑恢复上存在局限。

Method: 沿用 SLAP 多模态目标，将 AFx-Rep 音频编码器与两个 Faust 代码编码器配对：一是微调 T5 处理 Faust 源码；二是基于 Faust 编译器中间表示的图神经网络，捕捉拓扑与 UI 参数；推理时通过掩码 UI 参数使嵌入仅编码效果链拓扑。

Result: 参数可见时，两种代码编码器在混合长度链检索上持平，在单效果库上各有取舍；参数完全掩码时，PEACE 远高于随机的有序链拓扑恢复且不受监督方法限制；在分布外混响检索基准上优于预训练模型，并可提升冻结的纯音频表示。

Conclusion: PEACE 对拓扑与参数的双重理解，为可基于 DSP 代码进行搜索、生成与条件控制的音乐信息检索系统奠定基础。

Abstract: This paper introduces PEACE, the first joint embedding of audio effect code and output audio. Building on SLAP's multimodal objective, we pair an AFx-Rep audio encoder with two code encoders for Faust, a functional language for audio signal processing. First, we evaluate a fine-tuned T5 transformer over Faust source code. Second, we evaluate a message-passing graph neural network over an intermediate representation of the Faust compiler, capturing both topology and UI parameters. We evaluate on audio-to-code retrieval, where masking UI parameters at inference yields embeddings that encode effect chain topology alone. When parameters are visible, the two code encoders tie on retrieval of mixed-length chains but have tradeoffs on single-effect galleries. With parameters fully masked, PEACE recovers ordered chain topology far above chance without the limitations of supervised methods. PEACE outperforms pretrained models on an out-of-distribution reverb retrieval benchmark and can improve frozen audio-only representations. Its dual understanding of topology and parameters lays the groundwork for music information retrieval systems that search, generate, and condition on DSP code.

</details>


### [509] [Rubric-Based Optimization for Text-to-Music Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03589)
*Ping Wang,Guang Yang,Shao-Rong Su,Junkai Wu,Pang Wei Koh,Noah A. Smith*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 论文研究基于预训练音频-语言模型（ALM）的评分量表（rubric）奖励，作为自回归与扩散式音乐生成器的后训练信号，并在多指标与客观属性任务上验证其有效性与适用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐质量是多维度的，单一自动指标难以全面刻画。后训练文本到音乐生成需要能反映多方面的奖励信号，因此需要探究结构化评分量表奖励的可行性，并与专门化的客观奖励进行对比。

Method: 用ALM对每个生成片段按评分量表打分，将同一文本提示下生成的候选按分数排序，转化为偏好对，对MusicGen-small和ACE-Step v1进行DPO；同时把量表分数直接作为标量奖励，对ACE-Step v1进行DiffusionNFT。另在节奏、调性、配器这三个存在精确客观奖励的属性上，直接优化专门化奖励并与量表奖励对比。

Result: 在MusicCaps上，基于量表的优化同时提升CLAP、SongEval和Audiobox-Aesthetics，其中ACE-Step上的DiffusionNFT增益最强。而在MusicGen-small上，用任一自动评估器构造偏好都会产生明显的跨指标权衡：目标评估器提升，其他独立评估器下降。节奏与配器上直接优化专门奖励可稳定提升目标属性，量表的迁移仅部分有效；调性上量表无显著提升。

Conclusion: 结果提示一种分工：ALM评分量表适合优化难以形式化的宽泛感知质量，而当存在可靠测量时，专门化的客观奖励仍是更优选择。

Abstract: Post-training text-to-music generation requires reward signals that capture multiple aspects of musical quality beyond what any single automatic metric can measure. We study structured, rubric-based rewards from pretrained audio-language models (ALMs) as training signals for both autoregressive and diffusion-based music generators. An ALM scores each generated clip against the rubric; we rank candidates generated for the same text prompt by their scores and convert these rankings into preference pairs for DPO on both MusicGen-small and ACE-Step~v1, and additionally use the rubric scores directly as scalar rewards for DiffusionNFT on ACE-Step~v1. On MusicCaps, rubric-based optimization improves CLAP, SongEval, and Audiobox-Aesthetics simultaneously, with the strongest gains obtained by DiffusionNFT on ACE-Step. By contrast, on MusicGen-small, building preferences from any one of these automatic evaluators produces clear cross-metric trade-offs: the targeted evaluator improves while other independent evaluators deteriorate. We further study tempo, key, and instrumentation, where precise objective rewards are available. Directly optimizing these specialized rewards reliably improves the target attributes, whereas ALM rubrics provide only partial transfer for tempo and instrumentation and no measurable improvement for key. Together, these results suggest a practical division of labor: ALM rubrics are effective for broad perceptual qualities that are difficult to formalize, while specialized objective rewards remain preferable when reliable measurements are available.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [510] [World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02323)
*Jie He,Wei Li,Junwen Tong,Rui Shao,Wei-Shi Zheng,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ProAct 框架，将流式 VLA 策略的生成源本身变为可预测的：由近期动作生成场景感知假设，经预测未来校验后构造以提议为中心的各向异性源分布，在提升性能的同时减少 50% 去噪步数、最高降低 25.8% 推理延迟、提升 34.8% 吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流的 VLA 策略从任务无关的各向同性高斯源采样动作块。该源既不条件于近期执行历史，也不条件于预测的未来演化，因此：(i) 丢弃了近期已执行动作建立的局部连续性；(ii) 即使引入预测性世界表示，也通常只条件化传输动力学，而不决定生成起点、允许的偏离范围以及可扩展的动作方向。

Method: ProAct 为 world-calibrated proposal-to-action 框架，包含三部分：(1) 轻量 Proposal Expert 通过一步运动锚定的端点流匹配，将近期动作转换为场景感知假设，使生成初始化在示范动作流形附近，以保持运动连续性；(2) 前瞻性 World Expert 将该假设作为软运动先验，预测任务一致的潜未来，从而同时刻画预期场景演化与提议—未来兼容性；(3) 基于该兼容性校准以提议为中心的各向异性源：用有界的每步范围控制允许偏离，并在条件数预算下以迹归一化低秩几何在平移、旋转、夹爪等耦合方向上分配细化。

Result: 相比 π0.5，ProAct 在仿真与真实世界任务上均提升性能，同时减少 50% 去噪步数，推理延迟最高降低 25.8%，吞吐最高提升 34.8%。

Conclusion: 将生成源由任务无关各向同性分布改为由近期执行与预测未来共同校准的提议中心各向异性分布，可同时改善动作连续性与未来兼容性，并在保持或提升任务性能的前提下显著降低推理成本。

Abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion. (ii) Even when predictive world representations are introduced, they often only condition the transport dynamics rather than determine where generation starts, how far it may deviate, or along which action directions it may expand. Building on this observation, we introduce ProAct, a world-calibrated proposal-to-action framework that makes the generative source itself predictable. (i) To preserve motion continuity, a lightweight Proposal Expert converts recent actions into a scene-aware hypothesis via one motion-anchored endpoint flow-matching step, initializing generation near the demonstrated action manifold. (ii) To jointly capture intended scene evolution and proposal-future compatibility, a prospective World Expert treats the hypothesis as a soft motion prior while predicting the task-consistent latent future. (iii) From this compatibility, the model calibrates a proposal-centered anisotropic source, where a bounded per-step extent controls the allowed deviation and a trace-normalized low-rank geometry under a condition-number budget allocates refinement over coupled translation, rotation, and gripper directions. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, ProAct improves performance across simulation and real-world tasks while reducing denoising steps by 50%, inference latency by up to 25.8%, and increasing throughput by up to 34.8%.

</details>


### [511] [GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02697)
*Yixuan Jiang,Wentong Li,An Liu,Zihao Xin,Fulin Tang,Cong Leng,Yang Gao,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 GeoScaffold 几何监督框架，在训练阶段一次性将3D几何内化进流式 Video-LLM 导航策略，推理时无需深度传感器、3D编码器或逐步工具调用，即可持续超越纯视觉导航器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式 Video-LLM 导航策略直接从第一视角RGB与指令映射到低层动作，但其2D预训练带来的3D几何先验薄弱；现有几何增强方案需在推理时持续付出代价（深度传感器、3D编码器或每步感知工具调用），不利于轻量化边缘部署。

Method: 先用训练轨迹的深度图学习一个紧凑的深度分词器并冻结；再以少量可学习的几何查询 token 微调策略，训练其隐状态重建导航关键几何（深度、连通性、可通行性）；该监督使查询状态成为用于动作解码的紧凑几何隐变量，并通过共享权重把几何内化进骨干表示。训练后丢弃分词器、目标生成器与重建头，骨干与动作接口保持不变。

Result: 在连续 VLN 基准上，GeoScaffold 一致优于领先的纯视觉导航器，为具备空间感知的具身导航模型提供了轻量边缘部署范式。

Conclusion: 几何监督可作为“脚手架”，仅在训练阶段付出代价，将3D几何永久内化到策略参数中；推理时无额外感知开销、模型结构不变，是兼顾空间感知与部署效率的实用范式。

Abstract: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.

</details>


### [512] [FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02832)
*Yoojin Oh,Jeongsol Kim,Yeonwoo Seo,Jangho Park,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Youngmin Kim,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FastOPD框架，通过on-policy蒸馏把大规模VLA基础模型压缩为轻量学生模型，实现少步甚至单步推理的高效部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA基础模型规模快速扩大虽提升了操作性能与泛化能力，但带来高昂计算成本，使真实部署愈发困难；现有方案多依赖缩小架构或减少流式策略的迭代去噪步数，效果和灵活性有限。

Method: FastOPD采用foundation-to-lightweight范式：为单状态教师监督适配flow map，并结合自一致性（self-consistency）目标，训练紧凑学生模型学习教师动态；理论上证明最小化该目标可使学生恢复与理想少步教师模型相当的分布。以π0.5、LingBot-VLA、MolmoAct2等为教师，并验证其在World Action Model上的适用性。

Result: LIBERO上仅两步推理即保留π0.5性能的84%，推理时延降低78.1%，平均成功率优于现有少步蒸馏基线；以LingBot-VLA为教师时，RoboTwin 2.0单步成功率较基础学生提升15.9个百分点；并成功将MolmoAct2蒸馏的紧凑学生部署到真实机器人。

Conclusion: FastOPD为大规模VLA基础模型的高效落地提供了可行路径，兼顾性能保持与推理加速，并可推广至WAM及真实机器人部署。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

</details>


### [513] [PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02840)
*Chunghyun Park,Beomjun Kim,Seungcheol Park,Heeseung Kwon,Yashu Shukla,Seunghoon Sim,Jinwoo Shin,Minsu Cho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PointWAM 将世界分解为场景与手部，在统一时空坐标系中以 3D 点轨迹联合预测二者演化，并将预测手部运动重定向为机器人动作，实现灵巧操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型多以 RGB 帧或隐式表征表示世界、以末端位姿或关节角表示动作，难以刻画灵巧操作所依赖的 3D 空间结构与接触几何。同时，缺乏任务特定物体或关键点选择使得大规模人类演示视频难以直接用于预训练。

Method: 提出 PointWAM：将世界解耦为场景（环境）与手部（执行者），在共享时空坐标系内以 3D 点轨迹联合预测二者的协同演化；输入为彩色点云与语言指令，输出为场景与手部的 3D 未来轨迹，再将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作。该显式解耦表征支持无需物体或关键点标注的大规模人类视频预训练。训练信号包含人类视频预训练与场景轨迹监督。

Result: 人类视频预训练使 DexJoCo 平均成功率提升 56.9 个百分点；场景轨迹监督在仅预测手部的基础上再提升 10.9 个百分点；两者结合后在十个 DexJoCo 任务上超越此前最优方法 11.7 个百分点，并在真机任务上优于强 VLA 基线。

Conclusion: 以场景-手部解耦的 3D 点轨迹作为世界与动作的统一表示，可有效利用无标注人类视频并显著提升灵巧操作性能，验证了显式 3D 几何建模在世界动作模型中的价值。

Abstract: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.

</details>


### [514] [From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02974)
*Simon Schwaiger,David Seyser,Alessandro Scherl,Zlatan Ajanović,Wilfried Wöber,Gerald Steinbauer-Wagner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种样本高效的可通行性估计方法，在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中以von Mises-Fisher混合原型表示可通行性，利用自然语言规则作为常识先验，并通过稀疏相对图像标注对原型方向与效用进行微调以实现域适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图像的可通行性估计高度依赖机器人平台、部署域和任务偏好，导致专用训练的模型适用性受限。为促进域适应，本文希望借助样本高效偏好学习来减少目标域所需的标注数量。

Method: 在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中，用von Mises-Fisher混合原型表示可通行性；以相对自然语言规则提供常识先验，并利用稀疏的相对图像标注，通过计算与样本均高效的微调来调整原型方向与效用，从而实现目标域适应。

Result: 在WayFAST上的实验表明，其精度可与端到端训练的估计器相当，同时支持样本高效的图像域适应。定性实验进一步验证了语言先验的零样本适用性，以及微调后估计器在语义图上更优的稠密预测效果；并通过剖析语义相近的自然语言提示，对学习到的原型进行了语义解释。

Conclusion: 该方法通过冻结视觉-语言特征空间中的混合原型与语言先验，结合稀疏相对标注的微调，实现了样本高效且可解释的跨域可通行性估计，兼顾精度与适应效率。

Abstract: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io

</details>


### [515] [HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03283)
*Patrick Wolf,Mateo de Mayo,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HexVIO系统，将立体惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载至Hexagon DSP，实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，可在0.83W下维持30fps实时跟踪约18小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间计算要求设备具备自主定位能力，视觉惯性里程计（VIO）是低成本且准确的方案，广泛应用于机器人、可穿戴设备、XR设备和无人机。高效VIO实现可带来更凉、更轻、更便宜且续航更长的设备与更好体验。现代智能手机和XR设备普遍搭载Hexagon DSP等商用协处理器，具备被利用以提升VIO效率的潜力。

Method: 将立体惯性里程计系统的视觉前端卸载到Hexagon DSP，后端保留在主CPU上；并针对DSP架构对实现进行优化，充分利用协处理器的并行与能效特性。

Result: 在商用智能手机上，HexVIO相比纯CPU执行实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，并能在0.83W功耗下长时间维持30fps实时跟踪，对应测试设备上约18小时跟踪时长。

Conclusion: 结果表明商用DSP有潜力支撑机器人与移动设备中的全天候视觉惯性跟踪，验证了将视觉前端卸载至DSP以提升VIO效率的可行性。

Abstract: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.

</details>


### [516] [I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03453)
*Qian Wang,Liam Merz Hoffmeister,Brian Scassellati,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: I2CD 从单张 RGB 图像直接预测凸分解，冻结预训练 Hunyuan3D-2 扩散 Transformer 与形状解码器，仅训练 38M 参数、不到十 GPU 小时的轻量级交叉注意力头，通过"凸槽"token 输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理仿真器和运动规划器需要凸碰撞几何，而图像到 3D 生成模型输出的是稠密、常为非流形的视觉网格。现有桥接方案依赖"先重建后分解"的慢速且脆弱流程，包括修复、抽稀和近似凸分解，难以直接用于物理引擎。

Method: 冻结预训练 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件扩散 Transformer 和形状解码器，仅训练一个 38M 参数、不到十 GPU 小时的轻量级交叉注意力头；其学习的"凸槽"token 直接输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数。

Result: 在 227 个留出的 OmniObject3D 和 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，I2CD 在八条"先重建后分解"流程中取得最高体积 IoU，端到端速度快 6–37 倍，每张图像约 0.5 秒。在 MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis 和 Isaac Sim 的跨仿真器研究中，所有引擎都直接使用 I2CD 几何；原始生成网格虽能"加载"，但多数情况下被静默替换为不同碰撞形状，或需要数秒到数分钟的逐对象预处理。在物理 xArm7 上，I2CD 为 20 个物体的杂乱场景生成规划就绪几何需 11 秒，而最强基线需 328 秒，抓放执行成功率相当（100 次试验中 85 对 90）。

Conclusion: I2CD 可从单张 RGB 图像直接输出紧凑、天然凸且无需后处理即可载入物理引擎的凸分解，在精度、速度和物理可用性上优于"先重建后分解"流程，并已在多种仿真器及真实机器人抓放任务中验证有效性。

Abstract: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).

</details>


### [517] [XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03516)
*Tingting Du,Ziyao Wang,Guoheng Sun,Ang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: XGenAct 是一种世界动作模型，将 RGB 观察、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线和功能角色分割统一编码为 RGB 视频，用单一视频扩散 Transformer 和单一目标学习时空预测，无需模态专用头，在 RLBench 上取得 52% 成功率（最强基线 26%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型基于 RGB 与动作预测未来，未显式建模机器人操作所需的场景空间理解（深度、法线、功能角色等）；已有方案多通过专用预测头或分支补充有限空间任务，导致空间监督范围受限且模型架构割裂。

Method: XGenAct 通过确定性编解码器（codecs）将 RGB 观察、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线、功能角色分割统一表示为 RGB 视频；训练时对感知与动作任务进行采样，采用单个视频扩散 Transformer 与单一目标函数学习跨空间的时间预测，避免模态专用学习头。

Result: 在 RLBench 留出任务上，结构化感知训练相比仅 RGB 训练提升闭环平均成功率；在五任务外部对比中 XGenAct 成功率达 52%，最强评估基线为 26%；此外其预测未来深度与分割的精度优于"先生成 RGB、再应用冻结感知专家"的评估流程。

Conclusion: 将多类空间感知信号通过统一视频表示与单一扩散目标联合训练，可有效提升世界动作模型的闭环操作性能与空间预测精度，验证了统一架构优于分散模态头的设计思路。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.

</details>


### [518] [Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02274)
*Awomo-PhysicalRSI Team,Danjiao Ma,Enhui Ma,Haohan Liu,Heng Jia,Hui Shan,Jianhua Xu,Jiahuan Zhang,Jiangdi Xu,Kaiwen Guo,Kaicheng Yu,Linwei Zhang,Liyang Jin,Maochun Luo,Pengyao Niu,Shiwen Li,Shuangyu Feng,Tong Zhang,Tianheng Wang,Xin Wang,Xiangru Huang,Yongqiang Huang,Zhaozhi Wang,Zijian Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Awomo-SimDataEngine系统，将资产/场景生成与机器人演示合成串联，在LIBERO-Plus上通过Isaac Sim演示协同训练将WAM成功率从77.17%提升至89.43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人训练数据生成不能只追求视觉逼真，还需物体可交互、摆放物理有效、任务可重复执行，现有流程难以同时满足这些要求。

Method: 构建智能体式系统Awomo-SimDataEngine，包含共享资产服务（ISArt支持刚体与铰接物体的结构约束部件与关节生成）、双路径场景生成（Unravel从图像重建可编辑场景、SimForge从文本构建单/多房间环境）、图原生harness进行构建-验证-有界修复并将失败路由至责任模块、PolicyForge将验证后世界与任务及机器人本体绑定以生成可回放演示。

Result: 评估覆盖资产几何、场景质量与下游策略学习；在MuJoCo-based LIBERO-Plus上，与Isaac Sim演示协同训练使WAM总体成功率由77.17%升至89.43%，目标与空间成功率分别提升31.66和6.25个百分点，长时程任务增益有限。

Conclusion: 生成数据对跨模拟器策略训练具有实用价值，但长时程任务仍是瓶颈。

Abstract: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively.These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [519] [SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02338)
*Jingyun Yang,Baiyu Shi,Timothy Yu,Haitian Liu,Alberta Longhini,Weichen Wang,Rika Antonova,Zhenan Bao,Jeannette Bohg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出低成本电容式触觉皮肤SoTa，实现人手与机器人手全掌覆盖下的统一202-taxel布局，验证了人-机共同训练可显著提升接触丰富操作任务的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-触觉机器人数据稀缺：灵巧演示依赖遥操作，限制数据集规模；人类演示采集成本低，但要用于跨本体数据扩展，前提是人与机器人手佩戴信号对应的触觉传感器，要求传感器能贴合不同手部几何、覆盖全手、且跨本体共享布局。

Method: 提出SoTa电容式触觉皮肤：多层结构配合织物电极，可自制薄软皮肤并按需定制几何，单张材料成本低于10美元；在人与机器人的对应手指与手掌区域保持202个taxel的统一布局；该共享布局支持以通用触觉编码器进行人-机共同训练，无需学习跨传感器映射。评估涵盖耐久性测试与三个接触丰富操作任务。

Result: 传感器经过10,000次加载-卸载循环后仍保留超过97%的初始响应跨度，在1,280次紧握拳折叠循环中走线保持连续；相比纯视觉策略，触觉观测提升分布内成功率；在固定机器人演示预算下，加入人类演示使八个评估条件下的平均成功率从22.8%提升至45.9%（提升逾一倍），并在全部五个分布外条件下均有改善。

Conclusion: SoTa以低成本、可定制、跨本体共享布局的触觉皮肤，解决了人-机触觉数据可用性问题，并通过共同训练显著提升接触丰富操作的成功率与泛化性；作者计划开源制造与使用所需资源。

Abstract: A growing body of work suggests that tactile sensing gives robot policies contact information that complements vision in dexterous manipulation. However, visuo-tactile robot data remains scarce: dexterous demonstrations require teleoperating robots, which limits dataset scale. Human demonstrations are far cheaper to collect and offer a path to scale this data, but only if human and robot hands carry tactile sensors with corresponding signals. This requires sensors that conform to different hand geometries, cover the full hand, and share a common layout across embodiments. We present SoTa, a low-cost capacitive tactile skin that provides full-hand coverage on humans and robots while preserving a shared layout of 202 taxels across corresponding finger and palm regions. Our multilayer design with fabric electrodes enables in-house fabrication of thin, soft skins with customizable geometry for under $10 in materials per skin. The sensor retains over 97% of its initial response span after 10,000 loading-unloading cycles with traces retaining continuity through 1,280 tight-fist folding cycles. The shared taxel layout supports human-robot co-training with a common tactile encoder and no learned cross-sensor mapping. Across three contact-rich manipulation tasks, tactile observations improve in-distribution success over vision-only policies. With a fixed robot demonstration budget, adding human demonstrations more than doubles mean success across eight evaluation conditions, from 22.8% to 45.9%, improving success in all five out-of-distribution conditions. We plan to open-source the resources needed to fabricate and operate these skins.

</details>


### [520] [NEEDLEWORK: Offline Rewriting of Robot Data with Verified Local Stitches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02339)
*Juntao Ren,Yifan Hou,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: NEEDLE是一种离线数据集增强算法，通过在高维机器人演示的已有观测之间添加短且有验证的动作桥，实现轨迹缝合，无需新环境交互或特权状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人演示中即使单条轨迹低效或失败也包含有用行为，轨迹缝合可将其组合成更优训练数据。但在高维机器人数据中，识别有效连接并验证其可行性很困难，已有方法多依赖低维状态表示。

Method: NEEDLE首先仅利用RGB图像、本体感觉和情节级结果，识别并创建能够绕过次优绕路、扩大动作覆盖的连接，并将失败轨迹纳入数据集增强；随后提出一种采样技术，将已被接受的桥接纳入策略训练，不合成中间图像，也不丢弃原始演示。

Result: 在真实机器人任务上，NEEDLE相较于每个任务上最强基线，成功率平均提升21个百分点。

Conclusion: NEEDLE证明了无新环境交互、无特权状态条件下，利用动作桥进行高维机器人演示的轨迹缝合与数据集增强，可有效提升策略学习性能，同时保留原始数据的覆盖性。

Abstract: Robot demonstrations may contain useful behavior even when individual episodes are inefficient or unsuccessful. Trajectory stitching offers a way to compose these behaviors into improved training data, but identifying useful connections and verifying their feasibility is difficult in high-dimensional robot data, where many prior methods rely on low-dimensional state representations. We introduce NEEDLE, an offline dataset-augmentation algorithm that addresses these challenges by adding short, verified action bridges between recorded observations in high-dimensional robot demonstrations. First, NEEDLE identifies and creates connections that bypass suboptimal detours, broaden action coverage, and augment the original dataset with failed trajectories, using only RGB images, proprioception, and episode-level outcomes, without new environment interaction or privileged object state. Next, we present a sampling technique that incorporates accepted bridges into policy training without synthesizing intermediate images or discarding the original demonstrations, allowing policies to learn alternative actions while retaining the original dataset's coverage. On real-robot tasks, NEEDLE improves success rate over the strongest baseline on each task by an average of 21 percentage points. Videos and supplementary materials are on https://needle-work.github.io/.

</details>


### [521] [Filter-Aware Fine-Tuning for Safe Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02341)
*Pranit Mohnot,Christian Helten,Daniele Gammelli,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文揭示了人形机器人全身运动中"跟踪策略"与"运行时安全滤波器"独立处理时产生的动力学、目标与信息失配问题，并提出滤波器感知微调方法CoFiT来解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全全身运动对人形机器人在非结构化环境中部署至关重要。当前主流范式将参考指定与执行分离：由规划器、遥操作或运动生成器提供参考，强化学习策略在动力学可行范围内跟踪该参考。运行时安全滤波器（如CBF）可在跟踪器输出上施加干预以强制新约束，但作者指出，将跟踪策略与安全滤波器独立对待会引发根本性失配——滤波不仅改变执行动作，还会改变诱导的状态分布。

Method: 作者通过案例研究分析"策略-滤波器"接口，隔离出动力学失配、目标失配与信息失配三类问题并揭示其根因。基于这些洞察，提出CoFiT（Constrained Filter-aware Tuning），一种针对预训练跟踪器的滤波器感知微调方法。

Result: 在多种约束场景中，CoFiT相较仅滤波训练将违规时间在TWIST2上降低91%、在SONIC上降低21%，且所需安全滤波器修正更小。在Unitree G1硬件上，CoFiT使TWIST2的违规时间降低83%，并完成所有试验且无需操作员干预；而基线试验中有50%需要操作员紧急停止。

Conclusion: 研究提供了关于策略-滤波器交互的可操作洞察，并建立了将学习型跟踪器与运行时安全滤波器集成的设计原则。

Abstract: Safe whole-body motion is essential for deploying humanoid robots in unstructured environments. Modern humanoid control commonly separates reference specification from execution, with a planner, teleoperator, or motion generator providing a reference that a reinforcement-learning policy tracks through dynamically feasible whole-body control. Runtime safety filters, such as control barrier functions (CBFs), offer a promising approach for enforcing newly introduced constraints via interventions on the tracker's outputs. We show, however, that treating the tracking policy and safety filter independently induces fundamental mismatches, as filtering alters both the executed actions and the induced state distribution. We study this policy-filter interface through case studies that isolate dynamics, objective, and information mismatches, highlight their root causes, and use these insights to develop CoFiT (Constrained Filter-aware Tuning), a filter-aware fine-tuning method for pretrained trackers. Across diverse constraint scenes, CoFiT reduces violation time relative to filter-only training by 91% on TWIST2 and 21% on SONIC, while requiring smaller safety filter corrections. On Unitree G1 hardware, CoFiT reduces violation time by 83% for TWIST2 and completes every trial without operator intervention, whereas 50% of baseline trials require an operator stop. Together, these results provide actionable insights into policy-filter interactions and establish design principles for integrating learned trackers with runtime safety filters.

</details>


### [522] [SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02360)
*Sofya Konstantinova,Miguel Altamirano Cabrera,Artem Lykov,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SocialVLA是一个本地、策略无关的社会感知网关，将人类自发的语音韵律、面部/视觉反应及显式停止短语转化为VLA操作策略的运行时中断信号，并在Unitree G1上验证了从社会反应到物理中断与恢复的完整闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略虽能完成多样化的机器人操作任务，但执行过程中无法自我识别错误，导致失败发生。人类旁观者在机器人出现异常行为时会提前产生快速的发声、面部或言语反应，这类互补信号可在失败完成前提供干预线索，因此需要一种机制把自发的社会反应转化为运行时干预信号。

Method: 提出SocialVLA：本地、策略无关的社会感知网关，融合因果韵律音频检测、视觉反应识别、显式停止短语与机器人相关性估计；采用异步首事件融合机制，以最早达到足够置信度的信号触发VLA保持（hold），并通过独立语音通道采集言语纠正，用于参与者指示的继续、重启或指令修改。

Result: 在Unitree G1物理操作平台上由15名参与者开展评估，包含238个标注的应干预片段与1.038小时非干预行为。冻结模型离线回放达到54.6%召回率与69.5%精确率，未过滤的音视频融合召回率达64.3%；相关性估计将误停片段从100降至57，精确率由60.5%提升至69.8%。在第16名未见参与者的前瞻性部署中，冻结系统达到59.5%召回率与91.7%精确率。检测器到融合的中位延迟47.9 ms，VLA门控到物理保持延迟336 ms，反应发生到保持延迟1.021 s。

Conclusion: 结果表明存在一条完整的本地通路，可实现从自发社会反应到物理VLA中断以及参与者指示恢复的闭环，为人机协作中的运行时干预提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies enable diverse robotic manipulation but can fail during execution without recognizing their own errors. Human observers provide complementary signals, as unexpected robot behavior can trigger rapid vocal, facial, or verbal reactions before failure is completed. We introduce SocialVLA, a local, policy-agnostic social perception gateway that converts spontaneous human reactions into runtime intervention signals for VLA manipulation. SocialVLA combines causal paralinguistic audio detection, visual reaction recognition, explicit stop phrases, and robot-relevance estimation. An asynchronous first-event fusion mechanism triggers a VLA hold from the earliest sufficiently confident signal, while a separate speech channel captures verbal corrections for participant-directed continuation, restart, or instruction revision. We evaluate SocialVLA on physical Unitree G1 manipulation using 15 participants, with 238 annotated intervention-worthy episodes and 1.038 h of non-intervention behavior. Frozen offline replay achieves 54.6% recall and 69.5% precision, while unfiltered audio-video fusion reaches 64.3% recall. Relevance estimation reduces false-stop episodes from 100 to 57 and increases precision from 60.5% to 69.8%. In prospective deployment on an unseen 16th participant, the frozen system achieves 59.5% recall and 91.7% precision. Median detector-to-fusion latency is 47.9 ms, VLA-gate-to-physical-hold latency is 336 ms, and reaction-onset-to-hold latency is 1.021 s. These results demonstrate a complete local pathway from spontaneous social reaction to physical VLA interruption and participant-directed recovery.

</details>


### [523] [Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02368)
*Shukai Gong,Xuanran Zhai,Yintianrun Zhang,Ruopeng Cui,Ye Huang,Yiyang Fu,Dexuan Lyu,Chaojie Li,Xinyi Song,Peiwen Lin,Chuang Wang,Mingyuan Jia,Yufan Deng,Jiaxin Fang,Bo Liang,Jiaxin Li,Yuxiang Gao,Hao Liu,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出分层框架 ViGAR，将长时序组合操作任务分解为视觉子目标规划器与子目标执行器，两者共享预训练世界模型表示，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人部署需要完成包含多个协调子任务的长时序组合操作，而现有的世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽能联合预测短时程视觉未来与动作，却缺乏显式的子任务级推理能力，难以进行任务级规划。

Method: ViGAR 采用分层框架：给定当前观测与全局指令，视觉子目标规划器预测下一子任务的视觉子目标；子目标执行器以该子目标为条件，联合生成未来视觉轨迹与动作。两个组件共享预训练世界模型表示，从而共享物理知识；同时利用全局目标图像作为上下文即可实现上下文学习，无需参数更新即可产生不同的子任务分解与行为。

Result: 在 RoboTwin Clean2Random 基准上，ViGAR 在 Clean 与 Random 设置下分别取得 82.00% 和 67.02% 的成功率，平均成功率超过最强基线 12.86 个百分点。在五个组合任务和两个上下文学习任务的真实机器人实验进一步验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将显式子任务级规划与世界-动作建模结合，并通过共享世界模型表示统一规划与执行，能有效提升长时序组合操作性能，且天然支持无需参数更新的上下文学习。

Abstract: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.

</details>


### [524] [Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02398)
*Junyi Hu,Zhewen He,Zhenhua Li,Yi Fang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出将机器人演示编译为"效果程序"（对象3D关键点轨迹、抓取点、终态），并以世界-动作模型PEWAM将效果、执行、动作、终态解耦为四条具有独立流匹配时间的流；通过对程序钳制并采样执行流，将推理转化为"编程"并在实时场景中闭环求解。单条演示在LIBERO-Goal上完成40/90，远超基线（至多19），支持人类可编辑、跨四种机械臂零重训练迁移，并在真实Franka上由单段人类视频编译的程序完成36/40。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人演示同时编码了两类信息：对象发生了什么（效果）与某条特定机械臂如何实现（执行）。传统方法将二者纠缠在一起，导致学到的策略与特定机器人本体、特定演示轨迹强绑定，难以迁移、难以人为编辑、难以从单条演示泛化。作者希望只对"对象效果"进行条件建模，从而把"做什么"与"谁来做"解耦，使演示成为可编程、可复用、跨本体的抽象。

Method: 1) 将演示编译为"效果程序"：移去演示者后保留运动对象的3D关键点轨迹、每个对象的两个抓取标记点、以及场景终态配置。2) 提出PEWAM（71.5M参数的世界-动作模型），将效果、机器人执行、动作、终态表示为四个流，各流使用相互独立的flow-matching时间步。3) 推理时钳制效果程序并采样执行流，将推理形式化为"编程"，并从实时场景闭环重解。4) 程序为坐标集合，可直接由人编辑：位移改变终态、旋转改变接触点从而调整抓取朝向。5) 同一程序无需重训练即可迁移到四种机械臂；在Franka上以其他任务真实演示微调后，可直接编译单段人类视频为程序执行。

Result: 在LIBERO-Goal留出任务上，单条演示编译的程序完成90个episode中的40个，而同一骨干网络改用目标图像或语言条件、以及已发表的演示条件方法最多仅完成19个。在Meta-World的三个留出类别上超过已发表最佳结果（但五类均值未超过）。同一程序无需重训练即可在四种机械臂上运行；在被推动（扰动）后重解完成60个episode中的23个，而回放演示仅完成6个。在真实Franka机械臂上（已用其他任务的真实演示微调），由单段人类视频编译的程序完成40次试验中的36次，而同一骨干以视频末帧作为目标图像条件仅完成22次。

Conclusion: 通过将演示形式化为与本体无关的效果程序，并用多流flow-matching世界-动作模型解耦效果与执行，论文把策略推理转化为可编辑、可闭环重解的"编程"过程。该方法在仿真与真实平台上均显著优于图像/语言条件与回放基线，具备跨机械臂零重训练迁移、人类可编辑、以及从单段人类视频直接编译程序的能力，为可泛化、可交互的机器人学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: A robot demonstration records two things in the same frames: what happened to the objects, and how one particular arm made it happen. We condition on the first. A demonstration is compiled into an effect program: the 3D keypoint trajectories of the objects that moved, two points marking where each was held, and the configuration the scene ends in, with the demonstrator removed. PEWAM, a 71.5M-parameter world-action model, generates effect, robot execution, action and terminal state as four streams with independent flow-matching times, so clamping a program and sampling the execution turns inference into programming, re-solved closed loop from the live scene. On held-out LIBERO-Goal tasks, one demonstration's program completes 40 of 90 episodes, where the same backbone given a goal image or language, and published demonstration-conditioned methods, complete at most 19; on three of Meta-World's held-out classes it exceeds the best published results, though not on the five-class mean. Because a program is a set of coordinates, a person can edit it: the placement follows a shifted terminal state and the grasp turns with rotated contact points. The same program runs on four robot arms without retraining, and after a push, re-solving completes 23 of 60 episodes where replaying the demonstration completes 6. On a Franka arm, fine-tuned on real demonstrations of other tasks, programs compiled from single human videos complete 36 of 40 trials, against 22 for the same backbone conditioned on the video's last frame as a goal image.

</details>


### [525] [Autonomous mobile robot operations logistics: a dataset of jobs, dispatch events and robot states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02428)
*Jan-Felix Klein,Yongkuk Jeong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MoRoOp：九个八小时班次记录的AMR运行数据集，涵盖1382个作业、4815个操作、19352个调度事件与140386条机器人状态观测，面向AI智能体评估、扰动检测、操作预测、数据驱动仿真与事件日志分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主移动机器人（AMR）在生产物流中承担物料运输，其运行由作业生成、任务调度与机器人控制共同支配，但缺少融合作业、调度与机器人状态的多层级真实运行数据，难以支撑运行决策与扰动分析研究。

Method: 在实验室套件准备与供给场景中采集九个八小时班次数据，机器人在每班次执行随机生成的套件供给、空箱补充与充电作业；数据集关联作业规格、构成各作业的操作、记录操作状态转换与结果的调度事件，以及包含位置、朝向、速度、各轮荷电状态与诊断信息的机器人状态观测，同时提供原始与清洗后的机器人状态表及作业生成使用的套件规格。

Result: 数据集包含1382个作业、4815个操作、19352个调度事件和140386条机器人状态观测；在真实运行的实验室环境中记录，保留了延迟、导航受阻与操作失败等技术上有效的观测。

Conclusion: MoRoOp提供了多层级、贴近真实运行的AMR运行数据，可支持AI智能体在运行决策记录上的评估、扰动检测、操作预测、数据驱动仿真与事件日志分析等复用方向。

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) increasingly perform material transport in production logistics, where their operation is governed by job generation, dispatching and robot control. We present MoRoOp, a dataset of AMR operations recorded in a laboratory kit preparation and supply scenario over nine eight-hour shifts. During each shift, an AMR executed stochastically generated kit supply, empty-box refill and charging jobs. The dataset links job specifications, the operations constituting each job, dispatch events documenting operation state transitions and outcomes, and robot-state observations comprising position, orientation, velocity, per-wheel state of charge and diagnostics. It contains 1,382 jobs, 4,815 operations, 19,352 dispatch events and 140,386 robot-state observations together with the kit specifications used during job generation. The dataset was recorded in an operating laboratory environment, and technically valid observations of delays, obstructed navigation and unsuccessful operations were retained. Both raw and cleaned robot-state tables are provided. Documented reuse directions include the evaluation of AI agents on operational decision records, disturbance detection, operation prediction, data-driven simulation and event-log analysis.

</details>


### [526] [OpenRUA: Robot-Use Agents Are Zero-Shot Visuomotor Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02459)
*Zhaoyang Chu,Earl T. Barr,Claire Le Goues,Peter O'Hearn,Mark Harman,Federica Sarro,He Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出零抽象封装OpenRUA，让通用编码代理仅通过终端直接使用机器人原生ROS 2接口，在CaP-Bench上达99.0%、LIBERO-PRO上达87.0%成功率，无需专用原语或任务训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作为让编码代理控制机器人，往往需要设计复杂的定制化"套具"（harness），规定专门工作流并提供定制接口。作者质疑：这种额外的套具工程是否必要？

Method: 提出OpenRUA零抽象套具：跳过定制抽象层，仅向现成编码代理提供对机器人原生软件接口ROS 2的终端访问。采用极简"工作区即套具"设计，只提供ROS 2文档与基础工具，不编排任何代理工作流，由代理自行组织工作。将感知重构为文件I/O，将操作重构为编码。以Claude Code（Claude Opus 5驱动）作为代理。

Result: 在CaP-Bench上成功率99.0%，LIBERO-PRO上87.0%，表明现成编码代理可作为零样本视觉运动策略通过原生接口工作。涌现行为：(1)感知方面，96.80%的回合中代理自发编写程序处理原始传感输入并推导度量测量值；(2)操作方面，95.87%的回合自发构建运动控制客户端（如夹爪控制），50.13%的回合构建闭环控制程序（如基于传感器反馈调整运动）。

Conclusion: 现成编码代理无需专用原语或任务特定训练，即可通过机器人原生软件接口充当零样本视觉运动策略。极简设计下还涌现出自主构建感知与闭环控制程序的行为，说明复杂定制套具并非必要。

Abstract: Coding agents are extending their reach into the physical world by writing and executing robot control programs. One might expect the agents to use the existing mature software stack that engineers have developed over decades to access sensors and control motion. Yet prior work primarily engineers complex custom harnesses to orchestrate agents for robot use, particularly by prescribing specialized workflows and providing bespoke interfaces. This raises the question: "Is such additional harness engineering necessary?" We introduce OpenRUA, a zero-abstraction harness that bypasses bespoke abstraction layers by providing off-the-shelf coding agents with only terminal access to the robot's native software interface ROS 2. OpenRUA employs a minimalist workspace-as-harness design, only offering ROS 2 documentation and basic tools while leaving the coding agent to organize its own work without orchestrating any agentic workflow. Within this workspace, OpenRUA recasts perception as file I/O and manipulation as coding. With Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, OpenRUA achieves success rates of 99.0% on CaP-Bench and 87.0% on LIBERO-PRO, demonstrating that an off-the-shelf coding agent can serve as a zero-shot visuomotor policy through the robot's native interface, without bespoke primitives or task-specific training. Under this minimalist design, further analysis reveals striking emergent behaviors of coding agents: (1) For perception, the agent spontaneously writes programs that process raw sensory inputs and derive metric measurements in 96.80% of episodes. (2) For manipulation, the agent spontaneously builds motion-control clients (e.g., gripper control) in 95.87% of episodes and closed-loop control programs (e.g., adjusting motion based on sensor feedback) in 50.13% of episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA.

</details>


### [527] [RUL-Aware RRT*: Degradation-Balanced Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02469)
*Haibo Li,Zhiguo Zeng,Xu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，将关节剩余使用寿命信息融入规划过程，以缓解机械臂长期运行中的关节退化不均衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械臂长期运行会出现关节退化不均衡，最弱执行器过早失效，导致非计划停机和重大运营损失；传统运动规划不考虑关节健康状态，会加剧这种失衡。

Method: 提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，在规划中引入关节剩余使用寿命信息，并根据健康状态变化自适应调整各关节使用程度；在三种场景下评估：完全健康场景（FHS）、异质退化场景（HDS）和局部退化场景（LDS）。

Result: RUL-aware RRT*能有效抑制退化不均衡，延缓瓶颈故障出现，提高机械臂系统在长期运行中的可靠性。

Conclusion: 将健康反馈纳入运动规划，是提升持续磨损下机械臂耐久性与运行韧性的一种实用且稳健的途径。

Abstract: Robotic manipulators operating over long durations often experience uneven joint degradation, which causes the weakest actuator to fail prematurely, leads to unplanned downtime, and results in significant operational losses. Traditional motion-planning algorithms do not account for joint health conditions and therefore tend to exacerbate this imbalance during extended operation. To address this challenge, this study introduces the RUL-aware RRT*, a motion-planning method that incorporates joint remaining useful life information into the planning process and adaptively adjusts joint usage in response to evolving health conditions. The method is evaluated across three representative scenarios, namely the Full Health Scenario (FHS), the Heterogeneous Degradation Scenario (HDS), and the Local Degradation Scenario (LDS). The results show that the RUL-aware RRT* effectively suppresses degradation imbalance, delays the emergence of bottleneck failures, and improves the long-term reliability of the robotic system during extended operation. These findings demonstrate that integrating health feedback into motion planning provides a practical and robust pathway for enhancing the durability and operational resilience of manipulators subject to continuous wear.

</details>


### [528] [CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02527)
*Jiaxuan Luo,Xingguo Xu,Shanshan Wang,Yuhan Zhou,Zhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 学习型视觉奖励模型存在"错物失败"盲区：对其优化会同时放大任务成功与错物失败，且监控指标看起来健康；本文用抽屉任务实验、机理模型与冻结结果验证器揭示并缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型视觉奖励模型日益用于机器人策略优化，但它可能对"作用于错误物体"的执行给出与完成任务同样高的分数。若直接优化此类奖励，可能在不被常规监控指标察觉的情况下放大这些错物失败，因此需要系统刻画该失效模式、成因与缓解手段。

Method: 在抽屉任务上，对扩散策略的全部去噪器参数针对 Robometer 奖励进行微调（初始为无奖励暴露的监督策略）；设置五组训练运行、512 个评估种子，并与基于模拟器任务完成信号的同规模对照组比较。进一步检验该放大的复现条件（在策略原生扩散采样器下、与初始策略等距时、此前已对学习奖励优化过的策略上，以及两个批评者、两个优化器的受约束策略实验）。提出"倾斜模型"（tilt model）解释：KL 正则优化下，若某结果在初始策略下的期望奖励高于总体均值，其出现频率将上升；并用 26 组受约束设置验证预测的普适性。

Result: 五组 Robometer 优化运行使任务成功提升 10.2 个百分点，同时使错物失败上升 10.9 个百分点；而基于模拟器完成信号的五组运行仅提升成功、不放大错物失败（差异 9.2 个百分点，95% CI 5.6–13.0）。该放大在多种条件下复现。Robometer 总体区分成功与失败良好（AUROC .81），但对错物失败的评分略高于成功（AUROC .37），故优化同时抬升两者。倾斜模型在 26 组受约束设置中预测结果偏移的 Spearman 相关系数达 .89，包括任务成功率下降的设置；Robometer 公开的成功终止配方也继承了该错误。冻结的结果验证器可将同一优化重定向至所请求任务。

Conclusion: 仅靠奖励分数与任务成功率监控无法发现对学习型奖励优化所导致的错物失败放大；其根源在于奖励模型对"错物失败"的轻微偏好与 KL 正则优化的倾斜效应。使用冻结的结果验证器可纠正优化方向，为奖励模型的安全使用提供可行路径。

Abstract: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.

</details>


### [529] [Real-time Event-camera Stereo Visual Odometry via Keytime Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02601)
*Nikan Nobari,Jonathan D. Gammell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种连续时间事件相机双目视觉里程计流水线，利用WNOA先验将估计状态缩减至关键时间点，在保持事件异步性完整时间分辨率的同时实现实时运行，并在MVSEC与DSEC数据集上优于ES-PTAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率与高动态范围，对运动模糊和低光照更鲁棒。要最大化这些优势，VO流水线需以原生时间分辨率处理异步事件流。连续时间高斯过程回归与WNOA先验可处理异步测量，但直接应用会导致估计状态规模过大而难以实用。

Method: 提出连续时间事件相机双目VO流水线：以WNOA先验为基础，将估计状态缩减至关键时间点（keytimes），并通过插值将测量映射到其精确时间戳上，从而在保持完整时间分辨率与事件异步性的同时，将状态规模与密集测量数量解耦。

Result: 在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上评估：除一条序列外，所有测试序列中的估计精度均优于当前最先进的离散估计器ES-PTAM。在MVSEC与DSEC上分别达到22 Hz和6 Hz的实时估计，所有有效序列的RMS相对误差分别为0.46 cm和0.038度，较ES-PTAM分别提升11倍和15倍。

Conclusion: 结合WNOA先验的关键时间点连续时间建模能够在不牺牲事件异步性与时间分辨率的前提下实现实时、高精度的双目事件相机视觉里程计，显著优于离散式最先进方法。

Abstract: Event cameras have microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range which make them more resilient to motion blur and poor illumination than standard frame-based cameras. Event-camera visual odometry (VO) pipelines maximize these benefits when they process the asynchronous event stream at the native temporal resolution. Continuous-time Gaussian process (GP) regression and a white-noise-on-acceleration (WNOA) prior can handle asynchronous measurements but result in a prohibitively large estimation state when applied naively.
  This paper presents a continuous-time event-camera stereo VO pipeline that maintains the native measurement times of asynchronous events while also running in real time. It reduces the estimation states to keytimes while maintaining full temporal resolution by interpolating measurements to their exact timestamps with a physically founded WNOA prior. This decouples the state size from the dense number of measurements without discarding their asynchronous nature.
  The real-time continuous-time VO pipeline is evaluated on the MVSEC and DSEC datasets. It provides estimates in real time that are more accurate than ES-PTAM, a state-of-the-art discrete estimator, in all but one of the tested sequences. The pipeline respectively provides estimates at 22 Hz and 6 Hz on MVSEC and DSEC and RMS relative errors of 0.46 cm and 0.038 degrees across all valid sequences, which were 11 and 15 times better than ES-PTAM, respectively.

</details>


### [530] [A Passive AI System for Verifying Physical State on Automated Liquid Handlers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02668)
*Junqiong Joanne Qiu,Zeckria Kamrany,Ananya Anand,Emma Vidal,Yunjia Johanna Bai,Nathan S Chen,Sean Son,Varada Abhyankar,Taryn Jakub,Eleazar Eskin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Labware Setup Checker——一种不改动机器人硬件/固件的被动视觉系统，用外部摄像头与独立软件在数秒内校验Opentrons Flex的台面配置并与协议比对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化液体处理工作站虽可执行数字协议，但台面（deck）仍需人工装配并确认物理布局与实验意图一致，缺乏独立、非侵入式的校验手段。

Method: 外部消费级网络摄像头采集图像，浏览器应用将台面分割为槽位，依据已知台面几何校正槽位分配，分类耗材类型，并与参考协议库比对，报告缺失、错位或多余耗材；系统独立于机器人控制器，不中断也不阻断运行。

Result: 在SwabSeq RVP预PCR台面准备中，跟踪某槽位由空到底座再到完整板-底座组件，29帧机器人运动前图像全部识别成功；需精确匹配槽位的348次分类中95.1%与协议参考一致；480帧部分遮挡储液槽下6,720次槽位分配全部正确；三种相机位置与两种光照下槽位分配100%正确、分类一致率97.73%；笔记本纯CPU中位校验时间2.10 s，AWS部署下端到端4.24 s。

Conclusion: 外部摄像头加独立软件可在数秒内依据协议要求完成台面配置校验，使操作者在运行前复核物理设置，具备实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Automated liquid handlers execute digital protocols, but operators must assemble the deck and confirm that the physical setup matches the intended experiment. We present the Labware Setup Checker, a passive vision system that verifies deck preparation on an Opentrons Flex without modifying its hardware or firmware. A consumer webcam mounted outside the robot supplies images to a browser application. The checker segments the deck into slots, corrects slot assignments using the known deck geometry, classifies the labware, and compares the observed setup with a reference protocol library to report missing, misplaced, or unexpected labware. It operates independently of the robot controller and does not interrupt or gate a run. During SwabSeq Respiratory Viral Panel (RVP) pre-PCR deck preparation, the checker tracked a slot from empty to a base and then to the completed plate-and-base assembly, identifying the completed assembly in all 29 frames before robot motion. Across these frames, 95.1% of the 348 labware classifications for slots requiring exact matches agreed with the protocol reference. In 480 frames with partially occluded reservoirs, all 6,720 slot assignments were correct. Across three camera positions and two lighting conditions, slot assignment was 100% correct, and 97.73% of labware classifications matched the protocol reference. Median verification time was 2.10 s on a laptop using only its CPU and 4.24 s from frame capture to receipt of results during AWS deployment in the laboratory. These results show that an external camera and independent software can provide verification of deck setup against protocol requirements within seconds, allowing operators to review the physical setup before starting a run.

</details>


### [531] [DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02691)
*Boyuan Hou,Xiaoge Cao,Chaofan Zhang,Shuo Wang,Shaowei Cui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DeltaWorld交互式世界模拟器，通过预测动作引起的潜在特征变化（Delta-LTM）而非直接预测下一状态，并结合交互感知潜在对齐抑制物体穿透与过度变形，在跨机器人数据集上FVD降低46.6%、LPIPS降低31.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模拟器可减少对物理实验的依赖，为机器人规划、策略训练和评估提供可扩展环境。但现有世界模型通常直接预测整个下一潜在状态，难以捕捉机器人动作引起的细微变化，导致物体穿透、过度变形等物理不合理结果，且难以忠实响应动作、保持长时程机器人-物体交互动态。

Method: 提出DeltaWorld，包含两个核心组件：（1）Delta潜在转移模型（Delta-LTM），预测动作引起的潜在特征变化量，并将其加到当前潜在状态上得到下一状态，而非直接预测下一潜在状态；（2）交互感知潜在对齐（Interaction-aware Latent Alignment），构建反事实交互区域并对与交互相关的潜在变化进行监督，以缓解物体穿透与过度变形。

Result: 在IWS操作基准和自采集跨机器人数据集（涵盖多种机器人本体与操作任务）上评估。在跨机器人数据集上，相对IWS基线FVD降低46.6%，LPIPS降低31.1%。

Conclusion: DeltaWorld在机器人操作的长时程动作条件视频预测中展现出潜力，验证了增量式潜在转移与交互感知对齐在提升物理一致性方面的有效性。

Abstract: Interactive world simulators can provide scalable environments for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation by predicting action consequences while reducing reliance on repeated physical rollouts. To serve these applications, they must generate future image sequences that respond faithfully to robot actions and preserve the dynamics of robot-object interactions over long horizons. However, existing world models typically predict the entire next latent state and often fail to capture subtle changes induced by robot actions. Such omissions can produce physically implausible outcomes, including object interpenetration and excessive deformation. To address this limitation, we propose DeltaWorld, a physically consistent interactive world simulator for robotic manipulation. Our method introduces the Delta Latent Transition Model (Delta-LTM), which predicts action-induced latent feature changes and adds them to the current latent state to obtain the next state, rather than predicting the next latent state directly. To mitigate object interpenetration and excessive deformation in predicted future frames, Interaction-aware Latent Alignment is introduced to construct counterfactual interaction regions and supervise interaction-related latent changes. DeltaWorld is evaluated on the IWS manipulation benchmark and a self-collected cross-robot dataset covering multiple robot embodiments and manipulation tasks. On the cross-robot dataset, DeltaWorld reduces FVD by 46.6% and LPIPS by 31.1% relative to the IWS baseline. These results highlight the potential of DeltaWorld for long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction in robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [532] [Who Went Where When on the Lunar Surface: Forensic Trajectory Analysis to Identify Byzantine Rovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02694)
*Lachlan Holden,Feras Dayoub,Melissa de Zwart,David Harvey,Tat-Jun Chin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"非合作行星漫游车取证轨迹分析"问题：在多漫游车共享部署区域、仅有稀疏遥测（里程计、位姿先验、相对探测）的场景下，重建轨迹以核验安全约束；针对提供错误或伪造测量的拜占庭漫游车，提出以"漫游车可信度"而非"单个测量有效性"为核心的归因感知轨迹估计方法，在合成与真实行星类比数据上优于现有鲁棒位姿图优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来行星表面任务中多个独立运行的漫游车可能共享同一部署区域，需要事后核验其是否遵守月球安全区等运行约束。由于持续的原位观测通常不可得，只能依赖稀疏遥测数据进行轨迹重建。然而，若存在提供误标定或故意伪造测量以支持错误轨迹的拜占庭漫游车，标准鲁棒位姿图优化方法会失效——因为拜占庭测量可做到内部自洽且数量足够多，使真实且具指控性的测量反被判定为离群值。因此需要一种能识别拜占庭代理并仍能准确重建轨迹的方法。

Method: 提出归因感知的轨迹估计方法（attribution-aware trajectory estimation）：不判断单个测量是否有效，而是对漫游车可信度进行推理。方法枚举候选的可信漫游车子集，将其内部相对探测与边界相对探测的统计一致性与给定先验进行比较，据此评估各子集的可信度；随后仅使用归属于可信代理的测量来估计轨迹。同时指出标准离群鲁棒位姿图优化在该拜占庭设定下存在脆弱性。

Result: 在合成仿真与真实行星类比轨迹数据上，所提方法能够识别出拜占庭漫游车，并且相较现有鲁棒位姿图优化基线产生显著更准确的轨迹估计。

Conclusion: 面向非合作行星漫游车的取证轨迹分析需从"测量级鲁棒"转向"代理级归因"；通过评估漫游车可信度并仅采用可信代理的测量，可在存在拜占庭代理的稀疏遥测条件下实现更可靠的安全约束合规性核验。

Abstract: Future planetary surface missions are likely to involve multiple independently operated rovers sharing the same deployment region, raising the need to verify compliance with operational constraints such as Lunar Safety Zones. Because continuous in-situ observability is rarely available, such verification requires post-hoc reconstruction of rover trajectories from sparse telemetry, including odometry, pose priors, and relative inter-rover detections. We introduce the problem of forensic trajectory analysis for non-cooperative planetary rovers in the presence of Byzantine agents: rovers that provide miscalibrated or deliberately falsified measurements to support an incorrect trajectory. We show that standard outlier-robust pose graph optimisation methods are vulnerable in this setting, because Byzantine rovers can generate measurements that are internally consistent and numerous enough to make truthful incriminating measurements appear as outliers. To address this, we propose an attribution-aware trajectory estimation method that reasons over rover credibility rather than individual measurement validity. The method evaluates candidate credible rover subsets by comparing the statistical consistency of their internal and boundary relative detections against provided priors, and then estimates trajectories using only measurements attributed to credible agents. Across synthetic simulations and real planetary-analogue trajectory data, the proposed method identifies Byzantine rovers and produces significantly more accurate trajectory estimates than existing robust pose graph optimisation baselines.

</details>


### [533] [AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02706)
*Jiale Cao,Yike Niu,Zhengrong Xue,Huazhe Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AdaTempo：一种自监督方法，利用演示中的共享相对节奏结构来加速视觉运动策略，在保持成功率的同时实现最高3.57倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略往往继承了遥操作演示中不必要的缓慢节奏（slow timing）。然而，统一加速（uniform speedup）并不可靠，因为操作任务的不同阶段对加速的容忍度不同——有些阶段可以快，有些阶段加速后会失败。因此需要一种能按阶段自适应加速的方法。

Method: AdaTempo 采用自监督方式，核心在于利用多次演示中共享的"相对节奏（relative-tempo）"结构。其流程为：(1) 建立阶段对应关系（phase correspondence），将不同演示的对应阶段对齐；(2) 将对齐后的相对节奏聚合成一个共识（consensus）；(3) 将共识映射为连续的加速剖面（continuous speedup profile）；(4) 用该剖面重采样演示，生成加速后的训练轨迹。随后在重采样轨迹上训练标准策略（如 ACT、Diffusion Policy），使期望节奏直接嵌入学习到的行为中，无需运行时节奏选择或在线重定时（online retiming）。

Result: 大量评估显示，AdaTempo 可实现最高 3.57× 的加速，并且在成功率—速度权衡（success–speed trade-off）上优于原始策略和代表性加速基线方法。

Conclusion: AdaTempo 证明了通过挖掘演示数据本身的相对节奏结构，可以在不引入运行时开销的前提下，把所需节奏"烘焙"进策略中，从而克服统一加速的不可靠性，取得更优的加速效果与成功率平衡。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning often inherit the unnecessarily slow timing of teleoperated demonstrations. Yet uniform speedup is unreliable because different phases of a manipulation task tolerate acceleration differently. In this work, we introduce AdaTempo, a self-supervised method that accelerates visuomotor policies by exploiting shared relative-tempo structure in demonstrations. AdaTempo establishes phase correspondence, aggregates the aligned relative tempo into a consensus, and maps it to a continuous speedup profile used to resample demonstrations into accelerated training trajectories. Training standard policies such as ACT or Diffusion Policy on these resampled trajectories directly embeds the desired tempo in the learned behavior, without runtime tempo selection or online retiming. Extensive evaluations show that AdaTempo achieves up to a $3.57\times$ speedup and yields a stronger success--speed trade-off than the original policies and representative acceleration baselines.

</details>


### [534] [RoboChemGym: A Protocol-Driven Generative Simulation Framework for Long-Horizon Chemical Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02708)
*Chenxi Li,Haiyuan Wan,Rui Li,Jingyuan Li,Sha Zhang,Bohan Feng,Jianbao Cao,Zhangrui Zhao,Di Hu,Wangmeng Zuo,Shixiang Tang,Minting Pan,Dongzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboChemGym 框架，通过自改进任务合成机制自动生成符合真实实验规程的高保真化学实验操作演示，并构建分层基准评估具身智能体能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 湿实验是科学发现中假设验证的金标准，但劳动密集、成本高且具安全风险；具身智能体有望自动化这些流程，却受限于真实训练数据稀缺。现有仿真方法主要针对短时程、松结构任务，无法满足化学实验严格的流程约束与细粒度操作需求。

Method: 提出 RoboChemGym 框架，自主生成与真实实验规程对齐的高保真操作演示，核心是自改进任务合成机制，迭代优化任务执行与场景配置，从而为超过 10 步交互的复杂多物体流程可靠生成专家轨迹；同时设计分层基准，从原子操作到全周期实验流程系统评估性能。

Result: 能够为复杂多物体、交互步骤超过 10 步的实验流程可靠生成专家轨迹，并支持从原子操作到全周期实验流程的多粒度系统评估。

Conclusion: RoboChemGym 为化学任务中具身智能体的自动化数据合成与能力评估提供了可扩展范式，是迈向全智能实验室的关键一步。

Abstract: Wet-lab experimentation serves as the gold standard for hypothesis verification in scientific discovery; yet it is inherently labor-intensive, costly, and safety-critical. Embodied agents hold the promise of automating these tedious workflows, but their development is hindered by the scarcity of real-world training data. While simulation offers a scalable alternative for producing demonstrations, current methods primarily target relatively short-horizon tasks with loosely structured interactions, failing to meet the strict procedural constraints and fine-grained manipulation demands of chemical experiments. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{RoboChemGym}, a framework that autonomously generates high-fidelity manipulation demonstrations aligned with real-world experiment protocols, featuring a \textit{self-improving task synthesis} mechanism to iteratively refine task execution and scene configurations, enabling the reliable generation of expert trajectories for complex, multi-object protocols exceeding 10 interaction steps. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical benchmark that systematically assesses performance across varying granularities, spanning from atomic operations to full-cycle experimental workflows. RoboChemGym sets a scalable paradigm for the automated data synthesis and capability evaluation of embodied agents in intricate chemical tasks, serving as a critical stepping stone toward fully intelligent laboratories.

</details>


### [535] [RoboBridge: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent Framework for Sim-to-Real Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02717)
*Chenxi Li,Zhangrui Zhao,Rui Li,Yuan Gao,Kehui Liu,Jiarui Li,Dong Wang,Tong Si,Minting Pan,Wanli Ouyang,Dongzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboBridge将sim-to-real迁移视为可执行任务技能的持续适应过程，通过将任务知识表示为"过程"，结合VLA策略作为可复用工具，实现跨仿真与现实的持续程序化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能落地面临仿真到现实迁移的挑战。端到端VLA策略迁移依赖视觉/动力学校准、额外目标域示范与再训练；现有工具型智能体侧重单环境任务执行与经验复用，缺乏跨仿真-现实的程序性知识迁移与持续适应能力。

Method: 提出RoboBridge框架：将任务知识表示为连接任务意图、观测、工具操作与结果验证的过程（procedures）；利用交互反馈生成候选技能修订，经评估后持久化或拒绝；将预训练VLA策略封装为可复用动作工具，并辅以推理时引导实现细粒度执行而无需重训练；以共享任务语义与交互接口为桥梁，保持可复用任务结构，同时允许环境相关操作被选择性修订。

Result: 在LIBERO-PRO及对应物理任务上评估，研究了技能演化与迁移后适应两方面表现。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了从一次性策略部署到跨环境持续程序化学习的路径，为sim-to-real迁移与部署后持续适应提供了新范式。

Abstract: A key challenge in bringing embodied intelligence into the real world is transferring capabilities from simulation to reality and enabling agents to continually adapt after deployment. End-to-end vision-language-action policies provide strong manipulation capabilities, but their transfer to physical environments typically relies on calibrating simulated visual and dynamical conditions, collecting additional target-domain demonstrations, and optimizing the policy through further training. Tool-using embodied agents offer flexible task orchestration, yet existing systems primarily emphasize task execution and experience reuse within a given environment, with limited support for transferring procedural knowledge and continuously adapting it across simulation and reality. We propose RoboBridge, a framework that treats sim-to-real transfer as the continued adaptation of executable task skills. The agent represents task knowledge as procedures connecting task intent, observations, tool operations, and outcome verification. Interaction feedback is used to generate candidate skill revisions, which are evaluated before being persisted or rejected. A pretrained vision-language-action policy is exposed as a reusable action tool and enhanced with inference-time guidance, enabling fine-grained execution without retraining the underlying policy. RoboBridge grounds transferable skills in task semantics and interaction interfaces shared across simulation and reality. This representation preserves reusable task structure while allowing environment-dependent operations to be selectively revised through real-world execution feedback. We evaluate the framework on LIBERO-PRO and corresponding physical tasks, studying both skill evolution and post-transfer adaptation. Our framework provides a route from one-shot policy deployment to continual procedural learning across environments.

</details>


### [536] [Around the World: Unified Learned Locomotion on a 270 g Continuous-Rotation Quadruped](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02728)
*Arturo Flores Alvarez,Nathan Lintu,Dennis Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MiNI-Q（270g四足机器人）利用连续旋转腿部实现身体两侧支撑，仅用单一姿态条件化强化学习策略在机载运行，统一实现直立行走、倒立行走和落地恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环学习式运动控制在商用四足机器人上已成熟，但在亚千克（sub-kilogram）尺度仍不常见；同时连续旋转腿部赋予小型机器人跨越身体两侧的支撑构型，这一运动范围尚未被充分利用。

Method: 在环面 T^8 上定义连续关节空间参考及其重力条件化变换，避免使用状态机或相位切换；采用姿态与释放协同课程学习训练行为族；并进行执行器辨识、跨引擎验证与嵌入式部署。策略为参数量低于 100k 的单一网络，姿态条件化，完全在机载运行。

Result: 同一网络直立行走跟踪前向速度 RMSE 为 0.037 m/s，倒立为 0.050 m/s；30 次释放试验中 24 次恢复行走；可在四种室内地面上使用四种可互换足部几何。硬件实验与仿真消融揭示了这些能力与表示、条件化及训练选择之间的关系。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过姿态条件化的统一表征与协同课程学习，可将连续旋转腿部的运动范围转化为直立/倒立行走及恢复等行为族，并在亚千克级机器人上实现可靠的机载部署与硬件迁移。

Abstract: Closed-loop learned locomotion is established on commercial quadrupeds but remains uncommon at the sub-kilogram scale. Continuous-rotation legs give MiNI-Q, a 270 g quadruped, access to supporting configurations on either side of the body. We exploit this range with a single posture-conditioned reinforcement-learning policy that runs entirely onboard. A continuous joint-space reference on the torus $T^8$ and its gravity-conditioned transformation connect upright walking, inverted walking, and landing recovery without state machines or phase switching. Coordinated posture and release curricula train this behavior family; identified actuation, cross-engine validation, and embedded execution support hardware transfer. The same sub-100k-parameter network tracks forward velocity with RMSE of 0.037 m/s upright and 0.050 m/s inverted, resumes walking in 24 of 30 release trials, and operates with four interchangeable foot geometries across four indoor surfaces. Hardware experiments and simulation ablations connect these capabilities to the representation, conditioning, and training choices that exploit the platform's motion range. Demonstration videos and supplementary material are available on the project website: https://submissionreview.github.io/around-the-world/.

</details>


### [537] [CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02750)
*Tyler Chung,Nahl Farhan,Hao Zhang,Mingfeng Yuan,Jinjun Shan,Amy Wu,Yue Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Person Goal Navigation (PersonNav) 问题，即机器人在信息可及性受限与语言不确定条件下搜寻目标人物。作者提出融合距离与语义信息（习惯与意图）、以用户信息可信度加权的规划框架，并构建合成基准，实验表明其优于纯距离图基线，硬件测试验证了现实具身可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有寻人系统多依赖对目标个体的精确已知信息，适用于室内物品递送等固定场景；而基于学习的方法受限于人类隐私导致的公开数据稀缺或不可用。因此需要在更现实的信息受限与语言不确定条件下实现智能寻人导航。

Method: 提出一个规划框架，同时利用距离信息与关于受助者的语义信息（习惯与意图），并按用户提供信息的可信度进行加权；构建包含角色、物品与请求的合成基准场景，以模拟自然语言人机交互并在真机部署前评估性能；并实现基于大模型的变体，其显式信念表示支持后续贝叶斯滤波。

Result: 有信息的搜索优于经典基于距离的图基线；仅使用语义信息会导致缺乏依据、零散片段的搜索；本方法相对基线取得显著提升，基于大模型的变体表现相当；硬件测试表明方法支持现实具身，能在真实场景中权衡语义与距离信息。

Conclusion: 该工作向更智能的移动服务智能体迈进一步，使其能在真实环境中进行类人的、知情式搜索，适用于日常使用，并可通过显式信念表示为贝叶斯滤波等后续扩展提供支持。

Abstract: We address the Person Goal Navigation (PersonNav) problem, enabling robots to search for people under realistic constraints on information accessibility and language uncertainty. This tackles the current solutions revolving around rigid person finding systems requiring exact knowledge of the individual for item-delivery in indoor settings. While the focus in literature is on learned methods using unavailable public or sparse data due to human privacy. We propose a planning framework that combines distance and semantic information about the recipient (habits and intent) weighted by the trust of the user-provided information. A synthetic benchmark of scenarios is also developed including actors, items, and requests to evaluate performance before real-world deployment aiming to simulate natural language human-robot interactions. Results show our informed search outperforms classical distance-based graph baselines, while semantics alone lead to ungrounded, sporadic search. Our method achieves strong gains over baselines, with an LLM-based variant performing comparably, and its explicit belief representation naturally supports future Bayesian filtering. Hardware tests demonstrate our method supports real-world embodiment able to leverage between semantic and distance information in a real setting. This work moves toward more intelligent mobile service agents capable of human-like, informed search in realistic environments to be leveraged in day-to-day use. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/personnavsite-4ED2/index.html.

</details>


### [538] [Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02759)
*Fangyuan Wang,Songhao Huang,Haoxiang Sun,Shipeng Lyu,Chengyang He,Anqing Duan,Peng Zhou,David Navarro-Alarcon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出本体感知动作模型（PAM），在单一transformer去噪器中联合生成机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑无时间草图与密集可执行动作块，提升长时域操作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式机器人策略仅预测短动作块，缺乏显式长时域意图。现有方法通过语言计划、子目标图像或视频预测暴露长时域结构，但生成成本高且需转化为机器人动作。而直接预测未来动作虽免去转化，但密集时间索引轨迹参数需求大、短时域下又近乎重复动作块，指导价值有限。

Method: PAM在单一transformer去噪器中联合生成两部分：1）机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑、无时间草图，以弧长而非时间参数化，捕捉对执行时序不变的几何意图；2）密集可执行动作块。采用块因果注意力与交错去噪调度，保持有向的草图到动作依赖，使动作token在整个采样过程中条件于逐步更清晰的草图。

Result: 仿真中，PAM在Push-T和LIBERO-Long上优于仅动作的对应基线；在四个真实双臂任务上，成功率从47.5%提升至75.0%。

Conclusion: 通过联合生成无时间几何草图与密集动作块，PAM为生成式机器人策略提供了显式长时域意图，且无需额外转化成本，在仿真与真实双臂任务上均取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot's remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/

</details>


### [539] [Localized Conformal Safety Monitoring with Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02765)
*Luís Marques,Rong Fang,Disha Kamale,Dmitry Berenson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SLLCP——一种在冻结VLM之上的事后校准层，将VLM不可靠的预测转化为概率校准的安全预测集，在CARLA轨迹上显著提升碰撞轨迹识别率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监测规划驾驶轨迹需准确估计碰撞可能性，但现有经典方法受限于预测模型质量；VLM虽能推理高层动作后果，但其近似预测不适合自动驾驶等安全关键应用，因此需要对黑箱VLM预测进行不确定性量化。
